programme.title: South Africa / France
programme.desc: It's time for the grand finale for the French team, which is facing South Africa tonight in Twickenham for the title of the first edition of the World Championship. Fabien Galthie's men finished first in the North after a tougher course, marked by a single (short) defeat in New Zealand (34-32) when they entered the competition. For the South Africans, this will be a revenge after the defeat at the Stade de France (21-19) on November 13, as the Springboks retained their first place in the Northern hen despite another defeat in Ireland (20-17) on November 21. In the face of the power of the defending world champions, Antoine Dupont and his team-mates are eager to make their sense of the game speak, to win a starring title, one year before the next World Cup in Australia.

programme.title: Oppenheimer
programme.desc: A recognized physicist is being engaged by the United States to complete a scientific project aimed at revolutionizing world history.
programme.desc-more: In 1953, at the heart of a period of political paranoia known as the "witch hunt", Robert Oppenheimer (Cillian Murphy), the father of the atomic bomb, met with a secret commission. Accused of his political commitments on the left and of his relations with members of the Communist Party, he must defend his scientific and personal heritage. As he prepares to read a statement to clarify his position, Oppenheimer re-exists in his memories, evoking his intellectual youth marked by his studies in the United Kingdom. He also recalled his central role in the "Manhattan Project", a crucial initiative of the Second World War to create a nuclear weapon for the United States. Between moral dilemmas and internal struggles, Oppenheimer must navigate a world where his scientific genius is both admired and feared, while confronting the devastating consequences of his choices.

programme.title: Tenet
programme.desc: With other agents and his partner, a spy must prevent the Third World War. He uses a code that allows him to travel in time.
programme.desc-more: In a world where time itself can be manipulated, Tenet plunges us into the heart of a complex and thrilling intrigue. In Kiev, Ukraine, an American agent (John David Washington) finds himself in the middle of an ultra-secure operation during a concert, stormed by an armed commando. While captured, he makes the fateful decision to absorb a poison capsule, preferring to give himself death rather than betray his colleagues and reveal compromising information. When he woke up, he discovered that he had been rescued from a deep coma and that he had been recruited by a mysterious organization that only appealed to elite agents. The protagonist, now embedded in this new life, learns that he is engaged in a secret mission of unimaginable magnitude, which involves unconventional principles of time, which is called "inversion". These temporal movements defy logic and will upset everything we know about causality. He is entrusted with a crucial mission: to prevent a global catastrophe orchestrated by a mysterious antagonist, who has access to technology capable of rewriting the past. Along with Neil (Robert Pattinson), his enigmatic partner, he embarks on a journey through a world where the future and the past intertwine. Their quest leads them through several countries and dangerous situations, from face-to-face with Russian agents to the mangers of a trade magnate (Kenneth Branagh) whose intentions remain obscure.

programme.title: The Countess of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: Once arrived in Constantinople, Mercedès sought Haydee, a young captive whom she believed to be her daughter. To free her, she'll have to risk everything.
programme.desc-more: Marseille, 1815. Mercedès Herrera (Audrey Fleurot) is ready for anything for the man she loves, Edmond Dantes (Waël Sersoub), a sailor promised to a bright future. But their happiness is cruelly broken by ruthless betrayal. Edmond, wrongly accused, is torn from Mercedes and thrown into the depths of the Château d'If, without hope of returning. Devasted but determined, Mercedes is embarking on a wild race to save him, but Edmond is killed in their escape attempt and she herself is locked up, condemned to languishing in a cell close to the one that sheltered the love of her life. In this abyss of pain, everything seems lost. Mercedès now has only one goal, taking revenge on those who destroyed his life: Fernand (Thierry Godard), his own cousin, secretly in love with her; Danglars (Éric Elmosnino), an ambitious manipulator; and especially Héloïse de Villefort (Zabou Breitman), the implacable woman of the city's prosecutor.

Devasted but determined, Mercedes is embarking on a wild race to save him, but Edmond is killed in their escape attempt and she herself is locked up, condemned to languishing in a cell close to the one that sheltered the love of her life. In this abyss of pain, everything seems lost. Mercedès now has only one goal, taking revenge on those who destroyed his life: Fernand (Thierry Godard), his own cousin, secretly in love with her; Danglars (Éric Elmosnino), an ambitious manipulator; and especially Héloïse de Villefort (Zabou Breitman), the implacable woman of the city's prosecutor.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: After Benson and Carisi's investigations, a crime boss is in court. Fin tries to help a woman who's been drugged.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: The team is investigating a charge of rape in Iraq, involving a security company employee working for the US government.
programme.desc-more: After the departure of her partner, Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) has to navigate through a new chapter of her career in the New York Special Unit. With the arrival of Nick Amaro (Danny Pino), an inspector with a tumultuous past, she faces unprecedented challenges, including the trauma of a recent shooting that affects her emotional balance. At the same time, Olivia is entering into a complex relationship with David Haden, an ambitious prosecutor, who brings an additional dynamic to his already busy daily life. Unity also faces delicate cases, often inspired by real facts, including the Strauss-Kahn case, which shakes the foundations of justice. With the introduction of Amanda Rollins (Kelli Giddish), a resourceful inspector, the team must juggle personal tensions with professional issues, while fighting to protect victims and unravel increasingly thorny cases.

programme.title: Criminal spirits
programme.desc: Jennifer Jareau accepts a position at the Department of Defence. The team must find a new balance without it. She needs it. An angry man who only kills obese women and takes a piece of his foot from the routine murderer who, once a year, cuts his victims like fish before he throws them out to the sea, he has to face the inexhaustible human inventivity in terms of cruelty. But the worst could be coming for Prentiss, who again faces his old enemy, Ian Doyle. A season marked by the departures, contested by the fans, of Prentiss and Jareau.
programme.desc-more: At the FBI headquarters in Quantico, Virginia, Agent Aaron Hotchner (Thomas Gibson) is head of the Behavioural Sciences Department, an essential unit dedicated to the analysis of criminal behaviour. This elite group, composed of experienced profilers, is called upon to intervene in homicide cases across the country, in order to understand the motivations of criminals and anticipate their future movements. The team, which is distinguished by its solidarity and efficiency, includes a variety of members with complementary skills. Derek Morgan (Shemar Moore), the impressive physics agent, does not hesitate to use his strength in perilous situations, while Penelope Garcia (Kirsten Vangsness), the computer specialist, shows unparalleled ingenuity to find critical clues. Emily Prentiss (Paget Brewster), who succeeds Hotchner, brings new momentum to the team with his determination and expertise. Together, they confront Machiavellic criminals while navigating the complexities of their own personal lives. Each investigation plunges the team into moral dilemmas and psychological challenges, constantly testing their limits and commitment.

programme.desc: In the heart of the picturesque coastal town of Sète, a complex picture of the daily life of its inhabitants is revealed. It all starts with an accident between two boats on the coasts of the city, where two people die, and the appearance of an amnesia woman. Soon, members of the Delcourt, Vallorta and Moreno families found themselves involved in a web of family mysteries and dramas. Doctors, police officers, lawyers and ordinary citizens find themselves trained in a series of extraordinary events, facing challenges both personal and professional.

programme.title: The Countess of Monte Cristo
programme.desc: Marseille, 1815. Mercedès Herrera (Audrey Fleurot) is ready for anything for the man she loves, Edmond Dantes (Waël Sersoub), a sailor promised to a bright future. But their happiness is cruelly broken by ruthless betrayal. Edmond, wrongly accused, is torn from Mercedes and thrown into the depths of the Château d'If, without hope of returning. Devasted but determined, Mercedes is embarking on a wild race to save him, but Edmond is killed in their escape attempt and she herself is locked up, condemned to languishing in a cell close to the one that sheltered the love of her life. In this abyss of pain, everything seems lost. Mercedès now has only one goal, taking revenge on those who destroyed his life: Fernand (Thierry Godard), his own cousin, secretly in love with her; Danglars (Éric Elmosnino), an ambitious manipulator; and especially Héloïse de Villefort (Zabou Breitman), the implacable woman of the city's prosecutor.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.sub-title: From the shadow to the light
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 26 of the series New York Special Uniting With Mariska Hargitay, Ice-T, Peter Scanavino
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.sub-title: In the shadow of the father
programme.desc: After the departure of her partner, Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) has to navigate through a new chapter of her career in the New York Special Unit. Unity also faces delicate cases, often inspired by real facts, including the Strauss-Kahn case, which shakes the foundations of justice. With the introduction of Amanda Rollins (Kelli Giddish), a resourceful inspector, the team must juggle personal tensions with professional issues, while fighting to protect victims and unravel increasingly thorny cases.

Among them, Maxime Delcourt, a young man more determined than ever to want to show his abilities to the teachers of the establishment, including the merciless Emmanuel Teyssier, a famous pastry chef. The competition is expected to be tough among all students, especially since some apprentices are ready to make every effort to get to their ends.

programme.title: Love Currently
programme.desc: Among these lives that cross, David (Hugh Grant), the newly-created British Prime Minister, discovers that love only makes protocols and appearances when he surprises himself to fall under the charm of Natalie (Martine McCutcheon), a young and clumsy downing street collaborator. Jamie (Colin Firth), a writer in the midst of an existential crisis after being betrayed by his companion, fled all to take refuge in a house isolated in France. It is there, on the edge of a peaceful lake, that he meets Aurelia (Lúcia Moniz), a mysterious Portuguese maid who does not speak a word of English, but whose gaze seems to pierce his soul. Meanwhile, in London, Mark (Andrew Lincoln), a silent witness of his best friend Peter (Chiwetel Ejiofor)'s marriage to Juliet (Keira Knightley), hides a secret that consumes him: he is sorely in love with the bride. Around them, other stories are emerging, just as poignant or full of hope. A widower, Sam (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), tries to overcome his grief by helping his young son-in-law seduce a classmate, while Sarah (Laura Linney), who is delighted by his colleague Karl (Rodrigo Santoro), sees his shyness and family responsibilities threatening his happiness. Between whooping, clumsy statements, betrayals and heroic gestures, everyone will have to face their fears, doubts and desires for perhaps, finally, to find love... or lose it forever.

programme.title: My stepfather, my parents and I
programme.desc: Greg Furniker, who is about to marry the delicious Pam, is due to present his family to his future stepparents, Jack, a former CIA agent, and Dina, his shy wife. Greg's mother, Roz, is a sexologist for the elderly and her husband Bernie, a man in the home, is a merry-looking man. Greg is therefore quite stressed out that his parents meet Pam's. The latter are invited by Roz and Bernie to spend a weekend at their Florida property. Soon, the irascible Jack is surprised by the couple's very free lifestyle.

programme.title: We Europeans
programme.desc: Through reports and chronicles, this magazine proposes to talk about Europe, but especially about the people who do it, and all the positive and inspiring initiatives that flourish on the continent. Faced with the challenges that the 500 million Europeans face, the show shows what solutions our neighbours have invented to respond to them, and how we could draw on them. Each issue is thematized around a European country with a fifteen-minute report on an inspiring initiative, a guest on stage to see if the model presented is applicable to France and a column on news.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: Marleau's investigating an attempted murder. The victim, a former policeman who became a hotelier, was silent not to endanger her loved ones.
programme.desc-more: Captain Marleau (Corinne Masiero), an inspector with a sharp intuition, finds herself immersed in a series of investigations as delicate as they are confusing. When an ex-policeman is the subject of an attempted murder, Marleau tries to convince her to testify. However, the victim, haunted by fear for the safety of his loved ones, remains silent. While this case seems to be resolved, Marleau is quickly confronted with another mystery: a man on the run, accused of killing his own son. Not believing in his guilt, Marleau decided to temporarily hide him, endangering his own career. His determination led him to collaborate with an English detective, while a British journalist was kidnapped. Through these surveys, Marleau navigates a world of colourful characters, with remarkable appearances of guests like David Suchet and Yolande Moreau, enriching a captivating intrigue.

While Jackie is dedicated to her studies and dreams of a promising future, Clotaire prefers to mix with a group of young people with questionable intentions. Their passionate but tumultuous relationship takes a tragic turn when Clotaire is imprisoned for a crime he did not commit, causing their love to implode. Ten years later, the reunion between Cloutaire and Jackie, now married to a wealthy entrepreneur, is becoming complex. Claire, determined to regain her heart, will have to navigate through the tensions of their common past and the realities of their respective lives, while Jackie struggles between her duty as a married woman and the feelings that reborn on the surface.

programme.title: Case concluded, everyone has something to sell
Case concluded, everyone has something to sell
Black as snow : Off limit
programme.desc: A murder occurs in the mountains. Captain Meyer investigates when his youthful love becomes the suspect. He's got to solve the case to get him innocent.
programme.desc-more: The ski resort, usually synonymous with relaxation and leisure, becomes the scene of a chilling drama: Thierry Fortin, an influential cadre of a multinational agri-food company, is found dead after a fatal fall from a chairlift. Appearances suggest an accident, but the troubled circumstances of its disappearance quickly arouse suspicion. Swiss captain Andreas Meyer (Laurent Gerra), on a visit to meet his daughter Violette (Margaux Ribagnac-Vin), a waitress in the station, finds himself trained in the investigation when he discovers that Franzisca (Caterina Murino), his former love and manager of the hotel where the victim was staying, is designated as the main suspect. Determined to prove his innocence while piercing the shadows of this case, Meyer joins with Warrant Officer Constance Vivier (Clémentine Poidatz), a seasoned specialist in the High Mountain Gendarmerie Peloton (PGHM), whose expertise in hostile environments is proving valuable. As the leads multiply, the investigation reveals a complex network of professional tensions, personal rivalries and carefully maintained lies. Who had better have the disappearance of Thierry Fortin? Between the station's employees with equivocal behaviors, the victim's associates with disturbing motivations, and Franzisca's buried secrets, each clue seems to lead to a truth darker than it seems. Extreme mountain conditions, where storms can erase any trace in an instant, add extra pressure to a race against the clock.

programme.title: Black as snow: Deaths at the top
programme.desc: A vehicle is found in Switzerland, near the French border, with a corpse on board. A Swiss police officer and a French gendarme are working together.
programme.desc-more: When a vehicle involved in the spectacular robbery of a Geneva jewellery store is found at the foot of an abrupt cliff, in the French mountains, the authorities discover with stupor a corpse on board. The evidence suggests that the three fugitive criminals have taken the direction of the tops, transforming this hostile area into ruthless hunting grounds. L'adjudante Constance Vivier, a seasoned member of the PNHM, is forced to return to a turbulent professional past by teaming up with Swiss police captain Andreas Meyer. Their collaboration, already put to the test by persistent tensions, must this time face a race against the clock to track down fugitives before they disappear permanently in the vast mountains. Their only lead is an environment as dangerous as the men they pursue. To clarify this case, Constance can rely on the expertise of Daniele Pietro, a renowned mountain climber and successful writer, whose intimate knowledge of the places proves valuable. But as the team progresses in extreme conditions, a new corpse is discovered, buried in an ice crack.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: Captain Marleau arrives at Saint-Tropez to find the grandson of a wealthy man. Besides, the corpse of a paparazzo is running down a beach.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of "Captain Marleau", broadcast in 2020, the famous investigator with flamboyant personality returns with her inimitable style that mixes acerbic humour and sharp intuition. Marleau, interpreted by actress Corinne Masiero, is distinguished by his exaggerated manners and his frankness, but it is above all his sense of the extraordinary deduction that imposes him as one of the most feared detectives. As the episodes progress, we witness the resolution of mysterious murders and complex cases, each investigation being cleverly built around a suspect individual, whom Marleau skilfully hunts. She does not hesitate to interfere with the lives of those she suspects, observing their actions, behaviors and interactions in order to discover the mysteries surrounding them. His ability to decode unsaid and to untrace lies makes him an investigative specialist, capable of reversing the most tense situations. In this season, Marleau is confronted with a variety of things, ranging from a mystery surrounding a disputed legacy to a series of disappearances in a small village. Each plot is interspersed with interactions with colorful characters that enrich the painting, mixing comedy with drama. The tension is palpable in his entourage, where confidence can easily squabble under the sharp eye of the captain.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: "Brouillard en thalasso"A rich industrialist is found dead in a luxury hotel. A homeless person who is an ideal suspect is arrested. Marleau questions and continues the investigation.
programme.desc-more: A non-standard element of the national gendarmerie, Captain Marleau (Corinne Masiero) is distinguished by his frankness and his pronounced ch'ti accent. With her disconcerting style, with an unlikely chapka, she follows the crime scenes with a filiform silhouette and a phlegm of her own. However, his unconventional approach hides a formidable tenacity and a sharp flair to dislodge the most twisted culprits. Each episode plunges us into well-taught intrigues, taking place in picturesque scenery from the French regions, where it crosses a gallery of colourful characters, often embodied by prestigious guest stars. His sarcastic humour and sharp eyes allow him to interrogate witnesses and unravel the sons of complex stories, gradually revealing hidden truths. As the investigations progressed, Captain Marleau proved that behind his staggered appearance, there was a staggering determination to do justice.

programme.title: Reporting
programme.desc: A woman, convinced that her niece, her sister's daughter, was being abused by her parents, struggled against the indifference of Social Aid to Children and Justice.
programme.desc-more: 2006. Laurence, a mother of her family, is fighting to save her 9-year-old niece, Karine, from the abuse of her parents, Stéphane and Véronique. Despite repeated reports from her aunt to the officials of ESA and Justice, the girl remains, against all logic, in her parents. After writing a letter to the prosecution to save Karine, Laurence is prosecuted for slanderous denunciation by Stéphane and Véronique. Five years later, she fought again to get Karine's custody when she learned that she had been sexually abused.

programme.title: Investigative Supplement
programme.desc: How can we reduce the dizzying amount of France's debt? EUR 3 500 billion, or 119% of GDP. By 2027, the payment of interest on the debt - over €90 billion - will become the first item of government expenditure. What can we do to fill this abyssal hole? The journalists of "Inquisitorial Complement" go back to the political decisions that led to this unprecedented explosion of our debt. More than 1,300 billion euros in addition to that under Emmanuel Macron's presidency. At the last quinquennium, in 2024, the deficit fell sharply. Was there a state lie as some say? Would the executive have attempted to hide the seriousness of the situation? Exclusive documents and testimonies, notably that of former Minister of Economy Bruno Le Maire, shed light on the situation.

programme.title: TV without filter, 30 years of impertinence
programme.desc: A journey behind the scenes and the story of a delicate art: that of impertinence on television, or the art of overcoming limits without breaking the link.
programme.desc-more: Unpredictable, sometimes embarrassing, sometimes hilarious, but always revealing: impertinence arises where television, by its very nature, seeks to master everything. Yet television is never as alive as it is when it agrees to be a little shook. Through carefully chosen archives and testimonies, this documentary traces the evolution of this freedom of expression that crosses the history of the small screen, and questions the implicit rules of the set. Between freedom and constraints, challenges of images and editorial imperatives, television has a complex relationship with this insolence that it fears, but which it also knows how to use to create cult sequences.

programme.title: French humor
programme.desc: A retrospective of the sketches of French humorists who mock Hexagon, its culture, its history, its habits, its regions, its inhabitants.
programme.desc-more: France, humorists have it in the sights as well as in the heart. Who likes to chastise well. Beyond self-deteriority, it is certainly out of love that the humorists tease Hexagon, its culture, its regions, and its inhabitants. There is even a tradition of artists from popular circles who, because they are attached to their regions, know better than anyone to mock France and the French. From Dany Boon to the Unknown, from Gad Elmaleh to Elodie Poux, their humour is a magnifying magnifying magnifying glass that refers us to those we are by pushing more or less the line. So, what does the French really look like?

programme.title: Verdun: 300 days, 300 nights
programme.desc: 1916. For 300 days and 300 nights, more than a million French converge in Verdun, a strategic bulwark to fight German troops.
programme.desc-more: 1916. For 300 days and 300 nights, more than one million French from all regions of France and colonies converge in Verdun, a strategic bulwark to fight German troops occupying part of the country. For the first time, in the same momentum, France of the "small countries" is fighting to save the entire nation. Verdun is much more than a military battle, it is both a place and a founding moment inscribed in the memory of all families, where a new feeling was born, that of belonging to the Republic. Rare and unpublished testimonies of soldiers and civilians from the rear revive this battle.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole Latile, a schoolboy dissipated but resourceful, spends all his energy getting into trouble.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: A Belgian inspector and a French police officer investigate in Tournai, in the middle of the boatmen, after the discovery of a tattooed arm of a bee, under the Pont des Trous.
programme.desc-more: The peaceful waters of the Scheldt deliver a sinister message under the bridge of the Trous in Tournai: a cut arm wearing the tattoo of a bee, royal emblem inherited from Childeric I. Belgian inspector Mathilde takes over the case with the support of Vincent, a French police officer specially mandated. Both investigators gradually trace the trail of this enigmatic symbol deeply rooted in the history of the city. Their investigations plunge them into the particular atmosphere of the river's shores and lead them into the very closed world of the batelière community.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.sub-title: Murders at the Pointe du Raz
programme.desc: The body of an old woman is found stranded on the beach, at the foot of the Pointe du Raz. The affair revives an old Breton legend still alive in the region.
programme.desc-more: In this eighth season of "Mouttres à...", viewers are invited to dive into the heart of French regions, each offering its own picturesque setting and unique traditions. Each episode reveals a captivating police investigation, where murders are inextricably linked to local legends, ancestral customs or elements of historical heritage. Investigators must navigate through centuries-old stories and buried mysteries to detect the truth. This season highlights emblematic destinations such as the Cathar Country, with its medieval castles, and the city of Toulouse, rich in culture and history. Other places such as Cayenne, Cognac, Granville, Albi and Pont-l'Évêque also bring their own intriguing atmosphere, enriching each survey with a cultural depth. The characters, whether they are investigators or witnesses, find themselves immersed in stories where the past and present intertwine, offering a spectacle that is both entertaining and immersive.

programme.title: Cut-to-pan
programme.desc: A young woman continues to live in memory of her love for a young man who abandoned her while ignoring that he has found his death.
programme.desc-more: Jeanne Delaître is in love with Jean Doit. One day, the young man joined his companion, during a break at his place of work. Jeanne complains that she does not see Jean enough, of which she is very in love. But John seems to want to distance himself. In fact, three months later, he left her and disappeared. Jeanne then entrusted her to his best friend, Pierre. She remembers her relationship with Jean, the moments they spent together. She remembers how John evoked his difficult childhood and then his turbulent youth, who eventually led him to prison.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: The discreet wife of an illustrious lawyer is shocked by her existence after the discovery of buried secrets that threaten to burst into the open.
programme.desc-more: François Schaar (Daniel Auteuil), a renowned lawyer, finds himself at the heart of a media storm while defending the families of two young girls who have suffered from a notorious child crime. As the trial grows, Francis' personal life begins to crack under the weight of the accusations that emerge. His wife, Astrid (Emmanuele Devos), was forced to face the doubts of their adult daughter, Carole, who asked him to reflect on François' past actions, questioning the integrity of their family. Meanwhile, Raphael, their teenage son, adopts an increasingly erratic behavior, exacerbating tension in the home. As external pressure intensified, François had to navigate between his professional responsibilities and the growing troubles of his family life, while seeking to protect those he loved from the devastating consequences of his engagement in this mediated affair.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole Latile, a schoolboy dissipated but resourceful, spends all his energy getting into trouble.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the Marcus Level series, Marcus finds himself immersed in his favorite video game, an adventure that pushes him to navigate through increasingly complex and perilous levels. As he strives to defeat formidable enemies and solve clever puzzles, he discovers that the real star of the game, an iconic character loved by fans, has mysteriously emerged in the real world. This revelation upsets the balance between the two universes, and Marcus must not only overcome the challenges of the game, but also understand the implications of this unexpected intrusion. On the way, he meets unexpected allies and formidable opponents, each with their own motivations. His quest to return home then becomes a thrilling adventure, mixing action, humour and mystery, while exploring the themes of friendship and courage in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: Tandem
programme.desc: Julius Suton, historian specializing in the life of Nostradamus, is found dead at the foot of the Pine Tower with a mysterious vellum in his hand.
programme.desc-more: At the foot of the pine tower in Montpellier, an inanimate man wakes up, near a handwritten paper. Quickly, it collapses again, this time stiff dead. Meanwhile, the commander Léa Soler confides to her mother that she is afraid to meet Paul, who has not given any news since she replied "yes" to her marriage proposal. Arriving at the bottom of the tower, Léa learns that the corpse is that of a 35-year-old Montpellieran, historian specialist of Nostradamus. The famous paper is a vellum, parchment of the Middle Ages containing an old French text. For his part, Captain Paul Marchal found a cell phone window, suggesting that the researcher had fallen from the top of the tower.

programme.title: Skyfall
programme.desc: The man who was presumed dead on a mission, Bond reappeared after an attack on MI6. M re-engages him and sends him to the tracks of a high-flying criminal.
programme.desc-more: In a world where secret agents are increasingly in danger, James Bond (Daniel Craig) finds himself facing a formidable opponent in "Skyfall". As he began to pursue a hard drive containing the identities of undercover agents, his mission led him to Istanbul. Unfortunately, an accidental injury caused by his teammate left him for death, forcing him to disappear from traffic. This failure caused a fiery failure, and Mr (Judi Dench) was forced to leave MI6. Shortly thereafter, a tragic event upset the MI6 headquarters when a bomb destroyed M's office, marking the beginning of a new era of chaos for the British secret services. In this way, Bond, although still at a disadvantage, is resurfaced in London. Before he can investigate this devastating attack, he must go through a series of tests to prove his worth, testing not only his bravery, but also his loyalty to the organization he serves. As he advances in this spiral of danger and betrayal, Bond realizes that real threats can come from inside and from outside, paving the way for explosive confrontation.

programme.title: Telethon, everything for life
programme.desc: The story of the birth of the Telethon, a human and medical adventure that became 40 years later an event and a popular mobilization unique in the world.
programme.desc-more: In the 1980s, determined parents refused to accept the announced death of their children, who had a neuromuscular disease unknown to all, myopathy. Without money, without a network, without scientific legitimacy, these families are guided by their determination alone. They went to the United States to convince star Jerry Lewis to lend their name to them, then forced the doors of French television to impose a crazy bet: a 28-hour television marathon to raise awareness of their children's illness. On 4 and 5 December 1987, France as a whole mobilized, village by village, and collected nearly 30 million euros in record time.

programme.title: The invisible
programme.desc: In Wallis-et-Futuna, disability has long lived in the shadows, invisibility. Today, superstitions gradually fade, but the wounds of the past remain.
programme.desc-more: In Wallis-et-Futuna, disability has long lived in the shadows. Those who were invisible to the world were left out of sight, deprived of a genuine look and place in society. Behind closed doors, shame and fear of judgment were mixed with the pain of families convinced that a different child was a curse. Today, these superstitions are gradually disappearing. But the wounds of the past remain, and the path to acceptance and inclusion remains long. On this archipelago, it is urgent to catch up with the delays in recognition, support and dignity for each person with disabilities.

programme.title: Tandem : Back to the past
programme.desc: In "Tandem: Back to the Past", Léa and Paul embark on a family trip to spend a summer holiday in the recently acquired house of Annie and Pierre, who enjoy their well-deserved retirement. What should be a peaceful stay between laughter and memories quickly turns into an unexpected nightmare. During a hike in the surrounding nature, the group makes a macabre discovery: a human forearm, a remnant of an ancient drama, resurrected ghosts of the past and awakened truths buried for too long. This mysterious finding led Lea and Paul to reopen a classified investigation, that of the tragic death of Justine Camus. Justine, a former friend of Léa's at the Gendarmerie School and former girlfriend of Paul, was considered a suicide at the time of his disappearance 24 years ago. While the couple thought they had built a strong relationship based on transparency, they quickly discovered that unconvinced secrets and lies of the past threatened to destroy everything. Through poignant flashbacks that carried spectators in the 1990s, the film reveals the context of the era and the tumultuous journey of Justine, while alternating with current investigative scenes where Léa and Paul try to unravel the sons of a complex plot. As they plunge deeper into the investigation, unexpected allies and hidden enemies emerge, testing the strength of their couple and forcing them to confront their own demons. Between anxiety about discovering the truth and fear that it might alter their lives, Lea and Paul must navigate in a maze of secrets and betrayals, while fighting to preserve their love. "Tandem: Back to the Past" is a captivating thriller that combines police investigation with psychological drama, inviting spectators to reflect on the nature of memory, truth and weight of the past.

programme.title: TV without filter, 30 years of impertinence
programme.desc: A journey behind the scenes and the story of a delicate art: that of impertinence on television, or the art of overcoming limits without breaking the link.
programme.desc-more: Unpredictable, sometimes embarrassing, sometimes hilarious, but always revealing: impertinence arises where television, by its very nature, seeks to master everything. Yet television is never as alive as it is when it agrees to be a little shook. Through carefully chosen archives and testimonies, this documentary traces the evolution of this freedom of expression that crosses the history of the small screen, and questions the implicit rules of the set. Between freedom and constraints, challenges of images and editorial imperatives, television has a complex relationship with this insolence that it fears, but which it also knows how to use to create cult sequences.

programme.desc: A retrospective of the sketches of French humorists who mock Hexagon, its culture, its history, its habits, its regions, its inhabitants.

From Dany Boon to the Unknown, from Gad Elmaleh to Elodie Poux, their humour is a magnifying magnifying magnifying glass that refers us to those we are by pushing more or less the line. So, what does the French really look like?

With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Teen Titans are not teenagers like the others. Thanks to their superpowers, they intervene when the world is in serious danger. With humour and relaxation, they save the universe from all perils. At their head, Robin, who grew up in a circus with his parents. He was adopted by Batman, who trained him well. Next to him, the figure Starfire, an alien princess born on the planet Tamaran, but also Raven, daughter of a Terrin and a distant conqueror. A series of animated rhythmic, adventure-filled and humorous.
programme.desc-more: In a world where teenage superheroes fight for justice, the Teen Titans stand out for their offbeat humour and carefree spirit. Lead by former Batman protégé Robin (Scott Menville), they left Gotham City to settle in Jump City, where they dedicated themselves to protecting citizens while juggling the challenges of adolescence. Next to Robin are Starfire (Hynden Walch), an extraterrestrial princess with extraordinary powers, and Raven (Tara Strong), a young woman with mystical abilities inherited from an evil father. Together, they face various threats, ranging from super-villains to interdimensional monsters, while cultivating solid friendships and living hilarious adventures. With epic fighting and nasty situations, this series of animation takes the spectators into a whirlwind of action and laughter, proving that even heroes need moments of lightness.

programme.title: Telethon, everything for life
programme.desc: In the 1980s, determined parents refused to accept the announced death of their children, who had a neuromuscular disease unknown to all, myopathy. Without money, without a network, without scientific legitimacy, these families are guided by their determination alone. They went to the United States to convince star Jerry Lewis to lend their name to them, then forced the doors of French television to impose a crazy bet: a 28-hour television marathon to raise awareness of their children's illness. On 4 and 5 December 1987, France as a whole mobilized, village by village, and collected nearly 30 million euros in record time.

programme.title: Tom and Lola
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 3 of the series Tom and Lola
programme.desc-more: In the ruthless world of criminal investigations, where every detail and every second is precious, Lola (Dounia Coesens), captain of the Judicial Police, sees her routine upset by the unexpected arrival of Tom (Pierre-Yves Bon). The latter, a narcotics inspector and specialist in clandestine sectors, finds himself homeless after a painful breakup. Without hesitation, Lola opens his door – and, without knowing it, that of his service. What was to be a simple help between colleagues quickly turns into a collaboration as unlikely as effective. Between two sensitive cases, these two radically opposite methods – one methodical and Cartesian, the other instinctive and bold – transform crime scenes into a playground where there is a childish but formidable competition. "Ahead or not?", "The first person who identifies the weapon of crime pays for coffees!": their permanent challenges, between provocation and team spirit, leave their entourage pantois. Yet behind these faces is a rare alchemy, capable of dropping masks and solving seemingly insoluble affairs. But when the boundaries between work and personal life fade, the stakes become more complex. Between Lola's turbulent teenagers, hierarchical tensions and the ongoing affairs – trafficking, disappearances, organized networks – the duo will have to prove that their detonating dynamics can survive the trials. For in a world where pressure never weakens, a question persists: is their atypical partnership a force or a time bomb?
programme.desc: In the ruthless world of criminal investigations, where every detail and every second is precious, Lola (Dounia Coesens), captain of the Judicial Police, sees her routine upset by the unexpected arrival of Tom (Pierre-Yves Bon). The latter, a narcotics inspector and specialist in clandestine sectors, finds himself homeless after a painful breakup. Without hesitation, Lola opens his door – and, without knowing it, that of his service. What was to be a simple help between colleagues quickly turns into a collaboration as unlikely as effective. Between two sensitive cases, these two radically opposite methods – one methodical and Cartesian, the other instinctive and bold – transform crime scenes into a playground where there is a childish but formidable competition. "Ahead or not?", "The first person who identifies the weapon of crime pays for coffees!": their permanent challenges, between provocation and team spirit, leave their entourage pantois. Yet behind these faces is a rare alchemy, capable of dropping masks and solving seemingly insoluble affairs. But when the boundaries between work and personal life fade, the stakes become more complex. Between Lola's turbulent teenagers, hierarchical tensions and the ongoing affairs – trafficking, disappearances, organized networks – the duo will have to prove that their detonating dynamics can survive the trials. For in a world where pressure never weakens, a question persists: is their atypical partnership a force or a time bomb?

programme.title: Black Label
programme.desc: Rapper JoeyStarr and director David Bobée meet after collaborating together in 2019. This time, their choice was based on the work of Léon-Gontran Damascus, "Black Label", a collection of poems that explores various themes such as identity, colonialism, the experience of blacks in a world dominated by Western culture. On stage, JoeyStarr accompanied by Nicolas Mumbounou, deaf artist Jules Turlet, who performs the whole show in sign language, and the bassist Selène Saint-Aimé, who creates the musical framework for it, offers a retrospective of the battles of a people through a journey in time from 1492 to the present day.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: It's Ban Tang's party day. The Yes are planning to go together to the festival and Lan Jun hopes to meet Kai. Which is not Liam's taste.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.sub-title: In the service of His Majesty
programme.desc: The jungle Aces are a bunch of friends, animals, all more or less booby, who will live rock adventures in the forest.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Travis, Inspector McFlare's loyal lieutenant, came to find Clever to tell him of his doubts about the strange behavior of his leader.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, a pig named Clever from India, with a keen sense of observation, and her brother Bro, a little too impulsive, are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve old and complex cases, the two hairy compera are attacking mysteries that have long escaped human investigators. Their first case leads them into the world of mysterious disappearances of pets, where they discover a clandestine network of traffickers. With their ingenuity and sense of camaraderie, Clever and Bro immerse themselves in a thrilling investigation, questioning the inhabitants of the neighborhood and deciphering clues left behind. Their boldness and determination will lead them to surprising revelations that may well change the perception that humans have of these small creatures, while proving to them that team spirit can overcome the greatest obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Benny, the nicest and most popular dog in the neighborhood, suddenly changes his personality. He starts biting after seeing a symbol engraved on a tree in the park.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Tommy the gutted cat got bitten by a strange bat. His friend Red doesn't believe his eyes: Tommy has become a vampire!
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, two fearsome investigators, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional flair for observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and reckless, are attacking mysteries that escape even the experts of Scotland Yard. While the city has been in the grip of unresolved cases for years, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of deduction to decipher clues that no one else sees, while Bro does not hesitate to plunge head first into action, bringing a touch of unpredictability to their investigations. Together, they explore cases as varied as mysterious disappearances, bold robberies and buried secrets, while encountering formidable opponents. programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late

programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Mylène discovers that Anatole borrowed her clothes for a role-playing game on pirates. She's gonna have to take the tests for Jason to get them back.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Mr Lully and his musicians are in the middle of a rehearsal when Ariane suddenly loses control and throws herself on the cushion where Gazette was sitting.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant musical setting, Mr. Lully, a passionate conductor, leads an intense rehearsal with his musicians. As harmony reigns, the atmosphere changes abruptly when one of the musicians, Ariane, experiences an unexpected rise of anger. In the midst of tumultuous emotions, she threw herself on the cushion where Gazette, another member of the band, sat, thus disturbing the session and immerse the entire orchestra in chaos. Tensions rise as musicians try to understand the reasons for this emotional explosion. Mr Lully is facing a dilemma: how to manage this crisis without compromising the performance to come? Throughout the episode, the relationships between the characters are revealed, revealing hidden rivalries and buried secrets. This unexpected confrontation will test not only the group's cohesion, but also the individual aspirations of each member of the orchestra.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: The day before the class photos, Molusco found himself not attractive: he landed on the heads of the globe fishes who made him a super original hairstyle. Except that the fish are poisonous and intoxicate Molusco, who suddenly suffers from an excess of confidence in him.
programme.desc-more: In a world where absurd people are living alongside everyday life, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of a normal existence, similar to that of any eleven-year-old child. As he navigates between his marine origins and his desire for integration, he faces unique challenges. His attempts to blend into the life of a schoolgirl are often hampered by his physical peculiarities and strange behaviors inherited from his dual nature. Accompanied by his friends, who are trying to help him adapt, Musculo discovers the joys and sorrows of childhood, while learning to accept his singularity. The crazy situations and misunderstandings are linked, highlighting the themes of identity and self-acceptance. With a touch of humour and tenderness, this episode explores the obstacles that Musculo must overcome in order to realize his dream of an ordinary child's life, while revealing the richness of his unique personality.

On the way, he discovers the value of friendship, self-acceptance and the strength of identity, while facing the challenges that his status imposes on him.

At only eleven years old, he struggles with the challenges of an atypical adolescence, navigating between his extraordinary abilities and his desire for integration. As he tries to integrate with his entourage, Musculo has to face some nasty and often confusing situations, exacerbated by his unique condition. His friends, who accept him as he is, encourage him to embrace his differences, but Musculo still aspires to a life without labels. This inner conflict leads him into a series of adventures where he will have to learn to balance his extraordinary origins with his common aspirations. On the way, he discovers the value of friendship, self-acceptance and the strength of identity, while facing the challenges that his status imposes on him.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Molusco uses his powers to save a baby, but telling the truth could put his secret in danger. So Rafik is the hero and he becomes a star. Except he quickly gets a taste for fame...
programme.desc-more: In a world where the imagination is mixed up with reality, Musculo, a half-hust, half-human boy, ardently aspires to lead an ordinary child's life at the age of eleven. Although he has marine features that make him unique, he often feels in a gap with his comrades. His days are filled with challenges, oscillating between the joys of childhood and the difficulties associated with his singular condition. Between his attempts to blend into society and his interactions with his friends, Musculo gradually discovers the simple pleasures of childhood, such as playing at the park or participating in school games. However, his quest for acceptance is hampered by nasty situations and misunderstandings that reveal the prejudices of others. On the way, he learns that true strength lies not only in appearance, but also in self-acceptance and the ability to bond with friendship despite differences.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Athena, the bitch of a scientist, comes to consult Clever and Bro, because she and her master were attacked by the spectre of an old associate.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two unlikely brothers are embarking on investigations that defy understanding. Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro, his somewhat impulsive brother, find themselves involved in mysterious things that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Their first investigation plunges them into an unexplained network of disappearances that shakes the local community. By looking at every detail, Clever uses his intelligence and ability to notice clues that humans might neglect, while Bro, with his fervoury temperament, does not hesitate to engage physically in defending their quest for truth. Together, they must navigate a complex world where appearances are deceptive and where each character hides a secret. As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: A huge animal attacked Cosmo's booth during the night. Oscar and Malika are conducting the investigation and finding out that this is a young rogue.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad claims he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo must guide him on his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers that food is delicious and steals Lucky's father's pie.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The jungle Aces are a bunch of friends, animals, all more or less booby, who will live rock adventures in the forest.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: According to Alfred the pigeon, the former aviary of Buckingham Palace is haunted, for a living gargoyle keeps all the birds that approach it.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with extraordinary intelligence, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and intrepid companion, embark on captivating police investigations. While the city is immersed in mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve, the two brothers turn out to be unexpected detectives. Their keen sense of observation and their ability to decipher clues lead them into increasingly complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to daring robberies. Each investigation confronts them with intriguing characters, enigmatic witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations. As they investigate, Clever and Bro discover that truth can sometimes hide in the most unexpected places. Their complicity and determination will lead them to surprising revelations, proving that even the smallest can make a great difference in the quest for justice.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey keeps missing his word! But seeing how much Bingo trusts their mom, she grasps the scope of promises and the importance of keeping her word.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Belfort & Lupin discover that a young marmot arrived with a load of ice ordered by the King. They must help him get back to his own people.
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous setting of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unexpected companions, Belfort, a young boy with a valiant heart, and Lupin, Louis XIV's beloved dog, embark on fascinating adventures. While the royal residence gardens are dotted with secrets and mysteries, Belfort and Lupin dedicate themselves to the protection of the animals that inhabit the Royal Household and surrounding areas. Their unwavering friendship leads them to face a variety of challenges, ranging from the search for a rare bird in danger to the defense of a young fawn threatened by predators. Each episode leads them into thrilling quests where courage and trickery are of the essence. Between the carelessness of childhood and the majesty of the court, Belfort and Lupin learn valuable life lessons while establishing ties with their feathered and hairy companions, enriching their world of friendship and adventure.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Louis XIV commissioned a painting by Diane and Belfort, by the royal painter, Alexandre-François Desportes. The two sisters of Belfort are outraged.
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous setting of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, the unexpected friendship between Belfort, a faithful four-legged companion, and Lupin, an intrepid wolf, gave rise to adventures as captivating as they were moving. While Louis XIV reigned over the court, Belfort and Lupin undertook a series of bold missions to protect animals residing in the Royal Household and those from the surrounding forests. Each episode sees them navigate through lush gardens, court intrigues and unforeseen dangers, while discovering hidden secrets about the relationships between nobles and their animals. Their unwavering loyalty and team spirit push them to face a variety of challenges, ranging from the release of captive animals to the resolution of mysteries surrounding inexplicable disappearances. Together, they demonstrate that even the most unlikely bonds can lead to acts of bravery and sincere friendship.

programme.desc-more: In a world where absurd and imaginary meet, Musculo (Marc Bretonnière) is a unique young boy, both half-hust and half-human. At only eleven years old, he dreams of living an ordinary existence, like all children of his age, far from curious eyes and judgments. His days are filled with friends, games and adventures, but he constantly faces the challenges of his unique nature. In search of acceptance and normality, Musculo tries to integrate into his school and community, while sailing through the difficulties that his atypical appearance imposes on him. His interactions with colourful characters, such as his faithful friend Rasmus (Rasmus Hardiker) and his inspiring mentor Caroline (Caroline Mozzone), prompt him to discover that self-acceptance is the key to transforming his difference into strength. In this touching narrative, Musculo learns that friendship and courage can help him embrace his true identity.

programme.desc-more: In a world where the boundaries between human and animal reign are blurred, Musculo (Marc Bretonnière), a young half-hustler, half-human, is struggling with his unique identity. At only eleven years old, he aspires to lead a normal life full of adventures and camaraderie, like all other children of his age. Yet its unique appearance and aquatic characteristics often place it at the centre of ridicule and misunderstanding. Musculo, with the help of his friends, including the wise Rasmus (Rasmus Hardiker) and the lively Caroline (Caroline Mozzone), tries to navigate the daily challenges of school, games and relationships, while desperately seeking to integrate. Between the discovery of his particular talents and the obstacles imposed by his environment, he will have to learn to embrace his duality. This initiatory journey will lead him to redefine what really means to be "normal" and celebrate the diversity that makes it unique.

programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, an exceptional-looking Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and fearless companion, are attacking mysteries that even Scotland Yard has not been able to solve. Each episode sees them explore emblematic places and interview colorful characters, ranging from local traders to mysterious street dwellers. With a mixture of intelligence and instinct, Clever uses his sense of sharp observation to detect often neglected clues, while Bro, as a driving force, brings a touch of boldness to their investigations. Together, they form an unlikely but effective duo, sailing through the meandering of London's crime. Their quest for truth leads them to discover surprising revelations, questioning everything they thought they knew about their neighbourhood.

In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex mystery involving a series of unexplained disappearances and clues lost in the alleys of the city. While Clever uses his keen sense of observation to decipher the puzzles, Bro often gets carried away by his enthusiasm, which leads them into unforeseen and sometimes perilous situations. Together, they must navigate through a world of intrigues and secrets, while cultivating their brotherly bond and their love for adventure. The two brothers will discover that the key to solving this mystery may be their ability to combine their unique talents.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: This morning Oscar and Malika are on time at school?! They can enjoy the playground, but playing the Marelle, they make Triboulet appear, a strange little Arlequin ready to do anything so that the recree never stops. Oscar and Malika have to face the evil games of Triboulet to succeed in reaching the Prudence office and ring the end of the recreation.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Dad and Mom decide they'll never finish their housework until their daughters stop acting so crazy, but that doesn't happen.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Challenged by Lupin, the two sisters of Belfort entered the maze. According to legend, will they be transformed into a stone statue?
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the seventeenth century, two unlikely companions, Belfort, a faithful dog of King Louis XIV, and Lupin, a daring wolf, formed an inseparable team. Their friendship leads them to extraordinary adventures, where their courage and ingenuity are tested. Together, they travel the green alleys of the royal residence, launching rescue missions to rescue animals in distress, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the surrounding forests. Their quest leads them through intriguing mysteries and unexpected encounters, while highlighting the richness of animal life at that time. In a fascinating historical setting, Belfort and Lupin discover not only the importance of friendship and loyalty, but also the challenges of protecting those who have no voice. Each episode brings them a little closer to the soul of Versailles and its secrets.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: While the King's rosary plans to design a new hat with ostrich feathers, Madame Du Bec and Madame De Buc panic.
programme.desc-more: In the lively city of Belfort, the atmosphere warms up when the rosary of the King, an eccentric artist, begins to create a flamboyant hat decorated with ostrich feathers. This capricious ambition arouses the concern of two ladies of the high society, Madame Du Bec (Nathalie Homs) and Madame De Buc (Barbara Tissier), who see this as a danger to their status and reputation. Fearing that this new trend would destabilize the classical elegance of their circle, they decided to do everything possible to sabotage the chapelier's project. In a frantic race against the clock, the two women develop schemes to counter the designer's plans, leading them to a parade of colourful characters, including the faithful assistant of the chapelier (Guillaume Beaujolais) and a young apprentice (Hugo Brunswick) who wanted to prove his worth. Tensions rise as each one confronts each other in a ballet of intrigues and quiproquos, revealing the hidden undersides of the high society.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: Projected by Grizzy out of the cabin juried on China's great wall, the Lemmings land on a small traditional house in a bamboo forest.
programme.desc-more: In Canada's vast nature, Grizzy, an imposing bear, enjoys the tranquillity of its territory, a cottage isolated in the middle of the forest. His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.
