programme.title: Musical crossing at the Hotel de la Marine
programme.desc: This performance, presented in the prestigious framework of the Court of the Intendant at the Hotel de la Marine, brings together a string quartet and three lyrical singers around a program dedicated to the great works of the classical repertoire. Covered by generations of Talents Adami Classic, this evening highlights the remarkable voices of Michèle Bréant (soprano), Flore Royer (mezzo-soprano) and Alexandre Baldo (baritone bass), accompanied by an exceptional string quartet: Stéphanie-Marie Degand and Iris Scialom on violin, Marie Ducroux on viola and Christian-Pierre La Marca on cello. Together, they will perform masterpieces by Mozart, Borodine and Léo Delibes, while also drawing on an older repertoire, with works by Henry Purcell and Marin Marais.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: One night, Alfred the pigeon witnessed the removal of a hamster by a creature with an extraordinary ability to move agility.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's somewhat impulsive brother, are engaged in captivating police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity has led them to solve mysteries that even Scotland Yard has been struggling to clear for years. In this thrilling episode, the two animals discover a series of strange disappearances that seem to be linked to a disturbing urban legend: the Gorgon of Regent's Park, a mythical creature that, according to rumours, is hidden in the shadows of London's gardens. As they navigate through the secrets of their neighbourhood, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of analysis, while Bro uses his audacity to interrogate the inhabitants and decipher clues. Together, they will have to overcome unexpected obstacles and prove that even the smallest can dig up great truths in a city where appearances are often misleading.

As they sink into these mysteries, their brotherly bond will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about their own past.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Arriving at the stadium for the school Olympiads, Oscar and Malika meet Chloros, a half-god of waste, who must prove to his father, Zeus, that he is a great athlete.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole wants to get her crocmuched plush and makes her bitch think she's razed and covered with chips to get it in an attic vacuum.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: Seeking to escape by all means, Shaun jumps several times inside Shirley, emerging each time in a worse place.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: Lupin, a flair professional, starts a coaching session to wake up the nose of his friend Belfort who has to take a test in front of the king.
programme.desc-more: In the sumptuous gardens of the Palace of Versailles in the 17th century, a unique bond was established between Belfort, Louis XIV's favorite dog, and Lupin, a daring wolf. Together, they form an unexpected duo, uniting their forces to protect their fellow animals, whether they are from the Royal Household or from the vast surrounding areas. Their friendship leads them into thrilling adventures, oscillating between humour and emotion. While the kingdom is plagued by political intrigues and conspiracy, Belfort and Lupin often find themselves at the heart of delicate situations. They must overcome the traps set by the jealous courtiers and solve mysteries surrounding the disappearance of animals. Through fascinating discoveries and bold rescues, this heteroclite couple learns to overcome their differences, proving that friendship transcends the barriers between species. Their achievements are a celebration of loyalty and courage in a world full of greatness and danger.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: A great show is preparing for the Great Ecuries; Bucephalus the horse has a pain in the legs and no one can cure it. He's convinced he's going to be driven out of the Ecuries.
programme.desc-more: As a great equestrian show prepares for the Grand Ecuries of Versailles, the noble Bucephale horse, well known for its presence, is facing a personal crisis: a mysterious legache that threatens not only his health, but also his future in the prestigious stables. Convinced that he will be driven out and relegated to oblivion in a meadow, Bucephalus is invaded by anguish and despair. Faced with this delicate situation, the two protagonists, Belfort (Alexandre Nguyen) and Lupin (Hugo Brunswick), are committed to a determined mission to save their equine friend. With the complicity of an empathic veterinarian (Nathalie Homs) and other unexpected allies, they explore unusual remedies and unconventional methods to give Bucephale hope. As the carousel date approaches, friendship and solidarity will be tested, but Belfort and Lupin's determination could make all the difference.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: A small, half-hust, half-human boy, Molusco can communicate with whales and has a talking shell. Yet his only wish is to lead a normal life.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the boundary between human and animal is blurred, Musculo, a young half-hust, half-human boy, dreams of a normal existence. At only eleven years old, he aspires to live the daily adventures of every child of his age, but his unique appearance and extraordinary abilities complicate his life. Between the mockery of his comrades and the expectations of his family, Musculo struggles with his identity and desire to belong. As he sails in the maze of childhood, he discovers unexpected friendships and rivalries that push him to surpass himself. In this episode, Musculo faces a major challenge: to prove that he can be like others, while learning to accept his differences. His quest for acceptance and identity led him to a series of luscious adventures, where he would have to use his unique talents to overcome the obstacles that stand in his way.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Clever announces to Bro and McFlare that she has finally gathered enough clues to know where the next meeting of The Cause, the secret organization of the evil Knight, will take place.
programme.desc-more: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: The King of the pets of Cairo City, visiting Buckingham Palace in London, is the victim of a totally inexplicable robbery.
programme.desc-more: In the foggy streets of London, Clever, a pig of remarkable intelligence, is dedicated to an unusual mission: to solve the mysteries that affect pets and their owners. With a sharp mind and an unparalleled sense of observation, Clever joins a diverse team of accomplices, including four-legged friends and people passionate about justice. Each investigation plunges him into a secret world where treason, riddles and surprising revelations are mixed. From the disappearance of a precious cat to the strange behavior of a watchdog, each case puts to the test its ingenuity and determination. By sailing through mysterious London, Clever discovers that the truth is often more complex than it seems. With a touch of humour and a great sensitivity, this episode takes us into a thrilling adventure where friendship and loyalty are essential to triumph over dark forces that threaten the welfare of animals.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Professor Toybos has developed a liquid that can turn an ordinary animal into a dinosaur! By mistake, Oscar overturns a part of it on Maurice.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, two young inseparable neighbours, Oscar and Malika, embark on a thrilling adventure to attend school. However, their quest to arrive on time is systematically hampered by a series of unforeseen and extraordinary events. Whether it is a cat who refuses to come down from a tree, a sudden rain of confetti or an unexpected encounter with a fantastic character, every day reserves its lot of hilarious surprises. Despite their efforts, they still find themselves having to justify their delays to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, with her legendary scepticism, never believes them. Through the wild situations and unexpected twists, this French animation series offers young spectators a dose of humour and adventure, while stressing the importance of friendship and creativity in the face of the unexpected. Each episode is a new lesson on resilience and imagination.

programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Charlie Chaplin, the freedom genius
programme.desc: For over a century, the world has known Charlie Chaplin. Narrated by Mathieu Amalric, this documentary is the first in the Charlot archive.
programme.desc-more: For over a century, everyone knows and loves Charlie Chaplin. A burlesque genius, Chaplin put his talent at the service of an ideal of justice and freedom. His best scenario was that of his own destiny, which is part of the political and artistic history of the twentieth century. Chaplin actor and author, director and producer, composer and choreographer, whose financial independence will be the key to his artistic freedom and his humanist commitment.

programme.title: A Frenchman named Gabin
programme.desc: Jean Gabin was the most emblematic actor of French cinema of the 20th century because of his personal journey and his roles on the big screen.
programme.desc-more: Jean Gabin remains the most emblematic French actor of the last century. From the Third to the Fifth Republic, the Popular Front at the end of the Thirty Glories, the artist has embodied in cinema France of cities and fields, that of factories and cafes, ports and suburbs, through a comprehensive and varied filmography, rich in masterpieces such as "La Bête humaine", "Le Quai des mismes", "La Grande Illusion", "La Traversée de Paris" or "Un ape en hiver". Between 1935 and 1940, Gabin was featured in twelve films, ten of which became classics of French cinema, under the leadership of Jean Grémillon, Marcel Carné, Jean Renoir and Julien Duvivier. This documentary outlines a portrait of the actor and man, Jean Alexis Moncorgé.

programme.desc: Obsessed by a prophecy and driven by his wife, a bloody madman crushes all those who oppose his march to power on the throne of Scotland.
programme.desc-more: After a victorious campaign, Macbeth and Banquo, the army leaders of the Monarch Duncan, met three witches. programme.title: We need to make a world
programme.desc: In South Africa, Karl Sanchez, better known as Drag queen Nicky Doll, explores a country that transforms his wounds into collective power.
programme.desc-more: Between stories of resilience, unknown traditions and struggles for equality, Karl Sanchez, better known as Drag queen Nicky Doll, explores the human and cultural richness of each country. As the meetings progressed, he was welcomed by the locals, shared their daily lives, tasted local specialities, discovered singular practices and tried out new experiences. Light and deeply human, the series looks at the world in a quirky and positive way and carries a message of hope and tolerance. In South Africa, Nicky Doll explores a country that turns its wounds into collective power. From art to activism, from nature to drag, diversity is an act of resistance and reconciliation.

programme.title: The aces of the jungle to the rescue
programme.desc: The happy gang of jungle Aces continues to want to bring peace and justice to the nature around them, despite some enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant jungle full of surprises, the tranquillity of animals is often put to the test by perilous situations. Maurice, a tig-shaped manchot with a well-dipped character, joined a heteroclite team composed of Batricia, a cunning bat, Miguel, an impressively strong gorilla, and Gilbert, an astute tarsier. Together, they form the "Ace of the jungle", a group of brave animals dedicated to the protection of their friends and their habitat. When a danger threatens their peaceful community, a simple alarm signal, manifested by clouds of smoke rising from a volcano, is enough to mobilize them. Once they have gathered together, they develop bold plans to counter the threats to their world. This captivating cartoon, produced by a Toulouse society, invites young spectators to dive into a world of thrilling adventures where friendship and courage triumph over obstacles.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Clever announces to Bro and McFlare that she has finally gathered enough clues to know where the next meeting of The Cause, the secret organization of the evil Knight, will take place.
programme.desc-more: In a world where mystery and danger are mixed, Clever (Kaycie Chase), a clever investigator, announces to her colleagues Bro (Andy Chase) and McFlare (Doug Rand) that she has finally got a set of crucial clues. These revelations lead her to the location of the next meeting of The Cause, a secret organization led by an evil Knight whose intentions are obscure and threatening. As Clever and his friends are about to infiltrate this clandestine meeting, they realize that the stakes are much higher than they imagined. Each clue brings them closer to a plot that could have devastating repercussions on their city. In parallel, tensions are mounting between the team members, each facing their own demons. As time is running out, Clever must deploy all his ingenuity to thwart the Machiavellical plans of The Cause before it is too late.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: The King of the pets of Cairo City, visiting Buckingham Palace in London, is the victim of a totally inexplicable robbery.
programme.desc-more: In the foggy streets of London, Clever, a pig of remarkable intelligence, is dedicated to an unusual mission: to solve the mysteries that affect pets and their owners. With a sharp mind and an unparalleled sense of observation, Clever joins a diverse team of accomplices, including four-legged friends and people passionate about justice. Each investigation plunges him into a secret world where treason, riddles and surprising revelations are mixed. From the disappearance of a precious cat to the strange behavior of a watchdog, each case puts to the test its ingenuity and determination. By sailing through mysterious London, Clever discovers that the truth is often more complex than it seems. With a touch of humour and a great sensitivity, this episode takes us into a thrilling adventure where friendship and loyalty are essential to triumph over dark forces that threaten the welfare of animals.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: Salty, a cat from the Royal Guard, is paralyzed by a mysterious knight with supernatural powers. Clever and Bro must discover the identity of this knight and lift the spell.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and Bro's impulsive and adventurous brother, are engaged in investigations that go beyond imagination. Together, they start a series of mysterious cases that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. Their first challenge is to bring them into a complex enigma involving a daring art flight, where invaluable works have disappeared without leaving any trace. Thanks to their lively mind and ability to sneak into unexpected places, the two brothers discovered a well-organized criminal network, using clever techniques to escape justice. While they are thwarting the plans of their opponents, Clever and Bro will also have to overcome their own differences to make the truth come out. Their friendship and determination will be tested in this thrilling adventure, where each clue counts and where danger is around every corner.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: Oscar and Malika discover that their neighborhood is being painted in grey by a necropix, a creature from space that abhors colors. Our heroes must then help a young superhero chromapix stop it, and, thanks to their magical brushes, return to their city all its colors.
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Arts transition
programme.sub-title: From Offenbach to Verdi, variation around Paris
programme.desc: A concert recorded in 2014 at the Musée d'Orsay in Paris. The musical program was entirely dedicated to the city of Paris and was performed by the Orchestre Philharmonique de Radio France, directed by Mikko Franck, the Choir and the Master's degree in Radio-France, and by prestigious soloists and dancers of French Cancan. Like the Ville-Lumière, this show is romantic and festive, thanks to the most beautiful airs of the classical repertoire and the great popular songs inspired by it: waltzes, arias, songs, cancans and gypsy tunes, succeed each other and celebrate Paris, thanks to the works of Trenet, Offenbach, Waldteufel, Scotto, Massenet, Puccini, Lehar, Gounod, Gershwin and Verdi.

programme.title: Renaud Capuçon at Olympia: The Things of Life - Cinema II
programme.desc: Surfing on the huge wave of success that was won by her first album dedicated to the most mythical symphonies of the seventh art, the illustrious violinist continues her exploration with a second opus that pays tribute to the most famous French composers of film music. The concert featured Francis Lai with "Love Story", Maurice Jarre with "Lawrence d'Saudi", Michel Legrand with "L'Affaire Thomas Crown", Alexandre Desplats with "The Shape of Water", and Georges Delerue with "Le Dernier Métro" and "Rich and Famous".

programme.title: Pierre Boulez leads Stravinsky's "The Bird of Fire"
programme.desc: The composer and conductor Pierre Boulez is particularly known for his interpretations of 20th century classics in general and Stravinsky in particular. This representation given under the pyramid of the Louvre Museum was the culmination of a "cycle Boulez" at the Louvre. A 2000-member audience attended this performance of Stravinsky's "The Bird of Fire".

programme.title: The chamber orchestra of the Pablo Casals de Prades festival

Its open leadership gives the demonstration a new impetus.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc-more: In a small Australian city, a group of four pre-teens with a keen sense of justice and insatiable curiosity unite to found their own detective agency. Composed of the intelligent and determined Abby (Abby Bergman), the brilliant Aston (Aston Droomer), the russy Jamil (Jamil Smyth-Secka) and the creative Anna (Anna Cooke), this group of friends embarks on a series of captivating investigations that lead them to solve mysteries around their school and neighbourhood. Each episode confronts them with various puzzles, ranging from the disappearance of personal objects to disturbing rumours that disturb the peace of their establishment. As they strive to thwart clever ploys and discover the truth, young detectives must also navigate the challenges of friendship, loyalty and school rivalries. With an unwavering team spirit, they face unexpected obstacles, testing their investigative skills and their ability to remain united against adversity. "Super detectives!" plunges spectators into a thrilling universe where every investigation is a full-fledged adventure, filled with suspense and humour. Young heroes learn that solving mysteries is not only a matter of intelligence, but also of courage and solidarity.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional sense of observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and intrepid, are an unlikely duo of investigators. Together, they embark on exciting investigations that challenge even Scotland Yard's expertise. Each episode plunges them into mysterious and complex cases, ranging from unexplained disappearances to bold thefts, where their animal instincts and intelligence lead them to surprising deductions. Clever, with his sharp mind, uses his analytical skills to decorate the clues, while Bro brings a touch of bravery, not hesitant to plunge into action. Their complicity and unique dynamics allow them to confront formidable criminals and solve puzzles that human detectives have not been able to solve for years. In this adventure, the two brothers also discover buried secrets and unexpected truths, while strengthening their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "The race car"Oscar and Malika discover an old race car hidden in a dead end. They quickly realize that Vicky is a single car: she is alive! Our heroes are trying to help him find his former owner, but they are being hunted by Michelle, a former racer determined to send Vicky to the break!
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: "The wig house"The royal wig, is in panic: the Queen's favorite wig has disappeared. Gazette, the mouse, is upset, because this wig is his house.
programme.desc-more: Today, Mr. Binet (Antoine Schoumsky), the royal wig, is plunged into a real turmoil. The Queen's favorite wig, a key piece of her elegance and symbol of her authority, has mysteriously disappeared, sowing panic in the kingdom. Gazette, the little mouse (Barbara Tissier), is particularly affected by this situation, because this wig is not only an accessory: it is his home. Determined to find her shelter and help Mr.Binet, she embarks on a quest full of adventures. Together, they must navigate through the royal palace, interrogate the members of the court, and thwart the rumours that are circulating about this disappearance. As disturbing clues begin to emerge, the unlikely duo discovers a much larger plot that threatens to plunge the kingdom into chaos. Between mystery, humour and friendship, this adventure will lead them to unexpected revelations about power and loyalty.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: A scientific popularization magazine for all the curious, young and old. From their Cabin Max, Cécile and Mathieu, using models, experts and practical work, are looking at a fascinating theme.
programme.desc-more: CTPS takes you into the secrets of the kingdom of Egypt and eternal life. According to the Egyptians, for a soul to gain access to eternal life, it was necessary to keep its body. In the cabin, Max "undresses" a model of mummy to understand the techniques used and also tells us about the "naturally" mummified animals. Surprised, some mummies came from South America, others from China... the Egyptians were not the only ones to have this practice. Mathieu discovers the mummies of the Museum of Fine Art and Archaeology in Besançon and accesses a place forbidden to the public: reserves. Kimi goes to the Museum of Man to participate in an exceptional operation to restore an Egyptian mummy.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, an ordinary young woman, discovers that she is the heiress of a mythical jade armor, formerly worn by the famous superhero Jade. As evil resurfaces in the form of a criminal organization determined to plunge the world into chaos, Lan Jun must overcome his doubts and fears to assume the role of protector. Accompanied by her faithful friends, she undertook an initiatory journey that led her to explore the mysteries of her legacy and master the extraordinary powers conferred by armor. In parallel, she faces a formidable adversary, an ancient disciple of Jade, who wishes to seize the armor for his own purposes. Lan Jun will quickly realize that real power lies not only in armor, but also in his determination to defend what is right.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Taratata 100% live
programme.desc: Zazie opens the evening by performing "No matter", single from her 12? album "Volatil". She then found Lancelot for a replay of Benjamin Biolay's "La Superbe". Jayler plays "Riverboat Queen", an album by "Voices Unheard".

programme.title: Luidji at the Accor Arena
programme.desc: Luidji was a unique artist and returned in 2023 with a second album introspective where he addressed personal themes such as faith, ambition and passion: "Season 00". During his concert at the iconic Accor Arena, he delivered an immersive and captivating musical experience. With his melancholic melodies and poetic lyrics, the former employee in emergency situations converted into a musician with a fragile and sincere balance, transformed the scene into an intimate and powerful setting.

programme.title: Taratata 100% live
programme.desc: MC Solaar interprets "Maître de ceremoniale", from the last part of his triptych "Balade Astrale". Franz Ferdinand presents "Audacious", from the album "The Human Fear". The British Lola Young sings her hit "Messy", The French duo Terrenoire performs "Le folie dans la car", from the album "Protected.e". Great premiere on Taratata's stage for the rising star of the French song Yoa, who presents her single "Matcha Queen". The French revelation Solann offers an intense interpretation of his title "Les Ogres", from his first album "Si on sombre c'est beau". American metal band Papa Roach performs "Leave a Light On (Talk Away The Dark)" and "Last Resort".

programme.title: Yamê at the Golden Coast Festival
programme.desc: A Franco-Cameronian artist born to a musician father and a computer mother, Yama launched his solo career in March 2020 after starting as a keyboardist and singer in the Parisian Jams. programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: "Interference"Catastrophe: Lan Jun lost the bottle containing his mother. Cut off the power grid because of an Eclat, Xin Qi can't call for help.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Treasure of the Catacombs"Champollion, the famous archaeologist Sir Arthur Bones parrot, came to ask for help from Clever, because his master was abducted by a humanoid robot.
programme.desc-more: In a world where adventure and mystery are interspersed, Clever, a young amateur detective, finds himself confronted with an unexpected situation when he receives a visit from Champollion, the parrot of Sir Arthur Bones, a renowned archaeologist. Champollion, a panicked man, reveals that his master was abducted by a humanoid robot, an event that seems to have come out of a science fiction story. Intrigued and determined to help, Clever is engaged in an investigation that will lead him to explore ancient catacombs and long-sought secrets. As he investigates, he will discover mysterious clues and forgotten artifacts, while facing unexpected dangers. With the help of his friends, Clever will have to be a cunning and courageous man to thwart the kidnapper's plans and save Sir Arthur. The stakes are high, and each discovery brings it closer to a truth that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The trap of the octopus"A poodle that participates continuously in canine beauty competitions is attacked at night in its home by a tentacular creature.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a sharp sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little impulsive, are embarking on bold police investigations. Their insatiable curiosity and their natural instinct to solve mysteries push them to explore business that even Scotland Yard struggles to elucidate. Together, they decipher complex puzzles and face perilous situations, while using their trickery and team spirit. Clever, with his intelligence and attention to detail, contrasts with Bro's fervour temperament, creating a captivating dynamic between the two characters. As they go through their adventures, they discover a network of intrigues that drags them into theft, deceit and secrets that are well guarded. Their quest for truth leads them to rub themselves with mysterious characters and unexpected situations, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact on the world around them.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: «The Serval of the Thames»A very long-glawed feline with a speckled coat, wearing a carved mask, bursts into the Queen's room in the middle of the night and disappears with it.
programme.desc-more: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: «The Nebulous»Oscar and Malika meet Billy, the shepherd of the City in Heaven, who is looking for his flock of Nebulous, funny sheep of cloudy sheep...
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: "Princess is gone"Princess is gone. As Anatole just discovered a television series on Sherlock Holmes, he decided to conduct the investigation in the manner of the famous detective. But Olympus also thinks she's Sherlock Holmes and also conducts an investigation. Goliath, his grandmother's little dog is missing. It's serious. Will the detectives be up to their investigation?
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: "The gardens of Versailles" Belfort and Lupin come to the aid of the moles Arlette, Georgette and Colette who have dug galleries under the new French floor which must be presented to the King.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the 17th century, the sumptuous Palace of Versailles became the scene of unexpected adventures thanks to an extraordinary duo: Belfort, the faithful dog of Louis XIV, and Lupin, a bold wolf with a well-drained character. Together, they travel through the vast gardens of the royal residence, a place where natural beauty blends with architectural magnificence. Their unwavering friendship led them to engage in rescue missions, whether they were royal household animals or wild creatures in distress. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures, where they show courage and ingenuity to help their feather and hair companions. Between court intrigues and unexpected dangers, Belfort and Lupin embody loyalty and the spirit of adventure, making the hearts of the spectators vibrate at the rhythm of their epic exploits in a Versailles filled with magic and mystery.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Silence
programme.desc: The discreet wife of an illustrious lawyer is shocked by her existence after the discovery of buried secrets that threaten to burst into the open.
programme.desc-more: François Schaar (Daniel Auteuil), a renowned lawyer, finds himself at the heart of a media storm while defending the families of two young girls who have suffered from a notorious child crime. As the trial grows, Francis' personal life begins to crack under the weight of the accusations that emerge. His wife, Astrid (Emmanuele Devos), was forced to face the doubts of their adult daughter, Carole, who asked him to reflect on François' past actions, questioning the integrity of their family. Meanwhile, Raphael, their teenage son, adopts an increasingly erratic behavior, exacerbating tension in the home. As external pressure intensified, François had to navigate between his professional responsibilities and the growing troubles of his family life, while seeking to protect those he loved from the devastating consequences of his engagement in this mediated affair.

programme.title: GTA, the game no limit
programme.desc: In 30 years, the video game "Grand Theft Auto", known as GTA, has moved from pariah status rejected by the political and media class to iconic work.
programme.desc-more: In thirty years, the video game "Grand Theft Auto", now known as GTA, has moved from the status of pariah rejected by the political and media class to that of iconic work. A tech and testosterone version of the game of gendarmes and thieves, the franchise has reinvented the rules since the 1990s by offering hundreds of millions of gamers a total space of freedom. But beyond the unbridled pursuits and its sulphurous aura, what does this global phenomenon really reveal? The film, carried by the voice of actress and comedian Fadily Camara, and sublimated by Laurent Seince's artistic direction and the original musical creation of Dimitri Leroy, brings together for the first time the pioneers of GTA: Keith Hamilton, Paul Farley, Gary Penn and Jamie King.

programme.title: Jade's armor
programme.desc: "Even not bad" Wounded, Lan Jun must rest. But the teenager disobeys to date Kai. At the same time, La Tigresse finds an Eclat who makes her invulnerable.
programme.desc-more: In a world where legends come to life, Lan Jun, a young woman apparently ordinary, finds herself confronted with an extraordinary destiny. A heir to a legendary super heroine named Jade, she must wear the iconic armor that once protected the kingdom from evil. At first, Lan Jun doubted his ability to bear such a burden and honour Jade's legacy. However, as dark forces begin to emerge, threatening peace and harmony, she understands that the time has come to fight. With the help of his friends and unexpected allies, Lan Jun is embarking on a perilous quest to master his new skills and discover the hidden secrets of armor. Between personal challenges and epic confrontations, she must learn to believe in herself and embrace her role as a protector. The adventure that awaits her will lead her to explore unknown territories, both external and internal, as she prepares to face the evil that is looming on the horizon.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Invincible Opponent" When Inspector McFlare meets his agent, Pigeon Paxton, who is about to reveal important information to him, they are both attacked.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with a keen mind and remarkable observational capacity, and his brother Bro, a little more impulsive and bold, are embarking on police investigations that defy understanding. While Scotland Yard struggles to solve thorny business, the two fur brothers take charge, proving that even the smallest can have a great impact. Their first case plunges them into an intriguing mystery: a series of inexplicable disappearances of precious toys in the neighbourhood. With their sense of deference, Clever and Bro question unlikely witnesses, explore dark alleys and use clever schemes to dislodge the culprits. As they investigate, they discover an unsuspecting criminal network, testing their intelligence and courage. Each investigation brings them a little closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "The Golden Crown" At the museum, our heroes try to prevent a thief from stealing the precious crown of an Inca emperor. But what they don't know is that the crown is cursed, and soon Oscar and the thief turn everything they touch into gold! Our heroes must recover the crown and stop the thief who has decided to turn the city into a true Golden City!
programme.desc-more: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.

programme.title: Anatole Latile
programme.desc: Anatole Latile, a schoolboy dissipated but resourceful, spends all his energy getting into trouble.
programme.desc-more: Anatole Latile is a schoolboy with imagination and energy, but his adventurous spirit often pushes him to find himself in delicate situations. With his gang of comrades, there is never a lack of opportunity to embark on farfelus projects that lead him to multiply misadventures. Whether it's creating a faulty robot for the science class or organizing a surprise birthday party for his best friend, Anatole is a surprising ingenuity, although often misdirected. His carelessness and daring sometimes win him reproof from his teachers, but he also knows how to charm his friends with his contagious enthusiasm. Through his adventures, Anatole learns to juggle his aspirations with the consequences of his actions, thus discovering the value of friendship and responsibility. His tumultuous journey to school will lead him to unexpected life lessons, while keeping a lightness that makes his adventures charming.

programme.title: Shaun the sheep
programme.desc: In a peaceful corner of the English countryside, Shaun, a malicious and resourceful sheep, bores himself from the monotonous routine of the farm where he lives with his sheep companions. Always looking for a new adventure, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the daily monotony. With the help of his friends, a much less clever group of sheep, he concocts a bold plan to spend an unforgettable day. However, their escape quickly turns into a series of hilarious mishaps when animals find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations, ranging from a trip to a city trip to unexpected encounters with humans. While Shaun must show creativity and courage to get his flock embarrassed, he realizes that friendship and solidarity are essential to overcoming obstacles. In this animated comedy, Shaun's adventurous spirit and his faces promise to captivate spectators of all ages.
programme.desc-more: In a rural world where routines are settled, Shaun (Justin Fletcher), a sheep with a lively and malicious mind, is distinguished by his insatiable curiosity and his sense of adventure. He lives peacefully on a farm with his companions, a group of naive and somewhat clumsy ovine people, who follow him in all his frascs. When daily life becomes too monotonous, Shaun decides to take charge and escape from the farm to live a thrilling day. However, his plans take an unexpected turn when the farmer, distracted by events, finds himself in nasty and unforeseen situations. Accompanied by his faithful friend, the dog Bitzer (John Sparkes), Shaun will have to be ingenuity and team spirit to overcome the obstacles. Together, they will navigate through hilarious and unexpected adventures, proving that even the smallest can achieve great things when they are united.

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.desc: "A royal dog sickness"When you eat the remains of Louis XIV's dinner, Tane, Ponne and Diane suddenly find themselves all sick. Belfort immediately solicits Lupin.
programme.desc-more: As the night falls on Versailles, Tane, Ponne and Diane suddenly find themselves taken with intense nausea after having consumed the remains of Louis XIV's royal dinner. Their health is becoming a concern, and the situation is becoming alarming when they realize that this mysterious evil could have a much darker origin than just damaged foods. In the emergency, Belfort, a clever and insightful detective, is asked to solve this mystery. He appeals to his faithful partner, Lupin, a master of disguise and plot, known for his ability to thwart the most machiavelic plans. Together, they engage in a thrilling investigation through the historic corridors of Versailles, seeking to detect the truth behind this inexplicable malaise. As they investigate, they will discover well-kept secrets and conspiracy that could threaten not only their health, but also the stability of the kingdom itself.

programme.title: It's still not a witch.
programme.desc: Each living creature has genes, made up of DNA, that define its characteristics and enable its cells to function. Sometimes mutations in this code can cause rare diseases, affecting only a few people around the world. Max explains chromosomes, DNA and genes, while Cecile visits the Évry Genopoly to discover how scientists study these genes to treat these diseases. Kimi meets Sacha, with Duchenne myopathy, treated with gene therapy. A fascinating journey to the heart of our cells, with inspiring encounters between children, parents and researchers united against rare diseases!

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the "Mulusco" series, Molusco and Rafik face a major challenge: preparing a cake for a school duty. In the face of their lack of culinary experience, they decided to appeal to Mamie Pétula, Rafik's grandmother, who was known for her pastry skills. The call to Grandma Pétula triggers a series of crazy and unexpected situations, as the two friends try to follow her eccentric advice to the letter. Between unlikely ingredients and surprising cooking methods, their cuisine is transformed into a veritable laboratory of culinary experiences. The adventures are bound up as the two boys juggle with the expectations of their teacher and the whims of a farfetched recipe. As preparation progresses, they discover not only the secrets of pastry, but also the importance of mutual help and creativity, while facing hilarious and unexpected situations.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In this crazy episode of the "Mousco" series, Molusco's quiet life (Marc Bretonnière) takes an unexpected turn when he gets stinged by a spider. This sting causes a surprising reaction: his hand becomes sticky, making him unable to escape from this uncomfortable situation. In an inadvertent moment, Ozzy (Matthew Forbes), his eternal rival, came to his rescue after accidentally shoving him. Unfortunately, their awkward interaction leads them to an even more delicate situation: they are stuck hand in hand. While Molusco desperately tries to get rid of this grip, Ozzy is forced to help him, despite their differences. This episode highlights the comic and conflict dynamics between these two characters, which everything opposes, while exploring the themes of unexpected friendship and forced cooperation. The ensuing misadventures promise hilarious moments and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: In a colorful and baffled universe, Molusco, a character with a well-drained character, launches a surprising accusation against Coco, convinced that he is responsible for a series of mysterious flights. Indeed, missing objects are found in Molusco's rooms and his friends, and the evidence seems to accuse Coco. However, the situation is taking an unexpected turn when Coco (Marc Bretonnière) discovers that a mischievous hermit is hiding behind these misdeeds. In the face of this revelation, Coco finds himself in a race against the clock to prove his innocence and to expose the real culprit. As tensions rise and other characters, such as Rasmus Hardiker and Caroline Mozzone, mix with the case, Coco must gather clues and convince his friends of his good faith. This crazy adventure combines humour and mystery, while highlighting the dynamics of camaraderie within this heteroclite group.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Rafik, a young student full of training, eagerly wishes to impress Claudine, a little girl from her school who leaves no one indifferent. To seduce his heart, he turned to Molusco, a character as farfetched as he was ingenious, so that he made beautiful pearls for him. As Molusco embarked on an investigation to understand Claudine's tastes, he quickly discovered that Claudine had a particular talent to charm all the boys in her class. Indeed, she uses her childish charm to obtain gifts and attentions from her comrades, manipulating the innocent feelings of each. Molusco, intrigued by this dynamic, finds himself trained in a series of nasty and unforeseen situations. With the help of Rafik, he will not only have to create the perfect pearls, but also understand the subtleties of friendly and loving relationships at school, while learning to manage the stakes of manipulation and authenticity.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In a mysterious London, a disturbing event shakes the royal court when, in the middle of the night, a feline with a spotted coat and surprisingly long claws bursts into the Queen's room (Barbara Scaff). This serval, wearing a carved mask that gives it a enigmatic look, attacks the peace of the monarchy by disappearing with the sovereign. The alert is quickly given and a complex investigation is under way, involving members of the Royal Guard and city detectives. Andy Chase is a clever detective, determined to break the mystery behind this intriguing creature and find the Queen before it's too late. As the investigation proceeds, hidden secrets, unexpected alliances and surprising revelations emerge, plunging the spectator into an atmosphere of tension and intrigue where each clue could be the key to the resolution of this bold flight.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, Clever, a pig from India with extraordinary intelligence, and his brother Bro, an impulsive and intrepid companion, embark on captivating police investigations. While the city is immersed in mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve, the two brothers turn out to be unexpected detectives. Their keen sense of observation and their ability to decipher clues lead them into increasingly complex cases, ranging from mysterious disappearances to daring robberies. Each investigation confronts them with intriguing characters, enigmatic witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations. As they investigate, Clever and Bro discover that truth can sometimes hide in the most unexpected places. Their complicity and determination will lead them to surprising revelations, proving that even the smallest can make a great difference in the quest for justice.

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: In a series of hilarious and moving adventures, Oscar (Jillian O'Dowd) and Malika, two inseparable friends, are constantly late for school. Their daily lives are punctuated by rock-capped situations, where every day is a new opportunity to find yourself in unexpected perpetencies. Whether it's a school bus that's broken down, a wandering animal that blocks their way or their own mishaps, their over-imagining imagination is driving them into scenarios that are all more crazy than each other. Despite the obstacles, their unwavering friendship and team spirit enable them to overcome challenges while learning valuable life lessons. Through these fifty-two episodes, Oscar and Malika remind us that even when we are late, the essential thing is to enjoy the journey and adventure that awaits us, while cultivating unforgettable memories.
programme.desc-more: Oscar and Malika, two young inseparable neighbours, live rock adventures each morning by going to school. Despite their geographical proximity and friendship, each journey turns into a series of unexpected journeys that prevent them from arriving on time. Whether it's by crossing a mischievous dog that takes them into a treasure hunt, meeting colorful characters or meeting up with some crazy situations, each episode is a new opportunity for them to discover the world around them. Their insatiable curiosity and sense of humour push them to explore unanticipated paths, while strengthening their bond of friendship. Through this series full of freshness and imagination, young spectators are invited to follow these two heroes of everyday life in a world where adventure and camaraderie are always at the meeting, transforming the simple journey to school into an unforgettable epic.

programme.title: Okoo-koo
programme.desc: Okoo-koo - Season 5: even closer to children, even more inspiring! For his fifth season, Okoo-koo continues his mission: to awaken curiosity, encourage creativity and accompany children in their discovery of the world through fun, positive and inspiring content. This year, the show is getting even closer to its audience with \" Okoo, it's at home \", a new weekly sequence that gives the children the floor. Karim will meet them all over France to discover their passions, talents and initiatives, or will host them directly on the stage to share their universes. A section that places children at the heart of the program and values their creativity, personality and commitment.

programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: La Haine: nothing has changed so far
programme.desc: Captured in December 2024 at La Seine Musicale, Boulogne Billancourt. In the show "La Haine: nothing has changed so far", adaptation on stage of Mathieu Kassovitz's film released in 1995, three young people from the suburbs travel through Paris and its surroundings in 15 paintings mixing music, dance, cinema, rap, theatre and live show. The show tells the story of these three people who face economic, social and political difficulties, but who also remember to be an ode to love, solidarity and friendship. Behind the scene, screens allow spectators to be immersed in the story, in addition to the performance of the actors on the stage.

programme.title: Rim'K at Adidas Arena
programme.desc: Rim'K, the undisputed legend of French rap, has been able to pass through decades with brilliance and to mark several generations. He won in the 1990s with "Tonton du Bled", which now brings together elders and young listeners. The Algerian-based tonton is now collaborating with artists like TIF, Alpha Wann or SDM and sharing his love for music on stage with charisma and generosity. Icon of hip-hop culture and pillar of group 113, Rim'K, celebrates its 30 years of career at Adidas Arena!

programme.title: Paname, the great Paris of rap
programme.desc: What if rap was the first and true demonstration in Greater Paris? Back to a decade of out-of-standard, the 2010s, when Île-de-France established itself as one of the world's leading rap centers. From the Assaut Sexion to PNL, through the Entourage, Kaaris, MHD or Fianso, this documentary plunges into the roots of this scene, drawing on its diversity and navigating on both sides of the ring road to trace the ten years that have changed the music. Or that the music has changed.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Return of Warragul"A prestigious diamond exhibited at the British Museum has just been stolen and the flight bears the signature of Warragul, the famous diamond gnome.
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, the unusual duo formed by Clever, an exceptional-flavoured Indian pig, and his brother Bro, an impulsive but loyal companion, embarks on captivating investigations. Although their appearance may seem ordinary, their insatiable curiosity and lively intelligence propel them to the heart of mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve. In this episode, they find themselves facing a complex affair involving mysterious disappearances and misleading clues, which lead them through the dark alleys and the well-kept secrets of the city. Clever, with his keen sense of observation, deciphers the smallest details, while Bro, with his fervent temperament, does not hesitate to put himself in danger to discover the truth. Together, they must navigate a world where appearances are often misleading, while learning to trust their instincts to thwart the plans of an elusive criminal.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The Revenge of the Werewolf"One night, Goliath dog fell on stronger than he: a wolf dog with black coat, with luminescent eyes and standing on his back legs like a werewolf.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, the intrepid Clever, a pig from India with a keen sense of observation, and his brother Bro, a little too impulsive, are embarking on captivating police investigations. While the city is immersed in a series of mysteries that even Scotland Yard struggles to solve, the two hair-brothers find themselves at the heart of both confusing and enigmatic business. Their team spirit, although sometimes chaotic, allows them to address complex cases, ranging from inexplicable disappearances to daring thefts. Thanks to Clever's ingenuity and Bro's courage, they decode clues that others have neglected. Each episode leads them into thrilling adventures where they have to thwart the plans of clever criminals and solve mysteries that defy logic. Through their investigations, they discover not only buried secrets, but also the unwavering strength of their brotherly bond.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: "Wild diving" When Grizzy and Lemmings try to take the last pot of yummy, it flows in the middle of the lagoon and the bear wants to dive underwater.
programme.desc-more: In Canada's vast nature, Grizzy, an imposing bear, enjoys the tranquillity of its territory, a cottage isolated in the middle of the forest. His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: "Did you say blizzard? When Alicia offers Molusco to go snowboarding with him, he pretends to know a ray of it, while he never got on a snowboard. He manages to bring down snow, to train, but quickly the city finds himself caught in a snowstorm that Molusco no longer controls, and Alicia is in danger...
programme.desc-more: When Alicia offers Molusco to accompany him for a day of snowboarding, he, eager not to disappoint, pretends to master the sport, although he never laid a foot on a board. To prepare, he works to create snow artificially, hoping to become familiar with the joys of the slide. However, his clumsy attempts triggered an unexpected snowstorm that plunged the city into chaos. As Molusco desperately tries to control the situation, the storm is intensifying, putting Alicia and her friends in danger. In this winter adventure, Molusco will have to show courage and ingenuity to overcome obstacles and save Alicia, while discovering the real challenges of friendship and honesty. The episode explores with humour and tenderness the themes of bravery and self-confidence, while diving into a frosted universe full of twists.

programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: Coco's Techno has become addicted to his smartphone, but refuses to admit it. Because of his addiction, he causes a whole bunch of disasters, to the point that Rafik and Molusco have to develop different plans to treat him...
programme.desc-more: Coco, a young dynamic and modern man, finds himself trapped in the digital world because of his malady addiction to his smartphone. Although he is aware of the consequences of his behaviour, he stubbornly refuses to admit it, which leads to a series of disasters in his daily life. His friends, Rafik and Molusco, are worried about this downward spiral and decide to intervene. They are putting in place a series of farfelus and comical plans to try to get Coco out of this technological obsession. Between forced disconnection attempts and unexpected interventions, situations are linked, causing hilarious quiproquos. Friends will have to navigate through moments of tension, laughter and reflection, while they seek to save Coco from himself. Over the course of the episodes, the series addresses contemporary themes such as the dependence on screens and the challenges of friendship in the digital age.
