programme.title: Molusco
programme.desc: "The City Hall in Madness" Coco's favorite series is cancelled and Coco is determined to convince the mayor of his mistake. He manages to hypnotize the mayor but unfortunately his system has worked too well...
programme.desc-more: In the episode "The City Hall in Madness" of the series "Molusco", Coco, a young TV enthusiast, is devastated by the cancellation of his favorite series. Refusing to accept this decision, he embarked on a bold mission: to convince the mayor to re-establish the program. Coco is implementing an unconventional method by hypnotizing the mayor, hoping to persuade him of his error. However, his hypnosis system may be working a little too well, plunging the mayor into a state of total confusion. As Coco becomes aware of the unexpected consequences of his act, the situation quickly becomes chaotic. The members of the town hall, as well as the inhabitants of the city, find themselves trained in a series of nasty and unpredictable situations. Between whoproquos and twists, Coco will have to navigate in this disorder to try to restore order while realizing that sometimes it is better to leave things as they are.

programme.title: The treasures of the Paris of the Belle Epoque
programme.desc: From 1880 to 1914, a generation of artists arrived from all over the world in Paris to express their creativity. The Paris of that time shaped the image of Parisienne.
programme.desc-more: From 1880 to 1914, Paris became the capital of the world. During the Belle Epoque, a new generation of artists seeking freedom came from around the world to express their creativity in areas such as architecture, decorative arts, jewellery and advertising. The Paris of this flourishing era will also shape the mythical figure of Parisienne. As the dancers of the French cancan fascinate their audience, Paris celebrates progress and modernity by hosting the largest universal exhibition in history. This documentary explores these treasures of the Paris de la Belle Epoque.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "The secret horde" Benny, the most friendly and popular dog in the neighborhood, suddenly changes his personality. He starts biting after seeing a symbol engraved on a tree in the park.
programme.desc-more: In London's lively Lexington neighbourhood, two brothers, Clever, a lively-minded Indian pig, and Bro, his impulsive brother, are launching investigations that even defy Scotland Yard's abilities. Clever, with an acute sense of observation and an extraordinary intelligence, is often the brain behind their investigations, while Bro, always ready to act without thinking, brings a touch of energy and audacity to their adventures. Together, they are attacking mysterious and complex cases that have left the police perplexed for years. Each episode plunges them into captivating puzzles, where they have to decipher clues, question witnesses and navigate a world of intrigues. As their reputation grows, they attract the attention of enigmatic characters who seek to defeat them. Clever and Bro will have to unite their strengths and talents to solve mysteries that may well change their lives forever.

programme.title: Mystery Lane
programme.desc: "Lexington vampire"Tommy the gutter cat got bitten by a strange bat. His friend Red doesn't believe his eyes: Tommy has become a vampire!
programme.desc-more: In the lively Lexington district of London, two fearsome investigators, Clever, a pig from India with an exceptional flair for observation, and his brother Bro, impulsive and reckless, are attacking mysteries that escape even the experts of Scotland Yard. While the city has been in the grip of unresolved cases for years, Clever uses his intelligence and his sense of deduction to decipher clues that no one else sees, while Bro does not hesitate to plunge head first into action, bringing a touch of unpredictability to their investigations. Together, they explore cases as varied as mysterious disappearances, bold robberies and buried secrets, while encountering formidable opponents. As they journey, the two brothers discover not only the complexity of the crimes they try to solve, but also the strength of their brotherly bond in a world where danger is at every corner of the street.

programme.title: Mystery Lane

programme.title: Oscar & Malika, always late
programme.desc: "Bosse Terry"Malika played a simulation game where one can recreate his whole life, but the changes made in the game also seem to materialize in real life.
programme.desc-more: Every morning, Oscar and Malika, two young neighbours, go to school together. Every morning, their plan to arrive on time is upset by an event as extraordinary as it is improbable. This obliges them to justify themselves to the school principal, Ms. Prudence, who, of course, never believes them. Adventure, humor and surprise are on the programme of this French animation series for children.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: "The Family Reunion"When Dad is accused of having farted Bluey's nose, Mom is organizing a family reunion to clarify the situation.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Belfort & Lupin
programme.sub-title: From the menagerie to the rififi
programme.desc: "From the Rififi to the menagerie"The change of the enclosures of the lama Serge creates a real tsunami at the Household because Madame Rosa does not support her new neighbour.
programme.desc-more: At La Ménagerie, a local zoo, the change of the enclosures of the lama Serge (Alexandre Nguyen) provokes a real agitation. Indeed, Madame Rosa (Barbara Tissier), a passionate and devoted careful woman, cannot bear the presence of this new neighbour with an unpredictable character. Serge, with his mischievous temperament and his tendency to sow disorder, disturbs the well-ordered daily life of the household, where every animal and every employee has their place. The tension between Rosa and Serge, exacerbated by the mockery of other animals, is rising, while the zoo director, Mr. Bouvier (Hugo Brunswick), is trying to find a solution to calm the situation. Over the days, conflicts are increasing, leading to nasty and unforeseen situations. Between rivalries, emerging friendships and the challenge of living together, this episode promises a humorous exploration of inter-animal and human relations, where everyone will have to learn to accept differences.

programme.title: Grizzy and lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy, the empty stomach in front of deserted cupboards, sees the Lemmings operate a distributor for appetizing food, increasing its frustration.
programme.desc-more: In Canada's vast nature, Grizzy, an imposing bear, enjoys the tranquillity of its territory, a cottage isolated in the middle of the forest. His peaceful life was quickly disrupted by a mischievous group of lemmings, determined to challenge his authority and to appropriate the resources he considered his. These little creatures, always in search of adventures, do not retreat in front of anything to thwart Grizzy's plans, transforming every day into a battle of trick and trick. Their hilarious and often chaotic attempts put to the test the patience of the bear, who must use all his strength and intelligence to try to keep control of his territory. Between comical misunderstandings and fierce rivalries, Grizzy must navigate a world where survival is not only a matter of strength, but also of strategy and resourcefulness in the face of these unexpected opponents.

programme.desc: A psychiatrist's office at the end of the day. A final appointment, accepted in a heartbeat. A bipolar patient who claims to have committed the irreparable in the morning and who claims, a few hours later, to be cured, determined to stop his therapy. programme.desc: Because reading is and will remain one of the best ways to escape, François Busnel invites viewers to enter "La P'tite Librairie". On shelves there are novels, essays, great classics or comic books. In short, books to eat without moderation to make the mind travel from its couch. François Busnel proposes every day to discover or rediscover a French or foreign work: novel, essay, great classic or comic strip. In short, this is a good opportunity to get to the page.

programme.title: Malraux, the poetry of action
programme.desc: André Malraux, as ambivalent as he was exciting, has never stopped, both in his lifetime and after his death, unleashing passions. Fifty years after his disappearance, the "real" journey of this self-taught who has made up a destiny is traced. His itinerary is anything but straight. An attempt to steal statues in Cambodia will create a conscience and political commitment. A major anti-fascist fight in the inter-war period succeeds after 1945 a firm commitment to the Buttist alongside De Gaulle. But his commitment is not limited to action. The writer is never far away, for whom words are there to transcend reality and who wants to be the memorialist of his time.

programme.title: The future of the Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: Under the surface of the Coral Sea, off the Australian Queensland, stands the world's largest coral reef, the Great Barrier. Every year, the arrival of spring in this underwater environment generates the magnificent and fragile reproduction of coral. More than 60,000 sea turtles are heading to Raine Island to make it the largest spawning site in the world. Processes as magical as they are threatened by global warming. This documentary offers us an immersive journey into the frenzy of the beginning of life, accompanied by enlightening explanations from local marine explorers and curators.

programme.desc: In a circus game, Bluey is named trackmaster, along with his friends. But Hercules prefers to play the bike game. Fortunately, Bluey finds a solution that pleases everyone.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

As they try to thwart the plans of the fearsome Professor Wolf, they meet Grandma Wolf, the great-hearted grandmother of the wicked wolf, and Bonnie, her fearless cousin. Contrary to the image of Professor Wolf, Grandma Wolf and Bonnie prove to be adorable moat, full of tenderness and wisdom. Grandma Wolf, with her sweetness, even manages to calm her grandson's anger. Meanwhile, Bonnie does not step back in front of anything to protect her rabbit friends, showing remarkable courage. She then turned into a Super Nini, ready to defend her companions against the incessant attacks of her evil cousin. This episode highlights the themes of friendship, family and redemption, while offering moments of tenderness and thrilling action.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa is a mischievous and dynamic pig girl who lives on rewarding adventures with her family, composed of her little brother George, her mom Pig and her dad Pig. In a colorful and fun world, Peppa and George explore their environment while learning to express their emotions and interact with others. Their days are punctuated with games in mud puddles, visits to friends like Suzy Sheep and Pedro Pony, and exciting discoveries, whether by painting, playing hide-and-seek or going to the farm. Through these moments of complicity, young spectators are invited to discover the values of friendship, family and curiosity. Awarded by a BAFTA Award in 2005 for its quality of pre-school animation, this exciting series offers an educational and entertaining universe for toddlers.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. With his little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), they are living thrilling and fun adventures alongside their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig (Richard Ridings). Peppa loves jumping into mud puddles, an activity that gives him immense joy and symbolizes his mischievous spirit. Each episode takes them into a variety of situations, whether on a farm trip, a day at the beach, or even a simple visit to friends. Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters, such as their friend Suzy Sheep (Morwenna Banks) and the teacher, add a touch of magic to their daily lives, making each episode both educational and entertaining.

programme.title: Farm products: to drink and eat?
programme.desc: Farm products represent 4 billion euros in turnover each year in France. Farmers' and producer's co-operative markets are growing, and even large areas offer wide ranges of farm products in their shelves. In the consumer imagination, these products oppose industrial agriculture and are based on all the virtues. The reality is more contrasted. Apart from a few very well-structured sectors, the regulation that defines the farmer label is vague and not binding. To be entitled to it, we must produce and transform on the farm, defined as a single geographical entity.

programme.title: Small animals, big adventures
programme.desc: In Taiwan, a pangolin covered with scales must cross forests and plantations to find a female before the end of the love season. In Brazil, a couple of tamarind-lion struggles to feed their twins in a fragmented forest, between scarcity, rivalries and predators. These two stories reveal the impact of monocultures and the strength of alliances to survive in nature.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: Known for the beauty of its coasts and turquoise waters, Sardinia also draws a large part of its identity from its land and traditions. Behind the postcard landscapes lies a wild and mysterious island, where the steep mountains follow the immense dunes and forgotten villages. Sophie Jovillard is off the beaten track, discovering a more intimate, secret and unsuspecting Sardinia. From ancestral songs to shepherd secrets, from celebrating villages to lands where almost no water is grown, Sophie discovers an island that looks like no other.

programme.title: Malraux, the poetry of action
programme.desc: Fifty years after his death, a return to André Malraux's unusual journey, a fascinating figure who marked and wrote the legend of the twentieth century.
programme.desc-more: André Malraux, as ambivalent as he was exciting, has never stopped, both in his lifetime and after his death, unleashing passions. Fifty years after his disappearance, the "real" journey of this self-taught who has made up a destiny is traced. His itinerary is anything but straight. An attempt to steal statues in Cambodia will create a conscience and political commitment. A major anti-fascist fight in the inter-war period succeeds after 1945 a firm commitment to the Buttist alongside De Gaulle. But his commitment is not limited to action. The writer is never far away, for whom words are there to transcend reality and who wants to be the memorialist of his time.

programme.title: The future of the Great Barrier Reef
programme.desc: Australia is the world's largest coral reef: the Great Barrier. There are processes as magical as they are threatened by global warming.
programme.desc-more: Under the surface of the Coral Sea, off the Australian Queensland, stands the world's largest coral reef, the Great Barrier. Every year, the arrival of spring in this underwater environment generates the magnificent and fragile reproduction of coral. More than 60,000 sea turtles are heading to Raine Island to make it the largest spawning site in the world. Processes as magical as they are threatened by global warming. This documentary offers us an immersive journey into the frenzy of the beginning of life, accompanied by enlightening explanations from local marine explorers and curators.

programme.desc: Bingo pretends to be Bluey's new employee while Dad does exercises in the garden. When Bluey shows Bingo the offices, Dad does the hardest exercise in his life!
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.desc: Superlapin and Super Lou found a little pearl at the pool. They think she belongs to a siren and they're looking for her.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series, Simon Superlapin and his band make a surprising discovery that challenges their prejudices over wolves. As they try to thwart the plans of the fearsome Professor Wolf, they meet Grandma Wolf, the great-hearted grandmother of the wicked wolf, and Bonnie, her fearless cousin. Contrary to the image of Professor Wolf, Grandma Wolf and Bonnie prove to be adorable moat, full of tenderness and wisdom. Grandma Wolf, with her sweetness, even manages to calm her grandson's anger. Meanwhile, Bonnie does not step back in front of anything to protect her rabbit friends, showing remarkable courage. She then turned into a Super Nini, ready to defend her companions against the incessant attacks of her evil cousin. This episode highlights the themes of friendship, family and redemption, while offering moments of tenderness and thrilling action.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, who lives fun adventures with her family and friends. Always ready to explore the world around him, Peppa (John Sparkes) and his little brother George discover the joy of small things, whether by jumping in mud puddles or playing imagination games. Their daily lives are rhythmic with simple but rewarding activities, such as going to the park, visiting friends or learning new words and concepts. Peppa's parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, also play an essential role, bringing life lessons while having fun. Through the wild situations and charming interactions with other characters, such as Suzy Sheep and Danny Dog, the series offers a fun exploration of friendship, family and discovery, captivating young viewers with its stories full of warmth and humour.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. programme.title: Farm products: to drink and eat?
programme.desc: From markets to supermarkets, from mountain farms to mega-farms, from artisans to industrialists, research behind the scenes of the production of "farmers" products.
programme.desc-more: Farm products represent 4 billion euros in turnover each year in France. Farmers' and producer's co-operative markets are growing, and even large areas offer wide ranges of farm products in their shelves. In the consumer imagination, these products oppose industrial agriculture and are based on all the virtues. The reality is more contrasted. Apart from a few very well-structured sectors, the regulation that defines the farmer label is vague and not binding. To be entitled to it, we must produce and transform on the farm, defined as a single geographical entity.

programme.desc: The resistant Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier, known for his decisive testimony at the Nuremberg trial, tells of his communist and anti-fascist commitment.
programme.desc-more: Back to one of the greatest heroines of the 20th century: Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier tells through archives his journey as a French emblematic figure of the Second World War. Initially seduced by Stalin's speeches, she quickly became a communist activist and incorporated as a photographer's reporter the newspaper She is committed to the Resistance and faces Hitlerian ideologies. Arrested and then deported, she will give a decisive testimony at the Nuremberg trial.

programme.title: The 5 lives of the Earth
programme.desc: 800 million years ago, after an episode of extreme glaciation, the Earth experienced an evolutionary leap and saw the emergence of complex life forms.
programme.desc-more: Recent geological analyses have proved the theory that the Earth was, 800 million years ago, completely covered with ice. This period has shaped our planet and is responsible for the world as we know it. Nearly a billion years ago, the Earth was composed of only one immense land mass. This vast, sterile expanse of life was only home to its oceans. A complex phenomenon will then lead to a total recovery of the planet by ice. It is the rapid melting that follows that will lead to the appearance of the first forms of life.

programme.title: Winning return for the kitchen of old
programme.desc: Family cuisine, simmered dishes and the comforting side of Proust made a remarkable return to the table of great chefs and amateur cooks.
programme.desc-more: Once put in the old grimoires, the recipes of old make a frantic return today on social networks, in bookstores and in starred restaurants. This phenomenon, which combines nostalgia, a quest for meaning, conviviality and eco-responsible approach, demonstrates a deep need to reconnect with our roots but also with "good eating". Constance has made her 86-year-old Mamou a social media star by filming her preparing her family recipes. Some restaurateurs, like Jean Sévénes, surf on their childhood memories. Elsewhere, others do not hesitate to rehabilitate the offal or to put the soup in fashion.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo desperately tries to show that she knows how to make the pear while Nana can't make herself useful. Both feel a little lost.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: Neither Simon nor Gaspard want to listen to Grandma Wolf's advice. Professor Wolf doesn't want to listen to his grandmother, but he's wrong.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", Simon and his friend Gaspard find themselves confronted with a dilemma: to listen to the wise advice of Grandma Wolf, their grandmother, or to follow their own instincts. Despite her experience and wisdom, Mamie Wolf (the actress's voice), tries to pass on important life lessons, but the two young boys, full of determination and carelessness, choose to ignore her recommendations. Professor Wolf, also reluctant to pay attention to his own mother's warnings, finds himself in a difficult situation that prompts him to reconsider his attitude. Through comedic situations and unexpected twists, this episode highlights the importance of transmitting family values and listening to previous generations. As the consequences of their choices come to light, Simon and Gaspard will eventually face reality and recognize that sometimes the advice of elders is much more valuable than they think.

Proud of his work, he hastened to show it to his friends Lou and Simon, hoping to share with them the joy of his realization. However, as they return to the sandbox, a big surprise awaits them: the cake was destroyed in an unexpected accident. Devastated by this loss, Gaspard has to face disillusionment and sadness. But with the help of Lou and Simon, he discovers that true magic lies not only in creation, but also in friendship and solidarity. Together, they decide to embark on a new adventure to rebuild the cake, learning on the way valuable lessons about teamwork and resilience.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: François Pécheux sails on the 1000 kilometers of the Loire, the longest river in France, from its source in Ardèche to its estuary in Saint-Nazaire.
programme.desc-more: François Pécheux travels the longest river in France, the Loire, from the Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc, in Ardèche, to the estuary of Saint-Nazaire, where it flows into the Atlantic Ocean. 1,000 km down on a fierce and always unpredictable beauty. The globe-trotter meets enthusiastic guardian angels, solitary freshwater sailors but also well-drained characters and lovers of the Loire River. The journey begins at the foot of thousands of thousand-year-old volcanoes of the Central Massif, where we follow shy balloon meanders. Then the river widens to canoe.

programme.desc: Potatoes, a favourite food for French people, are at risk because of climate change, soil depletion and food security issues.
programme.desc-more: France is not only a major potato consumer, cooked in all its forms, but also the world's largest exporter. Focusing on the Hauts-de-France and Brittany, this potato culture brings with it its lot of problems. Indeed, its production requires a lot of energy and water and damages the soil. France therefore faces a huge challenge, namely to maintain its status as a potato master while taking into account the environmental and economic challenges associated with it.

programme.title: The Spanish flu, the great killer
programme.desc: In 1918, as the Great War left Europe exsangued, an enemy struck, without face or flag. Virulent influenza is spreading on all five continents.
programme.desc-more: The story of a deadly pandemic. It all started in 1918 in a military camp in Kansas where 30,000 men trained because America had just joined the war. On 4 March, about 100 soldiers left training. All suffer from the same symptoms: 40 degrees of fever, sourness, headache and a terrible cough. Despite the fulgurance of the epidemic, no measures are taken to limit contagion. The priority is to send 4 million men to the European front. The virus then spreads rapidly on all 5 continents.

programme.title: Apocalypse Stalin
programme.desc: In three episodes, Isabelle Clarke and Daniel Costelle paint the portrait of the one who was probably one of the most fierce tyrants of the twentieth century.
programme.desc-more: Based on restored and coloured archival images, Isabelle Clarke and Daniel Costelle painted the portrait of the dictator from 1878 to 1945. The first episode goes back to the incredible ascent of Georgian Jugashvili. In 1917 he was part of the Bolsheviks, along with Lenin, who seized power in Russia and set up a regime of terror while the civil war torn the country apart. Marked and supported by Lenin, Jugashvili made himself indispensable and became Stalin, the "man of steel". Possed by his Marxist "mission", he waged a war to death with Hitler twenty years later.

programme.title: Apocalypse Stalin
programme.desc: In 1942, after arresting the Germans in front of Moscow, Stalin faced Hitler's second assault and the fate of the world was played in Stalingrad.
programme.desc-more: In 1942 Stalin managed to stop the Germans in front of Moscow and now faced Hitler's second assault. In Stalingrad and Leningrad, men, women and children are plunged into hell and sacrificed for their country. Years earlier, when Lenin died, Stalin had put in place cold maneuvers to eliminate all his opponents, beginning with Trotsky, and take power. By his victories in Stalingrad and Leningrad, the tyrant is treated equally by his American and British allies, and thus becomes one of the most powerful men on the planet.

programme.title: Apocalypse Stalin
programme.desc: In 1944, the Soviets finally completed their liberation and, on the way to Berlin, discovered the horror of Hitler's extermination camps.
programme.desc-more: In 1944, the Soviets completed their liberation and discovered the horror of Hitler's extermination camps. Fifteen years earlier Stalin had imposed terror and had undertaken to transform his country by all means. The zeks, gulag's bagards, built giant factories, kolkhozes, colossal dams and marble columns of the Moscow metro. Magnified beyond reasonableness, Stalin rose in 1945 to the rank of half-god. Nine million soldiers and twenty million civilians died so that he could become the master of the world.

programme.title: Alexandria's Lighthouse: the latest secrets
programme.desc: Thanks to AI and the unprecedented underwater excavations, a team of archaeologists was able to reconstruct in 3D the famous lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the seven wonders of the world.
programme.desc-more: In the sea off Alexandria, under several meters of water, lies the remains of one of the seven wonders of the ancient world: the legendary lighthouse of Alexandria. For nearly 30 years, archaeologist Isabelle Hairy and her team have been exploring thousands of blocks to reconstruct the history of this extraordinary monument. Today, an exceptional operation is being prepared. The most monumental remains of the lighthouse, some of which weigh several dozen tons, will be re-assembled and digitized. Thanks to new technologies enriched by AI, the archaeologist will be able to establish a virtual replica of the lighthouse and show the genius of its architects.

programme.title: A house, an artist
programme.sub-title: André Malraux, the secrets of a giant
programme.desc: In 1945, André Malraux, 44, rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt, where he began a new period of creation.
programme.desc-more: André Malraux, a committed writer, first and most famous of the ministers of culture, knew how to put art into action as a person. Yet this historical figure of the Thirty Glorys hides a secret man, who never let anything appear, nor his intimacy, nor the dark hours he had passed through in the early 1960s. In 1945, after the resistance and the fighting, André Malraux, 44, dropped down his arms and rented the first and second floors of a large villa in Boulogne-Billancourt. As a new man, the famous pre-war novelist, author of "The Hope" and Goncourt Prize with "The Human Condition", begins a new period of creation.

programme.title: Migraine: the end of the puzzle?
programme.desc: Almost one in six Frenchmen suffer from migraine, a disease that is often misunderstood, and whose medical care is at the heart of a medical revolution.
programme.desc-more: Eleven million French people suffer from it. Yet migraine remains one of the most misunderstood and minimized diseases. Behind this common word is a fearsome neurological condition, capable of displacing those who suffer for hours, days, sometimes a lifetime. What's going on in a migraine's brain? Thanks to recent advances in brain imaging, researchers are beginning to penetrate the secrets of this complex disease, which remains invisible to conventional examinations. Today, the management of migraine is at the heart of a medical revolution that also raises many questions.

programme.desc: With French people more concerned than ever about the repercussions of the various political, health, social, economic, energy and war crises in Ukraine and the Middle East, intellectuals, artists and protagonists at the centre of the news come to bring their expertise to a debate. Karim Rissouli and Camille Diao, accompanied either by Laure Adler or Arthur Chevallier, receive several guests who provide answers to the questions that are topical while revealing their ideas. Ideas are the stars of this event, which highlights a diversity of views on the complexity of the world.

programme.title: The bookstore
programme.sub-title: The time we sang, by Richard Powers
programme.desc: Because reading is and will remain one of the best ways to escape, François Busnel invites viewers to enter "La P'tite Librairie". On shelves there are novels, essays, great classics or comic books. In short, books to eat without moderation to make the mind travel from its couch. François Busnel proposes every day to discover or rediscover a French or foreign work: novel, essay, great classic or comic strip. In short, this is a good opportunity to get to the page.

programme.title: It's In The Air (C dans l'air)
programme.desc: Journalists Caroline Roux (Monday to Thursday) and Aurélie Casse (Friday and Saturday) report together with experts on what is happening and give viewers the keys to understanding and understanding it in its entirety. The end of the program is dedicated to questions posed by viewers via SMS, Internet or social networks.

programme.title: Your Turn (C à vous)
programme.desc: Culture, politics, economy... In a Parisian loft, Anne-Elisabeth Lemoine and her group of columnists discuss and exchange around the most diverse news, live. The presenter is surrounded by Patrick Cohen, Pierre Lescure, Aurélie Casse alternately with Emilie Tran Nguyen, Mohamed Bouhafsi, Lorrain Sénéchal and Bertrand Chameroy. During the show, where they receive several guests, each presents a chronicle. During the first part of the program, a chef cooks a dish that they then taste in C to you, the continuation, the second part of the program.

programme.title: C to you next
programme.desc: Anne-Élisabeth Lemoine (Monday to Thursday) and Mohamed Bouhafsi (Friday and Saturday) present you the meeting of all those who are making the political, economic, societal and cultural news !. In the kitchen, a chef prepares a simple and original dinner.

programme.title: The Treasures of Shu's Kingdom
programme.desc: In southwestern China, an archaeological excavation site bears witness to a sophisticated civilization that upsets the history of ancient times.
programme.desc-more: A team of archaeologists, historians and scientists have uncovered a city that has been forgotten for millennia in southwestern China. They try to lift the veil on this great civilization until then unknown, upsetting the history of antiquity. Thousands of objects, bronze, jade and gold relics, dating back more than three thousand years, are back in the light. The site is a testimony to a sophisticated civilization with advanced metallurgy, complex urban planning and a rich belief system centered on the cult of the sun. The history of this fascinating international scientific inquiry offers a renewed reading of the origins of ancient China.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: It's Dad's turn to prepare breakfast and take the kids to school, but Bluey and Bingo aren't going to make it easy for him to be on time.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Simon
programme.sub-title: I don't want to go to the pool.
programme.desc: Simon, who fears his first session at the pool with his class, discovers that his friend Lou is also very afraid, so he pulls himself together and reassures her.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and lively world, Simon, a little mischievous rabbit with a wide toothed distance, navigates through the daily challenges of life with an overflowing curiosity. With a lively imagination, Simon does not step back to explore his environment, whether by playing with friends or discovering creative solutions to seemingly simple problems. Each episode of his adventure confronts him with situations that teach him valuable lessons about friendship, sharing and courage. With his companions, he learns to overcome the little fears of childhood, while cultivating his joyful and endearing personality. Simon thus becomes a model for his comrades, proving that even the youngest can face delicate situations with humour and determination. Through his experiences, he demonstrates that growing up means meeting challenges, but also enjoying the moments of joy and friendship that make everyday life look better.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: Swimming competition for Simon! Too much pressure! Fortunately Dad is here with his good ideas, his benevolence: Simon you will succeed!
programme.desc-more: In a sunny environment where children's imagination reigns in master, Simon (Mathias Casartelli) is a young boy passionate about gliders. One day, as he devoted himself to his passion, he saw Ferdinand (Angèle Humeau), his comrade, making an incredible cardboard plane with wheels. Emerged by Ferdinand's creation, Simon eagerly wants to try it. Ferdinand, benevolent, accepts, but imposes a condition: Simon must first push him to test his invention. After several attempts, excitement turns into frustration when lunchtime arrives, and Simon has to leave the game. Back in the world, he discovered that Ferdinand once again wanted him to push him, which caused Simon to get angry and return to his glider, taking his brother with him. However, the happiness of the two brothers attracted Ferdinand, who, eager for camaraderie, sought to join them in their laughter and games. This quest for sharing and friendship illustrates the dynamics of childhood and the quest for inclusion.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa Pig is a little slut full of life and imagination who lives thrilling adventures with her family and friends. Always ready to explore the world around him, Peppa, accompanied by her little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), her father Pig (Richard Ridings) and her mom Pig (Morwenna Banks), embarks on daily adventures. Whether it's to play in the mud, his favorite passion, or to go to birthday parties, each episode is an opportunity to discover valuable life lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters such as Suzy Sheep and Danny Dog each bring their unique touch to these enchanting stories. With a touch of humour and a dose of tenderness, Peppa Pig invites young viewers to laugh while identifying themselves with the crazy and moving situations of daily life.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. With his little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), they are living thrilling and fun adventures alongside their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig (Richard Ridings). Peppa loves jumping into mud puddles, an activity that gives him immense joy and symbolizes his mischievous spirit. Each episode takes them into a variety of situations, whether on a farm trip, a day at the beach, or even a simple visit to friends. Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters, such as their friend Suzy Sheep (Morwenna Banks) and the teacher, add a touch of magic to their daily lives, making each episode both educational and entertaining.

Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters, such as their friend Suzy Sheep (Morwenna Banks) and the teacher, add a touch of magic to their daily lives, making each episode both educational and entertaining.

programme.title: The roads of the impossible
programme.sub-title: Alaska, the adventurers of the cold
programme.desc: In the winter in Alaska, with its procession of extreme temperatures, ice and blizzard, all travel is risky, but some are still on the road.
programme.desc-more: In Alaska, the cold turns water into an ice highway, a vital route for the locals but very dangerous for those who venture where the ice is not thick enough. The oil hauliers encounter another danger, the avalanches. The roads are sometimes impassable, so pilots earn their lives on short flights, but the cold can easily damage their gear. The gold researchers are ready to brave the cold water and blizzard to try their luck in this lucrative business. While global warming is very much affecting the region, new dangers are emerging.

programme.title: Living away from the world
programme.desc: Ben Fogle is leaving for Iceland, where he shares the daily life of Hákon Hjördisarson, a former businessman who left the city for wildlife.

programme.title: The Lost Amazonian Civilization
programme.desc: In the Amazon rainforest, a team of archaeologists and botanists are looking for traces of a thousand-year-old and extinct civilization.
programme.desc-more: In the Colombian Amazonian forest, the French archaeologist Stéphen Rostain goes on the trail of the first Indians who, according to him, migrated and lived on these lands 13,000 years ago. If many d-archaeologists doubt this theory, the best evidence available to Stéphen is a rock fortress covered with paint based on mineral pigments. While the origin and meaning of these signs are still widely open to interpretation, they represent a wildlife much different from that we know.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: Known for its exceptional landscapes, its soft golden hills, its rows of cypress trees, its vineyards and its crystal clear waters, Tuscany is a paradise where dolce vita reigns. Jerome Pitorin walks around this fascinating region, especially in Florence, which is full of Renaissance treasures.
programme.desc-more: Jerome Pitorin goes to Tuscany to discover one of the most beautiful regions in the world. His journey began on Elbe Island to visit the house in which Napoleon lived during his exile and to walk on the mountainous paths. From there, he can see the island of Capraia, where he visits Alessandro, who has left everything to become a goat breeder. Back on the continent, he visited the largest cities in the region: Florence, Livorno, Lucca and Siena. He discovers magnificent cathedrals, Italians passionate about their cultural heritage and a strange local sport.

programme.title: Your Turn (C à vous)
programme.desc: Culture, politics, economy... In a Parisian loft, Anne-Elisabeth Lemoine and her group of columnists discuss and exchange around the most diverse news, live. The presenter is surrounded by Patrick Cohen, Pierre Lescure, Aurélie Casse alternately with Emilie Tran Nguyen, Mohamed Bouhafsi, Lorrain Sénéchal and Bertrand Chameroy. During the show, where they receive several guests, each presents a chronicle. During the first part of the program, a chef cooks a dish that they then taste in C to you, the continuation, the second part of the program.

programme.desc: Anne-Élisabeth Lemoine (Monday to Thursday) and Mohamed Bouhafsi (Friday and Saturday) present you the meeting of all those who are making the political, economic, societal and cultural news !. In the kitchen, a chef prepares a simple and original dinner.

programme.title: Belly pain: our intestinal struggles
programme.desc: While one in two Frenchmen regularly suffers from digestive disorders, how do they take care of their stomach and what are the keys to a good digestion?
programme.desc-more: One in two Frenchmen regularly suffers from digestive disorders. Often trivialized, sometimes invisible, these stomach aches can become a real handicap in everyday life. Behind these symptoms is a fascinating and complex organ: our digestive system. From irritable bowel syndrome to gastroesophageal reflux, through microbiota, this documentary explores the latest scientific knowledge about our "second brain" and gives keys to proper digestion, whether it be food or stress and emotional management.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc: Taki is a lovely little tanuki who lives in the forest with her little sister Taya and her parents. programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: In a colorful and lively world, Simon, a little mischievous rabbit with a wide toothed distance, navigates through the daily challenges of life with an overflowing curiosity. With a lively imagination, Simon does not step back to explore his environment, whether by playing with friends or discovering creative solutions to seemingly simple problems. Each episode of his adventure confronts him with situations that teach him valuable lessons about friendship, sharing and courage. With his companions, he learns to overcome the little fears of childhood, while cultivating his joyful and endearing personality. Simon thus becomes a model for his comrades, proving that even the youngest can face delicate situations with humour and determination. Through his experiences, he demonstrates that growing up means meeting challenges, but also enjoying the moments of joy and friendship that make everyday life look better.
programme.desc-more: In a sunny environment where children's imagination reigns in master, Simon (Mathias Casartelli) is a young boy passionate about gliders. One day, as he devoted himself to his passion, he saw Ferdinand (Angèle Humeau), his comrade, making an incredible cardboard plane with wheels. Emerged by Ferdinand's creation, Simon eagerly wants to try it. Ferdinand, benevolent, accepts, but imposes a condition: Simon must first push him to test his invention. After several attempts, excitement turns into frustration when lunchtime arrives, and Simon has to leave the game. Back in the world, he discovered that Ferdinand once again wanted him to push him, which caused Simon to get angry and return to his glider, taking his brother with him. However, the happiness of the two brothers attracted Ferdinand, who, eager for camaraderie, sought to join them in their laughter and games. This quest for sharing and friendship illustrates the dynamics of childhood and the quest for inclusion.

One day, as he devoted himself to his passion, he saw Ferdinand (Angèle Humeau), his comrade, making an incredible cardboard plane with wheels. Emerged by Ferdinand's creation, Simon eagerly wants to try it. Ferdinand, benevolent, accepts, but imposes a condition: Simon must first push him to test his invention. After several attempts, excitement turns into frustration when lunchtime arrives, and Simon has to leave the game. Back in the world, he discovered that Ferdinand once again wanted him to push him, which caused Simon to get angry and return to his glider, taking his brother with him. However, the happiness of the two brothers attracted Ferdinand, who, eager for camaraderie, sought to join them in their laughter and games. This quest for sharing and friendship illustrates the dynamics of childhood and the quest for inclusion.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Peppa Pig is a little slut full of life and energy that invites young viewers to dive into her colorful and playful world. With his little brother George (Harley Bird), his mom Pig (Morwenna Banks) and his dad Pig (Richard Ridings), Peppa explores the world around him with curiosity and a touch of impertinence. Each episode presents daily situations, ranging from games in the mud to visits to friends, farm adventures or beach trips. The characters meet friends such as Suzy Sheep (Lily Snowden-Fine) and Danny Dog, each bringing a unique touch to the stories. Through lessons on friendship, family and imagination, Peppa and her loved ones discover the joy of the little moments of life, often punctuated with laughter and surprises. This animated series, delicate and full of humor, captivated the hearts of children while awakening their curiosity about the world.
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. With his little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), they are living thrilling and fun adventures alongside their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig (Richard Ridings). Peppa loves jumping into mud puddles, an activity that gives him immense joy and symbolizes his mischievous spirit. Each episode takes them into a variety of situations, whether on a farm trip, a day at the beach, or even a simple visit to friends. Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters, such as their friend Suzy Sheep (Morwenna Banks) and the teacher, add a touch of magic to their daily lives, making each episode both educational and entertaining.

programme.title: Peppa Pig

Surrounded by her little brother George, Mom Pig and Papa Pig, she explores the world around her with curiosity and enthusiasm. Both children embark on daily adventures, whether they jump into mud puddles, visit the zoo or play with their friends. programme.title: Lucie in the Land of the Rising Sun
programme.desc: Two years after their American epic, Jérémy Michalak took the Lyon stylist Lucie Carrasco, with a neuromuscular genetic disease, to Japan. The journey will last ten days. The young woman will discover the capital, Tokyo, Mount Fuji. Then she will visit the beautiful Kyoto city and the Hiroshima memorial.

programme.title: On the casoar track
programme.desc: Anthropologist Florence Brunois-Pasina takes a film crew to the borders of inner Papua New Guinea to immerse themselves in the Kasua people, whom she has been around for 30 years. Guided by their hosts in the primary tropical forest, they set off together on the casoar trail. This large, considered dangerous terrestrial bird is considered by the natives as the great gardener of the forest. He disperses the seeds, a skill that gives him a role as sower and connector of the forest sectors, as well as as a nourisher of the Kasuas who live from the collection and gathering. Neither god nor totem, the casoar is a cornerstone of their world.

programme.sub-title: I want to make a tractor.
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 2 of the Simons series
programme.desc-more: In a sunny environment where children's imagination reigns in master, Simon (Mathias Casartelli) is a young boy passionate about gliders. One day, as he devoted himself to his passion, he saw Ferdinand (Angèle Humeau), his comrade, making an incredible cardboard plane with wheels. Emerged by Ferdinand's creation, Simon eagerly wants to try it. Ferdinand, benevolent, accepts, but imposes a condition: Simon must first push him to test his invention. After several attempts, excitement turns into frustration when lunchtime arrives, and Simon has to leave the game. Back in the world, he discovered that Ferdinand once again wanted him to push him, which caused Simon to get angry and return to his glider, taking his brother with him. However, the happiness of the two brothers attracted Ferdinand, who, eager for camaraderie, sought to join them in their laughter and games. This quest for sharing and friendship illustrates the dynamics of childhood and the quest for inclusion.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: In a colorful and lively world, Simon, a little mischievous rabbit with a wide toothed distance, navigates through the daily challenges of life with an overflowing curiosity. With a lively imagination, Simon does not step back to explore his environment, whether by playing with friends or discovering creative solutions to seemingly simple problems. Each episode of his adventure confronts him with situations that teach him valuable lessons about friendship, sharing and courage. With his companions, he learns to overcome the little fears of childhood, while cultivating his joyful and endearing personality. Simon thus becomes a model for his comrades, proving that even the youngest can face delicate situations with humour and determination. Through his experiences, he demonstrates that growing up means meeting challenges, but also enjoying the moments of joy and friendship that make everyday life look better.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: "The hearing exam" During an auditory examination, Peppa and his family discover that George needs an acoustic device. After a personalized fit, George hears much better and everyone is happy! Peppa is delighted to show her the sounds!
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little slut full of life and energy, always ready to explore the world around her. With his little brother George (Lily Snowden-Fine), they are living thrilling and fun adventures alongside their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig (Richard Ridings). Peppa loves jumping into mud puddles, an activity that gives him immense joy and symbolizes his mischievous spirit. Each episode takes them into a variety of situations, whether on a farm trip, a day at the beach, or even a simple visit to friends. Through these moments of play and discovery, Peppa and George learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and sharing. Colourful characters, such as their friend Suzy Sheep (Morwenna Banks) and the teacher, add a touch of magic to their daily lives, making each episode both educational and entertaining.

programme.title: On behalf of the lost children
programme.desc: In the 1930s, the great reporter Alexis Danan began a long fight to secure the closure of the children's bagnes in France.
programme.desc-more: In 1934, 56 young prisoners, aged 13 to 21, rebelled and escaped in the Belle-Ile-en-Mer correction house. Hunted by the inhabitants, fishermen and estivants, they are captured and violently punished. The case is scandalous and moves France as a whole. Alexis Danan, a great reporter in Paris-Soir, then launched himself in the fight of his life: denouncing the inhuman conditions of these children's bagnes, awakening opinion and getting the closure of these "houses of tortures". The terrible testimonies and revelations he delivers shake the country. Several detention centres were closing and the first reforms of juvenile justice were finally being implemented.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: "La Loire"François Pécheux sails on the 1000 kilometers of the Loire, the longest river in France, from its source in Ardèche to its estuary in Saint-Nazaire.
programme.desc-more: François Pécheux travels the longest river in France, the Loire, from the Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc, in Ardèche, to the estuary of Saint-Nazaire, where it flows into the Atlantic Ocean. 1,000 km down on a fierce and always unpredictable beauty. The globe-trotter meets enthusiastic guardian angels, solitary freshwater sailors but also well-drained characters and lovers of the Loire River. The journey begins at the foot of thousands of thousand-year-old volcanoes of the Central Massif, where we follow shy balloon meanders. Then the river widens to canoe.

programme.title: Photomaton, the great story of the little photo
programme.desc: Back to the popular, artistic and intimate epic of Photomato, which, by making the photographer disappear, invented a unique face-to-face with our own image.
programme.desc-more: Invented in New York in 1926 by Anatol Josepho, the Photomaton will revolutionize photography by putting the portrait at the reach of all. Two years later, the small automatic cabin arrived in Paris. Very quickly, she becomes much more than a machine: she makes memories as much as identity photos, and inspires artists, from surrealists to Andy Warhol, from Roland Topor to Pierre and Gilles. Promised to disappear with the arrival of digital and smartphone, the old silver cab is now experiencing an unexpected revival with a generation that grew up with social networks.

programme.title: Doctor David, King Doctor
programme.desc: Jean-Joseph David, a physician and military with an unusual destiny, alone embodies the ambiguities of the colonial system, where medicine was also an instrument of power.
programme.desc-more: Jean-Joseph David, a doctor and military doctor, landed on the island of Wallis in 1933, and was responsible for treating the population while strengthening French influence. But over the years, he far surpassed this role: he became a leading figure, and was nicknamed "Te Hau Tavite", King David. Through the journey of this fascinating and controversial figure, inhabited by humanist ideals or devoured by its ambitions, reveals a unknown facet of the history of colonization: that where medicine becomes a tool of power, between care and control.

programme.title: Simon
programme.desc: It's Super Hero Day, and Simon (Loti Bailey) is looking forward to wearing his flamboyant Super Rabbit costume. His enthusiasm was contagious, and his brother Gaspard (Mathias Casartelli) joined him in dressing up as Captain Rabbit. Together, they have fun having breakfast playing superheroes, ready to tackle their first mission: saving their faithful companion Milou, who is in the garden. However, the time to go to school is approaching, and Simon has to face reality. His father finally gave him permission to go into class in disguise, which filled him with pride. Upon his arrival, classmates were amazed by his daring costume, inciting a variety of reactions. Ferdinand, one of her friends, is worried that the mistress does not see this eccentric outfit with a good eye. To their surprise, the mistress (Joanna Ruiz) warmly welcomes Super Rabbit, adding a touch of adventure to this school day.
programme.desc-more: In a sunny environment where children's imagination reigns in master, Simon (Mathias Casartelli) is a young boy passionate about gliders. One day, as he devoted himself to his passion, he saw Ferdinand (Angèle Humeau), his comrade, making an incredible cardboard plane with wheels. Emerged by Ferdinand's creation, Simon eagerly wants to try it. Ferdinand, benevolent, accepts, but imposes a condition: Simon must first push him to test his invention. After several attempts, excitement turns into frustration when lunchtime arrives, and Simon has to leave the game. Back in the world, he discovered that Ferdinand once again wanted him to push him, which caused Simon to get angry and return to his glider, taking his brother with him. However, the happiness of the two brothers attracted Ferdinand, who, eager for camaraderie, sought to join them in their laughter and games. This quest for sharing and friendship illustrates the dynamics of childhood and the quest for inclusion.

programme.title: Alexandria's Lighthouse: the latest secrets
programme.desc: Thanks to AI and the unprecedented underwater excavations, a team of archaeologists was able to reconstruct in 3D the famous lighthouse of Alexandria, one of the seven wonders of the world.
programme.desc-more: In the sea off Alexandria, under several meters of water, lies the remains of one of the seven wonders of the ancient world: the legendary lighthouse of Alexandria. For nearly 30 years, archaeologist Isabelle Hairy and her team have been exploring thousands of blocks to reconstruct the history of this extraordinary monument. Today, an exceptional operation is being prepared. The most monumental remains of the lighthouse, some of which weigh several dozen tons, will be re-assembled and digitized. Thanks to new technologies enriched by AI, the archaeologist will be able to establish a virtual replica of the lighthouse and show the genius of its architects.

programme.title: At the end it's the sea
programme.desc: «La Loire»On the way down more than 1000 km to the estuary of Saint-Nazaire, François Pécheux discovers the Loire, a river with a changing and wild nature.
programme.desc-more: François Pécheux travels the longest river in France, the Loire, from the Mont Gerbier-de-Jonc, in Ardèche, to the estuary of Saint-Nazaire, where it flows into the Atlantic Ocean. 1,000 km down on a fierce and always unpredictable beauty. The globe-trotter meets enthusiastic guardian angels, solitary freshwater sailors but also well-drained characters and lovers of the Loire River. The journey begins at the foot of thousands of thousand-year-old volcanoes of the Central Massif, where we follow shy balloon meanders. Then the river widens to canoe.

programme.title: Family secret at the Orsay Museum
programme.desc: The masterpieces of the Musée d'Orsay invite us to explore the transformations of French society and family over four generations, from 1848 to 1914.
programme.desc-more: A mysterious photo album, "Denise and Jacques: True story by Emile Zola" is stored in the Orsay Museum reserves. Who are these two children? In the course of a genealogical survey, the fate of a popular family over four generations, between Paris and Burgundy, is revealed. Through their lives, the great upheavals of the 19th century are emerging: industrial revolution, rural exodus and wars. A saga at the Zola, with the illustrious writer in her own role, whose peripets come to life, canvas after canvas, in the masterpieces of the Musée d'Orsay, striking testimonies of their time.

programme.title: Life and nothing else
programme.desc: In 1920, an officer sought to identify the bodies of soldiers who had died at the front, with a view to returning them to families. Two women join in his task.
programme.desc-more: In 1920, in the north of France, Irene (Sabine Azema), a beautiful and rich bourgeois woman, and Alice (Pascale Vignal), a young unemployed teacher, wandered on the path in search of their husbands and engaged never returned from the front. Near Verdun, the two women crossed the road of Commander Delaplane (Philippe Noiret), a high-ranking military officer charged with identifying and identifying dead and missing in the ruins. The latter is charged by General Villerieux (Michel Dushoesoy) to find within four days an anonymous body that will have the honour of being buried in the grave of the unknown soldier under the Arc de Triomphe.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: "By car" With only five minutes to play "By car", Bluey and Mom are running against the clock to buy the milk required by a grincheuse guest.
programme.desc-more: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: "The Car Trip" Mama helps Bluey and Bingo find games ideas for fun in the car while Dad tries to stay in front of a convoy of gray nomads.
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: "Play with us Elvis"In the garden, Simon and Gaspard play with Elvis. But the dog never stays with them for long, more interested in a butterfly or cat.
programme.desc-more: In a sunny garden, Simon and Gaspard have fun with their faithful companion, the Elvis dog. However, the enthusiasm of the duo is quickly put to the test, because Elvis, always in search of adventures, seems more captivated by the wonders of nature than by his young masters. While Simon (voice of the actor) and Gaspard (voice of the actor) try to keep Elvis' attention, he moves away, attracted by a colorful butterfly flying in the air. Every attempt by children to bring their four-legged friend back is a comic failure, transforming their afternoon into a real treasure hunt. Between the wild races and the bursts of laughter, Simon and Gaspard discover that friendship with a pet can sometimes be as unpredictable as it is enriching. This playful episode shows with tenderness the ties that connect children with their animals, while celebrating the magic of outdoor games.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: "We want to play everything!"Simon and Lou meet at the park to play. But what game do you start with? Both friends want to play football, elastic, slide and hide-and-seek.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting episode of season 2 of "Simon Superlapin", Simon (who plays the main character) and his faithful friend Lou meet at the park, eager to enjoy a sunny day dedicated to games. As they settle on the green grass, a question arises: what game to start with? The two friends, overflowing with energy and imagination, are faced with an exciting choice. They are considering playing football, imagining spectacular goals, but the idea of jumping to the elastia makes them dream of strong sensations. The slide, with its dizzying descents, and the hide-and-seek game, promising bursts of laughter and moments of suspense, complete their list of activities. Through this day, Simon and Lou will learn not only the importance of friendship and sharing, but also to navigate between their desires and to choose together the game that will make their adventure unforgettable.

programme.title: Simon Superlapin
programme.desc: "The Mega Trampoline"The little Bunie moat offers Superlapin and Super Lou to compete for a trampoline in the cave of the villain Professor Wolf, because he is not there.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Simon Superlapin", the little Bonnie moat, full of energy and enthusiasm, offers his friends Superlapin and Super Lou to participate in a trampoline competition. The place chosen for this promising event is the cave of the fearful Professor Wolf, a villain known for his sneaky plans, but who is absent for the moment, thus offering a golden opportunity to have fun without fear. As the three friends prepare for this acrobatic adventure, they discover that the cave holds much more than trampolines. Indeed, clever traps and unexpected challenges await them, testing their courage and team spirit. Laughters mix with twists, and every jump becomes a new opportunity to learn about friendship and bravery. But the question remains: will they manage to escape Professor Wolf's machiavelic plans once he returns?

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: "A cold day in winter"It's very cold on this winter day but Peppa and George decided to go play at the park. All the water puddles are frozen, so the two children must find other sources of distraction...
programme.desc-more: Peppa is a little mischievous sow who lives in a colorful and joyful world surrounded by her pig family. She shares her life with her little brother George, who is still armed with her teddy dinosaur, as well as with their parents, Mom Pig and Papa Pig. Together, they engage in a multitude of daily adventures that lead them to explore their surroundings, whether they are on park trips, farm visits or beach trips. Peppa loves jumping in mud puddles, an activity that triggers laughter and joy. Peppa's friends, such as Suzy Sheep and Pedro Pony, often join their games, adding a touch of friendship and camaraderie to their experiences. Each episode highlights simple lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while offering a fun glimpse of life through the eyes of a small sow full of life and curiosity.

Not to mention the crocodile and crab hunt.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.desc: What if the Pyrénées-Orientales had much more to offer than their postcard landscapes? Between the turquoise waters of the Mediterranean and the peaks of the Pyrenees, Jérôme Pitorin travels a territory of high colour, where one cultivates an art of living well apart. From the colourful streets of Collioure to the dizzying citadels, from wild coves to vineyards suspended between the sky and the sea, the Pyrénées-Orientales reveal all the richness of their contrasts. During his meetings, Jérôme Pitorin discovers a land of character, where Catalan pride is lived and passed on to the daily. In the language, songs, dances, gastronomy or know-how, the inhabitants perpetuate a legacy to which they are deeply attached.
programme.desc-more: From the traditional "bouches" to the new Confluence district, the Lyon journalist shows local specialities. She went on a walk through the streets of Lyon with chef Grégory Cuilleron and the guide-concert Jean-Luc Chavent. Subjects: Lyon mothers or the art of perpetuating culinary traditions • In the course of the Saône, Confluence • The Paul Bocuse Institute: the art of exporting culinary know-how • The mysteries of Lyon • The wonders of the Golden Head Park • The Lyon balls.

programme.title: Beautiful escapes
programme.sub-title: Namibia, a miracle in the middle of the desert
programme.desc: A land of beauty and contrast, Namibia is a real jewel of southern Africa. The vast desert of Namib and its diversity of wildlife attract travellers who want to discover an African country less known than its neighbours, Tanzania and Kenya. Twelve major ethnic groups coexist in the country. Some of them live in self-serving communities, far from urban unrest, but the majority combine traditions and integration into modern society, like the Owambo, which make up almost half of the population.
programme.desc-more: Sophie Jovillard visits Windhoek, the capital, and Swakopmund.. This seaside resort on the Atlantic coast is the gateway to the north of the Skeleton Coast and the Namib Desert, to the south. The latter offers breathtaking panoramas. Namibia was one of the first countries in the world to anchor nature conservation in its constitution, proud of its grand landscape and wildlife. Today, 15% of the territory is protected. This is the case with Etosha National Park, one of the country's five wildlife reserves.

programme.title: Revelations, 200 years of photography
programme.desc: By making the images, the voices of the great photographers and the music, this film traces two hundred years of photographs of the world around us.
programme.desc-more: For two centuries, we have been photographing the world to try to grasp the truth, to keep track of it or to fix its beauty. Made up exclusively of photographs, this documentary offers a sensitive crossing of our visual history. From the first experiments to images of the 21st century, the words of great photographers, iconic and contemporary artists accompany this exploration of what photography has changed in our relationship to the world. It has made the invisible visible, upset our certainties, shaped our memories and transformed our way of telling history.

programme.title: The fabulous history of the Ambroise Vollard collection
programme.desc: The fabulous collection of modern art works by Ambroise Vollard had a stumbling block after the death of the art dealer in 1939.
programme.desc-more: In 1979, when the employees of Société Générale opened one of the unpaid safes, they discovered about 200 paintings of the greatest painters of the century. The collection is identified as belonging to Ambrose Vollard, a mythical art merchant, who died in 1939. A skilled businessman, this Reunionnais revealed Cézanne, Gauguin and Matisse. While he had left clear instructions for his legacy, World War II was going to slam everything and trigger a long battle to recover his works, from Serbia to Canada.

programme.title: Instagram/TikTok, the network war
programme.desc: Through Instagram and TikTok, the phones of billions of users have become the new battlefields of rivalry between Washington and Beijing.
programme.desc-more: Behind the telephone screens is a new cold war between the United States and China. In less than twenty years, Instagram and TikTok have become digital empires, able to capture billions of users every day. Long undisputed queen of social networks, the American Instagram saw an unexpected rival emerge: TikTok, a Chinese application whose revolutionary algorithm has changed the rules of the game. Both platforms shape our worldview, influence our opinions and worry to the highest spheres of power. In this technological war, all blows are allowed.

programme.title: Yesili
programme.desc: "The muffle"The budding builders attack the Eiffel Tower, but in Kapla. Only the final touch is missing, but be careful not to break everything!
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the "Yetili" series, young budding builders are embarking on a bold challenge: to reproduce the famous Eiffel Tower using blocks of Kapla. Armed with their overflowing imagination and team spirit, they work to assemble each piece carefully, while trying to capture the essence of this iconic monument. As they approach the final touch of their masterpiece, the tension rises. Children must be creative and cautious in order to avoid falling down their delicate structure. The laughter and the moments of camaraderie intertwine with the perpetencies, but an unforeseen threat threatens to compromise everything. Young architects must then demonstrate resilience and ingenuity to overcome obstacles, proving that even in times of doubt, friendship and collaboration can lead to extraordinary achievements.
