programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs and McGee are taking a psychological assessment to get back to their positions. Both agents and their colleagues are investigating a crime in parallel.
programme.desc-more: Gibbs (Mark Harmon) and McGee (Sean Murray) are still missing after being sent to Paraguay to track down a group of rebels. Two months go by without news, plunging their colleagues into growing concern as they try to find them. Meanwhile, Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama) must prepare to testify before Congress about the circumstances of this failed mission. Their concern is dispelled when Gibbs and McGee reappear, but their return is marked by traumas during their journey to South America. Before returning to their duties, they must undergo a psychological assessment to ensure their mental condition. Once the team is assembled, they re-enter the investigations, discovering the body of a missing lieutenant, found in a cemetery by workers. This macabre discovery leads to a new series of investigations that will test the team's skills.

programme.sub-title: The secret of the black pearl
programme.desc: On an island in the Philippines, isolated on a hostile beach, in the heart of a wild nature, reality TV candidates, more accustomed to luxury and comfort, will have to survive with almost nothing. In teams of two, they will have to learn how to manage daily life on the beach, where hunger, lack of sleep and stories, but also the different events. Indeed, to keep their place on the island the Apprentices-Aventurers will have to surpass themselves. If the adventure is too difficult, they will have only one alternative: ring the bell to give up.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Inspector Higgins disappears: NCIS is conducting the investigation. Ducky, for his part, went to Scotland to teach at the University of Edinburgh. Palmer's replacing him.
programme.desc-more: Gibbs (Mark Harmon) and McGee (Sean Murray) are still missing after being sent to Paraguay to track down a group of rebels. Two months go by without news, plunging their colleagues into growing concern as they try to find them. Meanwhile, Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama) must prepare to testify before Congress about the circumstances of this failed mission. Their concern is dispelled when Gibbs and McGee reappear, but their return is marked by traumas during their journey to South America. Before returning to their duties, they must undergo a psychological assessment to ensure their mental condition. Once the team is assembled, they re-enter the investigations, discovering the body of a missing lieutenant, found in a cemetery by workers. This macabre discovery leads to a new series of investigations that will test the team's skills.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: A Marine was murdered. The investigations soon revealed that his attackers could be linked to a gang that Torres had investigated in the past.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting new season of NCIS, the team of specialized agents, led by the intrepid Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), finds itself confronted with a series of complex and intriguing cases involving Navy personnel. Their investigation begins with the mysterious disappearance of a man, which occurred six months earlier, and which seems to be a crucial clue to a recent car explosion. As they explore this case, a new mystery arises: the tragic death of a woman whose body was found after a fall of a building. The victim's doctor, reluctant to share information about his or her background, becomes an issue for Gibbs, who must convince him or her to collaborate. Barely this resolved case, Gibbs, accompanied by Palmer (Brian Dietzen) and Quinn (Emily Wickersham), set out at sea to elucidate the murder of a marine, testing their ingenuity and determination. This 14th season promises to be rich in suspense and rebound.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: Everyone knows Joan of Arc, Louis XIV, Napoleon, Vercingétorix. Their cousins, on the other hand, did not enter history... \" La Petite Histoire de France \" decided to fix this mistake! Through 4 epochs - the Year 1 and the periods Jeanne d'Arc, Louis XIV and Napoleon - relive the history of France through those who deserved to be known... Or not!

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: Everyone knows Joan of Arc, Louis XIV, Napoleon, Vercingétorix. Their cousins, on the other hand, did not enter history... \" La Petite Histoire de France \" decided to fix this mistake! Through 4 epochs - the Year 1 and the periods Jeanne d'Arc, Louis XIV and Napoleon - relive the history of France through those who deserved to be known... Or not!
programme.desc-more: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: On Halloween night, while Palmer is convinced that his lab is haunted, Torres arrives at a crime scene and discovers that he knows a victim.
programme.desc-more: Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), the NCIS director, finds himself in a desperate situation after being abducted by Hakim, a ruthless terrorist. Forced to produce a video in which he supports Afghan fighters, Vance desperately seeks a way to convey a message to his agents. After his release, he has to face the consequences of this traumatic experience while recovering from his injuries. At the same time, Officer Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon) is engaged in a complex investigation into the death of a soldier found sluggish in his jacuzzi, a case that is particularly delicate and enigmatic. As the team tracks a bomb-layer responsible for several attacks, Gibbs, who aspires to a well-deserved vacation, is forced to resume service to capture a fugitive robber. This sixteenth season explores Gibbs' mysterious past in depth, revealing unexpected facets of his history.

programme.desc: Two months after Gibbs and McGee disappeared on a mission to Paraguay, their NCIS colleagues refused to abandon the search.
programme.desc-more: Gibbs (Mark Harmon) and McGee (Sean Murray) are still missing after being sent to Paraguay to track down a group of rebels. Two months go by without news, plunging their colleagues into growing concern as they try to find them. Meanwhile, Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama) must prepare to testify before Congress about the circumstances of this failed mission. Their concern is dispelled when Gibbs and McGee reappear, but their return is marked by traumas during their journey to South America. Before returning to their duties, they must undergo a psychological assessment to ensure their mental condition. Once the team is assembled, they re-enter the investigations, discovering the body of a missing lieutenant, found in a cemetery by workers. This macabre discovery leads to a new series of investigations that will test the team's skills.

programme.title: Take 2
programme.desc: A former CIA agent with special skills ripped his daughter out of the hands of a mob gang. A year later, the clan leader demanded revenge.
programme.desc-more: After the death of his son, Murad (Rade Šerbedžija), an Albanian criminal, is determined to avenge his loss. His quest for revenge led him to track down the author of this murder, Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson), a former CIA agent whose formidable skills were put to the test. While Bryan is on a mission to Istanbul for a rich Saudi Sheikh, he is pleasantly surprised by the unexpected visit of his daughter Kim (Maggie Grace) and former wife Lenore (Famke Janssen), who come to spend a few days with him. However, their family reunion quickly turns dark when Bryan notices that a car is following them, pointing out that they are under surveillance. By trying to explain to Lenore how to escape their pursuers, the danger is getting tighter around them. In a tragic turn, Lenore was captured, forcing Bryan to act quickly to save her. As he warns Kim over the phone to hide, every second counts and the tension rises. Bryan must once again draw on his past and use his contacts and expertise to prevent the tragedy from reoccurring.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: A former American intelligence officer learns that his 18-year-old daughter was abducted in the heart of Paris. He immediately began to search for him.
programme.desc-more: In "Taken", Paris' vibrant and often deceptive universe becomes the scene of a haletante hunt. Bryan Mills (Liam Neeson), a former secret agent in Los Angeles, saw his world collapse when he reluctantly agreed to let his 17-year-old daughter, Kim (Maggie Grace), travel to Paris with his best friend, Amanda. Although concerned, Bryan does not know that this idyllic journey will quickly turn into an unimaginable nightmare. Just arrived in Roissy, the two teenage girls crossed the path of a mysterious man, Peter. What begins as a promising adventure takes a dramatic turn when Albanian mafia are calling on young girls and brutally kidnapping them in their apartment. When he learns the bad news, Bryan immediately sets course for France. Determined, he has only four days to find his daughter, taking advantage of all his skills as a secret agent. In a race against time, he must navigate in a dark and dangerous world, where every false step could cost Kim's life.

programme.title: Foreign Legion: A Month in the Heart of Green Hell
programme.desc: Thirty-five elite soldiers face extreme training in the Amazon to obtain the badge of specialist of the foreign legion in hostile jungle.
programme.desc-more: Dive in the Amazon jungle, 35 elite soldiers of the French army, aged 20 to 45, must pass the most difficult military training. Guided by the formidable instructors of the Foreign Legion, they will have to push their physical and mental limits. Survival, strict discipline, obstacle racing, combat techniques... nothing is left to chance. All candidates are aiming for the prestigious badge of Amazonian forest specialists, but only the strongest and most enduring will go through these tests.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs (Mark Harmon) and McGee (Sean Murray) are still missing after being sent to Paraguay to track down a group of rebels. Two months go by without news, plunging their colleagues into growing concern as they try to find them. Meanwhile, Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama) must prepare to testify before Congress about the circumstances of this failed mission. Their concern is dispelled when Gibbs and McGee reappear, but their return is marked by traumas during their journey to South America. Before returning to their duties, they must undergo a psychological assessment to ensure their mental condition. Once the team is assembled, they re-enter the investigations, discovering the body of a missing lieutenant, found in a cemetery by workers. This macabre discovery leads to a new series of investigations that will test the team's skills.
programme.desc-more: Within the Naval Criminal Investigative Service, an elite unit specializing in crimes related to the Marines, terrorists or spy networks, a team with a variety of profiles and complementary work in the shadows to unravel intrigues where betrayals, lies and loyalty are met. Led by Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), a former Marine sniper with a turbulent past and legendary reputation, the agents combine surgical intuition with unconventional methods. With him, Timothy McGee (Sean Murray), a brilliant but sometimes too methodical analyst, and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama), a former agent infiltrated with explosive charisma, form a duo as effective as unpredictable. Completing the Ellie Bishop team (Emily Wickersham), a specialist in criminal psychology with formidable instincts, Jimmy Palmer (Brian Dietzen), a medical examiner with a heart, and Kasie Hines (Diona Reasonover), an expert in forensics whose analytical intelligence often saves the bet. Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. With him, Timothy McGee (Sean Murray), a brilliant but sometimes too methodical analyst, and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama), a former agent infiltrated with explosive charisma, form a duo as effective as unpredictable. Completing the Ellie Bishop team (Emily Wickersham), a specialist in criminal psychology with formidable instincts, Jimmy Palmer (Brian Dietzen), a medical examiner with a heart, and Kasie Hines (Diona Reasonover), an expert in forensics whose analytical intelligence often saves the bet. Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs (Mark Harmon) and McGee (Sean Murray) are still missing after being sent to Paraguay to track down a group of rebels. Two months go by without news, plunging their colleagues into growing concern as they try to find them. Meanwhile, Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll) and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama) must prepare to testify before Congress about the circumstances of this failed mission. Their concern is dispelled when Gibbs and McGee reappear, but their return is marked by traumas during their journey to South America. Before returning to their duties, they must undergo a psychological assessment to ensure their mental condition. Once the team is assembled, they re-enter the investigations, discovering the body of a missing lieutenant, found in a cemetery by workers. This macabre discovery leads to a new series of investigations that will test the team's skills.

programme.title: It's only the truth that matters
programme.desc: The iconic duo Pascal Bataille and Laurent Fontaine offer participants a rare space where words are freed. On the program: true stories, reunions, confessions, second chances... And always this inimitable concept: a curtain, a revelation, a decision. Faced with what their loved ones have never dared to tell them, will the guests agree to join them on the other side of the curtain or will they go on their side?

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

Led by Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon), a former Marine sniper with a turbulent past and legendary reputation, the agents combine surgical intuition with unconventional methods. With him, Timothy McGee (Sean Murray), a brilliant but sometimes too methodical analyst, and Nick Torres (Willer Valderrama), a former agent infiltrated with explosive charisma, form a duo as effective as unpredictable. Completing the Ellie Bishop team (Emily Wickersham), a specialist in criminal psychology with formidable instincts, Jimmy Palmer (Brian Dietzen), a medical examiner with a heart, and Kasie Hines (Diona Reasonover), an expert in forensics whose analytical intelligence often saves the bet. Not to mention Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), director of NCIS, whose strategic decisions weigh heavily in the course of investigations, and Alden Parker (Gary Cole), a former FBI profile whose arrival is changing the established dynamics.

programme.title: The little history of France
programme.desc: In a humorous and offbeat approach, this series highlights characters close to major historical figures of France, such as Vercingetorix, Jeanne d'Arc and Napoleon. Through a series of sketches in various historical contexts, the writers offer an unprecedented look at the landmarks of the past. Each episode plunges the spectator with humour into the daily lives of these iconic figures and their loved ones, often contrasted with the weight of history.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Leon Vance (Rocky Carroll), the NCIS director, finds himself in a desperate situation after being abducted by Hakim, a ruthless terrorist. Forced to produce a video in which he supports Afghan fighters, Vance desperately seeks a way to convey a message to his agents. After his release, he has to face the consequences of this traumatic experience while recovering from his injuries. At the same time, Officer Leroy Jethro Gibbs (Mark Harmon) is engaged in a complex investigation into the death of a soldier found sluggish in his jacuzzi, a case that is particularly delicate and enigmatic. As the team tracks a bomb-layer responsible for several attacks, Gibbs, who aspires to a well-deserved vacation, is forced to resume service to capture a fugitive robber. This sixteenth season explores Gibbs' mysterious past in depth, revealing unexpected facets of his history.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Alain and Valentine have expanded their business and added a marriage agency to their makeover activity. A client calls Valentine to save her couple.
programme.desc-more: Accused of murder, Jessica (Bénédicte Delmas) finds herself behind bars, while her colleagues at the Academy continue their rehearsals, determined not to let this tragedy start their passion for the show. When she was released, Jessica invested herself in her life, but fate was subject to other trials. Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), for her part, learns that Louis (Romeo Sarfati) must undergo a cardiac transplant, a news that further complicates the dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, Mathias (Lionel Auguste), who was the victim of an accident, faced a difficult reality after losing the use of her legs. Jessica's health is deteriorating, because she discovers that she has breast cancer. Followed by Laure at the Gulf Clinic, she refuses to let her disease define her existence. This thirteenth season is marked by dramatic events that upset the daily lives of this joyful band, facing unprecedented emotional and physical challenges.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: It's by chance that Jane is uncovering an organized network of human trafficking. Lisbon is thinking about Pike's proposal to join him in Washington.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: Hunting guarded
programme.desc: Just set up in its new house in the countryside, a couple discover that their neighbors use their garden as a hunting ground.
programme.desc-more: Adelaide (Camille Lou), an ambitious architect, and Simon (Didier Bourdon), a passionate musician, aspire to a radical change in their family life. Ereinth by the frantic rhythm of Parisian life and eager to regain a sense of their existence, they decided to leave the capital to settle in the picturesque village of Saint-Hubert-des-Bois. There, they discover a house that seems to be the perfect setting for their children, Romy and Leon. The transition to rural life begins under the best auspices, between walks in the middle of nature and moments of complicity. However, their tranquillity is quickly undermined with the beginning of the hunting season. The new neighbours, Bernard (Thierry Lhermitte) and Michel (Jean-François Cayrey), armed and on the alert, transform their dream of serenity into a disturbing reality. Adelaide and Simon will have to navigate between their desire for peace and the tensions that this new life generates.

programme.title: Supercondriaque
programme.desc: A doctor tries to find a woman for her 40-year-old hypochondriac friend, lonely and bulky. But this one falls in love with the practitioner's sister.
programme.desc-more: Romain Faubert (Dany Boon), a 39-year-old man, is a hypochondriac convinced that every small evil is a sign of a serious illness. His life is a true journey of the fighter, rhythmic by his incessant medical consultations and his maladic anxieties. His friend Dimitri Zvenka (Kad Merad), a professional doctor, is overwhelmed by Roman's often unfounded warnings. Despite his friendship and dedication, Dimitri is convinced that the key to Roman's well-being lies in the meeting of a companion who could ease his fears. The situation becomes more complicated when Dimitri's sister Anna (Alice Pol), who is distinguished by her altruism in welcoming Cherkistan refugees, confuses Romain with Anton Miroslav, the charismatic leader of the Cherkist revolution. This contempt leads Romain into a series of hilarious quiproquos, while he tries to navigate between his own anxieties and the expectations of others. As tensions intensify and the rock-capped situations accumulate, Romain will have to face his inner demons while adapting to a world that is foreign to him. The stakes then become crucial, and more than ever he will have to overcome his fears to find his place. This film, mixing humour and tenderness, explores the themes of friendship, love and the quest for identity, in a whirlwind of nasty and touching situations.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: A woman, who filed a complaint against a well-known athlete, discovers the slowness of the justice system. She then decides to take charge.
programme.desc-more: In the bustling streets of New York, the Special Unit for Victims, led by the Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) determined, is facing disturbing cases that test their skills and humanity. In this 21st season, inspectors, including the faithful Fin Tutuola (Ice-T) and the insight Kat Tamin (Jamie Gray Hyder), are delving into complex investigations of sexual crimes, child abuse and domestic violence. Each episode reveals the emotional and moral challenges that team members face as they navigate between the pain of victims and the quest for justice. Unity, often confronted with failing systems and prejudices, must also manage its own internal struggles, while striving to restore hope and dignity to the people it serves. The series, rich in drama and tension, offers a free-ranging look at often neglected realities.

programme.desc: A new crime leads investigators to wonder if the Zodiac killer would not be back after being silent for forty years.
programme.desc-more: Jennifer Jareau replaced Prentiss, whose death was recorded seven months earlier. Morgan swore he'd get his killer, Ian Doyle. Morgan finds himself in trouble with his family. His cousin Cindi may not be as dead as he claimed. Prentiss may not be that dead either. Kevin has other concerns in mind. He blames Garcia for being too close to Morgan. Bank attacks put the team on their teeth. In guest-star, polars author Patricia Cornwell delivers a lecture in one of the episodes of this seventh season.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Jessica and Paolo are homeless for a few days because their house is invaded by wood chips. Manuel is in charge of disinfection.
programme.desc-more: Accused of murder, Jessica (Bénédicte Delmas) finds herself behind bars, while her colleagues at the Academy continue their rehearsals, determined not to let this tragedy start their passion for the show. When she was released, Jessica invested herself in her life, but fate was subject to other trials. Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), for her part, learns that Louis (Romeo Sarfati) must undergo a cardiac transplant, a news that further complicates the dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, Mathias (Lionel Auguste), who was the victim of an accident, faced a difficult reality after losing the use of her legs. Jessica's health is deteriorating, because she discovers that she has breast cancer. Followed by Laure at the Gulf Clinic, she refuses to let her disease define her existence. This thirteenth season is marked by dramatic events that upset the daily lives of this joyful band, facing unprecedented emotional and physical challenges.

programme.title: Welcome to the Christmas Hotel
programme.desc: A young woman must take over the acting leadership of a new hotel in her hometown, whose inhabitants stubbornly refuse to open.
programme.desc-more: While she hoped to become general manager of a luxury hotel in Rome, Erin had to take over the acting management of a new establishment in her small hometown. In order to convince the inhabitants who oppose its opening, it creates L-Hotel de Noël.

programme.title: The Christmas Train
programme.desc: A cynical journalist, boarded a Washington-Los Angeles train to try to find inspiration to write about his father, finds an old love.

programme.title: Christmas under the sign of destiny
programme.desc: A man and a woman help an old woman on the street. From that day on, their paths are constantly crossing. Hasard or fatality?

programme.title: Christmas Waltz
programme.desc: While she takes dance classes to open the wedding ball, a young woman learns that her fiancé has to leave for professional reasons.
programme.desc-more: Avery is a young woman who succeeds and works in a large cabinet As she was about to get married as Christmas approached, Avery decided to leave David, her fiancé, a perfect man in appearance. He asked her to postpone their wedding, yet she decided to keep the dance class she had to take with him for the opening of the ball, where she met Nicky, a young boy full of training, and Roman, a client who encouraged her to take several lessons. But at that time David told him he had accepted a promotion and that he had to go to Boston.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Jane could be prosecuted for the murder of Red John. Cho and Abbott are continuing their investigation into human trafficking.
programme.desc-more: After gradually reducing his list of suspects concerning Red John, the serial killer who upset his life, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker) finds himself facing an increasingly complex dilemma. The closer he approaches the identity of the murderer, the more he intensifyes his acts of violence, sowing terror around him. Despite the traps set by Red John, Jane is perceptive and manages to expose the criminal. However, their explosive confrontation forces Jane to flee the country to escape the threat she faces. Two years later, Teresa Lisbon's team (Robin Tunney) was dissolved, and Van Pelt (Amanda Righetti) and Rigsby (Owain Yeoman) began a new life together. As Jane lives under a false identity, a new opportunity presents itself to him, marking the beginning of a season full of tensions and revelations, with the arrival of new characters, including Kim Fischer (Emily Swallow) and the FBI agent, who bring an unexpected dynamic to the plot.

programme.title: Mentalist
programme.desc: Patrick Jane and Lisbon are working together on a new investigation to clarify the murder of an FBI agent, who was allegedly killed on a undercover mission.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating seventh season of Mindalist, Patrick Jane (Simon Baker), a former consultant for the California Bureau of Investigation, is teaming up with the FBI to solve a series of particularly complex homicides. After finally ending his personal quest for revenge against Red John, the famous serial killer, Patrick now focuses on new criminals, revealing unrivalled observation and deduction skills. Teresa Lisbon (Robin Tunney), now a permanent member of the FBI, is providing unwavering support to Patrick, strengthening their professional partnership while exploring the dynamics of their relationship. Together, they face cases that go beyond mere murders, plunged into intrigues of psychological manipulation and mind games. The challenges are increasing as characters with dark motivations enter the stage, and Patrick Jane has to navigate through a world of mysteries where nothing is ever really what it seems.

programme.title: Daily, first part
programme.desc: A great information session that combines humour and impertinence. French and international politics, media, culture, sport: all topics are reviewed. Each show has a carte blanche to deal with the news in its own way.

programme.title: Daily, part two
programme.desc: Yann Barthès and his team offer you an essential appointment combining information, culture, sport and humour. This dynamic show offers a complete overview of the current situation, addressing various topics with a serious and light tone. A moment of intelligent entertainment to stay informed while relaxing.

programme.title: Quotidien Daily Show
programme.desc: This program offers a talk show based on current facts. Presented by former Little Journal host Yann Barthès, the show is broadcast in prime time access every day of the week. Between immersive reports, chronicles, interviews, "Quotidien" offers a condensation of the current affairs thanks to columnists such as Jean-Michel Aphatie, Amber Chalumeau, Julien Bellver, Étienne Carbonnier and Pablo Mira. The show also hosts several guests, both French and international. Concerts are even held on the stage.

programme.title: The Tomorrow War
programme.desc: Time travelers warn that 30 years later, humanity will lose a war against aliens. Dan Forester joins the struggle to save the world.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of a football match broadcast around the world, time suddenly seems to stop. Futuristic soldiers in armor, covered with dust and blood, appearing on the ground, carrying a terrifying message: in thirty years, humanity will be on the brink of extinction, decimated by a merciless war against a ruthless alien race. Governments, panicked, have no choice but to launch a desperate programme: to recruit civilians and military today to send them to fight in a future apocalyptic. Among them, Dan Forester (Chris Pratt), a former soldier converted to a professor of history, found himself propelled despite him on the front lines of a war he had not chosen. In this ravaged world where cities are nothing but ruins and where the fast and deadly alien creatures dominate the land, Dan discovers that the survival of humanity rests on an impossible equation: to change the course of history before it is too late. His only ally is Colonel Muri Forester (Yvonne Strahovski), a future scientist and elite fighter whose strategic knowledge could make a difference. But as battles continue in bloody chaos, Dan realizes that the keys to victory may well hide in his own past. His father, who had been missing for years, might have crucial answers to reverse the fate of the planet.

programme.title: The Lord of the Rings: the two towers
programme.desc: To save the world, two young, fearless hobbits must throw an evil ring into the fire of a volcano, and their friends face a powerful witch.
programme.desc-more: In Middle Earth, where the shadows of Sauron spread more and more daily, the struggle for the survival of free peoples reached a decisive turning point. Frodo Sacquet (Elijah Wood), carrying the Unique Ring, and his tireless companion Sam Gamegie (Sean Astin) continue their exhausting march towards the Mordor, a cursed territory where every step brings them closer to their destiny. Their route, sown with tangles and despair, is now guided by a disturbing presence: Gollum (Andy Serkis), a creature torn between his visceral hatred for the Hobbits and his sickly obsession with the Ring. Sometimes ambiguous allies, sometimes creeping threats, Gollum leads them through mortal marshes and hostile mountains, where every decision could seal their fate. Meanwhile, the Ring Community, dispersed but not defeated, faced its own trials. Aragorn (Viggo Mortensen), heir to a throne he still refuses to assume, Legolas (Orlando Bloom), the mortally shot elf, and Gimli (John Rhys-Davies), the dwarf in the heat of fire, are pursuing the monstrous Uruk-hai creatures of Saraumane, who have taken away their young companions Merry (Dominic Monaghan) and Pippin (Billy Boyd). Their quest leads them to Rohan, a kingdom where legendary riders see their strength slashed under the corrupt influence of Sarumane. There they discovered Theoden (Bernard Hill), a broken king, manipulated by the fates of the enemy, whose people were on the brink of annihilation.

programme.desc: Three sisters gather to celebrate what might be their last Christmas in their childhood home, which their parents plan to sell.

programme.title: My target for Christmas
programme.desc: A young woman, taken by her schedule, can't organize Christmas with her friends. But it may well be that love is mixed up in the situation.

programme.desc: The Christmas market pastry contest is not as Mia hoped, who saw her grandmother as the winner. The arrival of his ex doesn't make it any better.

programme.title: Hercules Poirot

programme.title: Hunger Games: The Rebellion, Part Two
programme.desc: Panem is under the control of the tyrannical President Snow. Katniss, the leader of the rebellion, and his closest friends will try to eliminate the despot.
programme.desc-more: In the smoking ruins of Panem, where the revolt roared like a storm ready to burst, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) awakened, both physically and morally. Saved in extremes by the rebels of District 13, an underground bastion led by President Coin (Julianne Moore) led by an iron hand, she discovers a world where war is no longer a distant threat, but a daily reality. Around her, her most loyal allies – Haymitch Abernathy (Woody Harrelson), an alcoholic strategist with a worn heart, and Plutarch Heavensbee (Philip Seymour Hoffman), master of shadows and manipulations – are preparing a final offensive against the Capitol. But Katniss, who had become the living symbol of rebellion, also bore the weight of the lives broken by his struggle. The situation gets complicated when Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson), saved from the claws of the Capitol, returns changed. Under the influence of a brainwash orchestrated by President Snow (Donald Sutherland), he oscillates between lucidity and violence, unable to distinguish the enemy from the ally. For Katniss, seeing it as it is, torn between love and hatred, is a far more unbearable torture than his own wounds. Yet it has no choice: war requires sacrifices, and every decision could mean the death of innocent people. As traps multiply, Snow, master of power games, prepares his final shot. Aware that Katniss is the greatest threat to his regime, he is developing a diabolical plan to discredit, break it, and destroy the hopes of the districts. Between psychological attacks, unexpected betrayals and political schemes where no one really is what he claims to be, Katniss must navigate in a maze of lies.

programme.title: Hunger Games: The Rebellion, Part One
programme.desc: Gathered by the rebels of District 13, Katniss, symbol of the revolt, is going to search for his friend Peeta, who was embezzled in the Capitol camp.
programme.desc-more: After cutting the bully of the Capitol to the ashes of the arena, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) now embodies much more than just a survivor: she has become, despite herself, the face of a revolution. Exiled in District 13, a former underground military base headed by an iron hand by President Alma Coin, Katniss discovers a society organized for the war, where every decision could change Panem's destiny. But the young woman, marked by the trauma of the Games and the loss of those she loves, must overcome her own demons to take on this role. Advised by her closest allies – including Plutarch Heavensbee, a wise strategist, and Gale Hawthorne, her childhood friend – she is preparing to wage a much bigger battle than anything she has ever known. Its goal: to save Peeta Mellark, prisoner of the Capitol and victim of brainwashing, while uniting the districts under the same banner.

programme.title: Happy Christmas
programme.desc: Decided not to spend Christmas alone with his wife, a man invites an uncontrollable retiree for Christmas Eve, a decision he quickly regrets.
programme.desc-more: Vincent Barand (Franck Dubosc), a father determined to perpetuate the tradition of a New Year's Eve gathering all his family, announced the end-of-year celebrations under very dark auspices. While his wife Beatrice is trying to keep her calm, the announcements fall one by one: their son Baptist, who is in hospital, is on guard and cannot be released; their daughter Agathe is about to fly with her husband Cyril and their children to a secret destination, a "Christmas gift" that will take them away from the family home; Maxime, their eldest son, persists in his silence and resentment towards Vincent, an ancient resentment that seems impossible to appease. Refusing to see the magic of Christmas fainting, Vincent, stubborn and inventive, decided to take charge. Rather than resigning to a morose New Year's Eve, he embarked on an initiative as bold as he was expected: inviting a retirement home resident to share their meals. Monique, a woman with a well tempered character and a lively mind, crossed the threshold of the Barands. But if Vincent hoped to give a little warmth back to this evening, he had not anticipated the overflowing energy and the very specific desires of Monique. She, far from contenting herself with a simple polite presence, has only one obsession: to find her best friend Jeanne, with whom she has always celebrated Christmas.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Christmas markets and department stores: the madness of the biggest rush of the year
programme.desc: Every year, the magic of Christmas invades the cities of France. A month before December 25, illuminations, wooden chalets, or regional specialities are emerging. In the middle of a rush, one of France's largest hypermarkets opened its doors. A team went to immersion with staff to live one of the most important days of the year. Behind the scenes of this store, amazing techniques are used to lure the customer. In the face of the giants of distribution, another war is taking place in the Christmas markets. A team visited two mythical markets: Paris and Strasbourg, self-proclaimed capital of Christmas with its 300 chalets. But are the regional specialities offered to visitors, including the famous hot wine, always very authentic? How can we avoid traps?

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: "Pretty to everything"Sarah, competing with Iris for a show, hurts his back during a rehearsal. Laure asks her to rest, but the girl doesn't want to hear anything...
programme.desc-more: Accused of murder, Jessica (Bénédicte Delmas) finds herself behind bars, while her colleagues at the Academy continue their rehearsals, determined not to let this tragedy start their passion for the show. When she was released, Jessica invested herself in her life, but fate was subject to other trials. Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), for her part, learns that Louis (Romeo Sarfati) must undergo a cardiac transplant, a news that further complicates the dynamics of the group. Meanwhile, Mathias (Lionel Auguste), who was the victim of an accident, faced a difficult reality after losing the use of her legs. Jessica's health is deteriorating, because she discovers that she has breast cancer. Followed by Laure at the Gulf Clinic, she refuses to let her disease define her existence. This thirteenth season is marked by dramatic events that upset the daily lives of this joyful band, facing unprecedented emotional and physical challenges.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Burglars, thefts and assaults: tension for the Avignon police
programme.desc: Avignon, a city with 460,000 inhabitants, is a destination best known for its tourist attraction. But home-jacking, theft of luxury products in stores and young miners involved in drug trafficking are part of the city's daily life. To preserve the softness of life, 466 police officers are mobilized every day, in particular to fight against thefts of all kinds. The police are called for theft of a sweater worth nearly 600 euros. The police also intervene on homejackings, domestic violence robberies, in the presence of the inhabitants. But Avignon is also a city surrounded by sensitive neighbourhoods that are plagued by drug trafficking. Sebastien, a 24-year-old police officer, is increasingly dealing with minors, recruited as resellers.

programme.title: 90' Investigations
programme.sub-title: Pursuit races and flagrantes delictos with the LAC of Avignon
programme.desc: Sandro, Tony, Jean-Marc and Jérôme are part of the BAC of Avignon, which ensures the safety of the 90,000 inhabitants of the Cité des Papes. In their daily fight against drug trafficking, these shock police officers find themselves confronted with highly organized networks that compete with ingenuity to constantly install new drug deals. These officers also track traffickers whose illegal trade is exploding, including smugglers of cigarettes. Fred and Tony got their hands on a nice pactole. At night, it is mostly thieves and burglars who give the police a twist. LAC men and women can also be on the front line on party nights or large football matches that sometimes warm up minds.
programme.desc-more: In Avignon, delinquency does not stop at the edge of the walls of the city of the Popes. To ensure the safety of its 90,000 inhabitants, the police are mobilized night and day. Among them, LAC operates on the front line in the fight against all kinds of trafficking, robbery and burglary. The magazine's team followed in their daily lives, as close as possible to their mission, Sandro, Tony, Jean-Marc and Jérôme.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: "Corruption on all floors"Kim, Rollins' sister, reports the practices of a doctor, who issues analgesic prescriptions in return for sexual intercourse.
programme.desc-more: In the bustling streets of New York, the Special Unit for Victims, led by the Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) determined, is facing disturbing cases that test their skills and humanity. In this 21st season, inspectors, including the faithful Fin Tutuola (Ice-T) and the insight Kat Tamin (Jamie Gray Hyder), are delving into complex investigations of sexual crimes, child abuse and domestic violence. Each episode reveals the emotional and moral challenges that team members face as they navigate between the pain of victims and the quest for justice. Unity, often confronted with failing systems and prejudices, must also manage its own internal struggles, while striving to restore hope and dignity to the people it serves. The series, rich in drama and tension, offers a free-ranging look at often neglected realities.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: The whole band is at Nathan and Haley's to spend Thanksgiving with their family and friends. Nothing's gonna happen as planned.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: On October 6, 2010, Véronique Duchesne, 47, disappeared in Saint-Quay-Portrieux. Three days later, his body was found at Minard's tip. His relatives think of suicide but the reality is quite different: Véronique Duchesne was strangled. The investigation is stale for years, for lack of evidence.
programme.desc-more: For more than 16 years, Véronique Duchesne's relatives have been hoping to get answers. On October 6, 2010, this 47-year-old mother left to buy cigarettes in Saint-Quay-Portrieux, Côtes-d'Armor. Three days later, his body was found at Minard's tip. If his relatives think first of suicide, the reality is quite different: Véronique Duchesne was strangled. The lack of witnesses and evidence has resulted in years of investigation. From Brittany to Senegal's prisons, through Morocco, investigations are increasing until the truth finally breaks out. On September 21, 2026, at the assize court of Saint-Brieuc, Thierry Meunier, the husband of Véronique Duchesne, declared his innocence in the box of the accused. *False suicide, real murder: the Véronique Duchesne puzzle* *Adam Young's mysterious death*
programme.desc: For more than 16 years, Véronique Duchesne's relatives have been hoping to get answers. If his relatives think first of suicide, the reality is quite different: Véronique Duchesne was strangled. The lack of witnesses and evidence has resulted in years of investigation. From Brittany to Senegal's prisons, through Morocco, investigations are increasing until the truth finally breaks out. programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: Strangled and buried under a slab of concrete: this is the horrific fate reserved for Aurélie Vaquier, a young, sparkling, solar woman who had just settled in Bédarieux, in the hinterland of Hérault. programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Evelyne, head of the midwives of the maternity ward of Marne-la-Vallée private hospital, will soon retire after forty years of passion.
programme.desc-more: At the maternity centre of Marne-la-Vallée private hospital in Île-de-France, a team of fifteen midwives is mobilized to look after over 1,900 births that produce there each year. programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: A strong storm will come down on the city. The authorities are trying to deal with this by warning the population. The lives of the inhabitants are in danger.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In France, one in twenty newborns has a mother over 40 years of age. The pregnancies of these women, which are more risky than others, are particularly monitored.
programme.desc-more: Alexandra decided to have a child at 44 years of age, requiring a major follow-up of her pregnancy and a scheduled delivery in Caesarean section. If she awaits the happy event with serenity, her companion José questions her parenthood in her 40s. Astrid, however, is waiting for her second little boy, but is concerned about the weight of her baby, which has exceeded her term by a few days. Finally, Ana is about to give birth to her son after having had a lot of difficulty accepting and managing the miscarriage of her previous pregnancy.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: It was a short night for Brooke, who buried her young girl's life. When she wakes up, she realizes she's not wearing her engagement ring anymore.
programme.desc-more: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: A huge battle for the wealth of the Solitary Mountain is being prepared between the armies of the Dwarfs, the Elves, the Humans, the Wrags and the Orcs.
programme.desc-more: The Middle Earth trembles under the assaults of an ancient threat, while the shadows of war spread over its lands. At the heart of this chaos, Smaug le Doré, a dragon with incandescent scales and thirst for insatiable destruction, pours out his devastating fury on Lac-Ville. The flames licking the roofs, the screams of terror echoing in the alleys, the city seems condemned. Yet in the midst of this disaster, Bard (Luke Evans), an archer with unfailing courage, stands. Armed with his own determination and assisted by his son, he confronts the beast in a desperate battle, where every arrow could seal the fate of thousands of souls. The fall of the dragon gives a breath of hope to the survivors, but peace remains fragile, almost illusory. Meanwhile, under the majestic vaults of the Solitary Mountain, Thorin Écu-de-Chêne (Richard Armitage) and his dwarve company are plagued with a curse far more insidious than the blades of their enemies: the madness of gold. The treasure of the dragon, gathered in the depths of the lost kingdom, exercises a mortal grip on them, corrupting their hearts and threatening to tear their fraternity. Thorin, once noble and wise, darkened into a growing paranoia, ready to do anything to keep his spoil, even at the price of the loyalty of his brothers and sisters. Around him, tensions rise, and the old alliances crack under the weight of greed. But the danger is not just from inside. Outside, an army of Orcs, thirsty with blood and commanded by dark forces, gathers to invade the Mountain. The men of Lac-Ville, the Elves of Fondcombe, and the dwarfs of Thorin's company find themselves trapped in an inevitable conflict, where each camp defends its own interests. Meanwhile, Galadriel (Cate Blanchett), the powerful elven lady, embarked on a perilous mission to free Gandalf (Ian McKellen), a prisoner of the Necromank, whose dark influence spreads like a tide of darkness. In the midst of this whirlwind of betrayal and violence, Bilbon Sacquet (Martin Freeman), the discreet but cunning hobby, tries to remind Thorin to reason, before the thirst for revenge and wealth consumes any hope of peace. Alliances are formed and broken, swords are shrouded, and the fate of Middle Earth is played in an epic battle where five armies are fighting in bloody chaos.

programme.title: Crime Chronicles
programme.desc: On 25 September 2023, in front of the Drôme assize court, a high-voltage trial opened in Valencia. Raymond Touilet, 58, is accused of the murder of Chantal de Chillou, a single mother without history. Despite extensive research and dozens of leads explored, the murder has been unpunished for two decades.
programme.desc-more: On 25 September 2023, an icy trial opened in front of the Drôme Court of Assizes in Valencia. Raymond Toillet, 58, appeared for the murder of Chantal de Chillou, a single mother without stories whose mutilated body was discovered in a forest in August 2001. For two decades, the case has haunted investigators, for lack of conclusive evidence. But thanks to recent scientific advances, a dramatic twist has enabled Touilet to be identified as the alleged rapist and murderer. As the trial progresses, shocking revelations appear, linking the accused to other terrifying crimes. This landmark trial highlights the horror of a case that has been in the shadows for too long and the triumph of modern technologies in the quest for justice.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: When complicity turns into conflict, Super Nanny comes to bring harmony
programme.desc: Sophie, a maternity lawyer, and Jérémy, a real estate agent, are the parents of three children: Victoria, 4 years old, Leo Paul, 3 years old, and Valentin, 3 months old. Sophie manages the daily life at home while Jérémy works. Between constant squabbles and disputes that can go so far as to blows, everything becomes a pretext for rivalry between the two elders. Sophie, for her part, struggles to impose herself fearing to assume the role of "bad", while Jérémy, more authoritarian but very busy with her work, intervenes less often, not without a hint of humor. In this context, where conflicts take place, despite the notable lack of screens within the home, Super Nanny will have to redouble her ingenuity to restore family balance.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: For his 50th family, Super Nanny welcomes a newborn
programme.desc: Pregnant eight months ago, Priscillia is waiting for her fourth child with her companion Johnny. A new birth she is already dreading because she never managed to take her place as a father. He is a dissociative and incapable of exercising authority, and he leaves her alone in the family. Also, Priscillia fears that she will not manage to take on the baby's arrival, which could happen earlier than expected. Super Nanny, who is carrying out his fiftieth mission here, must help the couple change so that they can welcome the newborn in the best conditions.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: With four kids who don't want to sleep, we're done... Super Nanny we need you!
programme.desc: Jennifer's, on parental leave, and Kevin, project manager in the BTP, the daily with Julian, 11, Liam, 4, Eden, 2 and a half years, and Léna, 16 months, became exhausting. For fear of frustrating their children, parents easily yield to their demands. Between the disputes, the difficulties of setting limits and Eden, who regularly rejects his mother for the benefit of his father, the couple struggles to find his place. Super Nanny tries to get this daily routine straight by introducing new routines and helping parents to assert themselves. But between the good resolutions and their implementation, the road is set to be fraught with difficulties.

programme.title: Super Nanny
programme.sub-title: Family XXL and shouting in the shovel, don't panic, Super Nanny is coming!
programme.desc: Together for 16 years, Marilyne and Jimmy have been a large family with their seven children: Solanne, 15, Lola, 12, Malone, 11, Illan, 8, Nino, 6, Lizie, 4, and Charly, 1 year. But behind this XXL tribe, the daily life is explosive: shouts, disputes and tensions are rumbling the day. Solanne, the eldest, took on the role of second mom, while Lola and Malone isolated themselves, the latter spending hours in front of the screens. Nino and Lizie, on the other hand, multiply the nonsense and provocations. Overwhelmed, Marilyne tries to impose a strict organization before leaving for work, leaving Jimmy in retreat. Family balance threatens to collapse. Super Nanny intervenes to try to recreate the bond and soothe this family with breath.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In the new maternity home of the private hospital in Dijon Burgundy, nearly 1,500 babies are born with the help of medical staff. The team of midwives, gynaecologists and child-care assistants is close to the mothers, accompanying them in all stages of delivery, but also with the dads. Caregivers see all kinds of fathers passing from those who want to participate actively in the birth of the baby to those who immortalize every moment of birth, and those who are very fragile.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: In February 1982, the first test baby was born at the maternity hospital of Antoine-Béclère de Clamart, Hauts-de-Seine, thanks in particular to Professors René Frydman and Jacques Testart. A step forward that now allows one in thirty children to be born in France thanks to a medically assisted reproductive technique. Many doctors have since taken over the torch of these two Professors, including Michael Grynberg. He is a specialist in reproductive medicine and manages several hundred births every year.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Since the first shootings, five years ago, from "Baby boom" to the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain-en-Laye, more than a hundred babies were born under the eye of the cameras. The work of doctors, midwives and caregivers is a cross-section of the future parents' lives. For the first time, teams from the show went back to see Gabin, Cassandre, Andrea and Marie to show them the images of their coming to the world. Emotional moments are at the meeting.

programme.title: The Scott Brothers
programme.desc: In this exciting eighth season, Nathan Scott (James Lafferty) is embarking on a new phase of his sports career, exploring opportunities outside basketball fields, while juggling with the challenges of personal life. Haley (Bethany Joy Lenz) is receiving news that could upset her life and her family. Meanwhile, Brooke (Sophia Bush), in the midst of wedding preparations, faced increasing difficulties with her shop, which her mother Victoria (Jana Kramer) seemed to be endangering by constant disagreements. Determined not to let these obstacles affect him, Brooke seeks to advance in her personal life. At the same time, the Quinn couple (Shantel VanSanten) and Clay (Robert Buckley) face a dangerous situation that threatens their happiness. This season is marked by palpable dramatic tension, with events that accumulate and heavy consequences to bear for all protagonists.
programme.desc-more: While Julian (Austin Nichols) finally made the decision to move to Brooke (Sophia Bush), she was preparing to welcome Alex Dupre (Jana Kramer), a famous actress who would become the face of her new clothing collection. Millicent (Lisa Goldstein), Brooke's best friend, goes to the airport to get Alex back, but the meeting is not going as planned, as Alex proves to be unbearable and capricious. Meanwhile, Nathan (James Lafferty) was under pressure because of the blackmail exerted by Renee (Kate Voegele), which prompted him to worry about his career as a basketball player. Although he tries to reassure Clay (Robert Buckley) by saying that he did not have an affair with Renee, tensions are rising and secrets are beginning to emerge. The relationships between the characters become more complex as they navigate between ambitions, betrayals and desires, each seeking to find its place in this tumultuous world.

programme.title: Fifty shades darker
programme.desc: Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson) decided to turn the page after her tumultuous relationship with Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan). She began a new job in the publishing house run by the seductive Jack Hyde (Eric Johnson), who seemed determined to help her flourish. However, despite his efforts to move forward, Christian cannot help but watch her from afar, haunted by nightmares that revive the wounds of her childhood, marked by the violence of her father. During an artistic opening, destiny brings together the two protagonists again. Christian, with palpable intensity, asks Anastasia to give him a second chance. Intrigued but suspicious, she agreed to share a dinner with him, thus plunged into a whirlwind of confrontational emotions. As they try to reconnect, shadows of the past threaten to destroy any hope of reconciliation and love.

programme.title: Fifty shades of Grey
programme.desc: In Seattle, the life of Anastasia Steele (Dakota Johnson), a shy and clumsy literature student, turns when she meets Christian Grey (Jamie Dornan), a charismatic and mysterious businessman. She was asked to interview Christian for an article in her student newspaper, and was immediately captivated by her seductive appearance and disconcerting assurance. As they begin to associate, their intense connection quickly takes an unexpected turn. Christian, who is in the grip of his own inner demons, reveals to Anastasia his inclination for unconventional sexual practices. He suggested that she sign a contract setting out the rules of a relationship that was much more complex than she had imagined. Disturbed between his attraction for this enigmatic man and his own limits, Anastasia finds herself immersed in a world of passion, pain and self-discovery, questioning his values and desires.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Being a mother is not necessarily innate... maternity often causes a metamorphosis that sometimes creates many doubts, questions and upsets a woman's life. No woman becomes a mother in the same way, whether in tears or in laughter. These mothers, with a very different course, sincerely evoke their stories. Some have learned about motherhood in pain, others have never given up on the desire to become mothers, despite trials or after long years of waiting.

programme.title: Baby boom
programme.desc: Women's expectations for childbirth are high. Some want to control everything, others hope that this moment is as short as possible or that everything will take place according to their convictions, even if it is suffering. For almost a month, the series followed the daily maternity day of the inter-municipal hospital in Poissy-Saint-Germain. Midwives, doctors, caregivers, childcare workers are mobilized every day to help mothers live in the best conditions this unforgettable moment.

programme.title: Baby boom

programme.title: Top Info
programme.desc: Discover TOP INFO, the new daily JT designed for young adults. Each edition will open up to three highlights of the current situation, before continuing with a substantive subject, embodied by young journalists, to deepen a theme. Once a week, this sequence will focus on combating misinformation and media education.

programme.title: The three brothers
programme.desc: Didier Latour (Didier Bourdon), Bernard Latour (Bernard Campan) and Pascal Latour (Pascal Légitimus) have nothing in common, except for the same father they never knew. On the day a notary calls them to announce that they inherit three million francs, their lives are changing. Money, crazy projects, dreams of greatness... Everything seems possible. But their euphoria is short: a simple administrative delay, and poof! The fortune their file between fingers. Worse still, they find themselves accused of fraud, hunted down by the police and the bailiffs, and forced to flee with, as a bonus, a child turbulent of which no one wants. Then begins a frantic run through France, where our three unlucky "brothers" chain the galleys with an innate talent to make things worse. Between begging disguised as a street show, attempts to rob disastrouss and encounters with characters more hideous than each other, their journey becomes a series of disasters as unpredictable as hilarious. Every plan to get out of business turns into a fiasco, every lie collapses under their own unsureness, and their emerging solidarity is constantly being tested.

programme.title: The twelve works of Asterix
programme.desc: Asterix and Obelix are taking up a new challenge launched by Julius Caesar, more than ever overtaken by the valiant resistance of the Gallic village to the armies of Rome.
programme.desc-more: Pushed to the end by the determination of the Gauls, Julius Caesar, the Roman leader, saw his army wipe out the crushing defeats against this intrepid village. Convinced that these warriors can only be gods, he concocts a bold plan to prove the opposite: to propose to the Gauls an epic challenge composed of twelve works, inspired by the trials of Hercules. If Asterix (Roger Carel) and Obelix (Jacques Morel), chosen as champions of their village, succeed in accomplishing these impossible missions, Caesar promises to recognize his defeat and to liberate Gaul. If not, they will have to submit to Roman supremacy. Equipped with the famous magic potion of Panoramix (Henri Virlogeux), which gives them an incredible strength, Asterix and Obelix embark on an adventure filled with humor and unexpected adventures. Through tumultuous trials, they will have to show courage, cunning and friendship to overcome the obstacles posed by Caesar and his army.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Wishing to have a correspondent, Finn throws bottles at the sea. He doesn't know that whoever answers him and claims to be called Colin is actually Gustav.
programme.desc-more: Desiring to be friendly and find a confidant, Finn embarks on an unusual adventure by throwing bottles at the sea, hoping to establish a correspondence like his friends Sam and Andrew. His curiosity leads him to believe that he can confide in a mysterious interlocutor. However, he does not suspect that the one who responds to his calls, claiming to call himself Colin, is none other than Gustav, a member of the fearsome Pashas. In this captivating intrigue, Gustav skillfully manipulates Finn to lead him to reveal a secret well guarded by Captain La Barrée. The latter is linked to his wooden leg, a mysterious relic of the missing gallion of James the Borgne, a legendary pirate. As Finn sinks into this deceitful game, he discovers unexpected truths about himself and the world of pirates, questioning his notion of friendship and trust.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: While he feels that he is not respected by anyone, Andrew discovers precious shells and uses them as a currency for exchange for services.
programme.desc-more: In a competitive and often ruthless environment, Andrew, a young student of the Academy of Pirates, feels invisible and despised by his comrades. His life takes an unexpected turn when he discovers shells of dazzling beauty, which prove to be valuable objects. By using these shells as a currency of exchange, Andrew manages to attract the attention of his peers, who suddenly become friendly and helpful to him. This new popularity gives him a sense of power and importance, but he soon ignores the warnings of Sam, his faithful friend, who sees this situation as a risk of manipulation and dependence. As Andrew takes advantage of his position, tensions rise and the consequences of his choices begin to emerge. The episode explores the themes of the quest for validation, the superficiality of relationships and the dangers of greed within a youth seeking identity.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: Planktons fought the Pachas in a naval battle, but they recovered a new boat. Captain La Barrée has a trick for her students.
programme.desc-more: Finn, Sam and Andrew, three young pirate seekers, are entering the formidable Pirate Academy, a school where rivalry is as intense as the waves of the ocean. Upon arrival, they were assigned to the Plankton class, a group often underestimated, and found themselves quickly competing with the Pachas class, students renowned for their navigation and combat skills. In a naval battle that puts their ingenuity and courage to the test, pressure rises. To help them overcome this obstacle, their teacher, Captain La Barrée, a charismatic and cunning pirate, offers them an unorthodox solution: cheating. As tensions get stronger and the stakes get higher, Finn, Sam and Andrew have to decide how far they are ready to go to prove their worth and gain respect for their peers. Friendship, loyalty and honour will be tested in this thrilling adventure.

programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. programme.title: The Return of the Great Blond
programme.desc: A distracted musician finds himself, without knowing it, at the centre of a war that the secret services are conducting and soon is threatened with death.
programme.desc-more: In Rio de Janeiro, François Perrin (Pierre Richard), affectionately nicknamed the Great Blond, saw an idyllic romance with Christine (Mireille Darc), wrapped in a sunny and carefree daily. However, thousands of miles away, in Paris, a growing political tension threatens to upset its peace. Captain Cambrai, head of the secret service, was tasked with destroying Colonel Toulouse (Jean Rochefort), whom he held responsible for the death of his colleague, Colonel Milan. To do so, he must prove that François is not a secret agent and has never been involved in spying. Alerted by this investigation, Colonel Toulouse sends killers to Brazil to eliminate the Great Blond, thinking that his presence might jeopardize his plans. Ignoring that he is at the heart of a dangerous spying game, François finds himself caught between two fires, while the French secret services are fighting to control the situation. While seeking to preserve his love and life, François must navigate a world of conspiracy and manipulation, transforming his dream vacation into a real nightmare.

programme.title: The big blond with a black shoe
programme.desc: A musician, particularly distracted, is considered a major secret agent by two general intelligence officers. His life is so upset.
programme.desc-more: François Perrin (Pierre Richard), a distracted and clumsy violinist, arrives at Orly airport with unattended shoes, unconsciously attracting the attention of the secret services. Colonel Toulouse (Jean Rochefort), destabilizing his rival, Colonel Milan, saw François as the perfect decoy to carry out his ploy. Convinced that the seemingly innocent configuration of this ordinary man can be exploited, he designates him as a spy to be watched. From then on, François was hunted by secret agents, photographed and listened to without any suspicion on his part. What he does not know is that his apparent insignificance plays in a secret war, leading him into a world where danger is around every corner. As he navigates through these rock-like situations, he meets beautiful Christine (Mireille Darc), of which he falls in love. Their nascent romance, however, is met with the spying intrigues surrounding it, causing quiproquos and misunderstandings. As events unfold, Francis must try to unravel the reality of fiction while preserving his heart and life.

programme.title: Jamie has tentacles.
programme.desc: Mitch, the comics salesman, claims he's Jamie's best friend. Contact and Gratchett decide to remove it in order to lure Jamie into a trap.
programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. Under constant threat from Lieutenant Contact, a ruthless robot, and Sergeant Gratchett, a mutant cow determined to capture him, Jamie and Nerdy unite to face these perils, learning the value of friendship and courage in a world where every moment can be fatal.

programme.title: Asterix the Gaulish
programme.desc: A small village of Gaulis is the only one to resist the assaults of Julius Caesar's armies. But its inhabitants have a secret: a magic potion.
programme.desc-more: In 50 BC, while the whole Gaul is firmly under Roman occupation, a small village valiantly resists the power of Emperor Julius Caesar. This village is home to legendary heroes such as Asterix (original voice: Roger Carel), a clever and resourceful warrior, and Obelix, his faithful friend and menhir deliverer, whose superhuman strength came from an accident with the magic potion. Designed by Panoramix (original voice: Jacques Morel), the village's venerable druid, this potion gives incredible strength to anyone who consumes it. Without being ridiculed by this band of indomited Gauls, the Romans fomented a bold plan: to kidnap Panoramix to appropriate the secret of its magic. However, the Druid is clever and has skills that could well thwart the plans of his enemies.
