programme.title: Armors
programme.desc: "The importance of teamwork" TJ, who has been able to rely on his own talents, discovers the importance of teamwork on the basketball field as during a perilous mission.
programme.desc-more: In a world where dinosaurs, long gone, are reborn with incredible strength, a new generation of heroes rises to defend the Earth. Five teenagers, with a unique connection to these prehistoric creatures, discover that they are the only ones able to communicate and to ally with these imposing reptiles. Each of them wears a special armor that allows them to pilot their dinosaur and deploy extraordinary capabilities. At the heart of this thrilling adventure, our young protagonists, faced with an ancient evil that threatens the balance of their world, must overcome their doubts and learn to work together. In parallel, they face formidable enemies who seek to exploit the powers of dinosaurs for their own ends. The epic fighting between armor and dark forces is intensifying, testing not only their skills as warriors, but also their friendship and loyalty. As they explore wild landscapes and mysterious ruins, each teenager will have to discover his own inner strength and the true sense of heroism. "Armorsaurs" promises to be a series of captivating actions, where friendship and courage are the keys to saving a world at risk, while revealing secrets that even the bravest of them would never have imagined.

programme.desc-more: Within the secret Phoenix society, an organization acting in the shadows to protect the interests of the US government, Angus "Mac" MacGyver (Lucas Till) uses his intelligence and ingenuity to get out of the most perilous situations. At the same time, Wilt (Justin Hires) was sent to espionage training, learning to navigate the dangerous world of intelligence. While MacGyver and his team, composed of Riley Davis (Tristin Mays) and Jack Dalton, face various threats, two iconic figures from the original series are emerging, adding a touch of nostalgia and tension to their adventures. programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: "A love of vigie"Andrew invited Dolores to watch the shooting stars, but he discovered that the Pachas had taken possession of them. Finn and Sam decide to intervene.
programme.desc-more: In the episode "Un amour de vigie" of the series "Pirate Academy", Andrew, a young romantic pirate, invites Dolores, his comrade, to climb up to the vigie to admire the show of the shooting stars. This enchanting moment quickly turns into a delicate situation when they discover that the vigil was invaded by a group of Pachas, fearsome pirates known for their unpredictable temperament and penchant for looting. As Andrew tried to convince Dolores to remain calm in the face of this threat, Finn and Sam, two other crew members, decided to intervene to save their friends. A confrontation between young pirates and Pashas is then set in motion, where ruse and bravery will be put to the test. As the episode unfolds, unexpected alliances are formed and tensions emerge, revealing the real motivations of the characters and the stakes of their quest for freedom.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: "Forbidden swimming" While it is very hot at the Pirate Academy, the captains observe the theft of the gulls, which is worrying. Swimming is forbidden, but Sam is only at his head.
programme.desc-more: As the heat wave moved into the Pirate Academy, an atmosphere of tension and mystery invaded the camp. The captains, superstitious, made a radical decision: swimming was now prohibited. They claim to have observed a bad omen in the gulls' theft, an event that triggers disturbing rumors among young pirates. Students, initially reluctant to believe in this ban, end up giving in to the panic, except Sam (a actor to be specified), a fearless young pirate who refuses to be influenced by these superstitions. Determined to enjoy the summer, he decided to brave the ban and dive into turquoise waters, taking with him a handful of friends who wanted to live the adventure. But as the laughter resonates, an unexpected event turns their plans into a change, questioning the border between legend and reality within the Pirate Academy.

Desperate to catch up with their mistakes and to please their comrade, they decided to borrow the legendary compass of La Barrée, a precious and emblematic object that belonged to their captain. programme.title: Jamie has tentacles.
programme.sub-title: Back to the future of the subjunctive
programme.desc: "Back to the future of the subjunctif" Jamie and Nerdy are being visited by a Nerdy of the future who accidentally gave an extraterrestrial sandwich to a squirrel, who transferred.
programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. Under constant threat from Lieutenant Contact, a ruthless robot, and Sergeant Gratchett, a mutant cow determined to capture him, Jamie and Nerdy unite to face these perils, learning the value of friendship and courage in a world where every moment can be fatal.

programme.desc: A young woman, committed to redecorating the apartment of a successful New York author, is committed to restoring her taste for life.
programme.desc-more: In the magical Christmas effervescence in New York, where windows sparkle and flakes dance between skyscrapers, Eva embodies the secret fairy of the holidays: her job? Fulfill the wildest wishes to make New Year's Eve unforgettable. Between bright garlands and custom decorations, it instills the magic of the holidays in the most prestigious interiors. This year, his mission leads him to the mythical Fifth Avenue, where he awaits a luxurious and enigmatic apartment, Lucas, a successful novelist whose words have conquered millions of readers. But when Eva crosses the threshold of this New York sanctuary, she discovers more than just a space to be transformed: Lucas, supposedly absent, is there, plunged into heavy silence, eyes riveted on a white page. Behind the facade of the charismatic writer is a broken man. Since his wife's disappearance, Christmas is no longer for him but a painful reminder, a season that revives memories and chokes inspiration. The guidelines are accumulating, its publisher simmering, and words, once so fluid, now refuse to come. Eva, whose gift is to guess the desires of others, understands as soon as her mission far exceeds the simple decoration: and if the real gift that Lucas was waiting for was not a garland of more, but a reason to believe again in the magic of the holidays?

programme.title: A soul mate for Christmas
programme.desc: A young woman, who just lost her job, is trading her Connecticut farm for the chic apartment of a London accountant during Christmas parties.
programme.desc-more: As the end of the year approaches, as the glittering lights and the magic of Christmas envelop the world, two lonely souls, separated by an ocean, prepare to experience an unexpected experience. Molly Cooper (Laura Vandervoort), an independent farmer from Connecticut, leads a simple and warm life surrounded by its animals and snow-covered landscapes that make its region charming. On the other side of the Atlantic, Patrick Kensington (Rainbow Sun Francks), a refined and busy man, lives in a stylish London apartment, where the bustling pace of the city leaves him little time to enjoy the sweetness of the holidays. To escape the routine and discover a new way to celebrate Christmas, Molly and Patrick decided to temporarily exchange their homes. What was initially only a simple practical arrangement quickly turns into a correspondence full of complicity. Through their exchanges of emails and messages, a sincere and deep connection is established between them. Despite the distance, they share their traditions, dreams and hopes, gradually discovering that they have much more in common than they would have imagined. As Christmas day approaches, they finally agree to meet in person in Molly's snow-covered farm. But between the unexpected of the journey, the secret expectations and the doubts that may arise at the idea of moving from virtual to real, this encounter promises to be as exciting as it is incertaine. Will the preparations for the holidays, the reunions with the relatives and the small happiness of the daily life reinforce this nascent alchemy, or will the differences between their two worlds prove more difficult to overcome than they had believed? In an atmosphere where Christmas magic blends with the most tender emotions, Molly and Patrick may discover that the most beautiful gift is not under the tree, but in the unexpected encounter of two hearts ready to open up to love...

programme.title: Ice Age 4: The drift of continents
programme.desc: After Scrat has led a large asteroid to Earth, Sid, Diego, Manny and their friends are looking for a way to stop the imminent apocalypse.
programme.desc-more: In a vibrant prehistoric world of colours and life, the Scrat squirrel (voice of Chris Wedge) is embarking on a desperate quest to catch a glans. However, his obsession caused a monumental cataclysm, causing the separation of continents and upsetting the balance of the planet. At the heart of this chaos, the mammouth Manny (voice of Ray Romano) finds himself isolated on a piece of drifting ice, far from his family, his wife Ellie (voice of Queen Latifah) and their daughter Pêche (voice of Keke Palmer). Manny, accompanied by his faithful friends – the Diego-sabre tiger (voice of Denis Leary) and the clumsy lazy Sid (voice of John Leguizamo), as well as his grandmother – must navigate through turbulent waters and face unprecedented challenges. Their journey led them to cross the road of a band of formidable pirates, led by the terrifying Captain Gutt (voice of Peter Dinklage). In a confrontation between courage and trickery, the group will have to unite its forces to overcome the dangers and regain their path to safety. The stakes have never been so high, and friendship will be tested in this thrilling adventure full of humour and emotion.

programme.title: Asterix and Cleopatra
programme.desc: Following a bet with Julius Caesar, Cleopatra asked his architect to build a palace for him in three months. Asterix and Obelix arrive in Egypt.
programme.desc-more: To prove her grandeur in the face of Julius Caesar, Queen Cleopatra of the Ptolemy dynasty, is challenging an ambitious challenge: to build the most impressive palace in the world in Alexandria in a record time of three months. To achieve this achievement, she calls for the help of the architect Nombrebis, who finds himself under pressure, because failure would mean a tragic end, throwing him to the crocodiles. Aware of the magnitude of this monumental task, Numebis appeals to his long-time friend, the Gallic Druid Panoramix, whose legendary magic potion is the key to success. Asterix and Obelix are also engaged in this crazy adventure, ready to cross the Mediterranean. However, Julius Caesar is not ready to let his opponent triumph. Amonbofils, a sneaky rival of Numebis, joins Caesar's plans to sabotage the project.

programme.title: Gabby and the Magic House
programme.desc: Chat-lloween is beating up! Gabby and Pandy make cat lanterns with Baby Box, look for candy with Marine and make ghost bananas with P'tichou.
programme.desc-more: Gabby is a sparkling and imaginative little girl, passionate about cooking, manual activities and time spent with her friends. Her life takes on an extraordinary turn when she discovers that her dollhouse is more than just a toy: it is a real portal to a magical world where everything becomes possible. Every time she plays with her dolls, Gabby finds herself immersed in fascinating adventures, filled with enchanting characters and challenges. Accompanied by her faithful friends, she explores colorful kingdoms, solves creative puzzles and learns valuable lessons about friendship, creativity and determination. Thanks to his magical home, Gabby discovers that the power of imagination can transform reality and that every day is a new opportunity to learn and grow. With a mixture of humour and tenderness, this series invites young spectators to believe in their dreams and to give free rein to their creativity.

programme.title: Rainbow High
programme.desc: Iris traps the Rayant in a dollhouse without a way out. Girls must rediscover the strength of their friendship to find the key to the portal and escape.
programme.desc-more: The arrival of new students at Rainbow High High is disrupting the delicate balance of social relations within the school. While old friendships are being tested, tensions are mounting between emerging groups of young designers and designers. The new arrivals, with their flamboyant personality and undeniable talent, arouse both admiration and jealousy among the students already in place. Each of them brings a unique touch to the dynamics of the high school, intensifying the competition to stand out in an environment where glamour and creativity are the key words. The protagonists will have to navigate through the intrigues, betrayals and unexpected alliances to find their place in this world where appearance counts as much as talent. Between fashion, friendship and rivalry, Rainbow High explores the challenges of adolescence and the quest for identity in a vibrant and artistic community.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: In the colorful world of "Pirate Academy", the episode "Sam la Pacha" brings to light Sam, a young pirate aspirant who often feels left behind by her comrades, Finn and Andrew. Proven sympathy for her, the two friends decided to write her a fictional letter allegedly sent by an imaginary grand uncle. They chose the name James Le Borgne, a famous pirate Pasha whose reputation makes the seas shudder. However, they do not know that this name really belongs to a true historical character, a pirate with multiple exploits. When Sam receives this letter, her imagination gets bogged down, and she starts a quest to discover the legacy of her so-called ancestor. This misunderstanding leads to a series of hilarious and unexpected events, revealing not only Sam's passion for piracy, but also the friendships that unite the trio in the face of adventure and the unexpected.

programme.title: Pirate Academy
programme.desc: As the Academy of Pirates prepares to celebrate its flagship event, Sam (actor to be determined) is at the head of the race for the coveted title of "pirate of the year". After overcoming a series of perilous trials, he is about to be crowned for his exploits. However, pressure is rising and anxiety is taking hold of him in the idea of having to deliver a speech to his fellow men and women and to his formidable mentors. Sam, a young pirate with a valiant heart but a sensitive soul, is beginning to doubt his oratory abilities. Fear of failure prompts him to consider last-minute solutions, but he quickly realizes that this ordeal is more than just a speech. In search of self-confidence, Sam will have to navigate through his own uncertainties, discover the strength of friendship and learn that sometimes the greatest challenges are hidden behind the words that one hesitates to pronounce.

As the institution prepares for a major maritime cooking contest, Finn (a character full of training and creativity) takes over from his sick brothers. With his innovative approach and his love for gastronomy, Finn quickly proves that he is a talented chef, much superior to his elders. His dishes, combining boldness and tradition, captivate other students and judges. However, this fulcruming ascent does not come without challenges, as Finn must navigate the internal rivalries and high expectations of his comrades. programme.title: Boy, Girl, etc.
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 1 of the series Boy, Girl, etc.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and baffled universe, Boy and Girl, two young humans, share their daily lives with a bunch of eccentric anthropomorphic animals: Dog, a loyal and farce dog, Cat, a mischievous and cunning feline, and Mouse, a curious and intrepid little mouse. Together, they live under the same roof in a joyful bazaar, where the crazy situations and misadventures are linked. Every day, Boy and Girl discover the joys and challenges of a community life, learning to navigate through small arguments and moments of camaraderie. Their atypical family, although different from traditional norms, teaches them essential values such as friendship, solidarity and acceptance of differences. As the episodes progress, this unlikely sibling strengthens, proving that love and understanding can overcome all barriers, even those that seem the strangest.

programme.title: Jamie has tentacles.
programme.desc: By wanting to transport Jamie to the Vloks, Contact and Gratchett mistakenly sent her to a planet inhabited by lamas, who took Nerdy for their messiah.
programme.desc-more: Chassed by the Vloks, an alien race avid with flesh, Jamie, the prince of planet Blarb, is forced to flee to Earth to escape a tragic fate. He arrived on our planet and found refuge with Mr. and Mrs. Walsh, a caring couple who offered him shelter. In this new world, Jamie has a special connection with their son, Nerdy (Gabriel Bismuth-Beloved), a shy and introverted teenager whose life is mainly held behind the doors of his room. Despite his extraordinary powers, Jamie must sail with caution, concealing his abilities to avoid attracting the attention of the Vloks. Under constant threat from Lieutenant Contact, a ruthless robot, and Sergeant Gratchett, a mutant cow determined to capture him, Jamie and Nerdy unite to face these perils, learning the value of friendship and courage in a world where every moment can be fatal.

programme.title: We Europeans
programme.desc: Through reports and chronicles, this magazine proposes to talk about Europe, but especially about the people who do it, and all the positive and inspiring initiatives that flourish on the continent. Faced with the challenges that the 500 million Europeans face, the show shows what solutions our neighbours have invented to respond to them, and how we could draw on them. Each issue is thematized around a European country with a fifteen-minute report on an inspiring initiative, a guest on stage to see if the model presented is applicable to France and a column on news.

programme.title: Special Envoy (Envoyé spécial)
programme.sub-title: Ceuta: the underside of a migration wave
programme.desc: Never before had a wave of migration caused so many victims in Ceuta. At the end of July, 145 people died trying to join Ceuta, according to Caminando Fronteras, most of them drowned in a new crowd movement. In less than 48 hours, nearly 80,000 people crossed the border between Morocco and Ceuta illegally. A massive arrival that plunged the Spanish Lenclave into an unprecedented and endless humanitarian crisis. What happened on July 30 and 31, 2026? Is it a spontaneous crowd movement or an organized operation? Why do some Moroccan police officers seem to have let migrants pass?

programme.title: To follow with Loïc de La Mornais
The flavors of Christmas
programme.desc: Grace Cooke, star chef and pioneer of gastro-scientific cuisine, reigns over the stoves of the largest restaurants with surgical precision and bold creativity. Yet behind this perfect shell is a exhausted woman, in doubt. When a stinging article by an influential critic demolishes his last menu, calling his kitchen "cold and soulless", Grace feels the floor slipping under his feet. For the first time, she questions everything: What if, despite the stars and praises, she had lost what really mattered? Injured and disoriented, she fled the bustle of Parisian cuisines to her hometown, a small snow-covered village where childhood memories and the smell of hot bread remind her of a time when cooking was synonymous with sharing and love. It is there, between the familiar walls of her childhood home and the winter landscapes that sooth her soul, that she crosses the road of Asher St. James, a traveler writer with casual charm and free spirit. He, too, sought meaning, placed his suitcases in the village to write a novel inspired by local stories. An unexpected alchemy is created between them. He, with his poetic words and his new look at the world, helps to reconnect to his roots; She, with her culinary knowledge and perfectionism, reveals a new way of seeing life. Together, they explore the Christmas markets, Grace's forgotten recipes, and the simple little happiness that had disappeared from her busy life. Yet, as Grace rediscovers the joy of cooking with her heart, a dilemma arises: can she really turn her back on her career to regain this lost authenticity? As Christmas parties approach, tensions rise. Her family, proud but worried, pushes her to take over the reins of her professional life, while Asher, drawn between her desire to stay and her need for freedom, must make a choice. Between the world's expectations and the desires of her soul, Grace will have to find her way – a path that may not resemble any other.

programme.title: Christmas in Pemberley
programme.desc: As Christmas approaches, New York's effervescence is replaced by the snowy sweetness of a picturesque little town, where the traditions and magic of the season mix together to create a enchanting atmosphere. Elizabeth Bennet (Jessica Lowndes), a dynamic and passionate event organizer, is entrusted with a delicate mission: orchestrating a festival that will bring life to this warm community. But when she arrived, she discovered that the place she had imagined for this celebration, the majestic estate of Pemberley, was about to change hands. Indeed, William Darcy (Michael Rady), his billionaire owner, as mysterious as he is charismatic, decided to sell this historic home, thus endangering the preparations for the festival. Determined to turn this challenge into an opportunity, Elizabeth, with her contagious energy and creative spirit, tries to convince William to give her a chance. Despite his initial reluctance and apparent coldness, he eventually accepted, provided that everything was organized according to his strict rules. But while Elizabeth is trying to transform Pemberley into a fairytale place, she faces unexpected obstacles, both logistical and emotional. Between the tensions related to the organization of the event and the secrets surrounding William, a complex relationship gradually became established between them.

programme.sub-title: Ballistics, theft, exhibitionism: 100 days with the Nice police (n. 1)

programme.title: High voltage investigation
programme.sub-title: Theft, incivility, assault: 100 days with the Nice police (No. 2)
programme.desc: Famous for its sumptuous Bay of Angels, Nice lives mainly on its 5 million annual tourists. But this craze also attracts crooks of all kinds. To stop them, the municipality has set up the largest network of cameras in France. Created ten years ago, the Urban Supervision Centre controls 3,200 cameras. Last year, 1,600 video clips were the subject of a judicial requisition, an average of four a day. Police officers are also facing increasingly violent attacks on the ground. But, thanks to their speed of action, the law enforcement forces often retain the advantage.

programme.title: High voltage investigation
programme.sub-title: The hot daily of the Cap d'Agde police officers
programme.desc: Cap d'Agde, a seaside resort in the Hérault department, attracts nearly 300,000 holidaymakers every year. Agde is home to beautiful beaches but also one of the most important naturist and libertin camps in Europe. If the day is the day, families enjoy the sea, the evening is the scene of many overflows. To ensure the safety of the estivants, some 50 armed and super-sensitivity police officers are taking turns. They intervene after attacks, robberies, exhibitionism, dangerous driving or to end fighting at night clubs.

programme.title: Lightning at the Christmas Market
programme.desc: In a small snowy town where the lights of the garlands glitter like stars fallen from the sky, Cassie, an ambitious and Cartesian young woman, returns after years of absence to revive the Christmas market of her childhood, a magical place where memories of her past mingle with cinnamon and fir fragrances. Despite a brilliant career in the event, Cassie, accustomed to urban challenges and high-end projects, is unrecognized by the unexpected and the over-yearly charm of this village where time seems to be stopped. His goal? Turn this market into an unmissable event, while honouring the memory of her grandmother, who was once the soul of her. But his well-oiled plan quickly comes up against the unexpected arrival of Nicolas, a enigmatic and charismatic man, who spontaneously proposes to help him organize the festivities. Initially annoyed by his casual approach and his casual humour, Cassie sees him as an obstacle to his legendary efficiency. Yet, behind his simple manners and his appearance as a barouder is a well-kept secret: Nicolas is none other than a prince, weary of the suffocating protocols of the court, who chose to simmer incognito in local life to discover the authenticity of a popular festival, far from the appartments and fireworks of his world. As preparations are in full swing – between wooden chalets to decorate, concerts to organize and culinary specialties to be highlighted – Cassie and Nicolas are still linked by increasing complicity. The sparks of their first disputes gradually give way to more tender exchanges, where shared laughter and improvised confidence create an unexpected alchemy. Yet their collaboration is not without challenges: the expectations of the inhabitants, the logistical unforeseen and, above all, the unsaid ones that weigh on Nicolas threaten to make everything change.

programme.title: The man in the Christmas sweater
programme.desc: Christmas is approaching in the snowy little town of Pine Ridge, where the garlands glitter and the spirit of the holidays seem to warm even the most lonely hearts. Yet, for Maggie, a single mother and tireless organizer of the celebrations of the neighbouring military base, this period is synonymous with sacrifices. As his daughter, Emily, flies away to spend the holidays with her father, Maggie prepares for a lonesome New Year's Eve, drowned under the preparations for the festivities for the soldiers and their families. Between the decorations to be finalized, the gifts to be packed and the meals to be coordinated, she hardly had time to think about her own melancholy – until an unexpected came to upset everything. Everything turns on the day when a badly stowed Christmas tree falls on the passage of Lucas (Scott Wolf), a New York architect in three-piece costume, visibly lost in this town far from urban agitation. The accident sends the refined city dweller to the hospital, where Maggie, eaten by guilt, feels compelled to look after him. Lucas, accustomed to skyscrapers and professional appointments, finds himself immersed in a world where Christmas traditions reign as masters, and where an entire community seems to live at the rhythm of bellsongs and hot chocolates.

programme.title: Royal lightning strike at Christmas
programme.desc: In the snowy and fairy-tale setting of the Swiss Alps, where the fir trees glitter under the garlands and where the bright air carries the spirit of the holidays, stands the Royal Ice Hotel, a luxurious palace as majestic as it is enchanting. It is here that Ava (Katie Cassidy), an ambitious and talented young woman, comes in with a mixture of excitement and apprehension. Passionate about luxury hotels and a keen sense of detail, she sees this seasonal position as a golden opportunity to prove herself in a world where excellence is a requirement. Yet, behind his unfailing professionalism is a sensibility to the skin, marked by past love disillusionments. Well determined to focus on his career, Ava doesn't imagine for a second that this Christmas might well reserve a surprise that will upset all his plans. It was then that she crossed the road of Henry (Stephen Huszar), a charismatic and mysterious man, staying incognito at the Royal Ice Hotel. Under his simple traveler's style in search of tranquillity, Henry actually hides a much more prestigious title: that of prince heir to a European kingdom. With protocol constraints and heavy expectations on his shoulders, he chose to escape the holiday season, hoping to find a semblance of normality. But when his eyes meet those of Ava, an unexpected spark arises, sowing the trouble in his heart as in his own. Between walks in the Christmas markets, evenings at the corner of the fire and conversations that stretch until dawn, a sincere and profound complicity settles between them.

programme.title: Cleopatra, looking for the dead tomb
programme.desc: After centuries of research, the tomb of the last queen of Egypt is about to be found. Thanks to excavations, 3D modelling and reconstructions, this documentary series traces the life of Cleopatra through ancient Egypt.
programme.desc-more: For centuries archaeologists from all over the world have been searching for the tomb of Egypt's greatest queen, Cleopatra. We followed their quest for clues in the desert as underwater off the coast of Alexandria. Between archaeological excavations and docu fiction, this series tells the last moments of Cleopatra, its alliances with Roman generals Julius Caesar and Marc Antoine, and its crazy ambition to lead her to suicide.

programme.title: The discovery of Egypt's last tombs
programme.desc: From the beginning of the mission to Saqqarah, Zahi Hawass and his team of Egyptian scientists feel that their area of search will be extremely rich. After digging some 40 wells, they finally discovered the Grail: dozens of coffins from the New Empire and the Lower Age, which will have to be scanned, and perhaps opened. Inside, individuals were buried with their secrets, sometimes unexpected... Thanks to modern techniques the team will go back in time, to make talk about the fates of these people who lived in Ancient Egypt 3000 years ago.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: Perpignan, July 2013. Francisco Benitez, a legionnaire, reports the disappearance of his wife, Marie-Josée, and his daughter, Allison. Shortly after Francisco Benitez was found hanged in his barracks, his face covered. The Montpellier Judicial Police will open an investigation into a question: Did Francisco Benitez kill wife and child before he killed himself?
programme.desc-more: On July 14, 2013, in Perpignan, Marie-Josée Benitez, 53, and her daughter Allison, 19, candidate for Miss Roussillon's election, mysteriously disappear. Eight days later, Francisco Benitez warned the police that he had no further news of his wife and child. The Perpignan Public Prosecutor ' s Office is opening up judicial information. On 5 August in the early morning, the legionnaire was found hanging in the toilets of his barracks. Francisco Benitez claims his innocence in a letter found there. The investigators are raiding the Benitez's home. Several elements burden the father of the family.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.sub-title: The Broken Destiny of Gaëlle Fosset
programme.desc: In April 2007, Gaëlle Fosset, 21, was found dead at her home in Saint-Germain-la-Campagne, Normandy. The young woman was stabbed with 66. The investigators feel that she voluntarily opened the door to her attacker. But there is no tangible evidence to elucidate this murder.
programme.desc-more: On 27 April 2007, Gaëlle Fosset was found dead and half naked at her home at the residence of the Park, in Saint-Germain-la-Campagne, a peaceful village in the Eure. The beautiful blonde received 66 stab wounds. Investigators feel that the young woman knew her attacker. His companion, friends and neighbour are heard. But there is no evidence to advance the investigation. Analyses allow us to isolate a male DNA on the jogging pants that Gaëlle wore on the evening of the drama.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.sub-title: The riddle of Constable Jambert's death
programme.desc: On 4 August 1997, Christian Jambert's body, a retired gendarme, was discovered in Auxerre. A 22 Long Rifle rifle is placed on his legs. The doctor called to see the death concludes that the suicide is taking place. Years later, his children opened the case again. The man was obviously murdered.
programme.desc-more: On 4 August 1997, Christian Jambert, a retired police officer who had investigated the case of the missing Yonne, was found dead in the garage of his house near Auxerre. A farewell letter is found on the spot. The general practitioner, in charge of the body examination, concludes that a suicide by gun was committed. No autopsy is performed. In 2004, seven years after the facts, the daughter of the former Warrant Officer requested forensic expertise. The experts then lean for the crime thesis.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In 2000, Suzanne Viguier disappeared from her home. A search revealed that the mattress she was sleeping on had become volatile. Jacques Viguier was charged with the murder of his wife, but was acquitted twice. Even today, no one knows what happened to Suzanne Viguier.
programme.desc-more: On February 27, 2000, Suzanne Viguier, 38-year-old ballerina, married to Jacques, a law associate in Toulouse, mysteriously disappeared from her home. On 9 March 2000, judicial information was opened. A search is carried out at the Viguier's residence. The police find out that the mattress that Suzanne was sleeping on disappeared. On 11 May 2000, Jacques Viguier was charged and imprisoned for the murder of his wife. Supported by his children, the academic will continue to claim his innocence.

programme.title: The Closer: LA Priority Investigations
programme.desc: Brenda faces professional difficulties: she is criminally and ethically charged with the way she conducts her investigations. Her private life is no more peaceful: she learns that her father is suffering from cancer and in episode 19, entitled "Last Sacraments", her mother died suddenly, which affects her terribly. This seventh season is also the last, and longest, - She has 21 episodes. Kyra Sedgwick herself decided to end the show, explaining that she wanted to stop to spend more time with her family. - She's Kevin Bacon's wife in town.
programme.desc-more: In a sunny afternoon in Los Angeles, a brutal execution shakes the city: three members of the East Side Catorces, a feared gang, are shot dead in a park. Inspector Brenda Leigh Johnson (Kyra Sedgwick) and her team from the Priority Investigations Unit are called to the scene of the drama in an emergency. Faced with this widely publicized murder, Brenda must navigate between public pressure and the complexities of a case that reveals broader issues than expected. As she begins her investigation, Brenda notes the disturbing presence of a man at the crime scene: Colonel Walter (Robert Gossett), a former military instructor who claims to know the identity of the shooter. Although his knowledge seems valuable, there is growing mistrust at Brenda's. She wondered about the colonel's real intentions, as tensions, secrets and gang rivalries resurfaced, complicating an already delicate investigation.

programme.title: So far everything's fine.
programme.desc: Fred Bartel (Gilles Lellouche), the ambitious leader of a Parisian communications agency, is in a critical situation. Accused of a heavy tax backlog exceeding one million euros, he has to face the inevitable pressure of the administration. To avoid bankruptcy, he made the drastic decision to move his company to La Courneuve, a difficult suburb, despite the dissatisfaction of his staff, who had to adapt to this new reality. Fred met Samy (Malik Bentalha), a clumsy dog-master, who had a tumultuous relationship with his own animal. In order to benefit from the tax incentives offered by the Free Zone, Fred must hire local residents, so he turns to Samy for help. However, the situation becomes more complicated when the bank, concerned about the company's instability, decides to suspend its financial support, thus endangering not only the future of the agency, but also the dreams of Fred and his employees.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On 26 February 2003, garbage bags containing pieces of human body were collected in the Pas-de-Calais on the edge of the Scheldt Canal. The victim, Janine Sopka, 59 years old and resident in Saint-Hilaire-sur-Helpe, was cut by saw. By investigating the neighbourhood, the gendarmes learn that the victim was multiplying the love affair without a future. They're looking for the men she had a relationship with and interested in the one who had dinner with her on the night of her disappearance, without being able to link him to the murder. They wonder if Janine Sopka would not have crossed the road of Mons's de specter, a Belgian serial killer never identified.

programme.title: Alert removal
programme.desc: Through six cases of child abduction, this documentary series sets a device whose effectiveness is no longer to be proved: the abduction alert. Meetings with incredible families of dignity and resilience, moving testimonies of victims, Discovery of the reverse of the decor to understand the workings of a unique and colossal device, in the same way as a series of police fiction.

programme.title: Alert removal
programme.desc: On 3 August 2007, in Saint-Denis de La Réunion, Alexander, 12, was kidnapped with great violence by five men hiding in front of the helpless eyes of his family. For the first time in the history of the island, the Alert Abduction plan is triggered. Soon, investigators are interested in the sect "Sorry and Immaculate Heart of Mary" and its young guru. He, convicted of paedophilia, is on the run and protected by his followers. The case mobilized the inhabitants of La Réunion until Juliano Verbard, the guru, was arrested and Alexander was released.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In early March 2004, two students from the Medical Educational Institute (IME) in Mignanoux-Beauvoir, Vienna, discovered a garbage bag surrounded by tape in a grove located opposite their establishment. Inside, Olivier Fargues' corpse, brilliant engineering student. Originally from the Pyrénées-Atlantiques, the 22-year-old was brutally beaten in the head. Olivier had mysteriously disappeared on the night of March 2 to 3 after eating with friends in a bar in downtown Poitiers.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In September 1999, in Saint-Malo, Dr. Yves Godard and his two children, Camille, six years old, and Marius, four years old, mysteriously disappeared during a trip to the sea. The police officers discovered significant traces of blood in the doctor's home. This is Marie-France's wife, Yves's wife, who also disappeared. Yves Godard becomes suspect number one. Judicial information is opened for voluntary homicide and an international arrest warrant is issued.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On 21 December 1997, Mokhtaria Chaib, a 19-year-old woman, was found dead near the Perpignan railway station (Pyrénées-Orientales). On 26 June 1998, the body of 22-year-old Marie-Hélène Gonzalez was discovered. The criminal investigation police noted similarities with the disappearance of a 17-year-old high school girl, Tatiana Andujar, whose body was still undetected. Two suspects are then arrested: a man convicted of illegal medical practice and a person caught cutting... his host. Back to this survey rich in twists and turns.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In July 2013, Julie Michel, 26, disappeared during a drive. His vehicle is found in Massat, 300 km from his destination. Witnesses claim to have seen her but then no more trace of the young woman. His mother discovered that Julie was part of a sect led by a Belgian guru. Then other tracks emerged, all more unexpected than the others. None of the evidence was sufficient to explain Julie's disappearance. But a new testimony will re-launch the investigation.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In July 2008, near Bourges, Thierry Chauvineau's lifeless body, a well-known owner of local bars and restaurants, was discovered by his companion in their bedroom. He was killed with several gunshots and his safe was emptied. Many suspects appear: her partner herself, her poker partners, a former employee dismissed, as well as a suburban carid himself found shot dead. But fifteen years later, no track was completed and Thierry Chauvineau's partner continues to fight to get investigations back on track.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In December 2010, Bandjougou Diawara's lifeless body was found near his car in Noisy-le-Grand. The police discover that this real estate agent had been imprisoned several times for drug trafficking. The investigation will lead to the conviction of his partner to 20 years in prison. But the latter hires a private investigator who highlights all the inconsistencies in the investigation and manages to get the convicted person cleared. Since then, the mystery about this murder has remained whole but strangely, a lead has never been explored.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: In March 1983, in the suburbs of Grenoble, Ludovic Janvier, 6, was kidnapped by an individual in front of his brother Jerome, 7 years old. Later, another boy was abducted in Grenoble under the same circumstances and found dead in a landfill. Four years later, she is a 10-year-old girl who disappears in Isère. Despite all the investigations, these abductions of children have never been clarified. But last March, the Ludovic January case was the first case before the newly created "no further action" division of the Nanterre court.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Every year, the French Antilles fear the arrival of devastating cyclones. Faced with these phenomena, many specialists are mobilizing. Pilots crossing the eye of the cyclone to the drone-equipped oceanographers, all track these storms to Miami. Their aim is to anticipate precisely the place and strength of the impact, a crucial challenge because the climate is warming.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.title: Cherbourg: The submarine factory
programme.desc: The Redoutable, the first French nuclear submarine. It is the starting point for an unusual industrial and geopolitical adventure: that of the Cherbourg arsenal. Through unpublished archives and testimonies of workers, engineers and sailors of the time, exploration behind the scenes of a top secret construction site, emblematic of the French nuclear power. Beyond the technological feat, the Cherbourg naval base also has a social history, that of a territory shaped by the defence industry, between worker pride, collective memory and contemporary issues.

programme.title: Teen and criminal: how did they turn?
programme.desc: On October 19, 2017, around the leisure base of Val du Riot, in Caudry, in the North, two walkers discover Ginette Alvarez's lifeless body, a person without history and discreet who is walking every day. The quinquennial was stabbed in the back. A witness call is being launched, but it is not successful. Until six months later, a 15-year-old college student, Corentin, told social media comrades that he was the perpetrator of the murder. However, the adolescent cannot explain his actions.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries

programme.title: The faces of crime
programme.sub-title: Philippe Gletty case: The boss we loved too much
programme.desc: How did Philippe Gletty's multiple lives lead him to death? On 4 March 2012, the body of this business manager was found in a forest path where he had curious habits. His execution gave him no chance. Yet this generous man seemed to be loved by all.

programme.title: The faces of crime in the region
programme.desc: In July 2013, Legionnaire Francisco Benitez reported the disappearance of his wife Marie-Josée and their 19-year-old daughter Allison at the Perpignan police station. A text from Marie-Josée's phone seems to indicate that the two women had fled to Toulouse. But this thesis does not seem to hold because the girl had to fulfill her dream: to compete in the election of Miss Roussillon. Ten days later, Francisco Benitez hangs himself at the Joffre barracks in Perpignan after having claimed his innocence in a letter.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age
programme.desc: In Iceland, a cataclysmic volcanic eruption triggers a series of events threatening humanity. A thick cloud of ashes extends across the globe, causing radical climate change and plunges North America and the rest of the world into a new ice age. The fall of temperatures is brutal, transforming familiar landscapes into an ice desert. In this apocalyptic context, the Hart family finds itself at the heart of chaos, struggling for their survival in the face of extreme conditions and invisible threats. Meanwhile, a team of scientists, determined to reverse the course of events, is mobilizing to find a solution to this unprecedented climate crisis. As time is running out and the extinction of humanity seems imminent, Harts and scientists must join forces to face the ice storm that threatens to swallow everything.

programme.title: The strength of the oceans
programme.desc: Experts are tracking hurricanes threatening the West Indies. Their aim is to better predict these severe cyclones intensified by global warming.
programme.desc-more: Every year, the French Antilles fear the arrival of devastating cyclones. Faced with these phenomena, many specialists are mobilizing. Pilots crossing the eye of the cyclone to the drone-equipped oceanographers, all track these storms to Miami. Their aim is to anticipate precisely the place and strength of the impact, a crucial challenge because the climate is warming.

programme.title: Bonifacio Falaise: Inevitable Erosion?
programme.desc: In Bonifacio, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of the erosion phenomenon that weakens the cliffs and anticipate the next collapses.
programme.desc-more: Perched on its limestone cliffs more than 80 meters above the Mediterranean, Bonifacio has been fascinated since the 12th century. Behind this picture of postcard is a real threat. The cliffs, subjected to the constant assaults of the sea and weakened by rainwater infiltrations, are gradually eroding. In 2022, the danger rose by a step: several houses were targeted by prefectural orders because of the risk of collapse. On the spot, scientists and geologists seek to understand the evolution of this phenomenon and to anticipate future collapses. Through their research, the city, originally conceived as a stunning fortress, reveals its extreme fragility. How far could erosion endanger Bonifacio's future?

programme.title: Cherbourg: The submarine factory
programme.desc: The Redoutable, the first French nuclear submarine. It is the starting point for an unusual industrial and geopolitical adventure: that of the Cherbourg arsenal. Through unpublished archives and testimonies of workers, engineers and sailors of the time, exploration behind the scenes of a top secret construction site, emblematic of the French nuclear power. Beyond the technological feat, the Cherbourg naval base also has a social history, that of a territory shaped by the defence industry, between worker pride, collective memory and contemporary issues.

programme.title: Teen and criminal: how did they turn?
programme.desc: On 19 October 2017, in Caudry, in northern France, a woman's body was discovered near the leisure base of the Val du Riot, which had been stabbed in the back.
programme.desc-more: On October 19, 2017, around the leisure base of Val du Riot, in Caudry, in the North, two walkers discover Ginette Alvarez's lifeless body, a person without history and discreet who is walking every day. The quinquennial was stabbed in the back. A witness call is being launched, but it is not successful. Until six months later, a 15-year-old college student, Corentin, told social media comrades that he was the perpetrator of the murder. However, the adolescent cannot explain his actions.

programme.title: Teen and criminal: how did they turn?
programme.desc: One day in January 2012, in Edouvans in the Doubs, Maxime, 14, passionate about mechanics, warns his parents that he will go on a motorcycle to join his friend Jeffrey, 17, but the evening came he did not return. The next day, his body, which was charred and had a large number of stab wounds, will be found on a forest road. Investigators immediately suspect Jeffrey. He had done a lot of research on the Internet to find out how to commit the perfect crime a few days before.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: Discovery of unknown places, dug by man: secret passages, underground churches or hidden caves. In the forest of Fontainebleau (Seine-et-Marne), a extinct civilization left enigmatic engravings in a mysterious cave. These could date from 6,000 years before J.C. Then, in the direction of Dénezé-sous-Doué, in Maine-et-Loire, where a cave houses an amazing series of statues engraved in the rock. Protestants or 16th-century Catholics could be the authors.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: Throughout France, historic places have been the scene of strange events • For centuries, a creature would have killed those who approached the Dordogne River, which joins the Garonne River. What really happened in the 1970s at the Château de Veauce, in the department of l'Allier? • In the Middle Ages, the Serre forest in the northern Jura was marked by a terrible history. • In Strasbourg, during the summer of 1518, a strange epidemic affected hundreds of inhabitants.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: A visionary Tyran or genius: Napoleon has been the subject of attacks as excessive as the admiration of his faithful. Two centuries later, the Emperor born in Ajaccio continues to divide and passion. Architect of modern law, institutions and contemporary military strategy, he deeply shaped France, leaving a complex and controversial legacy. Discovers the shadow zones and contradictions of an unusual character.

programme.title: Snowden
programme.desc: In 2013, an NSA analyst discovered that the world's population was being monitored via telecommunications and revealed the scandal to the press.
programme.desc-more: In the shadow of ultra-secure screens and servers, a relentless machine runs relentlessly, sucking billions of data every day from their owners' unseen knowledge. At the heart of this Orwellian system is the NSA, a government agency whose tentacles extend far beyond the American borders, tracking calls, emails, messages and even less digital traces left by ignores citizens. Under national security cover, a mass surveillance system has been established, fed by troubled alliances with tech giants and protected by layers of secrecy. It is in this maze of institutionalized lies that Edward Snowden (Joseph Gordon-Levitt), a young brilliant and idealistic analyst, enters believing that he is serving his country. With his outstanding cybersecurity skills, Snowden gradually accesses the darkest parts of the state apparatus. What he discovers is beyond understanding: a systematic, methodical intrusion into the privacy of millions of individuals, a massive violation of fundamental freedoms orchestrated by those who swear to protect them. While his superiors told him that these practices were necessary to counter terrorist threats, Snowden saw a whole new reality emerging – that of power without control, where the end justifies all means, where every citizen is a powerful suspect.

programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Real Steel
programme.desc: The boxing between humans no longer exists, people now admire the fighting of the ringbox, which opposes remote controlled machines. Covered with debts, Charlie is living through old-fashioned robots and scumbags. He must have been looking after Max, his son, for a summer he hasn't seen in a long time. They're not getting along well. One night Max finds himself in an old robot Atom case. He's reconnecting it.

programme.title: Eyjafjallajökull
programme.desc: Valérie and Alain, a divorced couple who have not been able to get along for a long time, find themselves forced to join forces on a plane trip to Greece, where they must attend their daughter's wedding. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when the eruption of the Icelandic volcano Eyjafjallajökull causes a change of destination, forcing their flight to land thousands of kilometres from their original goal. Now stuck together, Valérie and Alain have to drive over 2,000 kilometres to reach the wedding venue. Their journey is expected to be tumultuous, marked by tensions and disputes, as they are confronted with their common past and their accumulated grudges. The road quickly becomes a real verbal battlefield, where insults and humiliations are coming along, revealing the still sharp wounds of their separation. Throughout this journey, the two former spouses will have to navigate through their confrontational emotions and discover whether, despite their differences, there is a glimmer of hope for reconciliation.

programme.title: Why I Live
programme.desc: Mickaël Lumière (Gregory Lemarchal), a young man whose destiny marked the whole of France. In December 2004, under the bright lights of the Star Academy stage, Gregory won live competition in front of millions of viewers, becoming a star loved and a symbol of hope. But behind this victory lies a much more complex reality: since childhood Gregory has been living with cystic fibrosis, a devastating genetic disease that limits her life expectancy and puts her body to a severe test every day. This immersive narrative explores more than just an ascent to fame. He plunges into the privacy of an exceptional young man whose strength of character and passion for music transcend the obstacles imposed by his illness. Surrounded by the unwavering love of his loved ones, Gregory draws unwavering energy from their support. Despite repeated hospitalizations, exhausting treatments and moments of doubt, he refused to be defined by his illness. His voice, both powerful and fragile, becomes the vector of his dreams and his struggles, touching the heart of an audience who sees in him much more than just a singer.

programme.title: Mont Blanc, in the heart of the giant
programme.desc: In September 2026, a team of experts embarked on a unique and spectacular mission: climbing the roof of Western Europe to measure its exact altitude. The opportunity to test this colossus of ice and rock, whose variations tell the story of an environment in perpetual transformation and, at the key, a surprise: the summit has increased 1.88 meters compared to the previous survey, recalling that Mont Blanc is a living giant whose silhouette is constantly evolving. From glaciers to the eternal snows of the summit, plunge into the heart of this majestic and fragile massif, which has become one of the most observed witnesses of climate change.

programme.title: We must save Mont-Saint-Michel
programme.desc: If nothing was done, Mont-Saint-Michel could have lost what makes its legend: being an island. To save this emblematic monument from silting, the French state launched in the early 2000s one of the largest heritage sites ever undertaken in France. Hydraulic dam, new generation bridge,: plunge into the scenes of this battle against nature. Ten years after completion of the work, is the mission accomplished? Has Mont-Saint-Michel really become an island again?

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: A visionary Tyran or genius: Napoleon has been the subject of attacks as excessive as the admiration of his faithful. Two centuries later, the Emperor born in Ajaccio continues to divide and passion. Architect of modern law, institutions and contemporary military strategy, he deeply shaped France, leaving a complex and controversial legacy. Discovers the shadow zones and contradictions of an unusual character.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.sub-title: In the secret of the Templars
programme.desc: Belonging to the most secret and powerful religious and military order of the Middle Ages, the Templars left their mark on many sites in France. To make their rituals discover, which some associate with witchcraft, this documentary presents these extraordinary places. Among them, Domme, a small village in Dordogne where the history of these legendary knights would have crossed that of the Grail, but also Normandy, where a considerable fortune would be hidden, the forest of Orient, in Champagne, and the Abbey of Maubuisson, in Val-d-Oise.

programme.title: Secret France: the heart of mysteries
programme.desc: In Chinon, the peasant Jeanne d'Arc met on 25 February 1429 the future king of France Charles VII. That's where the young woman managed to convince him that she would help him deliver Orleans as soon as possible from the British assault. In Normandy, the German army occupied Falaise from 1940 to 1944. Soldiers searched the Château Guillaume-le-Conquerant in search of the Saint-Graal. At Fecamp, the discovery in July 1171 of two lead cases containing particles of Christ's blood attracted pilgrims for centuries.

programme.title: FBI: Missing Persons
programme.desc: In this intense season of "FBI: missing", the team of the Missing Persons Brigade is confronted with the tragic consequences of a hunt that has left deep scars. Danny (Enrique Murciano), haunted by post-traumatic stress, struggles to regain his balance, while Martin (Eric Close), seriously shot wounded, has to fight against a painkillers addiction that threatens his career. To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.

To strengthen the team, Jack (Anthony LaPaglia) welcomes Elena Delgado (Roselyn Sanchez), a former New York policeman with methods often considered aggressive, which brings a new dynamic but also tensions within the group. At the same time, Jack began an affair with Anne Cassidy (Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio), the widow of one of her mentors, adding a personal touch to her professional commitment. This season is marked by unusual investigations, including the one aimed at discovering the identity of an amnesia, thus breaking with the usual routine of disappearances.
programme.desc-more: The team of Jack Malone (Anthony LaPaglia), an experienced FBI agent, finds herself facing a delicate investigation when she receives a call about the disappearance of Barry Rosen, a man who recently won a chili eater contest with a $5,000 prize. While Barry seemed to be in good shape, his doctor had advised him to avoid this type of risk activity, fearing for his health. Far from being a mere case of disappearance, this case raises questions about the reasons and circumstances surrounding Barry's victory. Poppy Montgomery, in the role of Samantha Spade, and Enrique Murciano, incarnation of Danny Taylor, join Jack in this investigation that led them to explore the world of food competitions. As the investigation progresses, the team will discover hidden secrets and unexpected rivalries, while sailing through the stress and pressure of a race against the clock to find Barry before it is too late.

programme.title: Pearl Harbor, the world is burning
programme.desc: In the late 1930s, Japan intended to expand its empire to all Asia to re-establish its economy. Its objective is to break the Western powers out of the Asian continent and seize their colonies. To calm Japan's expansionary ardour, the United States imposed an embargo on Japan. In response, on 7 December 1941, Japan launched a surprise attack on the main American fleet anchored at Pearl Harbor base in Hawaii. The United States, which was struck at the heart of its defensive system, entered the war against the Japanese Empire the next day.

programme.title: Hitler Youth, the Indoctrination of a Nation
programme.desc: A review of the history of Hitler's Youth, which began in the 1920s, at the same time as the Nazi party was born. At that time, almost all political organizations had their youth movements, inspired by Scouting. In the "Hitlerjugend" (HJ), uniform is mandatory and masks social differences. Initially reluctant, Hitler understood that these children aged 6 to 18 represented the future of his party and his army. Hans Müncheberg, Salomon Perel, Alfons Rujner, Hans Werk and Wilhelm Küpper, who were among them, remember.

programme.title: Paris: The secret places of the occupation
programme.desc: The undergrounds of Paris played a central role during the occupation. In 1943, while the Nazis invested in the capital's careers and requisitioned strategic places by creating bunkers in the basement, they settled near the Senate where they decided to build an underground shelter 14 metres below the ground to act as a command post. In front of it, the French Resistance, under the leadership of Henri Rol-Tanguy, invests the capital's careers and creates its strategic command post under the Place Denfert Rochereau. The central role of the undergrounds of Paris during the occupation is understood through testimonies of survivors, interviews with historians and archival images.

programme.desc: Near Tarbes, in the Hautes-Pyrénées, the Sanguinet pruning company is not receding in the face of any challenge. In the Alpes-de-Haute-Provence, Thierry Tron and his son Thomas test the limits of their ultra-performance machines at 2000 meters altitude and must manoeuvre precisely in disregard of the danger before passing the relay to the carrier who will have to travel several kilometers under high voltage to lead his cargo to a good port.

programme.desc: Three construction sites with obstacles will make the foresters hard to live. In the Haute-Loire region, Benoît Godin and his team will have to cut down trees in a record time along a national whose circulation will not be cut off. But to work faster and faster, risks are increasing. 600 km from there, in the Alps of Haute-Provence, Etienne Seillier faces a major mission on extremely steep slopes. Only a very sophisticated technique will help him to get through it. But he will have to deal with aging equipment that will complicate his task. Finally, in the Basque country, Arian Perroux shoulder Nano in the pruning of four old poplars literally glued to a private property. This particularly brittle essence will complicate their mission.

The young woman will have to overcome many challenges to convince Enzo that she deserves her place in the company.

programme.title: The great puzzles of history
programme.desc: The ten plagues of Egypt, as told in the Bible, could have a scientific explanation. Researchers and archaeologists explore temples, volcanoes and lost cities to show that a volcanic eruption would have triggered a natural domino effect: the Red Nile, dead fish, insects, plague and climate change. This catastrophic phenomenon could be the cause of the ten Bible plagues.

programme.title: The Great Enigmas of History - S03E04
programme.desc: The tomb of Pharaoh Tutânkhamon is one of the greatest discoveries in the history of archaeology. The funeral treasure found by its side still fascinates the whole world. His tomb is also full of mysteries, several puzzles have never been elucidated. The technological advances have made it possible to reopen the investigation.

programme.title: The Great Enigmas of History - S06E05
programme.sub-title: Egypt, the volcano of the apocalypse
programme.desc: The fall of ancient Egypt may not be solely related to Cleopatra, which in 44 BC faced the assassination of his lover Julius Caesar. At that time, the whole world seemed to be standing against it as drought, famine and disease were spreading to the country. In Greenland's ice caps, new evidence indicates that Egypt's fall may have been accelerated by a major volcanic eruption.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Benson and Stabler investigate both an Islamophobic hate crime, a high school shooting, slave trafficking and a violent husband, and the multitude of sexual maniacs running the streets of New York. Their already trying investigations become almost impossible when victims themselves hesitate to testify. When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.
programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who made his daughter laugh
programme.desc: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.
programme.desc-more: "Friends", cult series, follows the adventures of six young New York singles. Monica, who lives in Manhattan, finds Rachel, a childhood friend who fled her marriage. They move in together and Rachel joins the circle of friends: Phoebe, Monica's ex-coloc, Chandler and Joey, their neighbors, and Ross, Monica's brother, who has been in love with Rachel since high school. The band often finds themselves at Central Perk. For ten seasons, spectators follow their careers and love stories.

While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: Josephine, guardian angel
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 14 of the Joséphine series, guardian angel, with Mimie Mathy, Philippe Caroit, Romane Portail
programme.desc-more: Josephine Delamarre (interpreted by Mimie Mathy) is much more than just a mortal; She is a guardian angel whose mission is to bring love, comfort and solutions to people in distress. With its invisible wings and heart overflowing with empathy, Josephine has magical powers that allow her to intervene in the lives of those who need her most. Whether it is to restore peace to a couple in crisis, save a company in disarray or support a young person in difficulty, Josephine always gives herself a lot of time in every situation she encounters. As the episodes progress, Josephine finds herself facing a variety of characters. She crossed the road of Shirley Bousquet, Bruno Debrandt and Jeremy Banster, each of whom, in their own way, embodied beings who were in the throes of personal dilemmas and trials. Each meeting is an opportunity for Josephine to deploy a cascade of strategies to bring a solution, while juggling the challenges of her own existence. She appeals to her wisdom, humour and creativity to give hope back to lost souls. Each episode illustrates how, even in the most desperate situations, a little magic and a lot of empathy can transform lives.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: Benson and Stabler are investigating the death of a woman, a man who was undercover, found dead and raped on a sidewalk in New York, her drug-covered coat.
programme.desc-more: Benson and Stabler investigate both an Islamophobic hate crime, a high school shooting, slave trafficking and a violent husband, and the multitude of sexual maniacs running the streets of New York. Their already trying investigations become almost impossible when victims themselves hesitate to testify. When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who made his daughter laugh
programme.desc: By singing a song to his daughter, Ross discovers that he can make her laugh, but also that he can sleep her: he dares not tell Rachel about it.
programme.desc-more: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: The Magi Kings
programme.desc: As they head for the Nativity crèche, the three Kings are suddenly projected into the future, in the 21st century, in Paris.
programme.desc-more: In the ancient East, under a shooting star announcing the birth of a king, three wise and venerable men, Melchior (Didier Bourdon), Gaspard (Pascal Légitimes) and Balthazar (Didier Bourdon), traveled through the deserts and mountains to Bethlehem. With gold, incense and myrrh, these Magi kings, as determined as they are naive, follow the heavenly light with unwavering faith. Their mission is clear: to pay homage to the Child Jesus, whose coming must change the course of history. But as they prepare to accomplish their destiny, a strange and inexplicable phenomenon propels them through the centuries, catapulting them into a world they cannot understand. When they open their eyes, it is in the Paris of the 21st century that they find themselves, in the midst of horns, neon and an indifferent crowd in a hurry to go about its occupations. Disoriented, but always driven by their sacred quest, the three men try to adapt to this modern world where no one believes in their history. Their eccentric appearance, their old-fashioned outfits and their mysterious discourses on a star and a divine newborn are worth being taken for marginals, even illuminated ones. Yet, despite the mockery and general misunderstoodness, Melchior, Gaspard and Balthazar refused to give up. They are convinced that the Child Jesus is hiding somewhere in this tentacular city, and they intend to find him.

programme.title: The Hobbit: Smaug's Desolation
programme.desc: With dwarfs, a hobby confronts a thousand dangers and a dragon holding a treasure. He takes over a power ring held by a strange creature.
programme.desc-more: Bilbon Sacquet (Martin Freeman), the discreet but courageous hobby, continues his perilous quest alongside Thorin Écu-de-Chêne (Richard Armitage) and his company of Dwarfs determined to take over their lost kingdom, Erebor, from the claws of the dragon Smaugh. Their journey leads them through hostile lands, where every forest, river and mountain contains deadly dangers, but also unexpected allies. After having barely escaped the trolls of the mountains, the group sinks into the dark depths of the Mirkwood Forest, a cursed place where black magic corrupted until the sunlight. Trees similar to spectra, deceptive illusions and creatures tamped in the shadows transform this crossing into a test of endurance and trickiness. Yet, this is just a taste of the horrors that await them: giant spiders, thirsty with flesh, stretch their mortal webs, while the Elves of the Black Forest, led by Prince Legolas (Orlando Bloom) and Captain Tauriel (Evangeline Lilly), capture them, taking them as intruders. If Legolas, guided by a mixture of mistrust and curiosity, hesitates to let them go, Tauriel, whose sense of justice transcends the borders of his people, sees in them a glimmer of hope in a world that is becoming increasingly darker. Freed from a daring escape, Bilbon and the Dwarfs find themselves propelled towards the shores of Lake Town, a prosperous human city built on stilts, where the reception is as uncertain as the deep waters surrounding it. Meanwhile, a much greater threat is emerging: Smaught (voice of Benedict Cumberbatch), the golden dragon with piercing eyes and implacable trick, watches over his treasure in the bowels of the Solitary Mountain, still unaware that intruders dare to defy his reign.
