programme.desc: A family with four children arrives, as every year, at the campsite, but each of its members has some small difficulties: Tom is moved.
programme.desc-more: Every summer, the Lefranc family settles at the campsite for a sunny holiday, but this year, the joy is tinged with tensions. The young Oscar, full of energy, sows the trouble with his incessant whims, while his sister Mathilde, a gifted child, feels abandoned by comrades who are too little stimulating to his taste. The situation becomes more complicated when Christophe, the father, announces an imminent mutation in Paris, a news that tears Elodie, his wife. Faced with this whirlwind of family difficulties, Tom, the manager of the campsite, is committed to helping. It has a variety of activities to strengthen ties between family members and restore harmony before the end of the summer.

programme.title: The teacher
programme.desc: A former unemployed clothing seller finds his salvation by becoming a teacher in an institution attended by turbulent students.
programme.desc-more: In the film "Le maître d'école" (1981), Gérard (interpreted by Coluche) is a dreamer and idealist who works as a salesman in a ready-to-wear shop in Paris. His life turns on the day he is witnessing an shocking incident: his boss does not hesitate to slap a child caught in flagrante delicto de thieving. This scene will awaken a deep indignation and awareness of the importance of education and benevolence to the younger ones. In reaction, Gérard made the radical decision to leave his job and to embark on a path that seemed to be more consistent with him: that of teaching. With his bachelor's degree and some notions of law, he became an alternate teacher and was appointed to a small provincial school. However, he quickly encountered the reality of the teaching profession, discovering that ethics, pedagogy and classroom management were skills that were not being improvised. Gérard faces many challenges, including the difficult behaviour of students, the resistance of some of the teaching staff, and his own inexperience. programme.title: New York, Criminal Section
programme.desc: "Machinery to kill"Inquiring into a series of murders of rich patrons, Logan and Barek go back to a woman, Chesley Watkins, the adoptive mother of many orphans.
programme.desc-more: In this fifth season of "New York, Criminal Section", Inspectors Robert Goren (Vincent D'Onofrio) and Alexandra Eames (Kathryn Erbe) welcome two new officers, Veteran Mike Logan (Chris Not) and Inspector Carolyn Barek (Annabella Sciorra). Although the two investigators' duos never cross, each one is confronted with complex and intriguing cases. Goren and Eames find themselves facing a grieving patriarch (Malcolm McDowell), whose grief hides dark secrets, while Logan and Barek have to navigate the tumults of a charismatic adoptive mother (Whoopi Goldberg), whose protégés seem to have drifted to crime. This season is distinguished by its innovative formula, where each pair of actors devotes themselves to only half a season, with one episode in two. Fred Dalton Thompson also made a striking appearance, adding a familiar touch to this new dynamic within the "Law & Order" universe.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: "The fugitive"Two criminals escaped from prison: it seems that one of them decided to take revenge on his former girlfriend, whose son he has previously raped.
programme.desc-more: Benson and Stabler investigate both an Islamophobic hate crime, a high school shooting, slave trafficking and a violent husband, and the multitude of sexual maniacs running the streets of New York. Their already trying investigations become almost impossible when victims themselves hesitate to testify. When two parents refuse to report a child to a paedophile in exchange for a large sum of money, Stabler's blood is only a turn. An episode inspired, like many others, by real facts. At the end of the season, Alexandra Cabot's character left his post and would only appear sporadically.

programme.title: Friends
programme.sub-title: The one who didn't want a baby anymore
programme.desc: In this memorable season of the iconic series, friendship and relationships continue to become complex for the inseparable group. While Chandler Bing (Matthew Perry) and Monica Geller (Courteney Cox) are embarking on an unexpected adventure trying to design a child in a maternity closet, the dynamics between other friends are changing. Joey Tribbiani (Matt LeBlanc), in a misunderstanding, finds himself improvising a meeting between Phoebe Buffay (Lisa Kudrow) and a mysterious stranger, Mike (Paul Rudd), who might well upset her life. Meanwhile, Rachel Green (Jennifer Aniston) is back on the job, and her feelings towards Ross Geller (David Schwimmer) are getting complicated, especially with the arrival of Charlie, a seductive colleague. Tensions rise and laughter is coming as each navigates through the joys and challenges of love, friendship and careers, all with unforgettable humour.

programme.title: The teacher
programme.desc: A former unemployed clothing seller finds his salvation by becoming a teacher in an institution attended by turbulent students.
programme.desc-more: In the film "Le maître d'école" (1981), Gérard (interpreted by Coluche) is a dreamer and idealist who works as a salesman in a ready-to-wear shop in Paris. His life turns on the day he is witnessing an shocking incident: his boss does not hesitate to slap a child caught in flagrante delicto de thieving. This scene will awaken a deep indignation and awareness of the importance of education and benevolence to the younger ones. In reaction, Gérard made the radical decision to leave his job and to embark on a path that seemed to be more consistent with him: that of teaching. With his bachelor's degree and some notions of law, he became an alternate teacher and was appointed to a small provincial school. However, he quickly encountered the reality of the teaching profession, discovering that ethics, pedagogy and classroom management were skills that were not being improvised. Gérard faces many challenges, including the difficult behaviour of students, the resistance of some of the teaching staff, and his own inexperience. However, with the help of her new colleagues – in particular Jacqueline Lajoie (played by Josiane Balasko), a passionate teacher, and Monsieur Meignant, an experienced teacher – Gérard begins to tame the subtleties of the profession. Through moments of doubt, failure and success, he learns the importance of patience, listening and empathy. Gradually, thanks to his passion and sincere commitment to his students, he managed to make himself indispensable and gain respect for both children and educators.

programme.title: Two superflics
programme.desc: In Miami, Florida, two unworked criminals are mistakenly recruited into the police and are actively fighting against large drug layings.
programme.desc-more: In Miami, Matt (Terence Hill) and Wilbur (Bud Spencer), two small crooks seeking recognition, try to enter the world of crime by being hired by a local malfrat. However, their ambition quickly led to a fight that eventually united them as friends and accomplices. Hoping to make a name, they decide to make a hold-up. However, Wilbur's unsightlyness creates a series of nasty and unforeseen situations that complicate their plan. To the surprise of the two men, they found themselves forcibly enlisted in a police training course, where they learned the basics of the profession, but in their unconventional way. Matt and Wilbur were eventually sent to the field, becoming police officers for the least atypical. During their mission, they met Susy Lee (Laura Gemser), an Asian young woman whose brother had recently been murdered. Motivated by a mixture of curiosity and desire to do justice, the two friends will try to solve this mysterious murder while navigating through the mess of the criminal world and the absurdities of their new existence as police officers.

programme.title: Miami superflics
programme.desc: In 1978, the Detroit bank was the victim of a bold robbery orchestrated by the formidable Joe Garret (Richard Liberty), who managed to eclipse himself with a massive $20 million loot. While one of his accomplices was shot dead during the operation, the other was apprehended by the police. Seven years later, in 1985, Garret's recently released ex-acolyte was found murdered in Miami in brutal circumstances. This event draws the attention of Doug Bennett (Terence Hill) and Steve Forest (Bud Spencer), two FBI agents who previously contributed to Garret's incarceration.To conduct the investigation, the two officers adopted the appearance of mere cops in order not to arouse suspicion. In a series of unpredictable twists, they start a frantic hunt through Miami, gradually revealing a complex criminal network. As they attempt to unravel the mystery surrounding the death of ex-comlice, the tension rises sharply, making their mission both perilous and thrilling.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.sub-title: Huikau na makau a na lawai'a
programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

She offered to participate in the charitable operation "Happy Christmas", which allowed her to raise funds for children whose parents were on mission. The time spent together will bring them closer together.

programme.title: The Christmas Legend
programme.desc: Harper had entrusted a box full of Christmas decorations, including a ball of mistletoe, to a friend who mistakenly gave it to a balance shop. His sister wishes to get this object back at all costs. Harper then went looking for the ball of mistletoe, because in his family, a legend wanted that when lovers kissed under a ball of mistletoe on the evening of New Year's Eve, they would marry before the next Christmas. The young woman is helped by Luke, the manager of the balancet. Gradually, both adults begin to bond.

programme.title: A Christmas tree, two lovers
programme.desc: In the snowy little town of Silver Peak, nestled in the heart of Colorado mountains, the end-of-year celebrations are sacred, especially for Erin Whitmore, the charismatic and determined daughter of the mayor. The event is a celebration of the famous light of the great tree, an event that brings together every year, inhabitants and tourists, and it is set to embark on a quest: to find the perfect tree, symbol of magic and unity. His choice is quickly made on a majestic spruce, punctuating in the garden of his mysterious neighbour, Kevin Dawson, a firefighter with a look as warm as his character is cold. But if Erin sees in this tree the centrepiece of his celebration, Kevin is viscerally attached to it. He was a former military servant who was converted to rescue, and he maintained a persistent resentment at Mayor Whitmore, whose past decisions, he said, betrayed the values of the community. In between, the dialogue will be as icy as the surrounding summits. However, Erin, determined not to give up, uses a trick as bold as she does unexpectedly: she proposes to Kevin to supervise the safety of the event, a role that will put him at the heart of the preparations... and will give him the opportunity to change his mind.

programme.title: A sweeter Christmas
programme.desc: As they prepare their wedding, Sophie and Sam are so surprised to see their love story adapted to Christmas film! Their small town of Waynesbridge is turning into a filming set, thus upsetting their daily lives. In the spotlight, everyone's expectations and unforeseen events are accumulating, putting their couple seriously to the test. Will they succeed in preserving their love and finally organizing the marriage they dream of?

programme.title: Christmas shoes
programme.desc: As snowflakes swirl in the illuminated streets of New York, Noëlle Carpenter, a lonely and disenchanted young woman, finds herself trapped in the Hudsons department store, where she works as a saleswoman. Tonight, on Christmas Eve, fate seems to have other plans for it. As she prepares to spend a morose night between desert rays, a mysterious unknown appears: Charlie (Candace Cameron Bure), a woman with enigmatic smile and a look full of strange benevolence. She's not exactly like the others. Charlie presents himself as an angel-guardian, who comes to offer him a gift as unexpected as extraordinary: a pair of magical shoes. These shoes, as elegant as they are unusual, have a fascinating power: each one of them allows Christmas to relive one of its last three Christmases, as if time were more than a canvas that it could undo and re-woven as it pleases. But why these memories in particular? And what does she seek to understand, or perhaps to repair, by going back into those moments? Between the suffocating laughter of a family Christmas Eve, the choices she regretted and the opportunities she had let go, Noëlle found herself confronted with her own regrets, her disappointed hopes and those small decisions that, without she had to account for, had shaped the course of her life.

programme.title: A Christmas in Scotland
programme.desc: In the heart of the Scottish Highlands, where snowy landscapes and Celtic legends blend under a winter sky, Lucy, a passionate but difficult archaeology professor, arrives with a crucial mission. Threatened to lose her post at the university, she must definitely find the ruins of a sanctuary dedicated to Beira, the mythical queen of winter, whose discovery could save her career. Her investigation leads her to an isolated manor, as majestic as it is enigmatic, held with an iron hand by Edina McAvoy, a woman of a well-dimmed character, convinced that the place is haunted by the ghost of her late husband. Between strange noises, slamming doors and painful memories, the atmosphere is charged with a mysterious melancholy, as if the past refused to erase. To explore the archaeological sites scattered throughout the region, Lucy turns to Duncan, the son of Edina, a charismatic but tormented man. Owner of a difficult whisky distillery, he gave up his dreams to take over the family business, but struggled to find a balance between tradition and modernity. Despite his initial reluctance, he agreed to guide Lucy through the icy moors and ancestral forests, where each stone could give a clue about the lost sanctuary. Between improvised excavations, evenings at the corner of the fire and shared confidences, an unexpected complicity arises between them, shaking their certainty. Yet their quest is confronted with unforeseen obstacles: hostile weather conditions, local rumours about a curse linked to Beira, and above all, the family tensions that are re-emerging. Edina, distrustful of this stranger who interferes in their lives, sees this collaboration with a bad eye. And when Lucy discovers that the sanctuary could be linked to a legend far darker than expected, she realizes that her research is putting in jeopardy much more than her career. Between ancient mysteries, emerging passions and heartbreaking choices, this Christmas in Scotland could well become the most unforgettable of their lives... But at what cost? In this enchanting winter tale, where history and present intertwine, a question persists: will they manage to reconcile their dreams with the ghosts of the past?

programme.title: A Christmas in Scotland
programme.desc: A young woman goes to Scotland to look for an old sanctuary which she hopes will revive her department in the university where she teaches.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of the Scottish Highlands, where snowy landscapes and Celtic legends blend under a winter sky, Lucy, a passionate but difficult archaeology professor, arrives with a crucial mission. Threatened to lose her post at the university, she must definitely find the ruins of a sanctuary dedicated to Beira, the mythical queen of winter, whose discovery could save her career. Her investigation leads her to an isolated manor, as majestic as it is enigmatic, held with an iron hand by Edina McAvoy, a woman of a well-dimmed character, convinced that the place is haunted by the ghost of her late husband. Between strange noises, slamming doors and painful memories, the atmosphere is charged with a mysterious melancholy, as if the past refused to erase. To explore the archaeological sites scattered throughout the region, Lucy turns to Duncan, the son of Edina, a charismatic but tormented man. Owner of a difficult whisky distillery, he gave up his dreams to take over the family business, but struggled to find a balance between tradition and modernity. Despite his initial reluctance, he agreed to guide Lucy through the icy moors and ancestral forests, where each stone could give a clue about the lost sanctuary. Between improvised excavations, evenings at the corner of the fire and shared confidences, an unexpected complicity arises between them, shaking their certainty. Yet their quest is confronted with unforeseen obstacles: hostile weather conditions, local rumours about a curse linked to Beira, and above all, the family tensions that are re-emerging. Edina, distrustful of this stranger who interferes in their lives, sees this collaboration with a bad eye. And when Lucy discovers that the sanctuary could be linked to a legend far darker than expected, she realizes that her research is putting in jeopardy much more than her career. Between ancient mysteries, emerging passions and heartbreaking choices, this Christmas in Scotland could well become the most unforgettable of their lives... But at what cost? In this enchanting winter tale, where history and present intertwine, a question persists: will they manage to reconcile their dreams with the ghosts of the past?

programme.title: The Tournesol case
programme.desc: Tintin and Haddock are looking for Professor Tournesol, who has just been abducted. Their investigation leads them to Borduria, a country in Eastern Europe.
programme.desc-more: Professor Tournesol, a leading scientist, has just developed a revolutionary invention: an ultrasonic weapon capable of destroying glass objects. Although initially conceived as a research project, this weapon has alarming destructive potential if it is perfected to target other materials. Only Professor Bretzel, his former colleague, has the knowledge to activate this machine. Tintin, accompanied by his faithful dog Milou, Captain Haddock and Professor Tournesol, set out to find Bretzel and warn him of the dangers of invention. However, they quickly discover that Bretzel was abducted by syldave agents. Shortly thereafter, Professor Tournesol's turn was to be kidnapped. Tintin and his friends then raced against the clock to find the missing scientists, thwart the malicious plans of the kidnappers and prevent this technology from falling into bad hands, while facing the obstacles that stand in their way.

118 is used in a shopping mall when a panicked mother reports the disappearance of her child. She doesn't know where he is, and the place is crowded.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

Athena and Bobby board their honeymoon cruise, but when duty calls them, their vacations are put on hold.
programme.desc-more: The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Fifth century, island of Brittany. The kingdom of Kaamelott is organized around its ruler, King Arthur. Surrounded by his faithful knights of the Round Table, he strives for the mission entrusted to him by the gods: to seek the Holy Grail!

programme.title: Lara Croft : Tomb Raider
programme.desc: An heiress, expert in antiquities and martial arts, is looking for a sacred object, also coveted by a sect as mysterious as it is worrying.
programme.desc-more: Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie), heiress of a colossal fortune and a line of fearless archaeologists, lives surrounded by priceless treasures, including a mysterious clock with unfathomable powers. This precious artifact, transmitted by his father, the famous archaeologist Lord Richard Croft (Jon Voight), contains a much greater secret than anything she could have imagined. Years earlier, his father had revealed to him the existence of the Illuminati, a secret and powerful organization, obsessed with the quest for this legendary clock. According to ancient accounts, this object would allow to control the gates of Time and Space, offering absolute power to the one who can use it. Lara discovers that, 5,000 years earlier, this clock had already played a decisive role in the victory of the first Illuminati over their enemies. But the mystery thickens when it learns that a rare astronomical phenomenon occurs every 5,000 years, aligning three planets to form a sacred triangle, making the clock operational. As the Illuminati, who are still active and more determined than ever, are approaching their goal, Lara is embarking on a frantic race across the globe. Between ancient ruins, mortal traps and ruthless enemies, it must decipher the riddles of the past to prevent this organization from achieving its dark purposes. With its sharp intelligence, legendary agility and boundless audacity, Lara Croft faces ever more perilous challenges. Each clue discovered brings it closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that threaten to rock everything.

programme.title: Magnitude 10.5: the apocalypse
programme.desc: In the United States, the rapprochement of the plates of the earth's crust is so fast that it causes a dramatic acceleration of geological changes.
programme.desc-more: In the United States, an unprecedented seismic cataclysm is being prepared when the brutal rapprochement of tectonic plates plunges the country into chaos. In a few hours, devastating earthquakes, tsunamis and floods ravage the coast, destroying entire cities and endangering the lives of millions of citizens. As the population is panicked, scientists, who had anticipated such a disaster in several millennia, find themselves deprived of the urgency of the situation. Seismologist Samantha Hill (Kim Delaney), accompanied by her father, is entrusted with the heavy task of finding a solution to save the country. In parallel, the president, incarnate by Beau Bridges, must navigate through political crises and decisions crucial to maintaining order and security. In this struggle against the clock, family ties and heartbreaking choices will be tested while the apocalypse threatens to take everything over.

programme.title: Magnitude 10.5: the apocalypse
programme.desc: Scientists are following with concern the formation of a fault in the Great Lakes region, as nuclear reactors are on its trajectory.
programme.desc-more: In a climate of seismic tension, scientists detect the formation of a threatening geological fault in the Great Lakes region. This natural phenomenon, which is rapidly changing towards the Gulf of Mexico, could lead to a catastrophic split of the United States into two continents, with disastrous repercussions on the population and the environment. At the heart of this crisis, Samantha Hill (Kim Delaney), an expert in seismology, alerts President Hollister (Beau Bridges) about the imminent dangers, including the proximity of two of the country's largest nuclear reactors on the fault path. In response, the president ordered the evacuation of the entire West Coast, anticipating a devastating earthquake. Samantha proposes a radical solution: an underground atomic explosion, the last attempt to stem the chain of shaking. As panic sets in, time is running out and every decision could be fatal to millions of lives.

programme.desc: It's the ingalls' effervescence. Mary was chosen to participate in a mathematics contest. The young woman elected and her mother go to Minneapolis...

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Charles and Mr. Edwards are embarking on a wild race to catch up with a crazy car in which Mary, Laura and Carl, the adoptive son of Mr. Edwards...
programme.desc-more: Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson), Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Carl (Sidney Greenbush) are curious children, captivated by the fascinating stories of the trains they heard at school. Their adventurous minds prompted them to convince Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and Mr. Edwards (Victor French) to take them on an excursion to the station, where they finally hoped to see these locomotives in action. Once there, the excitement rises as the children move away to play on a parked car, filled with carelessness and wonder. However, their joy quickly turns into terror when the car unwinds unexpectedly and begins to degrade the slope at full speed. As a train approaches at a high speed, Mary, Laura and Carl must show courage and ingenuity to try to control the situation and avoid a disaster. programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: Fifth century, island of Brittany. The kingdom of Kaamelott is organized around its ruler, King Arthur. Surrounded by his faithful knights of the Round Table, he strives for the mission entrusted to him by the gods: to seek the Holy Grail!
programme.desc-more: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: As they prepare to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the independence of the United States, the inhabitants of Walnut Grove receive a lesson in patriotism from a Russian immigrant.
programme.desc-more: In Walnut Grove, the effervescence is at its peak as the community prepares to celebrate the centennial of the United States of America. The villagers, led by Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), expressed their dissatisfaction with the increase in taxes, questioning the values and promises of the nation. At the heart of this turmoil, Yuli Pyatakov, a newly settled Russian immigrant, stands out for his unique view of America and its opportunities. Yuli, with her experience and personal struggles, tries to bring the community together around the idea that, despite the difficulties, there is still hope and pride to draw from their homeland. As tensions rise, the inhabitants of Walnut Grove will have to face their frustrations while rediscovering what makes their identity rich. The episode explores the themes of immigration, national identity and solidarity in times of crisis.

programme.title: The queens of the road
programme.desc: Clémence arrives early in Tours. After a detour imposed by a landslide, Cindy was delayed, while Mailys faced the traffic jams near Aix-les-Bains.
programme.desc-more: Clémence delivers to Pithiviers and arrives in advance in Tours, but presents the wrong delivery voucher. programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: As the financial crisis is hitting the region hard, farmers face unprecedented challenges. Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) and his friend Mr. Edwards, aware of the seriousness of the situation, accept a dangerous job: to transport an explosive product that could change the deal for their families. To carry out this mission, they join forces with Hill and Murphy, two trusted men, but the road they have to take is stumbling blocks and dangers. The picturesque landscapes of the prairie hide unexpected threats, making their journey all the more distressing. At every turn, they must show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles ahead. At the same time, tensions are rising among farmers, as they struggle to preserve their land and dignity in the face of adversity. This journey becomes a real test of their determination and friendship.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In a small village in the Midwest, the atmosphere at school is upset by the arrival of a new master, Mr. Applewood, who replaces Miss Beadle, the beloved school mistress. This change is not well experienced by the students, especially Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert), who quickly finds himself in the teacher's viewfinder. Applewood seems to have a attachment to her, unjustly accusing her of all the incidents that occur in her class, creating an atmosphere of tension and misunderstanding. Laura, usually full of life and curiosity, feels persecuted and unjustly treated. Her friends, including Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson) and twins Carrie and Grace (Lindsay and Sidney Greenbush), are trying to support her, but the situation is becoming more and more complicated. As pressure rises, Laura must find a way to defend her honour and restore justice to her class, while learning valuable lessons about resilience and friendship.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In Walnut Grove, the effervescence is at its peak as the community prepares to celebrate the centennial of the United States of America. The villagers, led by Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), expressed their dissatisfaction with the increase in taxes, questioning the values and promises of the nation. At the heart of this turmoil, Yuli Pyatakov, a newly settled Russian immigrant, stands out for his unique view of America and its opportunities. Yuli, with her experience and personal struggles, tries to bring the community together around the idea that, despite the difficulties, there is still hope and pride to draw from their homeland. As tensions rise, the inhabitants of Walnut Grove will have to face their frustrations while rediscovering what makes their identity rich. The episode explores the themes of immigration, national identity and solidarity in times of crisis.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In a small village in the Midwest, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is committed to doing various works for the widow Thurman, a recently bereaved woman. In exchange for his help, he hopes to obtain a precious porcelain service, an ideal gift for his wife, Caroline (Karen Grassle). Charles' closeness to the widow, however, while he spent many hours helping him, began to stir up murmuring among the inhabitants of Walnut Grove. The rumours of romance between Charles and the widow spread, creating a malaise within the community. Meanwhile, Caroline, though concerned about whispering, showed confidence in her husband. As tensions rise and the truth about their relationship emerges, Charles must navigate between his loving intentions and the hasty judgments of his fellow citizens, while preserving family harmony and the reputation of his wife.

After Bobby's death, barracks 118 must be rebuilt. Athena is conducting a dangerous investigation into a criminal network that fails to cost her life, before she is finally promoted to an inspector. She and Hen are also involved in a totally new mission in space. Buck, for his part, is looking for meaning in his life by taking under his wing the young Theo, while Eddie survives a stabbing attack and finds his son Christopher. Between mourning and renewal, the team is learning to be a reality.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

In exchange for his help, he hopes to obtain a precious porcelain service, an ideal gift for his wife, Caroline (Karen Grassle). Charles' closeness to the widow, however, while he spent many hours helping him, began to stir up murmuring among the inhabitants of Walnut Grove. The rumours of romance between Charles and the widow spread, creating a malaise within the community. Meanwhile, Caroline, though concerned about whispering, showed confidence in her husband. As tensions rise and the truth about their relationship emerges, Charles must navigate between his loving intentions and the hasty judgments of his fellow citizens, while preserving family harmony and the reputation of his wife.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: A devastating storm is coming down on the Ingalls' farm, destroying their crops and plunging the family into uncertainty. In the face of this disaster, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is forced to make a difficult decision: to leave for Wisconsin in search of better opportunities. However, this announcement only increases anxiety within the family, already experiencing difficulties. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) tries to keep up his spirits, but the prospect of leaving their homes, with memories and struggles, weighs heavily on the hearts of children, including Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson). While everyone expresses their fears and doubts, the dream of a better future seems to be moving away. Through family challenges and memories of their lives in Walnut Grove, this episode explores the themes of attachment to the earth, resilience and hope for adversity.

After Bobby's death, barracks 118 must be rebuilt. Athena is conducting a dangerous investigation into a criminal network that fails to cost her life, before she is finally promoted to an inspector. She and Hen are also involved in a totally new mission in space. Buck, for his part, is looking for meaning in his life by taking under his wing the young Theo, while Eddie survives a stabbing attack and finds his son Christopher. Between mourning and renewal, the team is learning to be a reality.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Kong : Skull Island
programme.desc: In 1944, an American soldier was forced to land on a Pacific island. He was soon joined by a Japanese soldier. But the two men face a greater danger: a giant monkey. In 1973, Bill Randa, a government envoy, and geologist Houston Brooks, organized a scientific mission on this island, long away from radars, and rich in potential scientific discoveries. Escorted by an adventurer, photographer and military escort, they boarded the island. Discover the origins of this famous monster.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: A treasure in your home
programme.desc: What if a treasure hides in your attic? In each episode, a private individual opens his or her doors, convinced to own a nugget: rare stamps, family jewels, old vase or forgotten old instrument. He entrusts us with the estimate he makes and what he dreams of accomplishing with that sum. Then visit a auctioneer, whose expert verdict sometimes contains cruel disillusionments... or beautiful surprises !!

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In Walnut Grove, the effervescence is at its peak as the community prepares to celebrate the centennial of the United States of America. The villagers, led by Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon), expressed their dissatisfaction with the increase in taxes, questioning the values and promises of the nation. At the heart of this turmoil, Yuli Pyatakov, a newly settled Russian immigrant, stands out for his unique view of America and its opportunities. Yuli, with her experience and personal struggles, tries to bring the community together around the idea that, despite the difficulties, there is still hope and pride to draw from their homeland. As tensions rise, the inhabitants of Walnut Grove will have to face their frustrations while rediscovering what makes their identity rich. The episode explores the themes of immigration, national identity and solidarity in times of crisis.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: In a small village in the Midwest, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is committed to doing various works for the widow Thurman, a recently bereaved woman. In exchange for his help, he hopes to obtain a precious porcelain service, an ideal gift for his wife, Caroline (Karen Grassle). Charles' closeness to the widow, however, while he spent many hours helping him, began to stir up murmuring among the inhabitants of Walnut Grove. The rumours of romance between Charles and the widow spread, creating a malaise within the community. Meanwhile, Caroline, though concerned about whispering, showed confidence in her husband. As tensions rise and the truth about their relationship emerges, Charles must navigate between his loving intentions and the hasty judgments of his fellow citizens, while preserving family harmony and the reputation of his wife.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: A devastating storm is coming down on the Ingalls' farm, destroying their crops and plunging the family into uncertainty. In the face of this disaster, Charles Ingalls (Michael Landon) is forced to make a difficult decision: to leave for Wisconsin in search of better opportunities. However, this announcement only increases anxiety within the family, already experiencing difficulties. Caroline Ingalls (Karen Grassle) tries to keep up his spirits, but the prospect of leaving their homes, with memories and struggles, weighs heavily on the hearts of children, including Laura (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary (Melissa Sue Anderson). While everyone expresses their fears and doubts, the dream of a better future seems to be moving away. Through family challenges and memories of their lives in Walnut Grove, this episode explores the themes of attachment to the earth, resilience and hope for adversity.

programme.title: The small house in the meadow
programme.desc: Granville Whipple, a talented musician, returned to Walnut Grove after being seriously injured during the Civil War. As he tries to reintegrate into the community, he is haunted by traumatic memories of his military past, making his recovery difficult. His inner pain is exacerbated by the eyes of others, who cannot help but see in him a broken hero. Despite these challenges, Granville found a semblance of comfort by reviving his passion for music. He decided to give classes to the children of the village, hoping to share his love of music while fighting his demons. As he learned, he established valuable links with the young students, including Laura Ingalls (Melissa Gilbert) and Mary Ingalls (Melissa Sue Anderson), who helped him rediscover joy and hope. This healing journey will not be without pitfalls, but it may well offer Granville a new chance to live.

After Bobby's death, barracks 118 must be rebuilt. Athena is conducting a dangerous investigation into a criminal network that fails to cost her life, before she is finally promoted to an inspector. She and Hen are also involved in a totally new mission in space. Buck, for his part, is looking for meaning in his life by taking under his wing the young Theo, while Eddie survives a stabbing attack and finds his son Christopher. Between mourning and renewal, the team is learning to be a reality.
programme.desc-more: 9-1-1 is a dramatic series that plunges into the heart of the crises that hit American citizens and highlights the heroic work of first responders. Through stories from police, firefighters and ambulances, the series offers us a perspective on the challenges they face on a daily basis. Each episode reminds us of the crucial importance of the 9-1-1 emergency number, which is a true link between those in distress and those who work for their safety. The heroes of this series are embodied in a casting composed of Angela Bassett in the role of Athena Grant, a determined and competent police officer, and Peter Krause in the role of Bobby Nash, the fire chief. Together, they lead a diverse team of stakeholders, each bringing their unique skills and personal stories. Jennifer Love Hewitt also joins the casting as a 9-1-1 operator, who has to navigate in stressful situations while facing her own emotional struggles. At each episode, viewers witness moments of extreme tension, whether in dangerous interventions, tragic accidents or personal crises. The series deals with real social issues, such as domestic violence, natural disasters and even unlikely catastrophic situations, while exploring how these events affect not only victims but also the actors themselves. Between moments of bravery and vulnerability, 9 -1-1 reminds us that behind every call to 9-1-1 is a human history, full of courage, sacrifice and hope. Thus, this series invites the public to reflect on the essential role these heroes play in our lives. 9-1-1 is not only a series of emergency interventions, but also an exploration of human ties in times of crisis, while paying tribute to those who risk their lives to save others' lives.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.sub-title: A'olelo olelo may ana ke ahi ua ana la
programme.desc: In Hawaii's effervescence, Detective Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) is at the head of a complex investigation on a university campus. Knowing the potential of Tani Rey (Meaghan Rath), a young woman who had experienced disciplinary difficulties, he offered to join his team. Tani, eager to prove his worth, accepts this opportunity, while being aware of the challenges ahead. At the same time, Junior Reigns (Beulah Koale), a former Marine, also showed his interest in integrating the 5-0. The team has to deal with a series of mysterious murders, where a serial killer draws inspiration from Hawaiian myths to orchestrate his crimes. In addition, rival gangs are engaged in a merciless war, while hackers threaten to disrupt the operations of the 5-0. With a multitude of files to be processed, McGarrett and his team must navigate through this climate of tension and danger to restore order in the archipelago.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.

programme.desc: After leaving the hospital, Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) and Danny Williams (Scott Caan) quickly returned to duty in Special Unit 5-0, where a murder investigation was awaiting them. The case takes an intriguing turn when the victim's body is discovered in the 5-0's premises, raising questions about the team's safety. As they try to solve this mystery, the agents must also work with an MI-6 agent to track down a formidable terrorist, responsible for an attack on the British embassy in Madrid. Barely the case closed, McGarrett and Alicia, a key figure on his team, became targets of a serial killer, who did not hesitate to remove them. Meanwhile, the rest of the team, including members like Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Kim) and Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), is mobilizing to save them, leading to unexpected twists in this season full of action and suspense.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: A season at the zoo
programme.desc: The team of carers must conduct a medical examination of a young giraffe, but adult females complicate the operation by refusing to leave. After successfully isolating the young, three people are needed to control them while Margaux performs the tests, which prove to be positive. Elsewhere in the park, an apprentice caretaker succeeds in his first demonstration with the sea lions.

programme.title: A season at the zoo
programme.desc: Mulder, the dominant mandrill, is very ill and should undergo further testing despite his ongoing treatment. In another area, the caretakers feed polar bears and now enrich their pens. The team tries to get the giraffes used to a new restraint corridor, but only Iringa is there. A tigeress from Sumatra worries the team by refusing to enter her building.

programme.title: A season at the zoo
programme.desc: At the zoo, a careful person prepares a creative meal for bears by hanging fruits and vegetables on the grills of their dressing room. On the Asian plain, the team innovates by serving otters in floating bamboos. Animals immediately run on their food. In the afternoon, a veterinarian is doing ultrasound of the dwarf hippopotamus Jazzy to detect a pregnancy, without success.

programme.title: E=M6
programme.sub-title: Sapins, pretzels, cremant, science celebrates Christmas in Alsace!
programme.desc: Every Sunday, this family science magazine answers in a didactic and fun way to the questions that everyone asks themselves, thanks to visual experiences, testimonies but also decryptions of specialists.

programme.title: E=M6
programme.sub-title: Snoring, having the chicken meat, being left-handed: 3 sights of our body explained by science!
programme.desc: Every Sunday, this family science magazine answers in a didactic and fun way to the questions that everyone asks themselves, thanks to visual experiences, testimonies but also decryptions of specialists.

programme.title: A Christmas tree, two lovers
programme.desc: In the snowy little town of Silver Peak, nestled in the heart of Colorado mountains, the end-of-year celebrations are sacred, especially for Erin Whitmore, the charismatic and determined daughter of the mayor. The event is a celebration of the famous light of the great tree, an event that brings together every year, inhabitants and tourists, and it is set to embark on a quest: to find the perfect tree, symbol of magic and unity. His choice is quickly made on a majestic spruce, punctuating in the garden of his mysterious neighbour, Kevin Dawson, a firefighter with a look as warm as his character is cold.

programme.title: Christmas at the Royal Palace
programme.desc: As an assistant to a famous and tyrannical photographer, Amanda is invited by the king of Pantria, who wants to immortalize the Christmas festivities. The young woman then decides to go there under a false name with the complicity of her best friend. On the spot, they met the royal family, King Richard, his wife Gloria and especially the seductive Prince Leopold. Even not belonging to the kingship, Amanda will soon fall under the charm of the young heir to the throne...

programme.title: Lauren's strange Christmas
programme.desc: In his home, Lauren Brunell was looking for a surgeon position in a prestigious Boston hospital, the capital of Massachusetts. But his candidacy was rejected. The doctor then has no choice but to go to a remote town in Alaska, where residents have only rarely seen a doctor for a year now. Lauren soon falls under the charm of Andy Holliday, one of the inhabitants of this warm little town. With her reindeer, her elves in the garden and her transport company, Frank, father d'Andy, is surprisingly like Santa Claus...

programme.title: A romantic winter
programme.desc: An event organizer in Los Angeles, Chelsea is very busy with her work and doesn't have a moment for her. When she inherits her uncle's cottage in Vail, a small town lost in the Colorado Mountains, she abandons her career and urban life on the west coast. Seduced by the authentic lifestyle of the merchants, Chelsea helps the village where she settled to regain her glory: she decides to organize a culinary contest with the support of the charming Owen.

programme.title: A Christmas in Scotland
programme.desc: In the heart of the Scottish Highlands, where snow-covered landscapes and Celtic legends blend under a winter sky, Lucy, a passionate but difficult archaeology professor, arrives with a crucial mission. Threatened to lose her post at the university, she must absolutely find the ruins of a sanctuary dedicated to Beira, the mythical queen of winter, whose discovery could save her career. Her investigation leads her to an isolated manor, as majestic as it is enigmatic, held with an iron hand by Edina McAvoy, a woman of a well-dimmed character, convinced that the places are haunted by the ghost of her late husband. Between strange noises, slamming doors and painful memories, the atmosphere is charged with a mysterious melancholy, as if the past refused to erase.

programme.title: Christmas Mail
programme.desc: Hannah (Sarah Drew), a talented and ambitious developer, has put everything on Perfect One, a dating application she created in the hope of helping lonely souls find their half. Yet, despite his professional success, his personal life has been a field of ruins since a break-up that left him disillusioned. Back in her hometown for the holidays, she hopes to draw the inspiration needed to re-launch her business. But it is without counting on the nostalgic charm of the places of her childhood, where every street, every Christmas decor reminds her of what she lost... And what she might find. As she prepares to test her application herself, a series of enigmatic messages begin to reach her. His anonymous correspondent, as mysterious as he is attractive, seems to understand his doubts better than anyone else. Between two lively exchanges, Hannah surprises herself to believe again in the possibility of a romance. But who really hides behind those words that make his heart beat faster? A former friend? A stranger crossed by chance? Or maybe someone she's always had before her eyes without ever really seeing him? As the preparations for the holidays accelerate and the secrets gradually reveal themselves, Hannah will have to choose between the security of her certainties and the risk of abandoning herself to the unexpected. In this winter ballet where misunderstandings and quiproquos mix with glittering garlands, a question persists: what if the most beautiful Christmas gift was the one we didn't order?

programme.title: Christmas shoes
programme.desc: As snowflakes swirl in the illuminated streets of New York, Noëlle Carpenter, a lonely and disenchanted young woman, finds herself trapped in the Hudsons department store, where she works as a saleswoman. Tonight, on Christmas Eve, fate seems to have other plans for it. As she prepares to spend a morose night between desert rays, a mysterious unknown appears: Charlie (Candace Cameron Bure), a woman with enigmatic smile and a look full of strange benevolence. She's not exactly like the others. Charlie presents himself as an angel-guardian, who comes to offer him a gift as unexpected as extraordinary: a pair of magical shoes. These shoes, as elegant as they are unusual, have a fascinating power: each one of them allows Christmas to relive one of its last three Christmases, as if time were more than a canvas that it could undo and re-woven as it pleases. But why these memories in particular? And what does she seek to understand, or perhaps to repair, by going back into those moments? Between the suffocating laughter of a family Christmas Eve, the choices she regretted and the opportunities she had let go, Noëlle found herself confronted with her own regrets, her disappointed hopes and those small decisions that, without she had to account for, had shaped the course of her life.

programme.title: Christmas Letters
programme.desc: Noah Harrington, a developer, is arriving in the small town of Oak Creek with the intention of replacing a post office abandoned by a modern office complex. His arrival is not seen with a very good eye. On the spot, he must work with Tessa, a city historian and protector, and try to find the right compromise. Noah and Tessa bring out old "Letters to Santa Claus" and soon they will come closer...

programme.title: Night programmes
programme.desc: To follow, rebroadcasts of the channel's programs, as well as documentaries and other reports intended to entertain the diapers like early-rises.

programme.title: Norbert, ex officio clerk
programme.sub-title: Céline, chicken sequestration / Anthony, mashed usurpation

programme.title: The Tournesol case
programme.desc: Professor Tournesol, a leading scientist, has just developed a revolutionary invention: an ultrasonic weapon capable of destroying glass objects. Although initially conceived as a research project, this weapon has alarming destructive potential if it is perfected to target other materials. Only Professor Bretzel, his former colleague, has the knowledge to activate this machine.Tintin, accompanied by his faithful dog Milou, Captain Haddock and Professor Tournesol, is on his way to find Bretzel and warn him of the dangers of invention. However, they quickly discover that Bretzel was abducted by syldave agents. Shortly thereafter, Professor Tournesol's turn was to be kidnapped. Tintin and his friends then raced against the clock to find the missing scientists, thwart the malicious plans of the kidnappers and prevent this technology from falling into bad hands, while facing the obstacles that stand in their way.

In the vibrant city of Los Angeles, the 118 relief team, led by Bobby Nash (Peter Krause), are facing increasingly unpredictable and dramatic emergencies. Whether it is a burning airship threatening a crowded stage or the collapse of a conference-hosting structure, each intervention tests not only their professional expertise, but also their personal ties. Meanwhile, Maya (Michelle Hurd) and Bobby have to deal with their new reality at home, while their son Harry is in Miami with Michael (Rockmond Dunbar) and David (Kenneth Choi). The challenges of daily life intertwine with the adrenaline of interventions, revealing the depth of the characters and the sacrifices they make. Over the course of the sixth season, rescuers discover that the real heroism lies as much in the action as in the management of the emotional crises that affect them outside of their work.

The long-awaited honeymoon of Athena Grant (Angela Bassett) and Bobby Nash (Peter Krause) takes an unexpected turn when they find themselves trapped in a catastrophic situation on their cruise. Meanwhile, Buck (Oliver Stark) is entering a new relationship that allows him to better understand his own emotions and rediscover himself, while navigating the complexities of love and commitment. Maddie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) and Chimney (Kenneth Choi) are preparing to celebrate their union, surrounded by their loved ones and colleagues, highlighting the joys and challenges of wedding preparations. At the same time, Harry (Gavin McHugh), Athena's son, returns to Los Angeles, crossing the path of people with varied stories, bringing their share of surprises and twists. This final season, as intense as the first, celebrates the 100th episode, mixing action, emotion and humour.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Lara Croft : Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft (Angelina Jolie), heiress of a colossal fortune and a line of fearless archaeologists, lives surrounded by priceless treasures, including a mysterious clock with unfathomable powers. This precious artifact, transmitted by his father, the famous archaeologist Lord Richard Croft (Jon Voight), contains a much greater secret than anything she could have imagined. Years earlier, his father had revealed to him the existence of the Illuminati, a secret and powerful organization, obsessed with the quest for this legendary clock. According to ancient accounts, this object would allow to master the gates of Time and Space, offering absolute power to the one who could use it.Lara discovers that, 5,000 years earlier, this clock had already played a decisive role in the victory of the first Illuminati over their enemies. But the mystery thickens when it learns that a rare astronomical phenomenon, occurring every 5,000 years, aligns three planets to form a sacred triangle, making the clock operational. As the Illuminati, who are still active and more determined than ever, are approaching their goal, Lara is embarking on a frantic race across the globe. Between ancient ruins, mortal traps and ruthless enemies, it must decipher the riddles of the past to prevent this organization from achieving its dark purposes. With its sharp intelligence, legendary agility and boundless audacity, Lara Croft faces ever more perilous challenges. Each clue discovered brings it closer to the truth, but also to the dangers that threaten to rock everything.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.desc: HGTV and Lanei Chapman travel the country to present some of the most unique, memorable and creative paradise gardens. Armed with a parasol, a glass and a towel Chapman visits breathtaking pools and gets advice to maintain a luxury oasis in his garden. This time, head to the southern United States to discover a spectacular pool that simulates a lagoon. For the coup the pond and its amenities need to be renovated. This is an opportunity for the team to make its ingenuity speak.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.desc: In Arizona, close-up on a magnificent swimming pool surrounded by lush vegetation and offering stunning views of the mountains. A true work of art, the swimming pool, with its unique shape and design, is harmoniously integrated into the natural landscape. The highlight of this swimming pool is its integrated jacuzzi, strategically placed to enjoy the breathtaking views. Thanks to this pool, the owners were able to create their own oasis, ideal for relaxing and relaxing after a long day.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard assists Raj in his quest for a new love. Leonard, at sea, misses Sheldon and Penny. He comes back by surprise and tries to experience strange things.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.
