programme.title: Inside McDo : a year in the #1 restaurant in France
programme.desc: It is one of the most well-known companies in the world and is present on all continents. With more than 2 million meals served a day, France is now the second largest global market for "McDonald's", just after the United States. This conquest of the country champion of gastronomy is not without intrigue the implantation of what is emblematic of junk food. Besides, competitors like "Burger King" or the "KFC" fried chicken king are also present alongside the American giant.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon oversees the emerging relationship between Meemaw and Dr. Sturgis, while his parents work to build relationships with other children.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), a young prodigy with unparalleled scientific talents, faces challenges that are far more complex than those of his equations. At only 9 years old, her parents, Mary (Zoe Perry) and George (Lance Barber), made the bold decision to enrol her in high school to provide her with an education that was commensurate with her exceptional intelligence. However, this transition turns out to be a real journey for the fighter. From her first day, Sheldon faced the misunderstanding and rejection of her classmates, who failed to grasp her genius or her unconventional manners. Tensions are intensifying as he tries to navigate in a less welcoming school environment while seeking to maintain a relationship with his family, including his twin sister Missy (Raegan Revord) and grandmother Meemaw (Annie Potts). Through his daily life, the series explores the social, emotional and intellectual challenges that this unusual young boy faces, while highlighting the family dynamics and the complex relationships that surround him.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon disassembles the refrigerator to stop a buzzing nerve. Then he writes a road map for repairs...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard assists Raj in his quest for a new love. Leonard, at sea, misses Sheldon and Penny. He comes back by surprise and tries to experience strange things.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.

programme.title: Inside McDo : a year in the #1 restaurant in France
programme.desc: It is one of the most well-known companies in the world and is present on all continents. With more than 2 million meals served a day, France is now the second largest global market for "McDonald's", just after the United States. This conquest of the country champion of gastronomy is not without intrigue the implantation of what is emblematic of junk food. Besides, competitors like "Burger King" or the "KFC" fried chicken king are also present alongside the American giant.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: George confides a secret to Sheldon and asks not to tell Mary. Uneasy about being unethical with his mother, the young boy is hiding at his friend Tam...
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

The aim is to recover old containers used to transport goods by boats and to convert them into a pool. Although this type of swimming pool has many advantages on paper, the installation is very problematic, as the pool has to be grazed to unload it from the transport truck. But the team is turning back the sleeves to carry out the project desired by the client.

programme.desc-more: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Close-up on Aurélie and Erwan, Marie and Jo, or Erwan and Aline, who chose to travel the roads of France, Europe or the world on their motorhome.
programme.desc-more: Zoom on Aurélie and Erwan who, for six months, have been travelling Europe in a motorhome with their children. After the south of the continent, they stop in Germany to attend their very first Grand Prix motorcycle with family. Marie and Jo, both in the city and on stage, have been travelling the roads of France for two years, between concerts and large spaces. Erwan and Aline, on the other hand, chose to leave 18 months around the world in a truck, with their daughter. Their adventure begins in Brittany, between local specialities and spectacular landscapes.

programme.title: The madness of the motorhome: a holiday not like the others
programme.desc: Three nomadic families travel the roads. One is challenging Cape Nord for a birthday, another joins friends in Ardèche, the latest Carcassonne exploration.
programme.desc-more: In Gironde, Tristan, Maite and their three children have been travelling in vans in France for two years. They take on a challenge: to travel 4000 km in three days to celebrate the 10 years of Léonore in the North Cape. Steve and Audrey, Alsatian barouders, have been traveling in a mobile home for eight years. With Bubble, their 35 year old renovated motorhome, they leave in Ardèche for an anniversary with friends. Erwan and Aline, for their part, turned a former military truck into a 20-m2 rolling house. With their daughter Hanitea, they first discovered the region of Carcassonne.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Perpignan, at the foot of the Pyrenees and a few kilometers from the Mediterranean Sea, attracts tourists. The municipal police are responsible for security in the heart of the city.
programme.desc-more: Perpignan is located at the foot of the Pyrenees, a few kilometers from the Mediterranean Sea. A privileged location for this city that attracts tourists. To monitor them and the 122,000 inhabitants, 160 municipal police officers were taking turns 24 hours a day at the municipal police. Professionals with a high level of training, many of whom are members of the Gendarmerie or the National Police. To combat multiple crime, Perpignan was the first commune in France to equip its police officers with automatic weapons and pedestrian cameras. One of the city's scourges is drug trafficking. In order to contain it, the police patroled some quarters very regularly to call the dealers.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: In Normandy, the city of Caen and its 106,000 inhabitants can count on a police station of more than 400 policemen to look after them 24/24.
programme.desc-more: Caen, the political capital of Normandy, is a historic city with a rich heritage. Protected by more than 400 police officers, it is fighting crime and drug trafficking. The police are also present on the roads to prevent accidents caused by drunken driving. The police station accompanies people in distress, victims of theft, assault or domestic violence. The images highlight the dedicated work of the police to ensure the safety of the population.

programme.title: Flic story
programme.desc: Control, call, rescue: the gendarmes of Normandy ensure the safety of all. The Le Havre company is followed in its daily life for 100 days.
programme.desc-more: Normandy is appreciated for its beautiful landscapes, monuments and long beaches. But in recent years the calm and serenity of this region have been increasingly disturbed by incivilities and crime. In fact, in the area the gendarmes have a lot to do. Drug users are growing in number and younger, causing problems in the streets and on the roads. Close-up of the daily lives of law enforcement personnel who are trying to guarantee the safety of all.

programme.title: Lucifer
programme.desc: Lucifer, a victim of transformations after a "revelation", confides in Chloe, upset. A sordid murder is launching the duo on a new investigation.
programme.desc-more: Because he's bored in hell, Lucifer leaves everything, quits and opens a nightclub in Los Angeles. He puts his deep knowledge of human turpitudes at the service of the local police, of which he becomes a valued consultant. Detective Chloe Decker assists him in his criminal investigations, while an angel, Amenadiel, tries to convince him to go underground and entrusts his soul states to a therapist, Linda. This adaptation of a comic book plays on the codes of the fantastic and the policeman, without omitting the register of seduction.

programme.title: Zone 51: The secret base that intrigues the planet
programme.desc: Flying saucers recovered by the American government, an extraterrestrial body analyzed in the greatest secret: Zone 51, in the middle of Nevada desert, northwest of Las Vegas, has been feeding theories for decades. "Independence Day" and "X-Files" have helped make it famous around the world. For nearly sixty years, the authorities refused to officially recognize its existence until the CIA did so in 2013. This documentary decrypts the declassified archives, collects the words of the whistleblowers and updates the latest developments.

programme.title: Did Noah's Ark really exist?
programme.desc: Through reconstitutions, five experts conduct a survey of the air of travel through the centuries, exploring one of the greatest mysteries in history.
programme.desc-more: Through reconstitutions, five experts attempt to clarify the shadow zones of one of the greatest mysteries in history. According to the Bible, Noah received a divine command: to build a ship to save his family and the animals from a flood to punish humanity. According to Genesis, Noah, his wife, and their descendants, were given specific instructions for the construction of the ark, allowing for the reception of a representative of each animal species on board. Only after more than 200 days of navigation would they have reached the peaks of Mount Ararat.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: Howard assists Raj in his quest for a new love. Leonard, at sea, misses Sheldon and Penny. He comes back by surprise and tries to experience strange things.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.

programme.title: Zero Euro Caddie: the Kings of System D
programme.desc: Refund offers, discount coupons, promotions, anti-gaspi applications: zoom in on four French people who have made the economy hunt a real specialty.
programme.desc-more: Close-up of four French people who have made the hunting of economies a real specialty. Near Narbonne, 33-year-old Damien combines the good plans to get his daily products free of charge. Elsa, 42, mother of three, manages to feed her family with a hundred and fifty euros a week thanks to a millimetred organization. Geoffrey, 26, refuses to take away and faces economic challenges to make herself happy at a low price. Finally, in Grenoble, Valentin, 28, collects weekly products thrown away by supermarkets to fight waste and fill his freezer. Their amazing journeys show how far some are willing to go to spend less.

programme.title: Hypermarkets: behind the scenes of a giant of the big distribution
programme.desc: With nearly 44,000 stores and 10 million customers every day, large-scale distribution is central to French life.
programme.desc-more: The large distribution is central to the life of the French. With a pace of life that has accelerated with time and a greater consumption, hypermarkets have become irreplaceable. To meet this ever-increasing demand, a seamless organization is needed to supply the shelves with thousands of products. To better understand how this gigantic machine works, Intermarché opened its doors. Discovery of work performed by order preparers, planners, technicians or supply managers.

programme.title: Nutella's crazy story
programme.desc: Everyone knows Nutella. In France, the brand represents more than half of the market for spread pasta and is one of the country's top food products. Yet, few know that this success was born in the back of a small Italian pastry shop. Just after World War II, in Piedmont, Pietro Ferrero sought to create a gourmet and accessible product. In 1949, his son Michele Ferrero, then 24 years old, turned this craft idea into an industrial adventure.

programme.title: Fringe
programme.desc: Olivia and its double alternative, nicknamed False-Livia, are at the centre of a narrative arc and conduct investigations in each of the universes where they are located. In every world, the constraints and differences are becoming increasingly apparent, as well as the plans of the Minister of Defence, Walter Bishop's alter ego. A strange war machine is also at the heart of the story. Fringe's third season is clearly focused on a tone close to science fiction. Blue or red credits indicate the world of action.
programme.desc-more: Walter Bishop (John Noble), a brilliant but unstable scientist, discovers with concern that these cataclysmic phenomena are linked to a machine that he himself activated, endangering not only our dimension, but also a parallel universe. At the heart of this struggle, Olivia Dunham (Anna Torv), a determined FBI agent, finds herself navigating between alternative realities and scientific mysteries. As Faux-livia (Anna Torv) desperately tries to intervene to save her world, tensions are intensifying. Olivia, meanwhile, appeals to Sam Weiss (Kevin Corrigan), a mysterious man who could hold the keys to understand the growing threat.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: No way out
programme.desc: Will Shaw (Henry Caveill), a young entrepreneur overwhelmed by stress, offers a sunny break in Spain to replenish himself and his family. After moving reunions, their idyllic journey takes a tragic turn: on returning from a night trip, Will discovers that their yacht was robbed and that his family disappeared without leaving any trace. He was panicked and found himself facing Zahir, a mysterious man who seemed to be linked to the disappearance. As tension rises, Will is just saved by his father, Martin (Bruce Willis), who reveals that he is a retired CIA agent. Together, they are engaged in a desperate quest to find the abducted family, navigating between state secrets and relentless stalking. They should contact Jean Carrack (Sigourney Weaver), an enigmatic woman who could hold the keys to solve this mystery, while escaping the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: The 10 disasters that have marked the planet
programme.desc: The planet is facing disasters that can cause thousands of victims and dramatic damage. Hurricanes, tornadoes, earthquakes, floods and volcanic eruptions are making news. But other disasters that originate from human error or criminal will can also cause many victims. Using exceptional archive images shot at the heart of the most spectacular events and synthesis images, a look back at the collisions that will remain forever in history.

programme.title: The 10 disasters that have marked the planet
programme.desc: Dams, these imposing structures built by Man to hold the water from the rivers, are essential elements of our modern infrastructure. They provide drinking water, irrigation, and hydropower. However, when these dams are lost, the consequences can be devastating, causing flooding, loss of life and considerable material damage. History is full of examples of dam ruptures that marked the planet, such as that of Vajont, Italy in 1963, Malpasset, France in 1959, or Val Ferret, Switzerland, caused by a Tsunami in 1995.

programme.title: The 10 disasters that have marked the planet
programme.desc:
The daily lives of millions of bus passengers can turn into drama in a second. Whether it is mechanical failure, human error or extreme weather, the causes are multiple and the human balance is often tragic. Ten major accidents around the world, which have broken families and shocked countries, are being analysed to understand their circumstances and how some of these disasters have led to major road safety reforms.
Director(s): Richard Fillon

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc:
Sheldon is displeased: Amy criticized the "Adventurers of the Lost Ark" by noting the intrigue's flaws. He tries to get revenge by decorating the works she loves. Leonard uses his problems with his mother to manipulate Penny. Howard is trying to do the same with his wife. Rajesh and Stuart sign up for a dating site...
Director(s): Mark Cendrowski Actors: Simon Helberg (Howard Wolowitz), Johnny Galecki (Leonard Hofstadter), Kaley Cuoco (Penny), Jim Parsons (Sheldon Cooper), Kunal Nayyar (Rajesh Koothrappali), Christine Baranski (Beverly Hofstader), Melissa Rauch (Bernadette Rostenkowski), Mayim Bialik (Amy Farrah Fowler), Kevin Sussman (Stuart Bloom), Christine Corpuz (Woman)

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc:
Amy tells Sheldon that she intends to work in university as well. But his plans ended up creating discord when Howard got involved, believing that he should give his opinion. He said that mixing privacy and work would be a bad idea. Sheldon lets herself be influenced and vexes Amy without wanting to. Bernadette doesn't believe her eyes. Howard ends up on Raj's couch...
Director(s): Mark Cendrowski Actors: Jim Parsons (Sheldon Cooper), Mayim Bialik (Amy Farrah Fowler), Kunal Nayyar (Rajesh Koothrappali), Simon Helberg (Howard Wolowitz), Johnny Galecki (Leonard Hofstadter), Melissa Rauch (Bernadette Rostenkowski), Kaley Cuoco (Penny), Todd Eric Andrews (Dr. Gunderson), Ayumi Iizuka (Scientist), Rachel Steele (Cafeteria Patron)

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc:
Howard is trying to organize a special event on the anniversary of his first date with Bernadette. Sheldon, for his part, made a scientific breakthrough that could prove to be major. But some details still need to be corrected. As for Penny, she's making a decision to do something for Leonard...
Director(s): Mark Cendrowski Actors: Kaley Cuoco (Penny), Kunal Nayyar (Rajesh Koothrappali), Melissa Rauch (Bernadette Rostenkowski), Simon Helberg (Howard Wolowitz), Mayim Bialik (Amy Farrah Fowler), Johnny Galecki (Leonard Hofstadter), Jim Parsons (Sheldon Cooper), Tom Fonss (Student), Rachel Steele (Cafeteria Patron), Darryl D. Stewart (Cafeteria Patron)

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc:
Sheldon feels hurt when Arthur Jefferies, alias Professor Proton, his childhood hero, asks Leonard to help him on a project instead of calling on him. He's planning his revenge. Raj joins the girls for a special evening. But Howard mixes in and turns away the meaning given to the event. Raj's upset about it...
Director(s): Mark Cendrowski Actors: Jim Parsons (Sheldon Cooper), Mayim Bialik (Amy Farrah Fowler), Kunal Nayyar (Rajesh Koothrappali), Simon Helberg (Howard Wolowitz), Johnny Galecki (Leonard Hofstadter), Melissa Rauch (Bernadette Rostenkowski), Kaley Cuoco (Penny), Bill Nye (Bill Nye), Bob Newhart (Arthur Jeffries)

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc:
Sheldon asks Leonard to help hide a mistake in the past. Penny's having an unexpected encounter. She meets Lucy, Raj's ex-girlfriend. The opportunity is too good, and the young woman cannot help interfering in her love life...
Director(s): Mark Cendrowski Actors: Jim Parsons (Sheldon Cooper), Kaley Cuoco (Penny), Kunal Nayyar (Rajesh Koothrappali), Melissa Rauch (Bernadette Rostenkowski), Simon Helberg (Howard Wolowitz), Mayim Bialik (Amy Farrah Fowler), Johnny Galecki (Leonard Hofstadter), Kate Micucci (Lucy), Morgan Hewitt (Lizzy), Meli Alexander (Cheesecake Factory Patron)

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc:
Everyone's planning to spend Thanksgiving's party in Howard's mom's house. But the latter is nailed to bed, so the small group proposes to cook. Sheldon is far from delighted by the choice of place for the holidays. Tensions are emerging between Penny and Leonard, because of a bad joke. Howard wants to take the opportunity to strengthen ties with his stepfather...
Director(s): Mark Cendrowski Actors: Mayim Bialik (Amy Farrah Fowler), Melissa Rauch (Bernadette Rostenkowski), Johnny Galecki (Leonard Hofstadter), Jim Parsons (Sheldon Cooper), Kaley Cuoco (Penny), Kunal Nayyar (Rajesh Koothrappali), Simon Helberg (Howard Wolowitz), Casey Sander (Mike Rostenkowski), Brian Smith (Zack Johnson)

programme.title: SOS garage
programme.desc: Vincent and his team travel to Bruay-sur-l'Escaut, in the Hauts-de-France, to discover Franck's garage. A bodywork in the image of its owner: black painted walls and death heads, welcome to the custom temple and the "bikers". This den of enthusiasts must however transform to attract a wider clientele. And the change will not concern the establishment: for too long, Franck has been overtaken by the situation. Laboratory and painting cabin, parts in thousands, cars packed: the craftsman will have to start from scratch, from office space to the motorcycle workshop. In just four days, Vincent and his team will do everything possible to save the company from this touching and volunteer garage operator.

programme.title: SOS garage
programme.desc:
Eric, 53-year-old mechanic, lives alone in his garage in Alsace with his three bassets. This hard work with a big heart never stops working. Obsessive of mechanics, it is known throughout the region because no breakdown resists it. But his generosity combined with administrative phobia prevents him from being profitable and generating an efficient economic model. He refused no mission, forgot to charge the customers, and the little he won, he reinvested him in equipment he did not need. Vincent and Thierry will have to help the Alsatian mechanic to take over and push him to take responsibility if he wants to save his garage.
Director(s): Hervé Fieujean

programme.title: SOS garage
programme.desc: Emmanuel is a carrot. Once a CAP and then a BEP in his pocket, he worked at Peugeot and Citroën, and then decided to start his business. He buys premises to do his bodywork, these include a home and a garage part but he feels quickly in the narrow. He then entered work to accommodate a painting booth. But the works did not end, Emmanuel worked without dead time, the carrot drowned and came to hate his profession. Vincent and Thierry will help him complete the work of his workshop.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: For some French people, living at home is a nightmare. The cause: an unbearable neighbourhood. They would be more than one in two Frenchmen who do not agree with those who live by their side. A road that is not very easy, a heat pump too noisy, the noises of children: all these issues of discord in the heart of the daily lives of the neighbours who can no longer live together. Insults, threats, violence: the consequences are sometimes disastrous. Immersion in the daily lives of neighbours who rot their lives and between whom the dialogue is completely broken.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: The neighbourhood can become a source of conflict and daily life can then turn into a nightmare, especially when neighbours are squatters who occupy a house or apartment and make a living hell for families living nearby without respect. Faced with these tensions, the first to be deployed to try to calm things down are the police forces: the police or the Gendarmerie. But often this is not enough. To end their ordeal, some do not hesitate to use professionals with muscular methods. Yann Collet's speciality is to dislodge squatters to help victims find a quick and effective solution.

programme.title: Neighbors' War: My Life Is Hell
programme.desc: Violence, insults, broken dialogue: focus on neighbours who rot their lives. These conflicts have always existed, but since the health crisis and the rise of telework, complaints related to the neighbourhood have increased by 60%, according to the General Housing Confederation (GCL). A road that is not very easy, a heat pump that is too noisy, and the noise of children: all these people are in discord, poisoning the daily lives of neighbours unable to live together. Between physical and verbal violence, some disputes eventually settle with a mediator. Others go to court.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.sub-title: A container swimming pool in La Rochelle
programme.desc: Directorate La Rochelle this time, where the teams will have to install a container pool. The concept of the container pool comes from Australia. The aim is to recover old containers used to transport goods by boats and to convert them into a pool. Although this type of swimming pool has many advantages on paper, the installation is very problematic, as the pool has to be grazed to unload it from the transport truck. But the team is turning back the sleeves to carry out the project desired by the client.

programme.title: Dream pools
programme.sub-title: A swimming pool artwork in Normandy
programme.desc: On the way to Normandy, where the family company Declercq, led by Grégoire, perpetuates a know-how of three generations. A visionary and audacious, Gregory designs custom-made concrete pools. Every year, his reservation book is full, and today he is facing a challenge: to build a swimming pool of 12 by 4.5 metres in 14 weeks, with three sides above ground and two symmetrical stairs. This demanding project is enhanced by a surprise: a work of art will be painted on the liner, a first for Gregory and his team.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this sixth season of the iconic series, Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) is on board the International Space Station, a unique experience that puts his ties with his friends to the test. Meanwhile, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) takes advantage of his relationship with Penny (Kaley Cuoco), but he cannot help feeling a growing insecurity in the face of their love. On campus, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) hired a new assistant, triggering the jealousy of Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik), who was stepping up his efforts to prove his worth. The group of friends is mobilizing to help Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) find love, but unexpected family secrets are beginning to emerge, undermining the balance of the group. While everyone faces personal challenges, a new career opportunity threatens to separate them, causing tensions and reflections on friendship and commitment.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: In this new season of the iconic series, the members of the geek band are at a decisive turning point in their lives. Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) returns from a trip and discovers significant changes in the daily lives of his friends. Penny (Kaley Cuoco), after leaving her job as a waitress, now devotes herself to her career as an actress and brings her ties to Leonard, going so far as to make an unexpected marriage proposal. Meanwhile, Raj Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) continues his quest for love and ends up meeting Emily, a fascinating dermatologist, who may well upset her life. The intrigues become more complex as Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons) and Amy Farrah Fowler (Mayim Bialik) navigate their relationship while facing personal challenges. This season promises to plunge even deeper into the dynamics of friendship and love within this brilliant and engaging group, while maintaining the staggered humour that made the series' success.

programme.title: The big buffets, broth: the backstage of the biggest restaurants
programme.desc: Diving behind the scenes of the Grands Buffets de Narbonne and Les Bouillons, two institutions of French restoration. Shots, snipers, bloodshed and theatrical shots: the camera follows the lives of these houses minute by minute. In the kitchen and in the room, every second counts. Teams must keep up with the pace of service and face unforeseen and client demands. As the services go on, a spectacle is often funny and sometimes moving. Behind each dish served and each table set, there are those who make these places live, between pressure and solidarity.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: Albert Einstein and the story of another Marie
programme.desc:
Inspired by Albert Einstein, a true hero in his eyes, Sheldon tried to play violin, with a relative success. He also decided to adopt the Jewish religion. He hopes that his family will give him all its support and help him to implement his new resolutions. Fearing to be pregnant, Mary confides in Meemaw and buys a pregnancy test with her. She has to wait for the result. It's a great moment of stress for her...

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: The mystery of the red bathtub
programme.desc: Vincent Person loved his 3-year-old son, Thibaut. Yet on June 24, 2019, he ended his child's days. A crime committed to punish the mother of her child. Undesirably jealous and possessive, Vincent Person exercised an unbearable hold on Estelle, forbidding him to shop alone, censoring his clothing choices, his communications. He even took her away from his family.
programme.desc-more: On September 11, 2008, 6-year-old Antoine disappeared in Issoire, Puy-de-Dôme. Thirteen days later, his mother, Alexandrine Brugerolle de Fraissinette, and his companion, Sébastien Ribière, were placed in custody. Released without prosecution, the couple decided to leave the area. But three years later, he found himself at the heart of another criminal case. In June 2011, Carine Desiles, a friend who hosted them, was found dead in her bathtub in Marseilles. Acquitted at first instance, Brugerolle de Fraissinette and Sébastien Ribière were sentenced on appeal in April 2018 by the Var assize court. Twenty years in prison for murder, two years in prison for concealing corpses for her.

programme.title: Hunting aircraft: XXL technology
programme.desc: France has three remarkable fighter aircraft that have changed the history of aviation. The Uragan, which was born in 1949, is a true UFO of the Air Force! It has a reactor that allows it to fly at still unknown speeds. This is a new feature in the operation of fighter aircraft. Three decades later, French experts developed Le Mirage 2000! The D version of this aircraft has a radar that allows it to remain invisible to enemy radars. But 20 years later, the Rafale was born an even more modern plane.

programme.title: Rafale, drones and cannons: the French arms revolution
programme.desc: Presentation of the French machines that will transform the fight of tomorrow. At the heart of this revolution: the future Rafale F5, a fighter plane profoundly transformed, with a new engine, new missiles, and the arrival of artificial intelligence. On the ground, the French army also relies on the new Griffon, able to protect its soldiers and transmit shooting data, as does the MEPAC, a mortar with a powerful force, and the CAESAR, a long-range gun that has become a symbol of modern artillery.

programme.title: Istres: in the heart of France's largest air base
programme.desc: With 2500 hectares, 40 kilometres of fences, 500 buildings and 5000 military personnel, the Istres Air Base has become a major centre of French defence.
programme.desc-more: The air base of Istres in the Bouches-du-Rhône, originally in 1917 with the creation of an aviation school, has become in a little more than a century, an important centre of French air defence. In Patagonia, he met Gabriel, who lived alone in a dilapidated cabin. Then head for the Iguazù Falls, on the border of Brazil and Paraguay, where the temperature is tropical. The globe-trotter seeks to meet Guarani Indians, the inhabitants of the forest. Unfortunately, this community is not the most welcoming with the Westerners.

programme.desc:
In western Brazil, under tropical temperatures, Jeremy Wade is looking for a particularly dangerous fish, which is believed to be responsible for the death of three herd keepers. A testimony suggests that the person responsible for this tragedy is a long, snakelike creature: an electric eel. It is in a shallow muddy body of water that the fisherman spot the fish. With great caution and patience, he manages to catch this impressive specimen.
Director(s): Alex Parkinson

programme.title: River Monsters
programme.desc:
In southern New Zealand, Jeremy Wade is in the footsteps of an eel, which allegedly attacked divers, took a child and devoured a live sheep. The first description of this scary fish was made by the navigator James Cook in the 18th century. Eel with sharp teeth like razor blades, this eel can be up to two metres long. Jeremy Wade intends to fish a specimen to make sure that her reputation as a man-eater is not a legend.
Director(s): Steve Gooder

programme.title: River Monsters

Jeremy Wade goes to Africa and more precisely to the Zambezi River to track down an invisible predator that attacks fishermen.

programme.title: River Monsters

Jeremy Wade travels along the shores of the Mekong, Thailand, to try to see a giant pastenague in the waters. This fish, a rare and terrifying specimen, has a tail armed with a poisonous darter. When hunting or feeling threatened, he shakes his tail and constitutes a real danger to anyone approaching it. Prudent but curious, the explorer stood at the watch.
Director(s): Luke Wiles, Barny Revill, Steve Gooder

Passionate about Hemingway's work, Cyril embarks on a traditional swordfish fishing off Zihuatanejo, Mexico. Local fishermen, won by his determination, accepted it in their marine territory. The intense cold threatens the team.

programme.desc:
The fire on an abandoned car triggered an investigation. When the firemen and the gendarmes discovered a carcase in the trunk, they first believed in a poacher's case before they realized that it was not the remains of an animal, but the corpse of Jacques Serraye.
Presenter(s): Rachid M'Barki

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc:
Pierre Bodein spent more than 35 years in prison between the prison and the psychiatric hospital. And every time you condemn, this question: can it be judged sound minded or is it crazy? Pierre Bodein was released on parole in the spring of 2004, and was sentenced to life imprisonment on 2 October 2008.
Presenter(s): Christophe Hondelatte

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Marc Machin, the Neuilly Bridge Murder
programme.desc: On the morning of December 1, 2001, Marie-Agnès Bedot, a 45-year-old mother, was found murdered by several stab wounds on the bridge of Neuilly. Marc Machin, 19, is then suspected of murder. The young man, however, claims his innocence. At his trial, he was sentenced to 18 years of imprisonment. On 22 May 2002, Maria-Judith Araujo's body was found dead on the Neuilly bridge. But the link between the two cases, which could clear Marc Machin, seems far from obvious to the judge.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: A review of a corruption case that caused a lot of ink to flow in the 1990s: the rigged football match between Valenciennes and the Olympique de Marseille (OM). It gives rise to a duel between men that everything opposes: on one side, Bernard Tapie, the club leader to have reported the European Cup in Hexagone. On the other hand, Eric de Montgolfier, an inflexible prosecutor, who has the idea of justice.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Abbé Pierre Dufour, the secret of the valley
programme.desc: In May 2006, Abbé Pierre Dufour, parish priest of Saint-Jean de Maurienne and vicar episcopal de Savoie, was sentenced by the Chambéry assize court to 15 years in prison for rape and sexual assault with abuse of authority. The priest had abused boys and young men who had been weakened by family problems. The case started with rumors. For a long time, the Church had refused to believe in such acts and two preliminary investigations had been closed. Christophe Hondelatte traces the facts and meets actors in the case, such as Hélène Gerhards, the investigating judge, or Andrée El Hadeuf, a parishioner of Abbé Dufour.

programme.title: SNCF: The secrets of XXL logistics
programme.desc: Every day in France, almost 15,000 trains run 28 000 kilometres of lines. Thousands of officers coordinate traffic, ensure safety and anticipate incidents so that trains leave and arrive on time. At Lyon station, where nearly 250 TGVs travel daily on the Paris-Lyon-Mediterranean axis, the supervisory teams manage departures and delays in real time. Help desk experts help drivers facing a failure remotely. A team also followed the maintenance of the trainsets in the technicalentres, where some TGVs are completely renovated, as well as the preparation of schedules, almost two years in advance.

programme.title: Amazon, the secrets of a XXL logistics
programme.desc: The e-commerce revolution is accelerating. Three in four French people have ordered over the Internet in the last 12 months. Undisputed leader of the sector, Amazon ships billions of parcels every year around the world. Behind this performance: millions of references, competitive prices and above all an out-of-standard logistics machine, driven by artificial intelligence.

programme.title: Inside Ikea: Behind the scenes of the Swedish giant
programme.desc: In the furniture, Ikea has established itself as a landmark of everyday life. Behind the arrow path and the furniture in kit hides a perfectly runned mechanics. Set up rooms, restaurant in the heart of the store, adjoining warehouse: everything is thought out to guide, inspire and simplify the purchase. In Nantes, one of the most popular sites in the country, teams coordinate daily deliveries, online orders, re-assortment of shelves and service of thousands of meals. Logistics, sales, catering, second life of products: dive into the scenes of the daily operation of a giant that has become indispensable.

programme.title: Ikea's crazy story
programme.desc: Ikea is the story of a Swedish-coloured brand, which has become the world leader in furniture and decoration. Ikea furniture, design, cheap and impronçable names, are everywhere. Created in 1943 by 17-year-old Swedishman Ingvar Kamprad, the brand is first and foremost a small mail-order company, but it takes him only 30 years to become a huge multinational.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: In the middle of the night, Alex lights his lamp because she heard some noise. Jean told her to reassure herself that she must be traumatized by the burglary.
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Marc Machin, the Neuilly Bridge Murder
programme.desc: At 19, Marc Machin was accused of murder and interrogated by the police officers of 36, Quai des Orfèvres. His past as a delinquent played against him and his schedule for the night of the death of Marie-Agnès Bedot, killed with several stab wounds, was unclear. The young man was on the bridge of Neuilly on December 1, 2001, but he doesn't remember much.
programme.desc-more: On the morning of December 1, 2001, Marie-Agnès Bedot, a 45-year-old mother, was found murdered by several stab wounds on the bridge of Neuilly. Marc Machin, 19, is then suspected of murder. The young man, however, claims his innocence. At his trial, he was sentenced to 18 years of imprisonment. On 22 May 2002, Maria-Judith Araujo's body was found dead on the Neuilly bridge. But the link between the two cases, which could clear Marc Machin, seems far from obvious to the judge.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 20 May 1993, the Olympique de Marseille won the championship match against the US Valenciennes-Anzin, which was 1-0. Two days later, the Valenciennes club revealed an attempt by OM to corrupt the game, which would have bought the successful outcome of the game. Back to the scandal.
programme.desc-more: A review of a corruption case that caused a lot of ink to flow in the 1990s: the rigged football match between Valenciennes and the Olympique de Marseille (OM). It gives rise to a duel between men that everything opposes: on one side, Bernard Tapie, the club leader to have reported the European Cup in Hexagone. On the other hand, Eric de Montgolfier, an inflexible prosecutor, who has the idea of justice.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Abbé Pierre Dufour, the secret of the valley
programme.desc: Abbé Pierre Dufour, parish priest of Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne, has long advocated in his homilies "a great moral rigour". But behind this facade rigor, a sexual pervert was hiding, who for nearly forty years attacked young boys, choir children, and then young men.
programme.desc-more: In May 2006, Abbé Pierre Dufour, parish priest of Saint-Jean de Maurienne and vicar episcopal de Savoie, was sentenced by the Chambéry assize court to 15 years in prison for rape and sexual assault with abuse of authority. The priest had abused boys and young men who had been weakened by family problems. The case started with rumors. For a long time, the Church had refused to believe in such acts and two preliminary investigations had been closed. Christophe Hondelatte traces the facts and meets actors in the case, such as Hélène Gerhards, the investigating judge, or Andrée El Hadeuf, a parishioner of Abbé Dufour.

programme.title: SNCF: The secrets of XXL logistics
programme.desc: A discovery of the behind the scenes of the vast railway network in France, revealing the work of the agents to ensure the safety and punctuality of the trains.
programme.desc-more: Every day in France, almost 15,000 trains run 28 000 kilometres of lines. Thousands of officers coordinate traffic, ensure safety and anticipate incidents so that trains leave and arrive on time. At Lyon station, where nearly 250 TGVs travel daily on the Paris-Lyon-Mediterranean axis, the supervisory teams manage departures and delays in real time. Help desk experts help drivers facing a failure remotely. A team also followed the maintenance of the trainsets in the technicalentres, where some TGVs are completely renovated, as well as the preparation of schedules, almost two years in advance.

programme.title: Amazon, the secrets of a XXL logistics
programme.desc: Amazon ships billions of parcels worldwide every year. Behind this performance, an extraordinary logistics machine, driven by artificial intelligence.

Undisputed leader of the sector, Amazon ships billions of parcels every year around the world. Behind this performance: millions of references, competitive prices and above all an out-of-standard logistics machine, driven by artificial intelligence.

programme.desc: Direction Nantes, for a dive in the backstage of the daily operation of an Ikea site, a giant of furniture that has become indispensable.
programme.desc-more: In the furniture, Ikea has established itself as a landmark of everyday life. Behind the arrow path and the furniture in kit hides a perfectly runned mechanics. programme.title: Ikea's crazy story
programme.desc: A review of the story of a Swedish furniture giant, Ikea, a brand that has been able to innovate and offer products that have become global references.
programme.desc-more: Ikea is the story of a Swedish-coloured brand, which has become the world leader in furniture and decoration. Ikea furniture, design, cheap and impronçable names, are everywhere. Created in 1943 by 17-year-old Swedishman Ingvar Kamprad, the brand is first and foremost a small mail-order company, but it takes him only 30 years to become a huge multinational.

programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: John and Alex are in bad faith, they're fighting, they're getting provoked. They're arrogant, selfish, greedy and jealous. But first, they love each other!
programme.desc-more: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the rules of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug. Yet behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, there is an unwavering complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Michel Providetet and Monique Olivier, the evil alliance
programme.desc: In 1984, Michel Provenet, a repeat offender, was sentenced to seven years' imprisonment. It was at this point that he met Monique Olivier, who responded to a small announcement. Two months after his release in December 1987, Michel Proveneret and his first death, with Monique Olivier's complicity.
programme.desc-more: Between 1987 and 2003, Monique Olivier "rabat" for her husband, Michel Provenret, seven young girls aged 12 to 21, who he rapes and kills in the Ardennes. In 2003, an eighth victim escaped. The information provided by the girl allows the law enforcement to trace the evil couple back. Arrested, Michel Provenret confesses nine crimes, but he is suspected of having committed others in Belgium. After his trial in Charleville-Mézières in 2008, the couple was sentenced to life incompressible, the heaviest of the penalties provided for in the Criminal Code.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Guy Georges, the Eastern Parisian killer
programme.desc: In the public mind, Guy Georges is the archetype of the sexual criminal, the serial killer, the one who inspires fear and disgust. The Guy Georges case is also the one that imposed the principle of DNA filing for the public and for the legislator.
programme.desc-more: In the fall of 1997, a killer spreads terror in the capital. Two young women living near the Bastille are raped and slaughtered at home. The man now known as the Eastern Parisian killer is making headlines and escaping the police. In 1998, at the laboratory of molecular biology in Nantes, where the pre-legged genetic fingerprints are stored in criminal investigations, Dr. Olivier Pascal compares the DNA sequences with the fingerprint of the Parisian Eastern killer. He found a concordance with the DNA of a certain Guy Georges, prelevé in 1995.

programme.title: Marc Dutroux: the Belgian demon
programme.desc: Marc Dutroux, who has been in prison since August 1996, is accused of kidnapping and rape of six girls, Julie, Mélissa, Ann, Eefje, Laetitia and Sabine. Considered a dangerous man, a multi-recidivist, well known to the police for paedophilia, Marc Dutroux will be tried at the end of 2003. The trial of this man raises questions that are calling all of Belgium.
programme.desc-more: On 15 August 1996, Belgium and Europe as a whole discovered Marc Dutroux's face. On that day, two girls, Sabine and Laetitia, were found alive on the indications given by Dutroux, arrested two days earlier. Then he reveals that Julie and Mélissa's bodies, which disappeared in June 1995, are buried in his garden. Soon, other confessions, whose monstrous details freeze Belgium with horror. After a trial full of twists and turns, he was sentenced to life imprisonment.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 22 March 2002, Jean-Raymond Blatti, accountant of a small company in the suburbs of Geneva, was found dead in his office, the skull being stoned. On her belly, the police discover an inscription: "Salal rapist", written in indelible ink.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: There is no doubt in the justice system: on 16 July 2000, around midnight, Edwige Alessandri killed her husband, Richard, with a shotgun. She says it's about the work of burglars. A version that a famous private detective tried to support, but without success, at the cost of a thorough counter-investigation.
programme.desc-more: On the night of July 16-17, 2000, Richard Alessandri, manager of a supermarket, was murdered at his home in Pernes-les-Fontaines, Vaucluse. His wife, Edwige, told the police that they had been the victims of a burglary that went wrong. Yet the evidence and testimony of their son suggest that Edwige Alessandri killed her husband. The woman has always been crying out for innocence. His defence and his support committee will not be enough to convince justice. She is convicted three times of this crime.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: André Kaas was accused of having commissioned the murder of his wife Sylviane in 1992 in the Rouen region. The man has the perfect culprit profile. A rich new man who was ostentatious in spreading his fortune, André Kaas was a regular member of swing clubs and, when his wife died, he did not really behave like a grieved widower.
programme.desc-more: On 5 April 1992, Sylviane Kaas was found dead at her home. Her husband, André, and their children are making the grim discovery as they return from the cinema. There is every indication that André is guilty, particularly in view of his behaviour following his wife's death. André was finally sentenced and sentenced to three years in prison. He was dismissed in 1996 and was dismissed in 2004. Meanwhile, the investigation was resumed by prosecutor Joseph Schmidt, but the murderer is still running.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On Albert Foulcher's road, there are six corpses. The first, in 1993, was that of a competing insurer, to whom he accused him of having sunk it; Then four in one day of January 2001, during a mad revengeful run in Languedoc. The last body is his: Foulcher killed himself.
programme.desc-more: In 1993, in Languedoc-Rousillon, Albert Foulcher was arrested for the murder of André Meffray, a retired insurer. Foulcher, who has always denied, remains in prison for three years before being released on parole in 1996. But three days before his trial in 2000, he disappeared. The police had no news of him for nearly a year, until he returned to kill the husband of one of his mistresses, as well as two gendarmes, and then another insurer. He was hunted by the Raid's men and killed himself in January 2001.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: Jacqueline Carrère-Ponthieux, accused of murdering her husband Gérard, has always claimed his innocence. After thirteen years of proceedings, she was finally acquitted by the courts. Christophe Hondelatte reconstructs the proceedings of this case. The killer of Gérard Ponthieux is still running.
programme.desc-more: On the night of September 21-22, 1997, the owner of a bar in Nogent-sur-Oise was killed in his room. Jacqueline, his wife, who spent the evening with him, quickly became the main suspect in this sordid affair. Especially since the police are finding everything. Money has always been a source of conflict within the couple. Yet, for many years, Jacqueline claimed his innocence.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Aurelien Pioger, death in the vineyards
programme.desc: Aurélien Pioger, a 28-year-old grape harvester, had just finished his season in Saint-Lambert-du-Lattay, Maine-et-Loire. On October 19, 2008, a hunting guard found his body hanging on the beam of a bait. The unlikely knots of an electric extension cord did not alert the coroner, who concluded that the suicide was a suicide.
programme.desc-more: On October 19, 2008, in Saint-Lambert-du-Lattay, Maine-et-Loire, a gamekeeper found a body, hanged on the beam of an agricultural appentis. It is the one of Aurélien Pioger, a 28-year-old young man who had just finished the harvest season. While suicide is first mentioned, there are a number of anomalies, as well as traces of beatings on his face, which intrigue the gendarmes. Soon, the investigation is moving towards the hypothesis of a disguised murder. Indeed, Aurélien was the victim of a very violent "collective punishment" on the part of some other harvesters.

programme.title: Ciné & Chill
programme.desc: Presented by Canelle Sab, Ciné & Chill offers a modern and uncomplexed look at cinema. Every week, the journalist delivers a review in a few minutes, incarnated, accessible and rhythmic from a film to the poster, with a writing thought for new uses and social media codes. In addition, a review of the essential news of the cinema goes back to the releases, announcements and events that make pop culture news. Ciné & Chill is also a hybrid and conversational event, which is also based on Brut's networks, designed to speak to both enthusiasts and new generations.

programme.title: Podium
programme.desc: A man, like Claude François, decides to take part in a television contest. But his wife threatens to leave him if he does not give up his passion.
programme.desc-more: Dive into the crazy and touching world of Bernard Frédéric (Benoît Poelvoorde), a man whose life revolves around an obsession: to perfectly embody the mythical singer Claude François. He is a professional sosy, and he chains the galas and provincial scenes, mic in hand and glitter in the suit, before the sometimes amused eyes, often exasperated by his entourage. But when Véro (Julie Depardieu) , his wife tired of this nomadic and eccentric existence, throws him an unrelenting ultimatum – family life or Cloclo – Bernard resolves to put on his heel boots and white tuxedo to put on a much duller suit-dress. Direction the bank, where he tries to blend in the mould of a lambda frame, suffocating day after day under the weight of routine and numbers. Everything changes when Couscous (Jean-Paul Rouve), his accomplice always as crazy as he is faithful, arrives with a new explosive: a Night of the Sames is organized on television, with at the key a national visibility and, who knows, a consecration for the best imitator of Cloclo.

programme.title: Seven Sisters
programme.desc: While the government is pursuing a single child policy, seven sisters, each of whom has a day of the week as their first name, are being hunted.
programme.desc-more: In 2073, the Earth choked under the weight of its own overpopulation. Resources are running out, megacities are spreading infinitely, and desperate governments are imposing radical measures to control population. Among them, the Single Child Act, applied without mercy by the Office of Birth Allowance (BAN), a powerful institution headed by a hand of iron by Nicolette Cayman (Glenn Close). In this world where every birth is planned, registered and strictly limited, breaking the rule is equivalent to a crime against the state. The violators disappear. "Illegal" children are being hunted. And those who dare to hide them risk everything – including their lives. It is in this climate of silent terror that Terrence Settman (Willem Dafoe) makes a decision that will seal the fate of his family. When an unexpected medical event gives birth to seven identical girls, he refuses to deliver them to the NDB. Instead, he drew up a bold plan: each of the sisters would bear the same name, Karen Settman, but only one specific day of the week, corresponding to his secret name (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday...). Located inside their apartment in high security, the seven young women grow up in ignorance of their own multiple existence, sharing a unique life through the stories of their "days". For the outside world, Karen Settman is just one person – a model employee, discreet, without history.

programme.title: A real Santa Claus
programme.desc: Manu, who is used to small jobs, becomes Santa Claus in a shopping mall. His meeting with Clementine and his son Julien will upset his daily life.
programme.desc-more: Manu keeps the little jobs going, never really find his place. When he gets a Santa Claus job in a shopping mall, he's far from imagining that this experience will change his life. This is where he meets Clementine and his son Julien, a young boy who asks him for a gift as surprising as it is unimaginable. Touched by this extraordinary wish, Manu decides to take up the challenge and make every effort to offer him the most beautiful gift. An unexpected encounter that might well give everyone a new reason to believe in the magic of Christmas.

programme.title: A real Santa Claus
programme.desc: In Strasbourg, a little boy expresses his wish for a gift to a man dressed as Santa Claus, whom he takes for the real old man with a white beard.
programme.desc-more: At the end of December, Julien and his mother took a walk. Suddenly, a man dressed as Santa Claus asks him to take a picture with him. Sitting on his knees, the little boy blows in his ear what he would like for Christmas. He was in a state of trouble, but under the insistence of the child, he finally gave him his word. At the end of the day, Manu, who was hiding under the costume, cannot forget this surprising encounter and goes to meet Julien to explain everything to him.

programme.title: The Christmas Parade
programme.desc: A fashion designer is inspired by Christmas to develop an innovative collection, which leads her to wonder about her professional and personal values.
programme.desc-more: As the glittering lights of Christmas illuminate New York, Charlotte (Rebecca Dalton), a talented fashion designer looking for meaning, feels overwhelmed by the city's frantic pace and demands of her profession. Despite his apparent success, he misses something: this creative spark that would allow him to stand out in a world as competitive as it is unforgiving. When the opportunity comes in the form of a prestigious fashion contest, whose theme is inspired by the magic of the end-of-year parties, Charlotte sees it as much more than just a professional challenge. It's a chance to prove your talent, but also to reconnect to what really matters. The challenge is great: she only got one week to design a whole collection, able to captivate a demanding jury and mark the minds. In search of inspiration, Charlotte makes a bold decision: to leave New York's agitation and return to her hometown, a place full of memories, nostalgia and human warmth. This return to the sources, far from the glitter and stressful deadlines, offers him the opportunity to review his priorities. Between the festive decorations that adorn the streets, the familiar faces that welcome him with open arms, and the snowy landscapes that awaken in her a forgotten sweetness, Charlotte gradually rediscovers what has nourished her passion for creation. Yet this introspective journey is not without challenges. Doubts resurface, memories of the past reappear, and unexpected encounters shake his certainty. Among them is Daniel, a man whose presence will call into question much more than his professional choices. As the days unfold and the competition closes, Charlotte will have to balance her ambitions with her deep aspirations. Will she be able to draw from this return to the origins the necessary strength to create a collection that is up to her dreams? What if true success was not only about victory, but about rediscovering oneself and values that give meaning to life? Between tradition and modernity, this Christmas could be the one that will change everything.

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc: On 19 January 2001, two motorists had a violent altercation in a commercial car park in Strasbourg. One of them, Jacques Plumin, a native of Guadeloupe, former athlete and former soldier who had become a vigil, took out a sword and seriously injured his opponent. Immediately incarcerated, he was sentenced to 12 years in prison. He was found to be the murderer of several young women.
programme.desc-more: On 19 January 2001, two motorists had a violent altercation in a commercial car park in Strasbourg. One of them, Jacques Plumin, comes out with a sword and seriously hurts his opponent. Immediately arrested, he was sentenced to 12 years in prison in September 2003. From the first few months of detention, Plumin was confused with the murders of three women and an attempted murder on a fourth. He was sentenced to life imprisonment in April 2006 with a 20-year security sentence for the murders of Gisela Dallman and Ursula Brelowski.

programme.title: Inside Ikea: Behind the scenes of the Swedish giant
programme.desc: In the furniture, Ikea has established itself as a landmark of everyday life. Behind the arrow path and the furniture in kit hides a perfectly runned mechanics. Set up rooms, restaurant in the heart of the store, adjoining warehouse: everything is thought out to guide, inspire and simplify the purchase. In Nantes, one of the most popular sites in the country, teams coordinate daily deliveries, online orders, re-assortment of shelves and service of thousands of meals. Logistics, sales, catering, second life of products: dive into the scenes of the daily operation of a giant that has become indispensable.

programme.title: Hypermarkets: behind the scenes of a giant of the big distribution
programme.desc: The large distribution is central to the life of the French. With a pace of life that has accelerated with time and a greater consumption, hypermarkets have become irreplaceable. To meet this ever-increasing demand, a seamless organization is needed to supply the shelves with thousands of products. To better understand how this gigantic machine works, Intermarché opened its doors. Discovery of work performed by order preparers, planners, technicians or supply managers.

programme.title: The post, a logistics XXL
programme.desc: The company's behind-the-scenes are shown, from the drone delivery to the Var's enclaved areas to the secretariat of Santa Claus set up in Libourne, Gironde. A letter can travel more than 800 kilometres in 24 hours. The delivery of mail and parcels, the manufacture of a stamp and the techniques to make it unfalsifiable are explained. This institution, dating back to the 15th century, has always adapted to high speed V: delivery of parcels in record time, efficient logistics, tools of the new generation digital...

programme.title: Cold Case
programme.desc: In Philadelphia, the team of the Unsolved Business Section, led by Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), is committed to reopening long forgotten investigations, confronting the ghosts of the past. The season opens with a tragic case: a massacre in a large area in 1995, where a possible third accomplice emerges, questioning the version of events. In another episode, the death of a policeman, suspected of corruption in 1968, revives investigations into a troubled past. The discovery of a teenager's remains in a garbage dumpster raises questions about the young man's identity and the circumstances of his disappearance. Each case is intertwined with poignant cultural references, such as the Columbine shooting and controversial doctor Jack Kevorkian. With a rich soundtrack, mixing artists like Bob Dylan and Coldplay, this Cold Case season plunges the spectator into an emotional exploration of the consequences of unsolved crimes.
programme.desc-more: Within Philadelphia police, Lieutenant John Stillman (John Finn), but also Inspectors Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), Scotty Valens (Danny Pino), Nick Vera (Jeremy Ratchford), Will Jeffries (Thom Barry) and Kat Miller (Thoms Trade) were part of a special brigade investigating past cases, which were closed at the time despite the fact that they were not resolved. The team will then interview witnesses, whose lives have changed significantly since the murder, try to find new clues and use new technologies that can provide some answers.

The discovery of a teenager's remains in a garbage dumpster raises questions about the young man's identity and the circumstances of his disappearance. Each case is intertwined with poignant cultural references, such as the Columbine shooting and controversial doctor Jack Kevorkian. With a rich soundtrack, mixing artists like Bob Dylan and Coldplay, this Cold Case season plunges the spectator into an emotional exploration of the consequences of unsolved crimes.
programme.desc-more: Within Philadelphia police, Lieutenant John Stillman (John Finn), but also Inspectors Lilly Rush (Kathryn Morris), Scotty Valens (Danny Pino), Nick Vera (Jeremy Ratchford), Will Jeffries (Thom Barry) and Kat Miller (Thoms Trade) were part of a special brigade investigating past cases, which were closed at the time despite the fact that they were not resolved. The team will then interview witnesses, whose lives have changed significantly since the murder, try to find new clues and use new technologies that can provide some answers.
