programme.title: A guy, a girl
programme.desc: In a Parisian apartment where the disputes are as fast as the bursts of laughter, vibrate a thirty-year-old couple as fond as it is exasperating: Jean (Jean Dujardin), nicknamed Loulou by the one who shares her daily life, and Alexandra (Alexandra Lamy), affectionately called Chouchou. He, a seducer clumsy with the great principles but with the little cowardice, she, an independent woman with a well-drained character, forms an explosive duo where love is measured in existential crises and improvised reconciliations. Between the walls of their housing – a battlefield of battle and tenderness at the same time – is a human comedy where the daily hassles become mountains to climb... or to bypass with a pirouette. Chouchou and Loulou, it's the story of two egos who fight, seek and find each other, tirelessly. He dreams of greatness but drowns in details (how to fold a road map without tearing it apart?), she manages their lives with a pragmatism that friezes despotism (the socks that drag are a crime against humanity). Between forgotten races, romantic dinners that turn to the settlement of accounts, and friends who always arrive at the wrong time, their relationship is a constant balance between the desire to break everything and the desire to repair everything with a hug.However, behind the arguments for a poorly closed pot lid or a lost remote control, is a constant complicity. Whether it is in the face of the intrusive mother-in-law, the insufferable office colleagues, or the temptations of infidelity that point their noses, Chouchou and Loulou navigate between nerve attacks and crazy laughs, proving that love is also a laugh of his own faults. For in the background, despite the low blows and the unsaid, one question persists: how can we stay together when we are both the best and the worst that can happen to each other?

programme.sub-title: Jean-Marc Petroff, the death of Jean-Claude Poulet-Dachary

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.sub-title: Roland Bondonny and Alain Bodchon: the mystery of blue meatballs
programme.desc:
On 25 August 2004, Marius Lac was found murdered in Corrèze. Three years earlier, he had testified in a case involving dog poisoning. On 14 February 2001, the notable Roland Bondonny was arrested and sentenced to two years in prison, one of whom was suspended. He had appealed. Shortly before the date of this second trial, Marius Lac was murdered.
Presenter(s): Christophe Hondelatte

programme.title: Bring In The Accused
programme.desc:

programme.sub-title: Annie and Yann Baudet, family murder

programme.title: Bring In The Accused

programme.title: Bring In The Accused

programme.desc: Around one in three women worldwide have experienced domestic or sexual violence, as a result of being a woman. programme.desc: The international rugby player at XV New Zealand Jonah Lomu had qualities that made him one of the greatest: speed, technique and power. But Lomu also suffered from a serious kidney disease that quickly worsened and eventually prevailed. This film evokes the weight of its world-renowned reputation, its fight against disease and certain aspects of its privacy. Its Togolese origins and natural shyness often conflicted with the attention given to its talent on the ground. This documentary pays tribute to the talent of this champion who disappeared in 2015 at the age of 40.

programme.title: Coming Madonna
programme.desc: Thanks to new archives and recently discovered audio tapes, this documentary traces Madonna's ascent from 1978 to 1992: a young woman landed in New York with little dollars in pocket to a global pop icon. Exclusive interviews with his family, friends and collaborators highlight his struggle to win in a male-dominated industry, until the shocking release of his book "Sex" in 1992. The documentary also reviews the personal dramas that have punctuated his life, such as the death of his mother and the death of close friends who have been swept away by AIDS. programme.title: Spinners
programme.desc: Ethan is a 17-year-old man living in a poor neighbourhood in Cape Town, South Africa. With no father or mother to support his little brother, he has no choice but to work for Damien, the godfather of a local gang. While he is linked despite himself to a crime of which he is innocent, he discovers an extraordinary talent for spinning, an exciting and extreme motorsport. The first African fiction selected at the CanneSéries festival, this series highlights a constantly changing South African community and an unknown car discipline.

programme.title: Farewell Jean-Pat
programme.desc: At 35, Etienne still did not forgive her "copain" Jean-Pat, who led her life hard throughout her childhood. In the midst of an existential crisis and while he hesitated to engage with Alice, his girlfriend, he decided to return to contact Jean-Pat in order to find the trace of his childhood love. He then learned of the sudden death of his former stalker in a road accident. Although he is not really devastated by the news, Etienne will be in charge of organizing the burial of her worst enemy, at the request of the mother mourned. One thing is for sure: Jean-Pat has not finished rotting his life...

programme.title: The resistant
programme.desc: Around one in three women worldwide have experienced domestic or sexual violence, as a result of being a woman. But everywhere, far from the spotlight, resistanceers circumvent oppression, refuse the limits imposed on them, and imagine concrete solutions to save lives. From India to Afghanistan, from Africa to Iran, to the United States, France and Ukraine, author Sarah Barukh, herself a former victim of domestic violence, is going to meet them. Each is a "visage of the possible", the face of a feminism that gives hope, that gathers, protects and frees. This film highlights a real system of repair, agile and solidary, which moves the lines. Because in the face of this "global pandemic", as the UN has expressed it, global solutions are needed.

programme.title: Wolves garous
programme.desc: 13 players with exceptional abilities arrive at the village of Thiercelieux for a life-size game that will last 13 days. Role cards are drawn and give rise to the first suspicions. At nightfall, one of them will be eaten by werewolves.
programme.desc-more: Adapted from the board game "The werewolves of Thiercelieux", this strategy game is animated by the comedians Panayotis Pascot, Fary Lopes, and Mister V. The principle is simple. In a fictional village, thirteen players with a singular profile (a mathematician, a former DGSE spy, a behaviorist, or a mentalist) take on the role of villagers or werewolves. Villagers must do their utmost to expose the lycanthropists who hide among them while maintaining human form. The werewolves, on the other hand, strive to blend among humans in order to eliminate them one by one during their sleep, in their backs, without being exposed.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In this fourth season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque and varied landscapes of France become the scene of captivating police investigations, where every murder is intimately linked to local legends and traditions. Follow the adventures of a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, who launch in exciting investigations in Grasse, in the heart of the world of perfumers, where scents and secrets mix. In Strasbourg, they explore the wine world, where wine passion sometimes hides deadly rivalries. Other investigations lead them to Dunkirk, where the mysteries of the northern coasts are revealed, and Martinique, on the sides of the majestic Pelee Mountain, where local culture and ancestral beliefs reveal disturbing truths. Each episode offers a mixture of suspense, regional culture and human drama, enriching intrigue with authentic elements.
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: The carrier - the series
programme.desc: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), the famous "carrier", is back with a new associate, Caterina Boldieu. In this season full of twists, their first mission takes them into a perilous world, where they must escort the son of an Italian anti-mafia judge. The latter must testify at the trial of a notorious murderer, and the safety of the young man is paramount. As Frank strives to protect him, an American song star also seeks his services, putting him in the face of a formidable competition. Quickly, he realizes that other carriers compete with him, each one ready to do anything to take over. In parallel with his risky missions, Frank cannot help but look for the woman he loves, who disappeared under mysterious circumstances. This combination of protection, betrayal and personal research makes this series a veritable whirlwind of action and emotion, where loyalty and danger are associated at every moment.
programme.desc-more: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), a former British Special Forces agent, traded his life as a warrior for the life of a "carrier", a man of trust who transported people and goods with formidable efficiency, without ever asking questions. Each new mission is dangerous, requiring perfect command of its combat and strategy skills. In this captivating series, Frank has to escort a general's daughter to a safe place, while being hunted by enemy agents. In another episode, he finds himself involved in a plot where a CIA spy is wrongly accused of betrayal, and he must thwart the plans of those who seek to bring him down. Moreover, the delivery of a revolutionary electronic chip in Paris proves to be a monumental challenge, forcing him to fight against time and unscrupulous opponents. At each mission, Frank implements his system of moral code, juggling loyalty and danger, while confronting the consequences of his past. Through thrilling pursuits and complex intrigues, the carrier navigates into a dark world where loyalty is measured by the ability to survive.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: While Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are continuing their investigations in New York, their collaboration is being tested by unexpected reunions. Joan crosses the path of Shinwell Johnson, a former patient whose tumultuous journey leads him to seek his help. Determined to help her, she finds herself immersed in a complex world of loyalties and difficult choices. At the same time, Holmes faces an unexpected return from Kitty Winter, her former partner, who gives her a crucial warning about an imminent threat. In this climate of tension, Captain Gregson (Aidan Quinn) seeks to have the contributions of the two detectives recognized, adding a political dimension to their efforts. This fifth season, which celebrates the 100 episodes, further deepens the dynamics between Holmes and Watson, while exploring themes of redemption, danger and the impact of past choices.
programme.desc-more: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are called upon to investigate a shocking double murder when the bodies sifted with two twins are found in a New York apartment. The brothers, one of whom had been adopted, had recently regained their family ties through a website. As they dive into the details of this complex affair, Sherlock and Joan discover a network of family scams and secrets that could explain the tragedy. In parallel with this investigation, Sherlock offers his father, a man with whom he has a tense relationship, to assist him in his affairs, hoping to convince him to leave New York. This dynamic father-son adds a layer of personal tension to the plot, while Sherlock navigates between his professional obligations and family conflicts, revealing the challenges behind his sharp intellect.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), the famous genius detective, faces a new challenge as he emerges from a period of detoxification. His willingness to resume service is complicated by his arrogance and unconventional methods. To help her navigate this delicate phase of her life, her father hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had taken a radical turn in her career. Joan, initially reluctant, is forced to follow Sherlock in his investigations, while juggling with his own demons and the pressure of a complex criminal world. Together, they form an unexpected duo, where Sherlock's relentless logic confronts Joan's intuition and sensitivity. As they resolve mysterious affairs in New York, their relationship evolves, mixing tension, respect and a touch of friendship, while revealing each other's flaws and wounds.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: A commissioner investigates the death of a man, found hanged in a hangar. The murder seems to be a tragic event in the 1980s.
programme.desc-more: In this fourth season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque and varied landscapes of France become the scene of captivating police investigations, where every murder is intimately linked to local legends and traditions. Follow the adventures of a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, who launch in exciting investigations in Grasse, in the heart of the world of perfumers, where scents and secrets mix. In Strasbourg, they explore the wine world, where wine passion sometimes hides deadly rivalries. Other investigations lead them to Dunkirk, where the mysteries of the northern coasts are revealed, and Martinique, on the sides of the majestic Pelee Mountain, where local culture and ancestral beliefs reveal disturbing truths. Each episode offers a mixture of suspense, regional culture and human drama, enriching intrigue with authentic elements.

programme.desc-more: In this new season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque landscapes of France become the scene of captivating criminal mysteries, where every investigation is intimately linked to the cultural heritage and local traditions. The protagonists, Fauve Hautot and Aurelien Wiik, find themselves immersed in the heart of sordid business that reveal the buried secrets of their region. The spectators follow these experienced investigators as they navigate between folklore and criminal investigation, digging up sometimes disturbing truths. The appearances of iconic figures such as Line Renaud, Samuel Labarthe, Francis Huster and Olivier Marchal add dramatic depth to the intrigues, enriching the story of their talent and charisma. This season promises a fascinating exploration of local mysteries, between dramatic tensions and unexpected revelations.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: In New York, Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), an exceptionally brilliant but arrogant detective, is trying to reintegrate into the world of investigation after a difficult period of detoxification. Her father, concerned about her well-being, hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had become her mentor, to help her stay on the right path and avoid a relapse. As an unexpected partner, Joan finds herself navigating the complex universe of criminal investigations alongside Sherlock. Together, they solve thorny business using Holmes' sharp intuition and deducing talent, often confronted with puzzles that test their skills. The dynamics between the duo, with the feminization of Watson's character, bring a new dimension to this modern adaptation of Conan Doyle's works. The challenges they face reveal not only mysteries, but also the personal struggles and human relations that unite them.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: On a captivating journey through France, "Mothers to..." plunges spectators into the heart of regions rich in history and culture, where every murder revealed is intimately linked to a local legend or a landmark event. Each episode highlights a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, whose skills are not always limited to those of the law enforcement agencies. These characters, sometimes from a variety of backgrounds, mix their talents and perspectives to solve complex puzzles that shake local communities. As investigations, tensions and affinities develop, adding a romantic and human dimension to their investigations. Between police intrigues and cultural discoveries, this series will seduce polar lovers while immersing them in the French heritage, making each murder a mystery to be deciphered, and a story to tell.

programme.title: Captain Marleau
programme.desc: Catherine Rougemont is a former police officer who left the police force to start a new life. She now has a charming hotel by the sea. Her existence is in a state of anguish when she is the victim of an attempted murder. Marleau, who had served under his orders in the past, came to the conviction that Catherine Rougemont knew the identity of her aggressor. But she doesn't want to tell her former colleague anything. She fears for the safety of the people she offered her protection to: battered women she hides in her hotel. And then, she wants to protect her 16-year-old grandson Gabriel, whom she has raised alone since her parents' brutal death... Director(s): Josée Dayan Actors : Corinne Masiero (Captain Marleau), Yolande Moreau (Catherine Rougemont), Patrick Bouchitey (Hugo Perez), Cédric Le Auguste (Loïc Planchon), Rod Paradot (Gabriel), Laure Josnin (Claire), Lucie Desclozeaux (Leïla), Margaux Vallé (Lisa Serelle), Piérick Tournier (Julien Batz), Maxime Secaud (Frank), Sarah Haxaire (the little unknown lady), Audrey Chamot (Sandra), Thomas Baelde (Interne hospital Calais), Gérard Pinteau (Major), Mathilde Braure (Ms Armelle Chavancy), Alexandre Carrière (Rémi Arnoux), Franck Andrieux (Enzo Cassini), Amar Oumaziz (Legiste), Saverio Maligno (Gendarme motoard méthéin), Clément De Preiter Baise (Homme STUP), Grégory Maiuri (Pêcher surfcasting)
programme.desc-more: A non-standard element of the national gendarmerie, Captain Marleau (Corinne Masiero) is distinguished by his frankness and his pronounced ch'ti accent. With her disconcerting style, with an unlikely chapka, she follows the crime scenes with a filiform silhouette and a phlegm of her own. However, his unconventional approach hides a formidable tenacity and a sharp flair to dislodge the most twisted culprits. Each episode plunges us into well-taught intrigues, taking place in picturesque scenery from the French regions, where it crosses a gallery of colourful characters, often embodied by prestigious guest stars. His sarcastic humour and sharp eyes allow him to interrogate witnesses and unravel the sons of complex stories, gradually revealing hidden truths. As the investigations progressed, Captain Marleau proved that behind his staggered appearance, there was a staggering determination to do justice.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: After the tragic death of his father, who was the victim of a terrorist act, Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin) was determined to bring justice to the Hawaiian archipelago. He agreed to lead a new elite unit, the Hawaii 5-0, to track down the biggest criminals in the state. He joined the team, and found Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a former high school friend who became a police officer, and met Danny Williams (Scott Caan), a recently transferred detective from New Jersey, who brought a touch of humour to the band's dynamics. Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a promising young recruit, completes this heteroclite team. Together, they are tackling complex cases, ranging from kidnapping an expert in cyberterrorism to fighting Samoan gangs, while navigating local intrigues and cultural tensions on the island.
programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.desc-more: Hawaii, famous for its white sand beaches and turquoise waters, also hides dark realities in its sunny climate. The island of paradise has become a playground for criminals, requiring urgent intervention. Lieutenant-Commander Steve McGarrett (Alex O'Loughlin), a SEAL of the U.S. Navy Special Forces, is on his way to Hawaii for a personal mission: to investigate the death of his father. However, the Governor of the State sees his presence as a strategic opportunity. McGarrett was convinced to create a special police unit with extensive powers, enabling this team to act unhindered to restore order on the island. McGarrett recruited Daniel Williams (Scott Caan), a former New Jersey policeman, and Chin Ho Kelly (Daniel Dae Kim), a veteran of Honolulu police. Next to them is Kono Kalakaua (Grace Park), a young recruit who has a fresh degree and an expert in martial arts. Together, they form an elite unit determined to track down and neutralize the criminals who threaten Hawaii's security. Throughout their dangerous missions, McGarrett also received support from Catherine Rollins (Michelle Borth), his girlfriend and lieutenant, adding a personal dimension to his fight against crime.

programme.title: The Agency all risks
programme.desc: In the effervescence of Las Vegas, tension rises when the mafia, shaken by the mysterious death of an organized crime leader, identifies Hannibal (George Peppard) as the main suspect. In response to this charge, a $100,000 prize is put on his head, attracting the attention of bounty hunters and criminals of all walks of life. Hannibal, known for his intelligence and trick, must not only prove his innocence, but also escape the many enemies who want to capture him. His team, composed of Futé (Dirk Benedict), B.A. Baracus (Mr. T) and the Murdock mechanic (Dwight Schultz), embarks on a bold mission to save him. Together, they navigate through a complex network of betrayals and manipulations, while trying to unmask the real murderer before time runs out. Hannibal's abduction could be the catalyst for an explosive confrontation with the mafia.

programme.title: Parker
programme.desc: In the effervescence of the Ohio Fair, Parker (Jason Statham), a meticulous and ruthless professional thief, leads a bold robbery with his rode team: Ross, Melander, Carlson and Jake. The operation, performed with surgical precision, promises a huge loot and a golden retreat. But when Parker refuses to participate in a new coup proposed by his accomplices, tensions erupt. Trahi by those in whom he had placed his trust, he was abandoned for death after a bloody ambush. Against all odds, Parker survives. Injured, determined and thirsty for revenge, he escapes from the hospital where he was treated and disappears in nature. Under a new identity, he methodically prepares his response, tracking down his former associates who believe he is definitely eliminated. His plan becomes more complicated when he crosses the route of Leslie (Jennifer Lopez), a clever and independent real estate agent whose lively mind and well tempered character immediately attracts his attention. Despite her initial reluctance, Parker realizes that she might well be the key to defeating the defences of her former accomplices. Together, they sink into a dangerous game where each movement counts. Between strained spinning, unexpected turning and brutal clashes, Parker and Leslie must stay a step ahead of enemies who still underestimate their determination. But in a world where loyalty does not exist and where every potential ally can prove to be a trap, revenge may well have a higher price than expected. As the countdown towards the inevitable confrontation accelerates, a question persists: in this environment where betrayal is commonplace, who can we really trust?

programme.title: Jack Teacher : Never Go Back
programme.desc: Armed with a glasses rifle, a sniper shoots six times, killing five people. Arrested, the man, apparently responsible for the carnage, has only one answer during his interrogation: "Find Jack Reacher". His lawyer decides to find this famous Jack Reacher and to foil the trap set by an invisible enemy... Director(s): Christopher McQuarrie Actors: Tom Cruise (Jack Reacher), Lee Child, Rosamund Pike (Helen Rodin), Richard Jenkins (Alex Rodin), Jai Courtney (Charlie), Werner Herzog (The Zec), Robert Duvall (Martin Cash), David Oyelowo (Emerson), Vladimir Sizov (Vlad), Michael Raymond-James (Linsky), Joseph Sikora (Barr), Alexia Fast (Sandy), Josh Helmman (Jeb), James Martin Kelly (Rob Farrior), Dylan Kussman (Gary), Denver Milord (Punk), Susan Angelo (Oline Archer), Julia Yorks (Chrissie Farrior), Nicole Forester (Nancy Holt), Delilah Picart (Rita Coronillado), Joe Coyle (Darren Sawyer), Alicia Murton (Mrs. Sawyer), David Whalen (Mr. Holt), Tristan Elma (Jita Coronado), Bob-Nicky-Nicky-Nicky-Nicky-Nick-Nick-Nick-Nick-Nick
programme.desc-more: Formerly a member of the military who became a solitary vigilante, Jack Reacher (Tom Cruise) is a man who prefers to live outside established standards, moving from town to town, always seeking the truth. When he decided to visit Major Susan Turner (Cobie Smulders), who was in charge of the military unit to which he belonged, he discovered with astonishment that she had been arrested for espionage. Convinced that this is a machination orchestrated by dark forces, Reacher commits himself to prove his innocence. However, the situation is rapidly complicated when Jack is charged with murder and is behind bars. Using his ingenuity and combat skills, he managed to escape, taking Turner with him in a frantic flight. Together, they will have to foil a complex plot while confronting formidable enemies, and discover the hidden truths that threaten not only their lives, but also national security.

programme.title: The carrier - the series
programme.desc: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), the famous "carrier", is back with a new associate, Caterina Boldieu. In this season full of twists, their first mission takes them into a perilous world, where they must escort the son of an Italian anti-mafia judge. The latter must testify at the trial of a notorious murderer, and the safety of the young man is paramount. As Frank strives to protect him, an American song star also seeks his services, putting him in the face of a formidable competition. Quickly, he realizes that other carriers compete with him, each one ready to do anything to take over. In parallel with his risky missions, Frank cannot help but look for the woman he loves, who disappeared under mysterious circumstances. This combination of protection, betrayal and personal research makes this series a veritable whirlwind of action and emotion, where loyalty and danger are associated at every moment.
programme.desc-more: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), a former British Special Forces agent, traded his life as a warrior for the life of a "carrier", a man of trust who transported people and goods with formidable efficiency, without ever asking questions. Each new mission is dangerous, requiring perfect command of its combat and strategy skills. In this captivating series, Frank has to escort a general's daughter to a safe place, while being hunted by enemy agents. In another episode, he finds himself involved in a plot where a CIA spy is wrongly accused of betrayal, and he must thwart the plans of those who seek to bring him down. Moreover, the delivery of a revolutionary electronic chip in Paris proves to be a monumental challenge, forcing him to fight against time and unscrupulous opponents. At each mission, Frank implements his system of moral code, juggling loyalty and danger, while confronting the consequences of his past. Through thrilling pursuits and complex intrigues, the carrier navigates into a dark world where loyalty is measured by the ability to survive.

programme.title: Kaamelott
programme.desc: The island of Brittany, in the fifth century. His legends, battles, the fantastic and respectable adventures of the Knights of the Round Table, gathered around their powerful and magnanimous King Arthur. But looking closer, Arthur is not always as wise as he would like to think, and his dear wife Guinevere is not the erudite nymph related by history, but rather a naive woman who keeps exasperating her husband. Guinevere's father, Leodagan, king of Carmellia, is a warmaniac who only thinks of fighting the other peoples, while his mother, Séli, is an ambitious acariquist always quick to share her bad mood with the kingdom. As for the famous Knights of the Round Table, they are not so brave and philanthropic that we are told that they want to believe it. Perceval and Karadoc are poltrons who are better at making the tavern of the village go bad than in fulfilling the missions entrusted to them by King Arthur. Yvain and Gauvain are two teenagers seeking glory but unable to prove their courage. Bohort is more interested in fashion than in fighting, and Merlin is an enchanter whose spells usually turn against him. King Arthur is embodied by talented Alexandre Astier, who is one of the three creators of the series with Alain Kappauf (Camera Café) and Jean-Yves Robin. He knows how to work with the family, since he shares the screen with Lionnel Astier (Leodagan of Carmelide) and Simon Astier (Yvain), who is the main hero of Hero Corp.

programme.title: Elementary
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller), the famous genius detective, faces a new challenge as he emerges from a period of detoxification. His willingness to resume service is complicated by his arrogance and unconventional methods. To help her navigate this delicate phase of her life, her father hired Joan Watson (Lucy Liu), a former surgeon who had taken a radical turn in her career. Joan, initially reluctant, is forced to follow Sherlock in his investigations, while juggling with his own demons and the pressure of a complex criminal world. Together, they form an unexpected duo, where Sherlock's relentless logic confronts Joan's intuition and sensitivity. As they resolve mysterious affairs in New York, their relationship evolves, mixing tension, respect and a touch of friendship, while revealing each other's flaws and wounds.
programme.desc-more: Sherlock Holmes (Jonny Lee Miller) and Joan Watson (Lucy Liu) are called upon to investigate a shocking double murder when the bodies sifted with two twins are found in a New York apartment. The brothers, one of whom had been adopted, had recently regained their family ties through a website. As they dive into the details of this complex affair, Sherlock and Joan discover a network of family scams and secrets that could explain the tragedy. In parallel with this investigation, Sherlock offers his father, a man with whom he has a tense relationship, to assist him in his affairs, hoping to convince him to leave New York. This dynamic father-son adds a layer of personal tension to the plot, while Sherlock navigates between his professional obligations and family conflicts, revealing the challenges behind his sharp intellect.

programme.title: Mr. & Mrs. Smith
programme.desc: Mr. and Mrs. Smith formed a seemingly banal couple, living an ordinary marital life in a comfortable house in the suburbs. Yet behind this quiet facade are explosive secrets: Mr. Smith (Brad Pitt) is an executor for a secret organization, while Mrs. Smith (Angelina Jolie) is a formidable pawn killer, working for the most offerrs. Each of them ignores the true nature of the other's activities, creating an insidious tension in their marriage. When their respective employers order an unexpected contract, Mr. and Mrs. Smith found himself competing, not knowing that they were meant to eliminate each other. While the couple is forced to measure each other in a whirlwind of frenetic actions and clever strategies, they also have to face the hidden truths of their relationship. Through thrilling action scenes and romantic comedy moments, they will discover whether their love can survive this explosive revelation or whether it is doomed to collapse under the pressure of their secrets.

programme.title: The zombie call
programme.desc: While at Boston Airport, Clay Riddell (John Cusack), a cartoon artist in the midst of a professional upsurge, is suddenly plunged into horror when passengers begin to undergo a tragic transformation. Every person who picks up his cell phone instantly becomes a zombie, caught in madness and thirst for insatiable blood. This unexpected phenomenon triggers unimaginable chaos near the airport, propelling Clay into a desperate race for his survival. Concerned about his wife and son who remained in New England, Clay realized that he must act quickly to find his family and escape the apocalypse that arose around him. He then met Tom McCourt (Samuel L. Jackson), a man determined to resist this supernatural threat. Together, they form a group of ravaged people who try to navigate through a devastated landscape, while facing not only the hungry zombies, but also the moral and psychological challenges dictated by this terrifying new reality. Will unity and solidarity be sufficient to counter this horde of living death?

programme.title: Pay the Ghost
programme.desc: One year after his son disappeared during a Halloween parade, Mike (Nicolas Cage) remains haunted by frightening visions. Accompanied by his former wife Kristen (Sarah Wayne Callies), he tirelessly tries to understand these messages and, in the end, to be able to find his son. His research will reveal to him an ancient secret that should have remained hidden forever.

programme.title: The carrier - the series
programme.desc: Frank Martin (Chris Vance), the famous "carrier", is back with a new associate, Caterina Boldieu. In this season full of twists, their first mission takes them into a perilous world, where they must escort the son of an Italian anti-mafia judge. The latter must testify at the trial of a notorious murderer, and the safety of the young man is paramount. As Frank strives to protect him, an American song star also seeks his services, putting him in the face of a formidable competition. Quickly, he realizes that other carriers compete with him, each one ready to do anything to take over. In parallel with his risky missions, Frank cannot help but look for the woman he loves, who disappeared under mysterious circumstances. This combination of protection, betrayal and personal research makes this series a veritable whirlwind of action and emotion, where loyalty and danger are associated at every moment.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In this fourth season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque and varied landscapes of France become the scene of captivating police investigations, where every murder is intimately linked to local legends and traditions. Follow the adventures of a duo of investigators, often composed of a man and a woman, who launch in exciting investigations in Grasse, in the heart of the world of perfumers, where scents and secrets mix. In Strasbourg, they explore the wine world, where wine passion sometimes hides deadly rivalries. Other investigations lead them to Dunkirk, where the mysteries of the northern coasts are revealed, and Martinique, on the sides of the majestic Pelee Mountain, where local culture and ancestral beliefs reveal disturbing truths. Each episode offers a mixture of suspense, regional culture and human drama, enriching intrigue with authentic elements.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: The personal problems of the protagonists interfere with their work. Van Buren announces his health problems to his team while McCoy presents himself to his own estate. Rubirosa confesses her past relationship with a corrupt magistrate. But in the meantime, the crime doesn't stop in New York. The temptation is therefore great to compromise with principles. Fortunately, Cutter is watching the grain and altercations are not uncommon in McCoy's office. After 20 seasons, "New York Judicial Police" drew his reverence, leaving behind her a rosary of spin-off and adaptations abroad, including "Paris, criminal investigations" with Vincent Pérez.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: Depressive teachers, stressed parents and school children in the moon try to survive the horrors and joys of daily life in school. Relationships intertwine for the best and often for the worst!
programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Captain Montgomery died, and Beckett, shot and wounded, underwent a major operation. She's safe and sound, but a priori amnesia because she doesn't remember Castle telling her she's a flame. Her health is improving from day to day and she eventually returns to the service, without immediately feeling able to return to the field. With Castle, she is still retracing her mother's killer, Castle's great dam, who is worried about her. In the fourth season, Lanie and Esposito split up, as did Alexis and his boyfriend, Ashley, while Ryan married his fiancée, Jenny. And Alexis, who grew up, is about to enter college, and is more interested in his father's work with the police.
programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: 21 Jump Street
programme.desc: Enemies sworn in at the college, Jenko and Schmidt meet at the police school where they become friends and graduate at the same time. They were tried immature after a blunder, and sent to a shabby police station to dismantle drug trafficking in a high school. Both officers must operate undercover and act as students. But times have changed a lot since their teens.

programme.title: 22 Jump Street
programme.desc: Young police officers Greg Jenko and Morton Schmidt are trying to arrest the Ghost, a drug baron working with the Mexican cartel. But the operation is a failure. Their chief then assigned them to investigate again for Captain Dickson. Their mission: to return to university to infiltrate and dismantle drug trafficking. The investigation is trampling, and the relationship between the two friends, who manage their infiltration differently, is complicated.

programme.title: Very special agents: U.N.C.L.E. Code
programme.desc: In the early 1960s, in the midst of the Cold War, CIA agent Solo (Henry Cavevill) and KGB agent Kuryakin (Armie Hammer) were forced to leave behind their ancestral antagonism. The two men then undertake a joint mission: to put out of order to harm an international criminal organization determined to shake the fragile global balance, by promoting the proliferation of nuclear weapons and technology. So far, Solo and Kuryakin have only one lead: the contact of the daughter of a missing German scientist, the only one able to infiltrate the criminal organization. They are starting a race against the clock to find its trace and prevent a planetary cataclysm.

programme.title: The nun
programme.desc: In a Romanian abbey, a controversial priest and a novice investigate the mysterious suicide of a nun and become the target of a clever spirit.
programme.desc-more: In a private school in Romania, a group of six young women are subjected to the tyranny of a ruthless nun, whose methods of discipline are as cruel as they are worrying. When one of them, who is being abused, finds herself pregnant, the nun, in an act of "purification", decides to torture her to atone for her alleged sin. Her friends, horrified, intervene to try to save their comrade, but the situation quickly becomes chaotic. Shortly afterwards, the nun mysteriously disappeared and the establishment closed its doors, leaving behind a heavy past. Seventeen years later, the return of two of the former students, now adults, is accompanied by the discovery of lifeless bodies, reviving traumatic memories. Accompanied by the daughter of their murdered friend, they return to school to face the demons of their past and the reappearance of this nun avengeess, ready to charge the price of their secrets.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: A man, a senior official in a post office, was murdered at his home. Terzani and Rex first question the victim's ex-wife.
programme.desc-more: In a quiet neighbourhood, the life of a senior post office official takes a tragic turn when he is found murdered at home. Inspector Terzani and his faithful companion Rex, a German shepherd with an exceptional flair, are embarking on a complex investigation that plunges them into the vic's privacy. By questioning the man's ex-wife, the investigators discover a woman tormented by separation and bitterness, who could hide unaccustomed secrets. While Terzani and Rex search the evidence left at the crime scene, they meet with colleagues from the victim and family members, each with their own underlying motivations and tensions. The atmosphere is becoming more and more intense as revelations accumulate, and the team must navigate between lies and truths to expose the culprit, while facing unexpected emotional challenges.

Each testimony reveals a hidden facet of man, while secrets of his past resurface. Rex and Terzani must unravel the true of the false in a world where seduction can prove fatal, while navigating in the intrigues and passions that surround the life of Excel.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Blew by the premature death of his wife, Andreas Mitterer learns that he will have a new partner, who is none other than a dog, named Rex.
programme.desc-more: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

programme.title: Inspector Lewis
programme.desc: A mother is found hanged. Against the advice of his superior, who categorically concluded that suicide was a crime, Inspector Lewis continued the investigation.

programme.title: Sphere
programme.desc: The US Army is organizing an expedition to explore, at the bottom of the ocean, an engulfed spaceship that contains a very strange sphere.
programme.desc-more: Norman, a psychologist, joins a group of scientists on a platform at sea. Under close surveillance of a secret service agent, he finds there Beth Halperin, his former companion, a biochemist, Harry Adams, a mathematician, and Ted Fielding, a young astrophysicist. Their mission, to study an immense ship that military personnel found, failed by three thousand meters of bottom.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: An accident causes a tunnel to collapse: a group of survivors organizes themselves and, together with an ex-supplier, tries to climb up to the surface.
programme.desc-more: In the oppressive darkness of a tunnel connecting Manhattan to New Jersey, an unexpected catastrophe is emerging. A truck carrying toxic waste explodes, causing a devastating detonation that blocks both tunnel entrances. As chaos and the relief teams are facing a stalemate, hope seems to be getting smaller. Kit Latura (Sylvester Stallone), a former head of the New York Samu, is then faced with a moral and professional dilemma. Witness of the tragedy, he feels the call of duty and decides to brave the dangers in order to try to save the victims trapped inside. In a hostile environment where smoke and panic reign, Latura must navigate through the rubble and failing ventilation systems, while facing its own inner demons. As the minutes pass, the stakes become increasingly critical. Kit Latura faces unforeseen obstacles, both physical and psychological, as he strives to carry out a rescue mission that could change the fate of many innocent people. Tensions are rising, and every second counts in this fierce struggle against the clock and the elements.

programme.title: Capucine
programme.sub-title: Capucine and its mission of life
programme.desc: In a vibrant world of colours and humour, Capucine (Barbara Bolotner) stands out for her sparkling personality and frankness. Equipped with her Airpods, she travels her daily life with contagious audacity, sharing her thoughts on human relations and the challenges of modern life through hilarious and staggering calls. Each episode sees her interact with a gallery of colourful characters, revealing her observation skills and her keen sense of irony. Capucine addresses a variety of themes, ranging from love to friendship, while offering a unique and touching female perspective on the world around him. Between moments of tenderness and bursts of laughter, she does not hesitate to question social norms and defy conventions, while remaining faithful to herself. Through his adventures, Capucine invites us to reflect on our own life path and the importance of being authentic.

programme.title: Stargate, the Stargate
programme.desc: 1928, Egypt. Under the burning sand of Giza, a team of archaeologists exhumes an artifact as mysterious as it is unexpected: a huge metal ring, covered with unknown hieroglyphics, defying any scientific logic. The secretly classified by the authorities, the object dark in the oblivion of military archives, where it waits, silent, for someone to pierce the secrets of it. Sixty-six years later, in 1994, Daniel Jackson (James Spader), a marginalised but brilliant Egyptologist, finally managed to decipher the inscriptions. His discovery is amazing: this ring, which he calls Stargate (the Stargate), is not a mere relic, but a portal that can connect the Earth to other worlds, to the borders of the galaxy. Technology so advanced that it can only be alien. Intrigued by the strategic implications of this revelation, the US Army entrusts Colonel Jack O的Neil (Kurt Russell), a hardened soldier marked by the loss of his son, the mission to explore the other side of the Gate. Accompanied by Daniel and a team of military men on the side, O的Neil crossed the unknown threshold. Their destination? A desert planet, bathed in golden light, where the remains of an ancient civilization are alongside a enslaved population. They quickly discover that this world is under the control of Ra, an entity that is becoming an all-powerful god. Mid-man, mid-machine, Râ reigns by terror, exploiting credulity and fear of his subjects to maintain his absolute grip. As the team tries to understand the mechanisms of the Gate and the secrets of this civilization, the dangers multiply. Between the Ra guards, armed with formidable technologies, and the traps of a hostile environment, every step forward could be the last. Daniel, fascinated by the mysteries of this world, sees in Ra much more than a tyrant: a key to understanding the origin of the Stargate and, perhaps, of humanity itself. But O的Neil, pragmatic and suspicious, knows that they are first and foremost intruders in a game much bigger than they are. As tensions rise and revelations flow, a question persists: how can we confront an enemy who believes that he is invincible, when we still ignore his powers? Between treason, shocking discoveries and struggles for survival, the team will have to show ingenuity and courage to hope to return home. But once the gate is crossed, nothing will be the same as before. For certain truths, once revealed, change the course of history forever.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: In the oppressive darkness of a tunnel connecting Manhattan to New Jersey, an unexpected catastrophe is emerging. A truck carrying toxic waste explodes, causing a devastating detonation that blocks both tunnel entrances. As chaos and the relief teams are facing a stalemate, hope seems to be getting smaller. Kit Latura (Sylvester Stallone), a former head of the New York Samu, is then faced with a moral and professional dilemma. Witness of the tragedy, he feels the call of duty and decides to brave the dangers in order to try to save the victims trapped inside. In a hostile environment where smoke and panic reign, Latura must navigate through the rubble and failing ventilation systems, while facing its own inner demons. As the minutes pass, the stakes become increasingly critical. Kit Latura faces unforeseen obstacles, both physical and psychological, as he strives to carry out a rescue mission that could change the fate of many innocent people. Tensions are rising, and every second counts in this fierce struggle against the clock and the elements.

programme.title: Mercury Code
programme.desc: In the ruthless world of secret services, where every mistake can cost a career – or a life –, Art Jeffries (Bruce Willis), a senior FBI agent, has had better days. After a failure during a delicate operation, he was relegated to minor missions, far from the important business. But when a case as mysterious as it is urgent lands on his desk, Jeffries understands that it may be his last chance to make up for it. His new mission: to protect Simon, a young autistic boy whose parents have just been murdered in troubled circumstances. What seems at first glance a simple case of witness protection quickly takes a much darker turn. Simon, despite his handicap which the outer world cup, has an exceptional cognitive capacity. Without knowing it, he decrypted an ultra-secret code, information so sensitive that it now attracts the worst predators. Unscrupulous killers, willing to do anything to eliminate the child and anyone who dares to get in their way. Jeffries then found himself plunged into a race against time, hunted by invisible but omnipresent enemies, whose resources and determination seemed boundless. To complicate things, Simon, overwhelmed by a hostile environment and stimuli that he cannot control, struggle to communicate, making Jeffries' task all the more arduous.

programme.title: We have to save Private Ryan.
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, Captain Miller and his men arrived on a beach in Normandy now called Omaha Beach. Just out of the hell of the landing, Miller was given a very dangerous mission: to drive his squad behind enemy lines to find and bring back healthy and except a soldier named Ryan, whose three brothers were killed in battle within a few days.

programme.title: Thirteen lives
programme.desc: On June 23, 2018, in Chiang Rai Province, Thailand, a team of young footballers, nicknamed the "Wild Boars", is embarking on an adventure that will quickly turn into a nightmare. After a training session, they decided to go to the cave in Tham Luang to explore its mysterious tunnels. However, their excursion takes a tragic turn when torrential rains flood the cave, trapping them inside. Parents, concerned about the prolonged absence of their children, go out looking for them and find out with horror that the entrance to the cave is submerged. In the face of this desperate situation, an unprecedented mobilization is being organized, bringing together local and international rescuers, equipped with diving equipment. As time is running out, every minute counts to save these young people and their coach, immerse rescue teams in a challenge as dangerous as it is moving. The determination, solidarity and courage will be tested in this race against time.

programme.title: Unsolved
programme.desc: On Saturday, August 6, 2011, the firefighters of Annemasse in Haute-Savoie were warned by an anonymous call of the presence of an injured man lying on a road outside the city. The victim, 34, is called Grégory Mercier. His murder of unheard of violence seems incomprehensible. The investigators are surprised that they did not receive any evidence when the crime was committed on the public highway. Then a denunciation will re-launch the investigation.

programme.title: Tel Aviv, the illusion of a city
programme.desc: A portrait of Tel Aviv, which has been living and vibrating through cinema for the last few years, hosting several film schools and hosting many film shoots.
programme.desc-more: Dive into the heart of Tel Aviv, this documentary film explores the cinematic effervescence that inhabits this dynamic metropolis. Over the years, the city has become a real crossroads for filmmakers, attracting talent from around the world and giving birth to a multitude of successful films. Through poignant interviews and testimonies, the documentary highlights the crucial role of film schools and the local university, which nurture creativity and artistic innovation. Directors, whether emerging or established, share their experiences and challenges when they turn into this vibrant setting, where each corner tells a story. The camera becomes a revealing tool, reflecting not only the complexity of life in Tel Aviv, but also the universal questions that result from it. By building links between Israeli cinema, society and culture, the film offers a profound reflection on the identity of the city and its relationship to the rest of the country, while highlighting the tensions and hopes that are going through it. This captivating portrait of Tel Aviv unfolds as a kaleidoscope of images and emotions, inviting the viewer to rediscover this city from a new angle.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: Depressive teachers, stressed parents and school children in the moon try to survive the horrors and joys of daily life in school. Relationships intertwine for the best and often for the worst!
programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: An entrepreneur has an appointment with a luxury prostitute. The next day, she was found dead. The investigation leads quickly to a sports club.
programme.desc-more: Guido Lorenzo (Francesco Arca), a fast-growing entrepreneur, is caught in a whirlwind of tragic events after a night with a luxury prostitute. The next morning, he discovered with horror that the young woman had been found dead in mysterious circumstances. The investigators, led by Rex's unwavering team, are quickly plunged into a complex investigation. The first clues lead them to a top-down sports club, where appearances are often misleading and secrets well guarded. As the investigators interview the club members, they realize that the victim had links with influential personalities, revealing a network of corruption and debauchery. Tensions are rising as Guido, suspected of having deeper links with crime, must prove his innocence while seeking to understand the truths hidden behind this vicious circle. Each revelation brings them a little closer to the heart of the riddle, where loyalty and betrayal are mixed dangerously.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: A man, recognized as a master in seduction and organizing courses to help shy men overcome their difficulties, is stabbed.
programme.desc-more: Antonio Tassinari, nicknamed Excel, is a charismatic man and expert in seduction, recognized for his innovative methods that help shy men overcome their relationship complexes. His life took a tragic turn when he was found stabbed in his apartment, leaving behind a series of questions. Rex, the exceptional detective dog with flair, and his faithful partner Terzani, are embarking on a complex investigation to discover the circumstances of his death. As they investigate, they meet a range of characters, ranging from former Excel students, who have benefited from his courses, to rivals jealous of his success. Each testimony reveals a hidden facet of man, while secrets of his past resurface. Rex and Terzani must unravel the true of the false in a world where seduction can prove fatal, while navigating in the intrigues and passions that surround the life of Excel.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Blew by the premature death of his wife, Andreas Mitterer learns that he will have a new partner, who is none other than a dog, named Rex.
programme.desc-more: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

programme.desc: Terzani is kidnapped by going to pick up food for Rex. Monterosso is launching the search. He learns that Tarantini, the kidnapper, just got out of prison.
programme.desc-more: As he gets ready to go out to seek food for his faithful companion Rex, Inspector Terzani (Francesco Arca) suddenly finds himself kidnapped by a mysterious kidnapper. Terzani's worrying disappearance soon aroused the concern of Rex, who, faithful to his master, began to search the premises for clues. Tensions are rising as Monterosso and his team try to uncover Tarantini's motivations and identify the places where he might have taken Terzani. In a race against the clock, Rex and Monterosso must unite their forces to save Terzani before it is too late.

programme.title: Without remorse
programme.desc: A Special Forces Marine is uncovering an international conspiracy as he seeks revenge for his pregnant wife who was murdered.
programme.desc-more: As the war rags in Syria, John Clark (Michael B. Jordan), a Navy Seal a seasoned, finds himself at the heart of a perilous mission with his comrades, including Keith Webb (Jamie Bell) and Rowdy King (Cam Gigandet). Their aim is to save hostages held in Aleppo, but to their surprise, they discover that their mission has led them to rescue Russian mercenaries. Three months later, as John tried to find a normal life in Charlotte, North Carolina, a tragedy struck: Rowdy was killed by an anonymous driver. This drama prompts him to reconsider his career, especially as his wife is expecting a child. In pain and anger, John is forced to plunge into a world of shadows and conspiracies, seeking justice for his friend while confronting the demons of his military past.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

Her frankness and impertinent humour make her an ideal confidant, able to transform ordinary moments into memorable memories. programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: After Jamie Ross's resignation, who preferred to find a job more compatible with his family life, Abbie Carmichael made her debut at the prosecutor's office. She is a former narcotics officer and is familiar with the mafia and drug dealers that Briscoe and Curtis face daily, even though she sometimes underestimates the threats that the underworld is putting on her loved ones. His conservative ideas, in a manner that is more progressive in Schiff and McCoy's mind, will be tested in a rape case. The introduction of this character allows this 9th season to strongly reflect ideological bipolarity in American society.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.
