programme.title: Shooter, sniper
programme.desc: Bob Lee Swagger, a former sniper, left the Navy after a heinous betrayal. Since then, he has been living in a chalet, on the top of a mountain that is difficult to reach. He believes he has definitely turned the page of his adventures of the past when Colonel Isaac Johnson comes to find him to ask for his help: a plot threatens the President of the United States. Swagger, still a patriot, cannot refuse to save his President and his country. But soon he understands that the officers he is in contact with manipulate him. He's trapped, accused of murder. He's being hunted by mercenaries, trying to thwart the plot he's been subjected to...

programme.title: Inside Man, the man from the inside
programme.desc: Under the appearance of building painters, a group of bold robbers launched a large-scale operation against the prestigious Manhattan Trust Bank, a renowned financial institution. By taking hostage all those present on the spot, the thieves implement a carefully orchestrated plan, forcing the hostages to put on identical combinations to blur the tracks. The brain of the operation, which still seems a step forward, has a particular objective: a safe containing well-kept secrets that could upset the course of events. Outside, the police commissioner, anxious but resolved, deploys an impressive security device to apprehend the thieves, while pressure rises to unravel the situation without the hostages being in danger. As hours pass, a game of the cat and mouse is set up between the police and the robbers, revealing more complex issues than it seems.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Andreas Mitterer, police commissioner in Merano, finds himself deeply saddened after the tragic loss of his wife. As he struggles to overcome his grief and find meaning in his life, he receives unexpected news: a new teammate will join his team. To his surprise, he is a police dog named Rex, renowned for his outstanding detection skills. Despite his initial scepticism, Andreas began to establish a connection with Rex, which turned out to be more than just a pet. Together, they must navigate a series of criminal cases that shake the region, while learning to work in tandem. As Andreas gradually recovers from his grief, Rex becomes a precious ally, helping him rediscover hope and joy in living through their thrilling investigations and their nascent friendship.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In a new working environment, Terzani and Rex, the famous police duo, are assigned to a police station headed by the rigorous Annamaria Fiori. Soon they find themselves immersed in an intriguing investigation that defies conventions. Indeed, a series of mysterious murders sow terror in the city, and the clues point to an unexpected culprit: a dog. While investigators are trying to break the mystery behind these crimes, they must navigate a network of secrets and lies. Each leads to reluctant witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations, while the apparently aggressive behaviour of the animal raises many questions. Terzani and Rex will have to be insightful and intuitive in order to unravel this disturbing affair, proving once again that appearances can be misleading in the world of crime.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Guido Lorenzo (Francesco Arca), a fast-growing entrepreneur, is caught in a whirlwind of tragic events after a night with a luxury prostitute. The next morning, he discovered with horror that the young woman had been found dead in mysterious circumstances. The investigators, led by Rex's unwavering team, are quickly plunged into a complex investigation. The first clues lead them to a top-down sports club, where appearances are often misleading and secrets well guarded. As the investigators interview the club members, they realize that the victim had links with influential personalities, revealing a network of corruption and debauchery. Tensions are rising as Guido, suspected of having deeper links with crime, must prove his innocence while seeking to understand the truths hidden behind this vicious circle. Each revelation brings them a little closer to the heart of the riddle, where loyalty and betrayal are mixed dangerously.

programme.title: Capucine
programme.desc: In this episode full of freshness and humour of the series "Capucine", the main character, Capucine (Barbara Bolotner), stands out for his boldness and frankness. Always equipped with its Airpods, it navigates lightly in the modern world, sharing its sparkling reflections and hilarious anecdotes as it unfolds its telephone conversations. Capucine, with her impertinent mind, finds herself at the heart of crazy situations that highlight the challenges of daily life, while offering a sharp look at human relations. In attempting to juggle her professional aspirations and sometimes chaotic interactions with friends and family, she reveals an authentic and endearing personality. This episode explores the themes of friendship, love and social expectations through the prism of a young woman who refuses to conform to standards, thus bringing a breath of fresh air and a dose of humour to the reality of modern life.

programme.title: Capucine
programme.desc: In a sparkling and staggering universe, Capucine, a young woman full of life and daring, stands out for her flamboyant personality and incisive humour. Armed with her AirPods, she travels the city while sharing her thoughts without a filter with her friends on the phone. Each conversation is an opportunity for her to reveal her thoughts about life, love and the absurdities of everyday life, all with a touch of impertinence that makes her charm. As the episodes progressed, Capucine sailed through nasty and touching situations, where his frankness drew as many friends as enemies. His interactions with colourful characters reveal the challenges of modern life, while highlighting themes such as friendship, self-seeking and acceptance of differences. In this episode, rock-capped situations are intertwined, with a series of unexpected events that test its resilience and creativity.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In Rome, a series of murders targeting Mafia sponsors is spreading terror in the criminal environment. At the scene of the murders, coded messages, typical of the yakuza, are discovered, allowing the involvement of a Japanese organization to be predicted. Inspector Terzani (Francesco Arca) and his faithful companion Rex, an outstanding police dog, are in charge of this delicate investigation. Their investigation leads them to Goro Yamashita, a fearsome gang leader at the head of a secret criminal association, determined to establish a new criminal branch in Rome. As they unravel the sons of this complex affair, Terzani and Rex must navigate a dark world where alliances and betrayals intertwine. Their mission then becomes a real struggle to prevent the establishment of this criminal organisation on Italian soil, while preserving the security of the city and its inhabitants.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In a peaceful library, the assassination of Patrizia Sensini plunges the community into fear. As the investigators arrive at the scene, they discover the grim crime scene where the victim was brutally killed. Behind a door, they find his daughter traumatized, who witnessed the murder. She has crucial information about the killer, but her emotional fragility complicates her testimony. The inspector and his team must navigate through the secrets of Patrizia's life to detect leads. Each clue brings them closer to an unpredictable killer, while fear settles in the city. Investigators discover that Patrizia was involved in a controversial project in the library, causing jealousy and tension. As tensions rise, the truth about the motivations behind this heinous crime begins to emerge, highlighting a network of lies and betrayals within the community.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In Afghanistan, a hostage rescue mission orchestrated by the Italian army turns into a disaster, highlighting the flaws of a faulty camouflage system. As the operation unfolds in a tense atmosphere, soldiers face critical decisions that will have tragic consequences. In this chaotic context, Inspector Terzani (Mauro Addis) takes a moment of respite to run alongside his faithful companion Rex, a trained German shepherd. Their race leads them to a grim discovery: the corpse of an abandoned soldier, whose death raises disturbing questions. While Terzani and Rex are engaged in a thorough investigation, they are digging up buried secrets and disturbing truths about the military operation. As they investigate, they must navigate between loyalty and betrayal, while facing the dangers of a hostile environment that threatens not only their lives, but also those they seek to protect.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In this poignant episode of the series "Rex", Monterosso (Francesco Arca), a tender hearted man, devotes his time to reading for blind people in a local association. His life took an unexpected turn when he crossed the path of Francesca (Alessia Barela), a young visually impaired woman who captured her attention and heart. After a night full of promises, where the complicity between the two characters flourishes, Monterosso proposes to take Francesca home, already dreaming of a future together. However, the next day, he faced a disturbing mystery: Francesca disappeared without leaving any trace. Determined to find her, Monterosso launched a personal investigation, discovering buried secrets and disturbing truths. Through this quest, he will have to navigate between hope and despair, while facing the challenges of love in a world where appearances can be misleading.

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: After Jamie Ross's resignation, who preferred to find a job more compatible with his family life, Abbie Carmichael made her debut at the prosecutor's office. She is a former narcotics officer and is familiar with the mafia and drug dealers that Briscoe and Curtis face daily, even though she sometimes underestimates the threats that the underworld is putting on her loved ones. His conservative ideas, in a manner that is more progressive in Schiff and McCoy's mind, will be tested in a rape case. The introduction of this character allows this 9th season to strongly reflect ideological bipolarity in American society.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: The prey
programme.desc: For weeks, a methodical killer has been spreading terror among the most vulnerable women, prostitutes that society has long relegated to the margins. The bodies accumulate, abandoned as human debris, and fear settles, suffocating, in the alleys where no one dares to lift his eyes. In the face of this growing threat, Commissioner Byron Crawford (Emile Hirsch), a cop hardened by decades of sordid crimes, is on the front line. His experience tells him one thing: this predator does not stop by himself. To track down this elusive monster, Crawford is forced to join forces with two FBI agents with radically different methods. Karl Helter (Bruce Willis), a young analytical and meticulous profile, and Rebecca Lombardi (Megan Fox), an impulsive and intuitive agent, are providing a federal approach to an investigation that goes far beyond local borders. As the clues become scarce and pressure rises, Lombardi, unable to bear the inaction, proposes a risky plan: to pretend to be an easy prey in order to attract the killer out of his den. But what was supposed to be a controlled operation is going to be a horror. The trap is closing... on her. Removed from the eyes of his teammates, Lombardi finds himself immersed in a nightmare that no one knows the rules of. Now every second counts. Helter and Crawford, despite their tensions and disagreements, have no choice but to join forces to find their colleague before she ever disappears into the bowels of a much darker network than they imagined.

programme.title: The Silencing
programme.desc: A former controversial hunter, Rayburn Swanson, whose teenage daughter disappeared five years earlier, now lives in isolation in the forest, the guardian of a natural reserve of animals that he is a staunchly protecting. While he's still looking for their daughter, his ex-wife Debbie, is convinced that the teenage girl is dead. In the neighboring city, Sawbill, Minnesota, Alice Gustafson, who campaigned to become sheriff, had to take care of her younger brother Brooks, who was regularly in trouble. When a teenage girl's body is found in the river, Alice is immediately placed on the case.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: In a world where crime reigns in control, a police officer (Francesco Arca) infiltrates a notorious criminal organization, determined to collect crucial information to dismantle this network. As he is immersed, he gains the confidence of the members, while juggling with the constant danger surrounding him. As he approaches his goal, his identity is compromised and he becomes the target of an ambush orchestrated by two mysterious killers. These murderers, with obscure motives, prove to be dreaded figures in the middle. The policeman, aware that every movement can cost him his life, desperately tries to escape. Tension rises as he navigates between loyalty and betrayal, while seeking to protect his loved ones from the consequences of his investigation. In this game of cat and mouse, the line between good and evil blurs, allowing for an explosive outcome.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Commissioner Marco Terzani and his faithful German shepherd Rex are investigating a series of criminal cases in Rome. Murders, poisoning, sports scandals, mysterious communities and family rivalries put the team to a tough test. Thanks to his unusual instincts, Rex helps reveal the truth behind increasingly complex investigations. A 16 season that gives Francesco Arca his chance in the role of Commissioner Marco Terzani.
programme.desc-more: In a quiet neighbourhood, the life of a senior post office official takes a tragic turn when he is found murdered at home. Inspector Terzani and his faithful companion Rex, a German shepherd with an exceptional flair, are embarking on a complex investigation that plunges them into the vic's privacy. By questioning the man's ex-wife, the investigators discover a woman tormented by separation and bitterness, who could hide unaccustomed secrets. While Terzani and Rex search the evidence left at the crime scene, they meet with colleagues from the victim and family members, each with their own underlying motivations and tensions. The atmosphere is becoming more and more intense as revelations accumulate, and the team must navigate between lies and truths to expose the culprit, while facing unexpected emotional challenges.

programme.desc-more: Antonio Tassinari, nicknamed Excel, is a charismatic man and expert in seduction, recognized for his innovative methods that help shy men overcome their relationship complexes. His life took a tragic turn when he was found stabbed in his apartment, leaving behind a series of questions. Rex, the exceptional detective dog with flair, and his faithful partner Terzani, are embarking on a complex investigation to discover the circumstances of his death. As they investigate, they meet a range of characters, ranging from former Excel students, who have benefited from his courses, to rivals jealous of his success. Each testimony reveals a hidden facet of man, while secrets of his past resurface. Rex and Terzani must unravel the true of the false in a world where seduction can prove fatal, while navigating in the intrigues and passions that surround the life of Excel.

programme.title: Pep's
programme.desc: Whether you teach, study or drop your offspring there every morning, the school leaves no one indifferent.
programme.desc-more: The school, a place of learning and socialization, is at the heart of the lives of many characters. Within this institution, students, teachers and parents navigate through the daily challenges of education. Each has its own aspirations, dreams and concerns, illustrating the diversity of school experiences. Teachers, often confronted with heterogeneous classes, must find creative ways to capture the attention of their students, while juggling administrative requirements. Parents, on the other hand, are fighting for the best possible future for their children, sometimes in disagreement with the school's educational choices. Through these interactions, friendships are formed, rivalries are emerging and life lessons are emerging. This school microcosm highlights the sometimes cruel and joyful realities of education, revealing that the school, whether taught or studied, inevitably shapes life paths.

programme.desc-more: In a school where the ordinary meets the extraordinary, the daily life takes place between laughter and tears. Teachers, like Mr. Moreau (Rayane Bensetti), try to maintain order in a class of schoolboys who are disinclined and dreaming. Outside the classroom, parents, stressed by the demands of education, struggle to give their children the best while facing their own doubts. Students, represented by characters such as Clara (Caroline Anglade) and Hugo (Morgan Bontemps), navigate between tumultuous friendships and first love emodies, while facing the challenges of adolescence. In the corridors and in the canteen, the intrigues are formed and concluded, revealing unexpected alliances and palpable rivalries. Every day at school is a microcosm of the joys and sorrows of life, where each interaction can lead to significant discoveries about oneself and others.

Thanks to his unusual instincts, Rex helps reveal the truth behind increasingly complex investigations. A 16 season that gives Francesco Arca his chance in the role of Commissioner Marco Terzani.
programme.desc-more: In a new working environment, Terzani and Rex, the famous police duo, are assigned to a police station headed by the rigorous Annamaria Fiori. Soon they find themselves immersed in an intriguing investigation that defies conventions. Indeed, a series of mysterious murders sow terror in the city, and the clues point to an unexpected culprit: a dog. While investigators are trying to break the mystery behind these crimes, they must navigate a network of secrets and lies. Each leads to reluctant witnesses and suspects with obscure motivations, while the apparently aggressive behaviour of the animal raises many questions. Terzani and Rex will have to be insightful and intuitive in order to unravel this disturbing affair, proving once again that appearances can be misleading in the world of crime.

programme.title: Rex

programme.desc-more: Guido Lorenzo (Francesco Arca), a fast-growing entrepreneur, is caught in a whirlwind of tragic events after a night with a luxury prostitute. The next morning, he discovered with horror that the young woman had been found dead in mysterious circumstances. The investigators, led by Rex's unwavering team, are quickly plunged into a complex investigation. The first clues lead them to a top-down sports club, where appearances are often misleading and secrets well guarded. As the investigators interview the club members, they realize that the victim had links with influential personalities, revealing a network of corruption and debauchery. Tensions are rising as Guido, suspected of having deeper links with crime, must prove his innocence while seeking to understand the truths hidden behind this vicious circle. Each revelation brings them a little closer to the heart of the riddle, where loyalty and betrayal are mixed dangerously.

programme.desc-more: As he gets ready to go out to seek food for his faithful companion Rex, Inspector Terzani (Francesco Arca) suddenly finds himself kidnapped by a mysterious kidnapper. programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: Stargate, the Stargate
programme.desc: 1928, Egypt. Under the burning sand of Giza, a team of archaeologists exhumes an artifact as mysterious as it is unexpected: a huge metal ring, covered with unknown hieroglyphics, defying any scientific logic. The secretly classified by the authorities, the object dark in the oblivion of military archives, where it waits, silent, for someone to pierce the secrets of it. Sixty-six years later, in 1994, Daniel Jackson (James Spader), a marginalised but brilliant Egyptologist, finally managed to decipher the inscriptions. His discovery is amazing: this ring, which he calls Stargate (the Stargate), is not a mere relic, but a portal that can connect the Earth to other worlds, to the borders of the galaxy. Technology so advanced that it can only be alien. Intrigued by the strategic implications of this revelation, the US Army entrusts Colonel Jack O的Neil (Kurt Russell), a hardened soldier marked by the loss of his son, the mission to explore the other side of the Gate. Accompanied by Daniel and a team of military men on the side, O的Neil crossed the unknown threshold. Their destination? A desert planet, bathed in golden light, where the remains of an ancient civilization are alongside a enslaved population. They quickly discover that this world is under the control of Ra, an entity that is becoming an all-powerful god. Mid-man, mid-machine, Râ reigns by terror, exploiting credulity and fear of his subjects to maintain his absolute grip. As the team tries to understand the mechanisms of the Gate and the secrets of this civilization, the dangers multiply. Between the Ra guards, armed with formidable technologies, and the traps of a hostile environment, every step forward could be the last. Daniel, fascinated by the mysteries of this world, sees in Ra much more than a tyrant: a key to understanding the origin of the Stargate and, perhaps, of humanity itself. But O的Neil, pragmatic and suspicious, knows that they are first and foremost intruders in a game much bigger than they are. As tensions rise and revelations flow, a question persists: how can we confront an enemy who believes that he is invincible, when we still ignore his powers? Between treason, shocking discoveries and struggles for survival, the team will have to show ingenuity and courage to hope to return home. But once the gate is crossed, nothing will be the same as before. For certain truths, once revealed, change the course of history forever.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: In the 1940s, in the midst of the Cold War, the Soviet Union set up an ambitious genetic engineering program led by Professor Viktor Dobronravov. This secret project aims to create superhuman beings by performing bold experiments on human and animal subjects. While the professor is working to develop extraordinary abilities in his subjects, his rival, Dr August Kuratov, is working on the Patriot project, which involves the creation of a universal teleguiding device, Module 1. However, a tragic incident occurs during an experiment, causing an explosion that turns Kuratov into a powerful mutant. With disproportionate powers and a thirst for revenge, he escapes control, threatening the already fragile balance of the country. The authorities, aware of the danger of Kuratov, decided to intervene and to bring together a team of former experimental subjects to arrest him, resulting in an explosive confrontation between the dark creatures and the forces of law and order.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: Guido Lorenzo (Francesco Arca), a fast-growing entrepreneur, is caught in a whirlwind of tragic events after a night with a luxury prostitute. The next morning, he discovered with horror that the young woman had been found dead in mysterious circumstances. The investigators, led by Rex's unwavering team, are quickly plunged into a complex investigation. The first clues lead them to a top-down sports club, where appearances are often misleading and secrets well guarded. As the investigators interview the club members, they realize that the victim had links with influential personalities, revealing a network of corruption and debauchery. Tensions are rising as Guido, suspected of having deeper links with crime, must prove his innocence while seeking to understand the truths hidden behind this vicious circle. Each revelation brings them a little closer to the heart of the riddle, where loyalty and betrayal are mixed dangerously.

programme.title: Rex
programme.desc: As he gets ready to go out to seek food for his faithful companion Rex, Inspector Terzani (Francesco Arca) suddenly finds himself kidnapped by a mysterious kidnapper. Terzani's worrying disappearance soon aroused the concern of Rex, who, faithful to his master, began to search the premises for clues. Noting Terzani's absence and alarmed by the situation, Monterosso (Giovanni Calcagno), a colleague from Terzani, decided to immediately launch the search to find his friend. The investigators quickly discover that the kidnapper, a man named Tarantini, has just served a prison sentence. Tensions are rising as Monterosso and his team try to uncover Tarantini's motivations and identify the places where he might have taken Terzani. In a race against the clock, Rex and Monterosso must unite their forces to save Terzani before it is too late.

programme.title: Capucine

Her ability to transform commonplace situations into hilarious and touching moments makes her an endearing figure. This episode, filled with lively dialogues and relevant reflections, plunges us into its colorful universe where each phone call becomes an opportunity for sharing and discovering. programme.title: Inspector Lewis

programme.title: New York Judicial Police
programme.desc: The personal problems of the protagonists interfere with their work. Van Buren announces his health problems to his team while McCoy presents himself to his own estate. Rubirosa confesses her past relationship with a corrupt magistrate. But in the meantime, the crime doesn't stop in New York. The temptation is therefore great to compromise with principles. Fortunately, Cutter is watching the grain and altercations are not uncommon in McCoy's office. After 20 seasons, "New York Judicial Police" drew his reverence, leaving behind her a rosary of spin-off and adaptations abroad, including "Paris, criminal investigations" with Vincent Pérez.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Manhattan, where skyscrapers hide as many dreams as nightmares, an elite criminal police unit is fighting relentlessly against one of the darkest scourges in society: sexual crimes. Under the inflexible but caring leadership of Captain Don Cragen (Dann Florek), this specialized team combines professional rigour and human commitment, placing victim protection at the centre of every investigation. In a world where violence leaves invisible traces, these police officers must not only track down the perpetrators, but also restore the dignity of those who have been broken. Among them, Inspectors Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) and Elliot Stabler (Christopher Meloni) form an emblematic duo, united by unwavering determination and empathy that pushes them to invest far beyond the files. Benson, whose personal past has created a strong sensitivity to the suffering of victims, especially women and children, embodies a calm force in the face of horror. Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

Stabler, a passionate family member, brings combative energy, sometimes at the limit of obsession, to bring justice to the fore. Together, they navigate through the meandering of the most icy cases, where every detail counts and where each testimony can cause an investigation to tip over. Over time, the unit evolves with the arrival of new members. Each case confronts them with a heartbreaking reality: broken lives, silences that are complicit, and systems that too often fail to protect the most vulnerable. Between the interview rooms where tight parts are played, the streets of New York where every shadow can conceal a danger, and the personal lives of these policemen – marked by the emotional repercussions of their profession – the series explores without fail the complexities of justice and redemption. Here, victories are measured as much as the convictions obtained as the lives saved, and each episode reminds that behind the statistics are destinies hidden. In this constant struggle, one question persists: how far are these men and women ready to go so that light prevails over darkness?

programme.title: Killing Field
programme.desc: David, a respected police officer, and his partner Cal, are on a mission to dismantle a network of drug dealers. In an intervention, their plan went wrong when Jean and Violet, a couple of desperate drug addicts, opened fire, seriously wounding David. Cal, determined to save his partner, is pursuing the fugitives who have fled to an isolated farm. This shelter belongs to Eric, a former veteran of the army haunted by his demons. Despite his own internal struggles, Eric agrees to help Cal, aware that the situation is desperate. However, tension rises when the head of the cartel, accompanied by his men, bursts into the farm, taking David as a hostage. Between loyalty, sacrifice and the shadow of the violence that is hovering, Cal and Eric will have to join forces to try to get out of this deadly battlefield and save David before it is too late.

programme.title: Inside Man, the man from the inside
programme.desc: Under the appearance of building painters, a group of bold robbers launched a large-scale operation against the prestigious Manhattan Trust Bank, a renowned financial institution. By taking hostage all those present on the spot, the thieves implement a carefully orchestrated plan, forcing the hostages to put on identical combinations to blur the tracks. The brain of the operation, which still seems a step forward, has a particular objective: a safe containing well-kept secrets that could upset the course of events. Outside, the police commissioner, anxious but resolved, deploys an impressive security device to apprehend the thieves, while pressure rises to unravel the situation without the hostages being in danger. As hours pass, a game of the cat and mouse is set up between the police and the robbers, revealing more complex issues than it seems.

programme.title: Thomas Crown
programme.desc: Thomas Crown (Pierce Brosnan) perfectly embodies the elusive man: charismatic billionaire, an amateur of enlightened art and unrepentant seducer, he cultivates a flawless reputation in the world of finance. But behind this facade is a remarkable burglar, as meticulous as it is audacious. When a masterpiece by Claude Monet, estimated at $100 million, disappears from the walls of a prestigious museum, suspicions naturally turn to him... No tangible evidence. To unravel the sons of this riddle, the proxy insurer, a brilliant and determined expert: Catherine Banning (Rene Russo). A specialist in art fraud, she excels in the art of unmasking criminals by playing with their own rules. But Crown is not an opponent like the others. Between them, a duel as intellectual as it is sensual, is installed, where every look, every word, becomes a weapon. The boundaries between hunter and prey are blurring, and the investigation is turning into a perilous game where seduction disputes with manipulation.

programme.title: Succession
programme.desc: Nick Pulovski is a policeman in Los Angeles, a specialist in car traffic. During a shooting, his partner was shot dead by Strom, a malfrat they were about to stop. He must then adapt to his new partner, David Ackerman, a son of good family, who seeks to exorcise the death of his brother for whom he feels responsible. The current has trouble passing between the two men, which everything opposes.

programme.title: Inspector Lewis
programme.desc: Back in Oxford after a two-year training on Virgin Island, Inspector Lewis, assisted by Sergeant Hathaway, investigated the death of a student. The victim, Regan, was shot dead. The murder weapon belongs to Daniel Griffon, a friend of the girl's. The young man was very unstable and convinced that his father, John Griffin, who had disappeared in a car accident, had been murdered.

programme.sub-title: Capucine and its mission of life
programme.desc: In a vibrant world of colours and humour, Capucine (Barbara Bolotner) stands out for her sparkling personality and frankness. Equipped with her Airpods, she travels her daily life with contagious audacity, sharing her thoughts on human relations and the challenges of modern life through hilarious and staggering calls. Each episode sees her interact with a gallery of colourful characters, revealing her observation skills and her keen sense of irony. Capucine addresses a variety of themes, ranging from love to friendship, while offering a unique and touching female perspective on the world around him. Between moments of tenderness and bursts of laughter, she does not hesitate to question social norms and defy conventions, while remaining faithful to herself. Through his adventures, Capucine invites us to reflect on our own life path and the importance of being authentic.

programme.title: Castle
programme.desc: Captain Montgomery died, and Beckett, shot and wounded, underwent a major operation. She's safe and sound, but a priori amnesia because she doesn't remember Castle telling her she's a flame. Her health is improving from day to day and she eventually returns to the service, without immediately feeling able to return to the field. With Castle, she is still retracing her mother's killer, Castle's great dam, who is worried about her. In the fourth season, Lanie and Esposito split up, as did Alexis and his boyfriend, Ashley, while Ryan married his fiancée, Jenny. And Alexis, who grew up, is about to enter college, and is more interested in his father's work with the police.
programme.desc-more: Richard Castle (Nathan Fillion) is a successful writer specializing in thrillers. His life takes an unexpected turn when a serial killer starts to imitate the murders described in his novels, attracting the attention of New York police. It was then that Detective Katherine Beckett (Stana Katic) questioned him in the course of the investigation, intrigued by the troubling coincidences between fiction and reality. After helping to solve this first case, Castle cannot resist the temptation to pursue the adventure. Desiring to get more involved, he used his friendship with the mayor of New York to become a consultant to the NYPD. This opportunity not only allows him to be at the heart of the action, but also to draw on his new experiences to write a series of novels featuring a dynamic heroine, Nikki Hard, inspired by Katherine Beckett's determination. As Castle navigates this new environment, he finds himself confronted with real murders, complex mysteries and a dynamic working with Beckett that oscillates between tension and complicity. Each episode blends with exciting police investigations and Castle's particular humour, while exploring the stakes of his literary heritage and human relations. Through his interactions with criminals, colleagues and loved ones, Castle discovers that reality can sometimes be more strange than fiction, while seeking to understand the motivations of those who commit the unthinkable.

programme.title: Stargate, the Stargate
programme.desc: 1928, Egypt. Under the burning sand of Giza, a team of archaeologists exhumes an artifact as mysterious as it is unexpected: a huge metal ring, covered with unknown hieroglyphics, defying any scientific logic. The secretly classified by the authorities, the object dark in the oblivion of military archives, where it waits, silent, for someone to pierce the secrets of it. Sixty-six years later, in 1994, Daniel Jackson (James Spader), a marginalised but brilliant Egyptologist, finally managed to decipher the inscriptions. His discovery is amazing: this ring, which he calls Stargate (the Stargate), is not a mere relic, but a portal that can connect the Earth to other worlds, to the borders of the galaxy. Technology so advanced that it can only be alien. Intrigued by the strategic implications of this revelation, the US Army entrusts Colonel Jack O的Neil (Kurt Russell), a hardened soldier marked by the loss of his son, the mission to explore the other side of the Gate. Accompanied by Daniel and a team of military men on the side, O的Neil crossed the unknown threshold. Their destination? A desert planet, bathed in golden light, where the remains of an ancient civilization are alongside a enslaved population. They quickly discover that this world is under the control of Ra, an entity that is becoming an all-powerful god. Mid-man, mid-machine, Râ reigns by terror, exploiting credulity and fear of his subjects to maintain his absolute grip. As the team tries to understand the mechanisms of the Gate and the secrets of this civilization, the dangers multiply. Between the Ra guards, armed with formidable technologies, and the traps of a hostile environment, every step forward could be the last. Daniel, fascinated by the mysteries of this world, sees in Ra much more than a tyrant: a key to understanding the origin of the Stargate and, perhaps, of humanity itself. But O的Neil, pragmatic and suspicious, knows that they are first and foremost intruders in a game much bigger than they are. As tensions rise and revelations flow, a question persists: how can we confront an enemy who believes that he is invincible, when we still ignore his powers? Between treason, shocking discoveries and struggles for survival, the team will have to show ingenuity and courage to hope to return home. But once the gate is crossed, nothing will be the same as before. For certain truths, once revealed, change the course of history forever.

programme.title: Daylight
programme.desc: In the oppressive darkness of a tunnel connecting Manhattan to New Jersey, an unexpected catastrophe is emerging. A truck carrying toxic waste explodes, causing a devastating detonation that blocks both tunnel entrances. As chaos and the relief teams are facing a stalemate, hope seems to be getting smaller. Kit Latura (Sylvester Stallone), a former head of the New York Samu, is then faced with a moral and professional dilemma. Witness of the tragedy, he feels the call of duty and decides to brave the dangers in order to try to save the victims trapped inside. In a hostile environment where smoke and panic reign, Latura must navigate through the rubble and failing ventilation systems, while facing its own inner demons. As the minutes pass, the stakes become increasingly critical. Kit Latura faces unforeseen obstacles, both physical and psychological, as he strives to carry out a rescue mission that could change the fate of many innocent people. Tensions are rising, and every second counts in this fierce struggle against the clock and the elements.

programme.title: Mercury Code
programme.desc: In the ruthless world of secret services, where every mistake can cost a career – or a life –, Art Jeffries (Bruce Willis), a senior FBI agent, has had better days. After a failure during a delicate operation, he was relegated to minor missions, far from the important business. But when a case as mysterious as it is urgent lands on his desk, Jeffries understands that it may be his last chance to make up for it. His new mission: to protect Simon, a young autistic boy whose parents have just been murdered in troubled circumstances. What seems at first glance a simple case of witness protection quickly takes a much darker turn. Simon, despite his handicap which the outer world cup, has an exceptional cognitive capacity. Without knowing it, he decrypted an ultra-secret code, information so sensitive that it now attracts the worst predators. Unscrupulous killers, willing to do anything to eliminate the child and anyone who dares to get in their way. Jeffries then found himself plunged into a race against time, hunted by invisible but omnipresent enemies, whose resources and determination seemed boundless. To complicate things, Simon, overwhelmed by a hostile environment and stimuli that he cannot control, struggle to communicate, making Jeffries' task all the more arduous.

programme.title: We have to save Private Ryan.
programme.desc: On June 6, 1944, Captain Miller and his men arrived on a beach in Normandy now called Omaha Beach. Just out of the hell of the landing, Miller was given a very dangerous mission: to drive his squad behind enemy lines to find and bring back healthy and except a soldier named Ryan, whose three brothers were killed in battle within a few days.

programme.title: Thirteen lives
programme.desc: On June 23, 2018, in Chiang Rai Province, Thailand, a team of young footballers, nicknamed the "Wild Boars", is embarking on an adventure that will quickly turn into a nightmare. After a training session, they decided to go to the cave in Tham Luang to explore its mysterious tunnels. However, their excursion takes a tragic turn when torrential rains flood the cave, trapping them inside. Parents, concerned about the prolonged absence of their children, go out looking for them and find out with horror that the entrance to the cave is submerged. In the face of this desperate situation, an unprecedented mobilization is being organized, bringing together local and international rescuers, equipped with diving equipment. As time is running out, every minute counts to save these young people and their coach, immerse rescue teams in a challenge as dangerous as it is moving. The determination, solidarity and courage will be tested in this race against time.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: After a devastating shooting, Detective Jane Rizzoli's team (Angie Harmon) is in a race against the clock to capture the criminal Alice Sands before she can wipe out Jane's life. As the investigation intensified, Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), the sharp-cut forensic doctor, suffered a head injury that forced her to undergo medical examinations. Faced with this alarming situation, Maura now faces cognitive problems that hinder her ability to analyze, a new challenge for this woman who is usually so competent. Tension is rising within the team as they have to juggle Alice's imminent threat with Maura's fragility. The seventh and final season of "Rizzoli & Isles" promises a thrilling moment and captivating twist, while providing a memorable outcome for deeply endearing characters.
programme.desc-more: Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), a well-dipped detective, is called to the rescue when the wife of a former teammate entrusts her with a desperate affair: her daughter has just been abducted in a car. The investigation is beginning on a complex family drama, where the girl's younger brother, witness to the abduction, provides crucial details to the investigators. He evokes a woman driving and a man sitting in the back, adding a layer of mystery to this already tragic affair. In parallel, Jane's team, including her friend and forensic doctor Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), is exploring the tense relationship between the victim's parents to avoid personal involvement. As hours pass, anxiety rises, and anxiety turns into horror when a girl's body is found in a nearby forest, rushing investigators into a race against the clock to unmasking the kidnapper.

programme.desc-more: In the peaceful and seemingly idyllic Wisteria Lane Street, located in the chic suburbs of Fairview, four housewives find themselves at the heart of a whirlwind of unexpected events. Susan Meyer (Teri Hatcher), a single mother with a tender heart, aspires to true love while juggling the challenges of motherhood. Lynette Scavo (Felicity Huffman), a former dynamic advertising environment, sacrificed her career to raise her children, but has to face the tumult of a chaotic family life. Bree Van de Kamp (Marcia Cross), a perfectionist and methodical, strives to maintain a control facade, while Gabrielle Solis (Eva Longoria), a capricious and seductive model, struggles with the demands of his flamboyant lifestyle. Over the seasons, the facade of their perfect life begins to crack, revealing buried secrets and unsuspecting drama. programme.title: Agent Rogue
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the IRA's terrorist threat placed a heavy burden on Britain, forcing MI5 to recruit freelance agents to monitor suspicious activities. At the heart of this turmoil, Robert Freegard (James Norton), a charismatic bartender, managed to pretend to be a secret agent, exploiting the naivety of innocent people to manipulate his entourage as he pleases. In 2002, Freegard, now a car salesman, in London, drew the attention of Alice Archer (Gemma Arterton), a promising business lawyer. Fascinated by her confidence and mystery, Alice quickly fell under her charm. However, what she doesn't know is that Freegard, playing a double game, weaves a web of lies that could destroy not only her career, but also her life. As Alice begins to penetrate the secrets of this enigmatic man, she finds herself trained in a world of manipulation and danger, where trust is a luxury that few can afford.

programme.title: The negotiator
programme.desc: A psychologist with the criminal police, Cameron Grainger does not forgive the death of a young hostage-taker, Erik Sanders, shot dead by the police while he was travelling. She had left her post. But she must return to service when criminals who have taken her sister away demand that she be their only contact.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: Jane and Maura are trying to elucidate two murders, which have deep personal connections to Korsak. Jane is receiving a most unexpected visit.
programme.desc-more: After a devastating shooting, Detective Jane Rizzoli's team (Angie Harmon) is in a race against the clock to capture the criminal Alice Sands before she can wipe out Jane's life. As the investigation intensified, Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), the sharp-cut forensic doctor, suffered a head injury that forced her to undergo medical examinations. Faced with this alarming situation, Maura now faces cognitive problems that hinder her ability to analyze, a new challenge for this woman who is usually so competent. Tension is rising within the team as they have to juggle Alice's imminent threat with Maura's fragility. The seventh and final season of "Rizzoli & Isles" promises a thrilling moment and captivating twist, while providing a memorable outcome for deeply endearing characters.

programme.title: Sphere5
programme.desc: What if we take the time to think rather than react? Ophelia Meunier and Carole Jérôme-Llewellyn have imagined and created this program together. Each conversation is prepared to be tailored, in order to create a profound and sincere exchange.

programme.title: At the heart of the crime

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: César Wagner investigates a murder in the Théâtre National de Strasbourg, where he finds a youthful love who has become director of the institution.
programme.desc-more: While he was performing at the Théâtre National in Strasbourg, a young apprentice actor, 20-year-old Samir, fell dead on the stage of the theatre. Caesar Wagner and his team are on the scene to clarify the circumstances of the death. The captain found a former high school acquaintance there: Anne Cornell was her first flirtation, now director of the institution. Léa, for her part, also falls on an old acquaintance, now an ambulanceman. This unexpected reappearance upsets her. As for the ongoing investigation, the first conclusions suggest poisoning.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: Marie-Ange Wagner, Mayor of Strasbourg and mother of Caesar, married Christian Haas. As the party is full in a castle, a corpse is found in a cold room.
programme.desc-more: César Wagner (Gil Alma), inspector in Strasbourg, finds himself in a real puzzle when he arrives late at the marriage of his mother, Marie-Ange, the mayor of the city. The ceremony, which takes place in a sumptuous castle, takes a tragic turn when a corpse is discovered in a cold room, plunging the festivities into chaos. The situation is complicated when Caesar and his team have to navigate a network of lies and secrets, as the main suspects are all linked to the organizing company of the event. Victoire Haas, the daughter of the groom Christian Haas (Florent Peyre), turns out to be the director of the company, adding a layer of tension and personal dilemmas to the investigation. In a context of loyalty and betrayal, Caesar must act with discretion to expose the culprit, while preserving the integrity of his family and the honour of his mother.

programme.title: Cassander
programme.desc: The director of a shelter was brutally murdered. Respected and hated at the same time, she had made many enemies.

programme.title: Cassander
programme.desc: The body of a young high school student in boarding school is found in a cemetery. The victim, unlike his comrades, came from a privileged environment.
programme.desc-more: With Helena Noguerra, Amaury de Crayencour. During an earthquake, the cemetery guard discovers the body of a 17-year-old high school girl, Angèle. programme.title: Cassander
programme.desc: On a beach around Lake Annecy, a walker sees the wreck of a burnt sailboat in the distance. A girl's body is found inside.
programme.desc-more: In Lake Annecy, a young girl was found dead in the wreck of a burnt sailboat. Gasoline poured over the bridge suggests that the fire was criminal. According to testimony, a man was on board too. The victim was called Cassiopeia, she was 17. The investigation conducted by Cassandre questions: what was a minor doing in the middle of the night on a sailboat? Does the young man still run? The Commissioner investigates in a very specific context: very soon the Annecy City Cup will be held, a regatta that attracts many tourists.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: Jane and Paul Wescourt fell from the top of a bridge. They're still undetected. Research continues. Maura and Jane's family are worried.
programme.desc-more: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), known for her frankness and determination, is working with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a medical examiner with a mysterious past and rigorous analytical methods. Despite their differences in style and personality, these two women form an unlikely but complementary duo, joining forces to resolve complex criminal cases. Jane, with her intuitive approach and sharpened instinct, often has to temper Maura's scientific analyses and sometimes too academic conclusions. Together, they navigate a world where violence and mystery mix, facing twisted suspects and disconcerting puzzles. As the surveys progress, their relationship evolves, revealing not only the challenges of their profession, but also the facets of their personal lives. Between thrilling intrigues and moments of camaraderie, Rizzoli and Isles demonstrate that friendship can arise from the most unexpected situations.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: In the Vosges forest, the authorities find the lifeless body of a journalist and animal activist, as well as the corpse of a lynx.
programme.desc-more: In the Vosges forest, the gendarmerie finds Juliette Plessy, a famous photographer and animal activist, without life. In charge of the investigation, César Wagner, police captain at the SRPJ in Strasbourg, and his team suspect the community of hunters of the murder of the young woman recently engaged in the defence of the lynx in the region. This tragic event exacerbates a virulent conflict between hunters and environmental activists, in a region where the presence of nature reserves is a real political issue.

programme.title: Caesar Wagner
programme.desc: In Strasbourg, a finger is discovered in one of the bottles intended for tasting for the contest of the best beer of a very popular festival.
programme.desc-more: A student discovers a human finger inside a bottle of Wagner beer. The latter was made by a brewery owned by Ingrid and Sybille, two cousins of Captain César Wagner. Quickly, the case ignites the regional press. In order to avoid conflict of interest, Caesar entrusts the investigation to his assistant Lea, while accompanying him on the ground. Élise Beaumont, the medical examiner, informs Caesar that a certain Daniel Lehmann came to the hospital for a cut ear. The latter was found dead at his home.

programme.title: At the heart of the crime

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: Jane and Maura learn that different parts of a body have been found: a difficult investigation begins. Angela's still looking for a job.
programme.desc-more: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), known for her frankness and determination, is working with Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), a medical examiner with a mysterious past and rigorous analytical methods. Despite their differences in style and personality, these two women form an unlikely but complementary duo, joining forces to resolve complex criminal cases. Jane, with her intuitive approach and sharpened instinct, often has to temper Maura's scientific analyses and sometimes too academic conclusions. Together, they navigate a world where violence and mystery mix, facing twisted suspects and disconcerting puzzles. As the surveys progress, their relationship evolves, revealing not only the challenges of their profession, but also the facets of their personal lives. Between thrilling intrigues and moments of camaraderie, Rizzoli and Isles demonstrate that friendship can arise from the most unexpected situations.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: While Jane is investigating a woman found dead in a dumpster, Frankie, for her part, finds herself involved in a shooting.
programme.desc-more: In Boston, Inspector Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon) and Forensic Doctor Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander) are an atypical but fearlessly effective duo in resolving complex criminal cases. While Jane, with a determined and sometimes impulsive temperament, is immerse herself in the violent world of crime, Maura, with a sharp intellect and scientific sensitivity, brings an analytical and methodical approach to each investigation. Together, they navigate through a series of mysterious murders, exploiting their respective skills to dislodge criminals who haunt the streets of the city. The series highlights their friendship, their personality differences and how they learn from each other, while confronting professional and personal challenges. Over the seasons, they find themselves facing increasingly formidable opponents, but their unwavering complicity and determination to do justice remain at the heart of their mission.

programme.title: Rizzoli & Isles
programme.desc: After a devastating shooting, Detective Jane Rizzoli's team (Angie Harmon) is in a race against the clock to capture the criminal Alice Sands before she can wipe out Jane's life. As the investigation intensified, Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), the sharp-cut forensic doctor, suffered a head injury that forced her to undergo medical examinations. Faced with this alarming situation, Maura now faces cognitive problems that hinder her ability to analyze, a new challenge for this woman who is usually so competent. Tension is rising within the team as they have to juggle Alice's imminent threat with Maura's fragility. The seventh and final season of "Rizzoli & Isles" promises a thrilling moment and captivating twist, while providing a memorable outcome for deeply endearing characters.
programme.desc-more: Jane Rizzoli (Angie Harmon), a well-dipped detective, is called to the rescue when the wife of a former teammate entrusts her with a desperate affair: her daughter has just been abducted in a car. The investigation is beginning on a complex family drama, where the girl's younger brother, witness to the abduction, provides crucial details to the investigators. He evokes a woman driving and a man sitting in the back, adding a layer of mystery to this already tragic affair. In parallel, Jane's team, including her friend and forensic doctor Maura Isles (Sasha Alexander), is exploring the tense relationship between the victim's parents to avoid personal involvement. As hours pass, anxiety rises, and anxiety turns into horror when a girl's body is found in a nearby forest, rushing investigators into a race against the clock to unmasking the kidnapper.

programme.title: The dress of my life

programme.desc-more: In the peaceful and seemingly idyllic Wisteria Lane Street, located in the chic suburbs of Fairview, four housewives find themselves at the heart of a whirlwind of unexpected events. Susan Meyer (Teri Hatcher), a single mother with a tender heart, aspires to true love while juggling the challenges of motherhood. Lynette Scavo (Felicity Huffman), a former dynamic advertising environment, sacrificed her career to raise her children, but has to face the tumult of a chaotic family life. Bree Van de Kamp (Marcia Cross), a perfectionist and methodical, strives to maintain a control facade, while Gabrielle Solis (Eva Longoria), a capricious and seductive model, struggles with the demands of his flamboyant lifestyle. Over the seasons, the facade of their perfect life begins to crack, revealing buried secrets and unsuspecting drama. This poignant and captivating drama explores the themes of friendship, betrayal and self-search, while plunging the viewer into a universe where everyday life often hides much darker realities. programme.title: Agent Rogue
programme.desc: In the 1990s, the IRA's terrorist threat placed a heavy burden on Britain, forcing MI5 to recruit freelance agents to monitor suspicious activities. At the heart of this turmoil, Robert Freegard (James Norton), a charismatic bartender, managed to pretend to be a secret agent, exploiting the naivety of innocent people to manipulate his entourage as he pleases. In 2002, Freegard, now a car salesman, in London, drew the attention of Alice Archer (Gemma Arterton), a promising business lawyer. Fascinated by her confidence and mystery, Alice quickly fell under her charm. However, what she doesn't know is that Freegard, playing a double game, weaves a web of lies that could destroy not only her career, but also her life. As Alice begins to penetrate the secrets of this enigmatic man, she finds herself trained in a world of manipulation and danger, where trust is a luxury that few can afford.

programme.title: Bulls on the screen

programme.desc-more: The Franco-Belgian band-designed film is experiencing a new golden age in cinema. This documentary reveals the behind-the-scenes adaptations of their large screen, between fidelity to original works, technological innovations and reinvention. A dive into the heart of a phenomenon that redefines popular cinema.

programme.desc: The rapid development of artificial intelligence is profoundly changing the manufacturing processes of the film industry, which is changing into a new era.
programme.desc-more: Cinema has always told stories of artificial intelligence, whether they are machines capable of thinking like humans or societies entirely controlled by algorithms. But today, these fictions become reality and deeply disrupt the entire industry. Through the testimonies of directors, actors and technicians, a industry is emerging that is torn between fascination and concern in the face of tools capable of writing, generating images or recreating faces. For the first time, cinema is no longer content to tell AI: it suffers directly from the effects, until it envisages films without filming or actors.

programme.title: Columbo
programme.desc: Ken Franklin and James Ferris form a duo of successful writers. While James is in charge of writing, Ken is promoting their works. But when James chose to end their common adventure and go on a run alone, Ken decided to assassinate him. He organizes his crime in such a way that it is his victim's own wife, Joanna, who provides him with an alibi. His testimony suggests James was shot dead in his office. Columbo is perplexed: at the crime scene, the corpse is missing.
programme.desc-more: Columbo is a police series that follows Lieutenant Frank Columbo's investigations, performed by Peter Falk. Recognising its worn raincoat and its casual look, Columbo embodies an archetype of detective who hides a sharp mind under a modest appearance. Each episode opens up to the crime itself, often a carefully orchestrated murder, allowing the viewer to know the identity of the victim and the perpetrator from the outset. This unconventional narrative choice highlights the intellectual challenge that awaits Columbo: to expose the culprit despite his prior knowledge. The series is distinguished by its methodical approach to criminal investigation. Columbo does not rely on spectacular investigative techniques or dramatic confrontations. On the contrary, he adopts a patient and insidious interrogation method, focusing on the anodized details that often escape the suspects. Through his apparently innocent exchanges, he manages to create an atmosphere of tension that causes criminals to make mistakes. This subtle way of sitting down his authority makes each episode a character study and a demonstration of intelligence. The episodes also feature a variety of characters, often performed by renowned actors such as Patrick McGoohan, Shera Danese and Bruce Kirby.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: A woman was found drowned in a washing machine from her dry cleaner, while a dormitory was improvised on the spot and the door was locked.
programme.desc-more: Tess Besançon, a brilliant student, died in an escape game organized by her business school. She was hit in the heart by a paper cutter. Tess was a daughter of a rich wine dealer and was in the run to take a year of study to Harvard, a prestigious American university. Fred questions the promotion comrades of the deceased. Alice, for her part, discovers that Tess was hiding many things. His studio, located on campus, was devastated.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: Prosecutor Solanas took two shots in the street, he's between life and death. His son, Ada's boyfriend, seems to be responsible. Why?
programme.desc-more: After taking two bullets in the street, prosecutor Eric Solanas finds himself between life and death. His son Amaury, who is the boyfriend of Ada, seems to think he was responsible for the drama. His father's assault may well be linked to the flourishing traffic of photos in the boy's high school. Alice, meanwhile, is looking for more information on Mathieu's run.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: In a hospital under pressure, the emergency physician, Nathan Gallois (Marine Delterme), was brutally murdered with a stroke of surgical scissors in the chest, plunged the establishment into a spiral of chaos. His service, already weakened by a lack of resources, is the scene of heightened internal rivalries, where tensions between medical personnel reach their peak. As the investigation into this shocking murder begins, secrets and hidden grudges begin to emerge, revealing a toxic work environment where everyone seems to have a motive. At the same time, Judge Marquand (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) finds himself facing a personal dilemma: he refuses to let Petit Paul (Gary Mihaileanu) see his father alone, ignoring the disturbing messages sent by Mathieu. This mixture of judicial drama and family tensions weaves a complex web where justice and truth are tested, and where each character will have to confront his own demons.
programme.desc-more: In a world where justice and truth intertwine, "The judge is a woman" plunges viewers into the heart of a poignant and complex investigation. At the centre of this intrigue, Judge Anne Vignaud (Marine Delterme) teamed up with Commander Marquand (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) to clarify the mystery surrounding the tragic death of Loïc Lardenois, whose body was discovered in a forest, the skull shattered and a weapon in hand. As the investigation progresses, Loïc's couple, Nadège (Medina Diarra), is immersed in a whirlwind of emotions. She still has not overcome the loss of their child, who died at birth, and accuses Dr. Lemaréchal (Guillaume Carcaud) of medical misconduct. This charge becomes a central element of the investigation, questioning the competence of the gynecologist and revealing latent tensions within the medical community. Investigators quickly discover that a break-in took place in the doctor's office on the night of the crime, adding a layer of mystery to this already complex case. As the pieces of the puzzle begin to assemble, pressure rises and unexpected revelations may well upset the fragile balance between justice and revenge. In this game of power and manipulation, the quest for truth is sown with tangles, where each character hides secrets and obscure motivations.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In the picturesque region of Burgundy, the harmony of landscapes is disturbed by shocking murder. Morgane (Cristiana Reali), a talented chef specializing in molecular cooking, is found dead in the forges of Buffon, his body showing signs of extreme violence with nitrogen-damaged lungs. Investigators Mylène Deville (Marie Vincent) and Frédéric Tessier (Franck Sémonin) are embarking on a complex investigation to uncover the mystery of this murder. Alain Malaval (Joseph Malerba), Morgane's companion, a former policeman converted to a cook, quickly became a suspect in Frédéric's eyes, who sought to understand the motives behind this heinous crime. As the evidence accumulates, a new twist occurs with the discovery of a second body in the locks: that of Commissioner Deville, who has been gone for years. The investigation takes an unexpected turn, linking past and present in a quest for truth.
programme.desc-more: Murders to... is a captivating police series that plunges viewers into the enigmatic universe of criminal investigations in the heart of French regions. Each episode takes us to a distinct place, rich in history and local legends, where the past resurfaces in a often tragic and bloody way. In every investigation, horrific crimes seem to resonate with historical events, legends or myths rooted in the collective memory of the inhabitants. The series examines how these ancient narratives can influence the present, while buried secrets resurface, leading the protagonists into a real nightmare. The series follows a group of determined investigators, ready to elucidate these dark mysteries. Their expertise, accompanied by an analytical and human approach, prompts them to interview not only suspects, but also witnesses and residents, always in search of hidden truths. In addition to their investigative skills, they must navigate through tense interpersonal dynamics and the emotional impact of crimes on the community. Investigators also face moral dilemmas, wondering how far they are prepared to go to unearth the truth.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In Rocamadour, a place full of spirituality and mystery, a man's body is discovered on the steps of the Penitent's Way, a historical pilgrimage route. The circumstances surrounding his death were disturbing: he was allegedly forced to climb the 216 steps on his knees, a practice of atonement dating back to the Middle Ages. A few days before his retirement, Commander Sophie Lacaze (Clémentine Célarié) was entrusted with this delicate investigation. She is assisted by her successor, Alexandre Delcroix (Grégori Derangère), a young investigator full of promises. Together, they plunge into the secrets of the city and quickly discover that the situation is even more complex: the daughter of the deceased, an eight-year-old girl, was abducted. As they try to solve this macabre mystery, Lacaze and Delcroix must navigate between reluctant witnesses and unexpected revelations, while fighting against the pressure of time to save the girl.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In the historic city of La Rochelle, a mysterious murder shakes local tranquillity: a businessman is found hanged in the Saint-Nicolas tower, with the letter "A" written in blood letters on his forehead. Their already tense relationship becomes complicated as Justine discovers buried secrets about her father's life. As they plunge deeper into the affair, they must navigate through a network of lies and unsaid, confronting not only the mystery of murder, but also the demons of their own family past.

programme.title: Balthazar
programme.desc: Always wanted after four months of cavalry, suspected of a series of murders, Raphaël Balthazar rallied Marrakech in the greatest secret. Far from the Parisian tumult and the police who still believe him guilty, he tastes a well-mastered serenity. But new murders in Paris will force him out of his hiding place: nicknamed the puppeteer, the serial killer imagines various stages for each of his victims... The former colleagues of Balthazar at the Forensic Institute were laid off.
programme.desc-more: Raphaël Balthazar (Tomer Sisley) is a forensic physician with an undeniable charisma and a lively mind. A epician in his soul, he sails between his meticulous work as a forensic expert and his passion for life, which is not without surprise to Commander Bach (Hélène de Fougerolles). The latter, pragmatic and strict in terms of procedures, has difficulty in passing the eccentricities of Balthazar. Beyond his charm and humour, Balthazar has a long history: the murder of his wife, whose daily memory he continues to evoke, haunting him in his daily life. As he gets involved in complex criminal cases, he is regularly immersed in investigations that combine science and emotions. By digging up the truths hidden behind each body, Raphael confronts his own demons and the pain of his loss.
