programme.desc: During an electrifying concert, Jay DeMarcus (bassist of the band Rascal Flatts) collapsed on stage, victim of an electrocution which seems to be, at first glance, a tragic accident. However, Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger), a member of the forensics team, is not convinced by this hypothesis. She initiates a thorough investigation to detect the truth hidden behind this incident, suspecting that a malicious act could be the cause of the musician's death. At the same time, Raymond Langston (Laurence Fishburne) is confronted with a different mystery when he discovers the lifeless body of a man who was caught in a lake. After thorough investigations, he identifies the corpse as that of Vance Colton, a former CIA operations director whose secrets could have much wider ramifications than expected. Both investigations intertwine, revealing a network of lies and betrayals that could upset their lives.

programme.title: Columbo
programme.desc: Lieutenant Columbo (Peter Falk), an iconic Los Angeles police investigator, is recognized for his staggered style and unique approach to criminal investigations. He is dressed in his worn raincoat and behind the wheel of his old Peugeot 403, and follows the crime scenes with an apparent nonchalance that conceals a fearsome acuity of mind. Each episode begins with the discovery of a sordid murder, often orchestrated by a guilty person convinced of his impunity. Columbo, with his distracted air and apparently anodized questions, managed to destabilize his interlocutors, causing them to reveal inconsistencies in their alibi. His perseverance and sense of logic prompt him to dig deeper, even when the evidence seems insufficient. As he proceeds to his investigations, he demonstrates that intuition and careful observation are his best allies in solving complex puzzles, trapping criminals in their own lies and helping to do justice.
programme.desc-more: Columbo is a police series that follows Lieutenant Frank Columbo's investigations, performed by Peter Falk. Recognising its worn raincoat and its casual look, Columbo embodies an archetype of detective who hides a sharp mind under a modest appearance. Each episode opens up to the crime itself, often a carefully orchestrated murder, allowing the viewer to know the identity of the victim and the perpetrator from the outset. This unconventional narrative choice highlights the intellectual challenge that awaits Columbo: to expose the culprit despite his prior knowledge. The series is distinguished by its methodical approach to criminal investigation. Columbo does not rely on spectacular investigative techniques or dramatic confrontations. On the contrary, he adopts a patient and insidious interrogation method, focusing on the anodized details that often escape the suspects. Through his apparently innocent exchanges, he manages to create an atmosphere of tension that causes criminals to make mistakes. This subtle way of sitting down his authority makes each episode a character study and a demonstration of intelligence. The episodes also feature a variety of characters, often performed by renowned actors such as Patrick McGoohan, Shera Danese and Bruce Kirby.

programme.title: The judge is a woman
programme.desc: Nathan Gallois, 39, took a stroke of surgical scissors in the chest. Who could blame this zealous emergency worker, indispensable to his hospital?
programme.desc-more: In a hospital under pressure, the emergency physician, Nathan Gallois (Marine Delterme), was brutally murdered with a stroke of surgical scissors in the chest, plunged the establishment into a spiral of chaos. His service, already weakened by a lack of resources, is the scene of heightened internal rivalries, where tensions between medical personnel reach their peak. As the investigation into this shocking murder begins, secrets and hidden grudges begin to emerge, revealing a toxic work environment where everyone seems to have a motive. At the same time, Judge Marquand (Jean-Michel Tinivelli) finds himself facing a personal dilemma: he refuses to let Petit Paul (Gary Mihaileanu) see his father alone, ignoring the disturbing messages sent by Mathieu. This mixture of judicial drama and family tensions weaves a complex web where justice and truth are tested, and where each character will have to confront his own demons.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: New York journalist found dead in a Las Vegas driveway. Langston knew her well, so he was out of the investigation.
programme.desc-more: In a dark alley, a woman's body is discovered, strangled, leaving the police in a state of disarray. The investigation is quickly led by Dr. Langston (Laurence Fishburne), who identifies the victim as a renowned journalist, known for his audacity and integrity. What makes this case even more disturbing is that the journalist had already investigated a similar case a few years earlier, involving mysterious Dr. Jekyll, a criminal who is elusive and whose crimes remain unresolved. By searching his bag, the team discovers disturbing photographs of all the victims of this insidious killer. The situation is taking an unexpected turn when the journalist's husband, a publisher with a temperament, accuses Langston of murder, endangering the investigation and the relationship of trust within the team. As tensions rise, Langston must navigate between revelations and accusations to untie this complex affair.

programme.title: Experts
programme.desc: A woman was attacked by a tiger shark in the pool at a Las Vegas casino. Experts are trying to figure out how the squale got there.
programme.desc-more: In the effervescence of Las Vegas casinos, a tragedy arises when a woman's body is discovered, a victim of a shark attack in the pool of a prestigious establishment. As investigators, including Al Robbins (Eric Szmanda) and Raymond Langston (Laurence Fishburne), analyse the scene, they discover a disturbing detail: the victim had already died before the squale attack. This complex revelation prompts them to dig deeper into the underlying rivalries of the casino world. Catherine Willows (Marg Helgenberger), determined to elucidate this mystery, discovers that the casino owner is in open conflict with his neighbour, a rivalry that may well have deadly implications. Meanwhile, Wendy (Wallace Langham) announced to Hodges (George Eads) that she was planning to leave the team, adding a layer of personal tension to the already complex plot. Experts must navigate between betrayals, rivalries and secrets to reveal the truth behind this enigmatic murder.

programme.title: Experts : Miami
programme.desc: The experts are retraceing a serious lead, which would explain why a census officer was found in a car.
programme.desc-more: While Jesse (Jonathan Togo) and Walter (Eddie Cibrian) are playing basketball on a Miami field, their moment of relaxation is abruptly interrupted by a patrol car that is rushing at full speed in pursuit of a mysterious black vehicle. programme.title: Experts : Miami
programme.desc: A chase in a crowded neighborhood ends up arresting the number one suspect in a homicide case in which Eric Delko is involved.
programme.desc-more: In the sunny and glamorous Miami setting, a rich heiress is found stabbed in her sumptuous villa on Star Island, diving the city into an atmosphere of mystery and tension. Investigators Ryan Wolfe (Adam Rodriguez) and Calleigh Duquesne (Emily Procter) quickly set off on the murderer's trail, travelling through neighbouring pavilions looking for clues. As they apprehend a suspect, an unexpected reversal occurs: a lawyer, visibly well informed, intervenes to defend the individual handcuffed. What is more shocking to the investigators is the revelation that one of the collaborators of this lawyer is Eric Delko (David Caruso), their former colleague. As tensions rise and buried secrets resurface, the team must navigate through a complex network of relationships and betrayals to discover the truth behind this shocking murder, questioning their loyalty and alliances.

programme.title: Experts : Miami
programme.desc: While the team found the trail of Delko, the victim of a terrible road accident in the Everglades, Horatio remembered the beginnings of his unit.
programme.desc-more: After a perilous mission to the Everglades marshes, the Miami criminal unit team is facing a critical situation: Agent Eric Delko (Eddie Cibrian) is found injured and in a critical condition, plunged into a coma in the hospital. While his teammates were worried about his life, Horatio Caine (David Caruso) was overwhelmed by memories of a late era, remembering their first encounter in 1997. Delko was a member of an elite unit, The Special Investigations Unit, which was already notable for its investigation of strange and mysterious murders. programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: In the Bois de Chanteloube, the body of a professor of oncology is found in the Mare au Diable. There are ritual signs that a sacrifice is being made.
programme.desc-more: In this new season of "Mouttres à...", the picturesque landscapes of France become the scene of captivating criminal mysteries, where every investigation is intimately linked to the cultural heritage and local traditions. The protagonists, Fauve Hautot and Aurelien Wiik, find themselves immersed in the heart of sordid business that reveal the buried secrets of their region. Every murder is anchored in a legend or a building full of history, thus revealing the dark facets of French heritage. The spectators follow these experienced investigators as they navigate between folklore and criminal investigation, digging up sometimes disturbing truths. The appearances of iconic figures such as Line Renaud, Samuel Labarthe, Francis Huster and Olivier Marchal add dramatic depth to the intrigues, enriching the story of their talent and charisma. This season promises a fascinating exploration of local mysteries, between dramatic tensions and unexpected revelations.

programme.title: Murders to...
programme.desc: A police captain is obliged to work under his daughter's orders, with whom he is not getting along, to resolve a delicate investigation.
programme.desc-more: In the historic city of La Rochelle, a mysterious murder shakes local tranquillity: a businessman is found hanged in the Saint-Nicolas tower, with the letter "A" written in blood letters on his forehead. This macabre crime evokes a tragic event that occurred in the seventeenth century when Catholic monks were massacred by Protestants, suggesting a connection between past and present. The investigation was entrusted to Captain Raphaël Weiss (Philippe Caroit), a seasoned investigator, who was under the command of his own daughter, Justine Weiss (Dounia Coesens). Their already tense relationship becomes complicated as Justine discovers buried secrets about her father's life. As they plunge deeper into the affair, they must navigate through a network of lies and unsaid, confronting not only the mystery of murder, but also the demons of their own family past.

programme.title: Columbo
programme.desc: "Requiem for a star"An actress on the decline, murderous of her husband, tries to silence her former secretary, engaged to a scandalous press reporter.
programme.desc-more: Lieutenant Columbo (Peter Falk), an iconic Los Angeles police investigator, is recognized for his staggered style and unique approach to criminal investigations. He is dressed in his worn raincoat and behind the wheel of his old Peugeot 403, and follows the crime scenes with an apparent nonchalance that conceals a fearsome acuity of mind. Each episode begins with the discovery of a sordid murder, often orchestrated by a guilty person convinced of his impunity. Columbo, with his distracted air and apparently anodized questions, managed to destabilize his interlocutors, causing them to reveal inconsistencies in their alibi. His perseverance and sense of logic prompt him to dig deeper, even when the evidence seems insufficient. As he proceeds to his investigations, he demonstrates that intuition and careful observation are his best allies in solving complex puzzles, trapping criminals in their own lies and helping to do justice.

programme.title: Columbo
programme.desc: A talented lawyer, Leslie Williams murders her husband. She thinks she's been able to do the perfect crime by imagining a hellish plan, designed to make the police believe that her husband was abducted. Columbo, who is in charge of the investigation, is surprised by the cold blood of this woman. To hand over the ransom to the pseudo-converters, she has to throw a bag full of tickets from her personal plane. Now, the daughter of the missing person returns from Switzerland. In addition, the bag containing the money is found at the place of its landing.
programme.desc-more: Columbo is a police series that follows Lieutenant Frank Columbo's investigations, performed by Peter Falk. Recognising its worn raincoat and its casual look, Columbo embodies an archetype of detective who hides a sharp mind under a modest appearance. Each episode opens up to the crime itself, often a carefully orchestrated murder, allowing the viewer to know the identity of the victim and the perpetrator from the outset. This unconventional narrative choice highlights the intellectual challenge that awaits Columbo: to expose the culprit despite his prior knowledge. The series is distinguished by its methodical approach to criminal investigation. Columbo does not rely on spectacular investigative techniques or dramatic confrontations. On the contrary, he adopts a patient and insidious interrogation method, focusing on the anodized details that often escape the suspects. Through his apparently innocent exchanges, he manages to create an atmosphere of tension that causes criminals to make mistakes. This subtle way of sitting down his authority makes each episode a character study and a demonstration of intelligence. The episodes also feature a variety of characters, often performed by renowned actors such as Patrick McGoohan, Shera Danese and Bruce Kirby.

programme.desc: They are passionate about researchers, yet they can go unnoticed. In Japan since ancient times, mosses are celebrated as half-gods and evoke contemplation, just like constellations in Europe! In France, these complex plant organisms could be an alternative to glyphosate: researchers are studying how to make it a natural herbicide. This documentary raises the veil on the stunning resistance and development capabilities of foams, and the possible secrets they have to reveal to us about climate disruption, space exploration... even immortality.

programme.title: Hydrogen: a false good idea?
programme.desc: In a world that is plagued by the climate crisis and unprecedented energy instability, this investigation addresses a central question: how to decarbonize societies in a fast and sustainable manner? At the heart of this reflection, hydrogen, the most abundant element of the universe, appears to be a promising solution. But behind the discourse of miracle energy, lies the technological, economic and geopolitical limits of a sector that is still far from being truly green. Between grey, green or "natural" hydrogen, the documentary raises the veil on the paradoxes of an energy presented as clean but still largely dependent on the fossil.

programme.title: Planet Killers
programme.desc: Investigation of the caids of the powerful tiger cartel that extends from Thailand to Vietnam and China, through Laos, and which by its traffic endangers this species.

This episode investigates the caids of the powerful tiger cartel that extends from Thailand to Vietnam and China, through Laos.

programme.title: Lightning, a lightning of genius
programme.desc: Long perceived as a destructive scourge, lightning proves to be an architectural force, indispensable to the balance of the Earth and to the very existence of the living.
programme.desc-more: For a long time, man has stood away from lightning, fearing its fulgurating power and extreme temperature. Today, thanks to state-of-the-art observation instruments, science finally penetrates the storm clouds and lifts the veil on one of the most spectacular natural phenomena. From its birth to the heart of the cumulonimbus to its springing into the sky, lightning reveals a complex mechanics, fed by ice crystals, cosmic particles and so-called "precursors" lightnings that are still invisible only a short time ago. But lightning isn't just hitting. It plays an unknown role, essential to the balance of the Earth. It would purify the atmosphere, enrich the soil and even be the original spark of life on earth.

programme.desc: Along with some scientists, Nicolas Hulot plunges into the jungle that covers the western part of New Guinea, the Irian Jaya. In these regions still live some people who have remained away from the modern world. Asmat, Korowais or Unas, these tribes live as they did thousands of years ago.
programme.desc-more: Nicolas Hulot and his adventure companions travel to the western part of New Guinea's island, the Irian Jaya. Starting from the marshy coast, bordered by mangroves, they sink north in the direction of the last equatorial glacier on the island. In the middle of the river, they are joined by representatives of the Asmat people, a Papuan ethnic group, still anthropophagus recently. Then they meet the Korowais, a population that lives in the trees, then the Unas, one of the last tribes on the planet that preserves an ancestral way of life. In the Sorong forest, Kris Tindigue lists the populations of marsupials and other casoars, threatened by intense logging.

programme.title: Lightning, a lightning of genius
programme.desc: Long perceived as a destructive scourge, lightning proves to be an architectural force, indispensable to the balance of the Earth and to the very existence of the living.
programme.desc-more: For a long time, man has stood away from lightning, fearing its fulgurating power and extreme temperature. Today, thanks to state-of-the-art observation instruments, science finally penetrates the storm clouds and lifts the veil on one of the most spectacular natural phenomena. From its birth to the heart of the cumulonimbus to its springing into the sky, lightning reveals a complex mechanics, fed by ice crystals, cosmic particles and so-called "precursors" lightnings that are still invisible only a short time ago. But lightning isn't just hitting. It plays an unknown role, essential to the balance of the Earth. It would purify the atmosphere, enrich the soil and even be the original spark of life on earth.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: "Muddy flows"Muddy flows, following the weather in some areas, are among the most formidable natural phenomena.
programme.desc-more: Over the past decade, over 50,000 people have been killed by land movements. Among them, mud flows are the most formidable. Under the influence of water, millions of cubic metres of land can detach and degrade the slope of a mountain at nearly 100 km/h, taking everything over its passage. This is what happened in Oso, USA, for example, in 2014. A disaster that killed 43 people. On all continents, mud flows can suddenly strike. To avoid the worst, scientists around the world are trying to understand the mechanisms of these devastating phenomena, in order to prevent them and protect themselves from them.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: "Tsunamis"To understand the origin of these monstrous waves and anticipate their power, this episode explains how scientists study their training process.
programme.desc-more: Life sources and oxygen for humans, the oceans cover 70% of the Earth's surface. But these calm waters sometimes create monsters: tsunamis. Leading scientific experts explain the tsunami formation process, such as the one that devastated the coasts of several Asian countries in December 2004. This ocean wave is caused by a land-based shock such as an earthquake, volcanic eruption or slippage, creating impressive waves.

programme.title: The missing post office
programme.desc: In the inland Sea of Seto, the former abandoned post office in Awashima was transformed into a sanctuary for undistributed letters, sent to the missing, the dead or to no one in particular. At 91, postmaster Katsuhisa Nakata continues to take care of these memory fragments with special attention. A silent film meditation on the passing time, the absence of loved ones and the considerable emotional weight of words that may never be read by their recipients.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: "Destinations and sandstorms"The deserts are spreading and desertification is now threatening 40% of the land. If scientists understand the formation of dunes, they remain powerless in the face of this progression. Inaction would cause the annual loss of millions of hectares of fertile land. This phenomenon is accompanied by more frequent and global giant sandstorms, raising questions about their origin.

programme.title: The science of the forces of nature
programme.desc: "Avalanches"From the Alps to the Himalayas avalanches are increasingly striking as a result of global warming. But how do these phenomena trigger?
programme.desc-more: With global warming, avalanches are growing all around the globe. These phenomena are linked to the composition of snow, which appears to be one of the most important factors in the departure of an avalanche. Many scientists analyse the functioning of these natural disasters in order to understand, predict and limit their impact. They can identify the most at risk territories and implement means to protect and protect the population.

programme.desc: Nicolas Hulot visited the islands of the South Pacific. After a flight over Robinson Crusoe Island, he joined Philippe Danton for the ascent of the highest summit of the island and the exploration of Morro el Verduguo, a large isolated rock covered with lush vegetation. Nicolas Hulot also filmed humpback whales with Laurent Ballesta and Eric Leborgne. On Easter Island, the most isolated on the planet, a large number of questions remain outstanding. Civilization was a flourishing time there, from the eighth to the seventeenth century. In the flash of torches, Edmundo Edwards and Michel Garcia are still looking for answers in lava caves and unexplored sites. Nicolas and Laurent Ballesta dived to discover the wreck of Dresden, a German cruiser scuttled by his commander in March 1915.

programme.desc: The West Coast of Canada, in British Columbia, is a wild archipelago, made up of countless islands of all sizes. Here, the temperate rainforest extends between the Coast Mountains (Coast Mountains) and the ocean. Originally, this forest covered 6.5 million hectares. The large rainforest in western Canada, which is bathed in shade and moisture, is the sanctuary of the ghost bear. Legend has it that anyone who crosses his path is visited all his life in his dreams by this strange black animal that has become white. Living, the forest is a natural plant to make oxygen. It is one of the most essential ecosystems for human beings.

programme.title: Grand-Popo
programme.desc: Grand-Popo, Benin, is threatened by coastal erosion and flooding. Its inhabitants struggle against the destruction of their city by major tourist projects.
programme.desc-more: Grand-Popo, a historic city in Benin between the ocean and the Mono River, is threatened by erosion and flooding. To curb its disappearance, the government, with the support of the World Bank, built dikes, artificial dunes and coconut plantations. This work, which was decided without any agreement, means the destruction of part of the city in favour of tourist complexes. Taken between the strength of nature and these great projects, the people of Grand Popo fight against oblivion and dispossession.

In the Seven Islands Nature Reserve, scientists study these precious guardians of marine balance to learn how to live together with the living world.

programme.desc: The discovery, on March 11, 1944, of many corpses ready to be incinerated in the cellar of a Parisian mansion marks the beginning of one of the most famous, and the most horrific, criminal affairs of the 1940s. Dr. Marcel Petiot is convicted of the murder of more than 20 people.
programme.desc-more: On March 11, 1944, in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, pestilential smells from the fireplace of a private hotel intriguing. In the cellar, the firefighters discover the unimaginable: human corpses defiled and ready to be incinerated in a boiler as well as a pit of living lime mixed with pieces of body. On the spot, a man, Dr. Marcel Petiot, claims that the corpses are those of collabos and gestaps eliminated by the Resistance. The police let him go. Two years later, on 4 April 1946, the doctor was sentenced to death by the Seine d'Assizes court for 24 murders. He was guillotined on May 25, 1946. Back on the path of the one whom he nicknamed "Dr. Satan".

programme.title: Paris, the mystery of the missing palace
programme.desc: Thanks to science and unheard of excavations, experts reconstruct the Palais de la Cité, the first residence of the kings of France, at its peak in the 14th century.
programme.desc-more: The first residence of the kings of France, the Palais de la Cité, stood in the Middle Ages on the most prestigious island of Paris, the historic cradle of France, facing Notre-Dame. Over the centuries, this masterpiece of architecture has almost completely disappeared. For the first time, a trio of experts will resurrect him, in 3D. Thanks to science and unreleased excavations, Yves Ubelmann, architect, Marjorie Coulin, photographer and drone pilot, and Bastien Varoutsikos, archaeologist, will track down the pieces of the puzzle to reconstruct it at its peak in the 14th century, and bring life to those who have populated it.

programme.desc: In June 2020, an archaeological discovery came to question the certainties of the specialists on the origins of the great Mayan civilization.

programme.title: Erotized violence in art: Proserpine and others

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: On 29 September 1902, Emile Zola, a man of letters of genius, then at the top of his glory, was found dead. Although the death occurred under strange circumstances, it is considered accidental. Yet, 26 years after the writer disappeared, on board a suburban train, a man confesses to his interlocutor that he murdered Zola. Is his confession credible?
programme.desc-more: On 29 September 1902, the writer died, a victim of carbon monoxide poisoning. The author of "Germinal", "Nana" and "L-Assommoir" is at the top of his glory. Three years earlier, the sexanenaire took sides for Captain Dreyfus in his famous plea "J-accuse", and made many enemies. Twenty-six years after that tragic night, a rower gives a friend a terrible secret. Historians and Zola's great-granddaughter shed light on the circumstances of this suspicious death.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: Since the ninth century, Venice has marked history. It ruled the Mediterranean for centuries, fascinated generations of travelers and sheltered famous artists. Historians and specialists trace more than a thousand years of history through 3D reconstructions and the presentation of unpublished documents.
programme.desc-more: Venice, exerts an eternal fascination on the whole world. Internationally famous for its unique architecture and its bubbling artistic life of all time, it has also extended its commercial domination and its desire to conquer centuries-old thanks, among others, to Marco Polo. Far from gondolas and other tourist photographs, historians and specialists invite us to discover the history of the city of Doges. Using documents and 3D reconstructions they lift some of the mysteries of the lagoon.

programme.title: "Vasa", the ghost gallion
programme.desc: On August 10, 1628, only 18 minutes after its inauguration, Swedish warship Vasa sank into Stockholm port. Why did this great ship sink?
programme.desc-more: In the cold waters of Stockholm Bay, the last remains of the Vasa were buried, a majestic galion having been wrecked in 1628. He belonged to the fleet of King Gustav II Adolph, who saw him as the representative of a new generation of warships. From Sweden to Germany, through Denmark and Brittany, an international team of scientists (historians, archaeologists, forensic doctors, experts in international trade...) study the wreck, rising from the waves in 1961, in an attempt to reconstruct the living conditions of 17th century Europe.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: The famous Neuschwanstein Castle, commissioned by Louis II of Bavaria in 1869, hides under its look of fairy tale of 19th century technologies.
programme.desc-more: Perched in the Alps, Neuschwanstein Castle looks like a fairy tale. Featuring central heating and telephones, this palace is a 19th century marvel.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: Petra, Jordan, is considered the eighth wonder of the world. 500,000 tourists come to marvel at its monumental buildings each year.
programme.desc-more: Located in Jordan, Petra is considered the eighth wonder of the world, visited by several hundred thousand tourists each year who come to marvel at its monumental buildings. Using new technologies, researchers manage to reconstruct the remains of the city as it was 2,000 years ago, during its splendor. They thus better understand the incredible genius of the Nabateans, who turned a desert into an opulent, influential and fat city, having even developed the first anti-seismic constructions of the time.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: The Louvre is tested with the latest technologies: from technical drones to 3D laser surveys, scientists will look at the monument.
programme.desc-more: In the centre of Paris stands the Louvre, the world's largest art and antique museum, visited by more than 10 million people each year. The opportunity to discover in an original way some of its 403 exhibition rooms and some of its most famous pieces such as The Mona Lisa, The Squatting Scribe, The Victory of Samothrace or the Venus of Milo.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: The Acropolis of Athens, symbol of ancient Greece, was erected in less than fifteen years. The secrets of this immense architectural feat are presented here.
programme.desc-more: The ultimate symbol of ancient Greek civilization, the Acropolis of Athens was erected in less than fifteen years under the direction of Pericles. This colossal yard required twenty thousand tons of marble, transported from distant quarries thanks to very ingenious lifting systems. More than just a temple, the Parthenon embodies a true demonstration of power and innovation.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: By searching the Great Wall of China, the experts decipher the work of the former builders, in an attempt to break the secrets of its construction.
programme.desc-more: Crossing the country from east to west, the Great Wall of China is one of the most incredible sites in the world, the result of the work of many successive Chinese generations over more than 2,000 years. While several million tourists travel through it each year, few know the hidden face. To understand how this incredible architectural ensemble was designed and to explore its construction secrets, experts use science and technology, analyzing it on different scales, from infinitely large to infinitely small.

programme.title: Monumental revelations
programme.desc: In Asia, Cambodia, is the largest religious building ever built by man: the temple of Angkor Vat, the largest of the 112 Khmer temples.
programme.desc-more: In Cambodia, there is the largest religious building ever built by man: the temple of Angkor Vat. The largest of the 112 Khmer temples lost in 400 km2 of jungle, with an area of 160 hectares. As monumental as it is mysterious, the one who is considered the eighth wonder of the world fascinates the general public as well as scientists. Rediscovered in the 19th century after 500 years of forgetting, the city of Angkor has long intrigued specialists. Today, thanks to the new technologies, this mystery is about to be lifted.

programme.title: Jihad on Europe
programme.desc: In 2014, Daesh, who had emerged from a break with Al-Qaida, emerged from Syrian chaos and its leader Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi proclaimed a "califat" joined by 6,000 Europeans.
programme.desc-more: In three parts, this documentary series looks back at the genesis of European jihadism, from London to Copenhagen, Paris, Madrid and Brussels. In the 1980s, Afghanistan was at war with the Soviet occupation. In Pakistan, Abdallah Azzam, a future mentor of Osama bin Laden, recruited foreign fighters as early as 1984. At the beginning of the 1990s, while the Cold War ended, the West would face a new situation, which would be acclaimed in the attacks of 11 September 2001. In Bosnia, England, Denmark or Belgium, a new balance is being struck.

Back on the path of the one whom he nicknamed "Dr. Satan".

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: What if Molière wasn't the author of his plays?
programme.desc: In collective memory, Molière is considered one of the most brilliant theatre writers. In 1919, however, Pierre Louÿs, poet and scholar, caused a real scandal by claiming that Molière's greatest plays were written by Corneille. Following this, many historians and researchers fed this thesis. In 1658 Jean-Baptiste Poquelin, alias Molière, passed through Rouen, where he lived a few metres from the great Cornelius. With the withdrawal of six years from the theatre world, Corneille would have made a pact with Molière: writing comedy of daring morals that his troupe, protected by the King, could stage. In the early 2000s, computer software analyzed the texts of the two lettermen: the results showed similarities.

programme.desc-more: This new magazine offers to illuminate the shaded areas and to dispel the doubts of the greatest chapters in history. The United States, which was struck at the heart of its defensive system, entered the war against the Japanese Empire the next day.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: What if Molière wasn't the author of his plays?
programme.desc: In collective memory, Molière is considered one of the most brilliant theatre writers. In 1919, however, Pierre Louÿs, poet and scholar, caused a real scandal by claiming that Molière's greatest plays were written by Corneille. Following this, many historians and researchers fed this thesis. In 1658 Jean-Baptiste Poquelin, alias Molière, passed through Rouen, where he lived a few metres from the great Cornelius. With the withdrawal of six years from the theatre world, Corneille would have made a pact with Molière: writing comedy of daring morals that his troupe, protected by the King, could stage. In the early 2000s, computer software analyzed the texts of the two lettermen: the results showed similarities.
programme.desc-more: Jean-Baptiste Poquelin, dit Molière, is one of the greatest French theatre writers. Yet in 1919, poet Pierre Louÿs caused a scandal by claiming that Corneille would have written the majority of his plays! In the early 2000s, computer software confirmed the poet's intuitions. By questioning 17th-century historians and actors, the host tries to shed light on this literary riddle.

programme.sub-title: The Poisons Case: The Secrets of Louis XIV
programme.desc: Historian Franck Ferrand evokes the shadows of certain chapters of history and tries to shed light on these unexpected aspects. At the end of the show, he moderated a debate with Clementine Portier-Kaltenbach. In this section, he is interested in the poison affair, one of the most mysterious criminal cases of all time, during the reign of Louis XIV. The king, afraid of the magnitude of these events, decided to stifle the matter. In 1709, old and ill, Louis XIV ordered a valet to burn compromising documents, involving great names of the court of France, such as Colbert, Louvois, but also Madame de Montespan. For decades, researchers have been constantly trying to find out what these documents are.
programme.desc-more: This new magazine offers to illuminate the shaded areas and to dispel the doubts of the greatest chapters in history. On 13 July 1709, the Sun King, bitter and ill, decided to smother forever a case that was in his reign, a series of poisoning crimes that occurred between 1679 and 1682, and in which hundreds of people were mixed, including the greatest names of the court. So he throws in the fire overwhelming documents, locked in a sealed safe for thirty years? Lively debate, from the National Archives, by Franck Ferrand with Clementine Portier-Kaltenbach, surrounded by guests.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: The secret record of the Dreyfus case
programme.desc: In October 1894, in a context of international tensions, a state affair broke out, which would divide France. Captain Alfred Dreyfus is sentenced by a military court to degradation and deportation for providing secret documents to the Germans. When voices are raised to denounce the injustice suffered by the French officer and doubt begins to arise about the probity of Dreyfus' accusers, the scandal breaks out. It turns out that the case accusing Dreyfus is indeed a montage, organized by senior officials of the French state and army. The study of the documents in this secret dossier allows us to trace the course of one of the most resounding political affairs in the history of France.
programme.desc-more: In 1894, a state affair was the headline of all the daily newspapers: French captain Alfred Dreyfus would deliver military secrets to a German attaché in Paris, Major Schwartzkoppen. The officer claims his innocence. For the first time, the secret file that had been wrongly convicted of spying could have been filmed. The investigation reveals the unsuspected scale of the plot against this senior, a Jewish Alsatian family. The greatest historians, lawyer and former Minister of Justice Robert Badinter, and Dreyfus' grandson, are returning to one of the most resounding cases in history.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: On 29 September 1902, Emile Zola, a man of letters of genius, was found dead at the height of his glory. Although the death occurred under strange circumstances, it is considered accidental. Yet, 26 years after the writer disappeared, on board a suburban train, Henri Buronfosse, a professional ramoner, confesses to Pierre Hacquin, his interlocutor, that he murdered Zola by deliberately blocking the pipe of his fireplace. Pierre Hacquin will wait 25 years before breaking the silence and confiding in Jean Bedel, a young journalist. The latter decides to investigate and discover documents that allow to cross-check Buronfosse's strange confessions.
programme.desc-more: On 29 September 1902, the writer died, a victim of carbon monoxide poisoning. The author of "Germinal", "Nana" and "L-Assommoir" is at the top of his glory. Three years earlier, the sexanenaire took sides for Captain Dreyfus in his famous plea "J-accuse", and made many enemies. Twenty-six years after that tragic night, a rower gives a friend a terrible secret. Historians and Zola's great-granddaughter shed light on the circumstances of this suspicious death.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: Lili Marleen, Nazi hymn or freedom song?
programme.desc: With his columnists, Franck Ferrand returns to the fate of the song "Lili Marleen". Today, if we keep the version of Marlene Dietrich, sung after World War II, its history dates back a few years earlier. It was used and banned by Nazi propaganda and was eventually adopted by the Wehrmacht military and then by the Allied soldiers. The story of this song dates back to April 1915 when, in the Russian trenches, the German poet and musician wrote an ode to his two beloved ones, Lili and Marleen. In the late 1930s, Lale Andersen, a cabaret singer, adapted this song, which would wait until the war to meet her audience.
programme.desc-more: Lili Marleen was composed in 1915 by Hans Leip, German poet and musician, for his beloved Lili and Marleen. This melancholic song, which was performed in 1938 by Lale Andersen, was taken over by Marlene Dietrich at the Liberation. In turn, used and forbidden by Nazi propaganda, adopted by the soldiers of the Wehrmacht and then by the allied soldiers, this rivet adapted in about fifty languages, became the first planetary tube. Debate moderated by Franck Ferrand with Clémentine Portier-Kaltenbach, Christophe Bourseiller, Stéphanie Coudourier and historian Jean-Pierre Guéno.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt

We are looking for who worked with the Germans, especially among the public figures whose journey is being examined during the occupation.
programme.desc-more: From 14 June 1940, Paris was occupied by the Germans. For some French artists, this defeat is an opportunity to take surprising routes. Franck Ferrand is taking the veil on the secrets of the sacred monsters of the Parisian scene. He is interested in Arletty's choices, Maurice Chevalier and Edith Piaf's travels to Germany, and Josephine Baker's journey. He also goes back to Jean Gabin's epic, now the Moncorgé soldier, and the spying activities for Gabrielle Chanel's German secret services.

programme.title: Paris, the mystery of the missing palace
programme.desc: Thanks to science and unheard of excavations, experts reconstruct the Palais de la Cité, the first residence of the kings of France, at its peak in the 14th century.
programme.desc-more: The first residence of the kings of France, the Palais de la Cité, stood in the Middle Ages on the most prestigious island of Paris, the historic cradle of France, facing Notre-Dame. Over the centuries, this masterpiece of architecture has almost completely disappeared. For the first time, a trio of experts will resurrect him, in 3D. Thanks to science and unreleased excavations, Yves Ubelmann, architect, Marjorie Coulin, photographer and drone pilot, and Bastien Varoutsikos, archaeologist, will track down the pieces of the puzzle to reconstruct it at its peak in the 14th century, and bring life to those who have populated it.

programme.title: When history makes dates
programme.sub-title: 14 May 1610, the assassination of Henri IV
programme.desc: "14 May 1610, the assassination of Henry IV"The assassination of Henri IV marked a decisive césure of political modernity: the murderous gesture of Ravaillac precipitated the sacralization of the royal state.
programme.desc-more: The founding of Rome in 753 B.C., the Socrates trial in 399 B.C., the donation of Constantine in 315, the Battle of Talas in 751, the death of Saint Louis on 25 Aug. 1270, the capture of Constantinople in 1453, the assassination of Henry IV on 14 May 1610, the declaration of American independence on 4 July 1776, the spring of the peoples in 1848, the bag of the Beijing Summer Palace in 1860: historian Patrick Boucheron makes history accessible and alive by decrypting several key dates.

programme.title: North Korea, the nuclear dynasty
programme.desc: Kim Jong-un, the last representative of a dynasty that has ruled North Korea for 70 years, wants to make his country the world's leading nuclear power.
programme.desc-more: The Korean People's Army celebrated its 75th anniversary in early February, and Kim Jong-un is determined to make his country the world's leading nuclear power. Balancing any possibility of disarmament from the back of the hand, the despotic leader strengthens his arsenal – with his "monster missile", the Hwasong-17. Never has the North Korean threat been so strong. Why is this obsession with nuclear power? How serious is it? Is Kim Jong-un as unpredictable as they say, and why is he trying to provoke the entire planet?

programme.title: Pearl Harbor, the world is burning
programme.desc: A review of the attack on Pearl Harbor on December 7, 1941, an operation that was a major turning point in the history of World War II.
programme.desc-more: In the late 1930s, Japan intended to expand its empire to all Asia to re-establish its economy. Its objective is to break the Western powers out of the Asian continent and seize their colonies. To calm Japan's expansionary ardour, the United States imposed an embargo on Japan. In response, on 7 December 1941, Japan launched a surprise attack on the main American fleet anchored at Pearl Harbor base in Hawaii. The United States, which was struck at the heart of its defensive system, entered the war against the Japanese Empire the next day.

programme.title: Archive mysteries
programme.desc: "1936. President Roosevelt goes back on the campaign"In 1936, Democratic Franklin Delano Roosevelt, who tried to re-establish the United States from the 1929 crisis, set out again for a second term.
programme.desc-more: In 1936, the Democrat Franklin Delano Roosevelt, who had tried to repel the United States of America from the 1929 crisis, returned to campaign for a second term. By train and car, he will travel for six months about thirty states. The tour is all the more difficult to organize because the president is paraplegic. Are reporters free to film and photograph him while he is travelling? If re-elected, will Roosevelt continue its policy of favouring the poorest?

As the sole master, Knut married Emma of Normandy to establish her power.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.sub-title: Nostradamus: The Truth About His Prophecies
programme.desc: What if Nostradamus was more historian than prophet? This is what many interpreters of his texts are saying today. Nostradamus is the greatest oracle of all time, and it is the greatest of all time. In his collection of Prophecies, he would have predicted the most important events in history, such as the French revolution, Napoleon's and Hitler's takeovers. What is the true meaning of his texts?
programme.desc-more: Michel de Nostre-Dame, said Nostradamus, was considered in his time as a great oracle. This French astrologer and doctor, born in Saint-Rémy-de-Provence in 1503, would have predicted the most important events in our history, from the French Revolution to the rise to power of Napoleon and Hitler. But his enigmatic verses lend themselves to countless interpretations. Historians who are specialists in these mysterious quatrains are taking stock of their latest progress.

programme.title: The shadow of doubt
programme.desc: Founded in the fifth century, Venice enters history when it emancipates itself from Byzantine guardianship in the ninth century, taking as patron saint Mark and raising a basilica to his glory. Over the centuries, the city extended its domination over the Mediterranean, becoming a great commercial power. A man embodies this spirit of conquest and enterprise: Marco Polo. The Republic fell in 1797, when Venice was taken by Napoleon. This does not tarnish the fascination of this exceptional city, whose historians and specialists evoke history with documents such as Marco Polo's will, Casanova's manuscript of memoirs, or Verdi's original score of "La Traviata".
programme.desc-more: Venice, exerts an eternal fascination on the whole world. Internationally famous for its unique architecture and its bubbling artistic life of all time, it has also extended its commercial domination and its desire to conquer centuries-old thanks, among others, to Marco Polo. Far from gondolas and other tourist photographs, historians and specialists invite us to discover the history of the city of Doges. Using documents and 3D reconstructions they lift some of the mysteries of the lagoon.

programme.title: The Mayan Mystery: From Origins to Fall
programme.desc: "The abandoned Mayan cities" Around 900 occurs a strange phenomenon: the abandonment of the Mayan cities. Invasions, climate disasters, wars? The issue is still pending.
programme.desc-more: Tikal and Calakmul are gigantic cities built by Mayan civilization at their peak, between 250 and 900 AD. The population of the Mayan population is also impressive for this period, with nearly eight million people. However, around 900 is a surprising phenomenon: the abandonment of the Mayan cities. Historians are wondering about the reasons for this decline. A team of experts is going to use new technologies to try to go back in time and try to understand what has pushed the Mayans to abandon their cities, temples, pyramids and palaces.

programme.title: The Mayan Mystery: From Origins to Fall
programme.sub-title: The Mayans, did they survive their fall?
programme.desc: "Did the Mayans survive their fall? Around 900, the Mayans must abandon their monumental cities. A hundred years later, they managed to build grand cities like Chichen Itza or Mayapan.
programme.desc-more: The Mayans ruled for nearly two millennia over most of Central America. In these territories, they founded cities such as Tikal or Palenque. However, around 900, they are forced to leave their cities because of a series of dramatic events. A century later, they built new and splendid cities like Mayapan and Chichen Itza. The year one thousand is going to be a golden age for the Mayans. Nevertheless, a series of challenges will arise in the face of them: climates, internal wars, deceptions, which causes a partial decline of the young people cited between 1200 and 1500.

programme.title: The Mayan Mystery: From Origins to Fall
programme.desc: «The origins»In June 2020, an archaeological discovery comes to question the certainties of specialists on the origins of the great Mayan civilization.
programme.desc-more: In 2020, knowledge of the origins of Mayan civilization was challenged through a new scientific and archaeological discovery. LIDAR technology has revealed the oldest and largest Maya site: Aguada Fenix. Follow a team of scientists, biologists and archaeologists, working on this site. This 3,000-year-old discovery will plunge the team into the traces of the origins of the early Mayan. With a length of one kilometre and a height of fifteen meters high, the structure of the building is immense.

programme.desc-more: Laure returns from Africa to seek care for Zacharia, a 10-year-old orphan. She's got a car accident with Jessica, who's having a miscarriage. Jessica and Baptiste opt for adoption and eventually welcome Zacharie. Laure cancels a trip to Africa to support Jessica, in the midst of depression. The yacht of Yannis Nomikos, David's father, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Yannis learns that he has an incurable disease but asks Lucie not to say anything. Grégory returns to Saint-Tropez after spending ten years in a Colombian prison. Caroline learns that she is pregnant but dare not tell David, who fears fatherhood. A season marked by the return of Frédéric Daban, in the role of Gregory.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Abby thinks she's sending her mother, a victim of behavioral disorders and refusing to take the medication, to her brother's, but she's getting excited at the last minute.
programme.desc-more: Carter agreed to take a cure to treat his drug addiction. Abby, who herself struggles with her addiction to alcohol, tries to support him. The unexpected arrival of her mother, who suffers from bipolar disorders, does not favour the balance of the young woman. Kerry, for his part, is deeply troubled by Kim Legaspi, a beautiful psychiatrist who does not make a mystery of her homosexuality. A dense season, exploring the complexity and subtlety of the characters, including Kerry Weaver, which reveals unexpected depths.

programme.title: The college years
programme.sub-title: At the edge of the abyss
programme.desc: Annette doesn't like seeing Aristide with Agnes...
programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: Clarisse tells Laetitia everything about Justine and Anthony...
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Les ans fac", Clarisse (Camille Raymond) confides to her best friend Laetitia (Virginie Desarnauts) about the tumults of her love life. It reveals the growing tensions between Justine (Rebecca Hampton) and Anthony Dupray, two characters with contrasting personalities who struggle to conquer Clarisse's heart. As rivalries intensify, Laetitia becomes the privileged witness of secrets and unsaid that may well change the course of their friendship. Emotional issues arise as young adults navigate the complexities of love and friendship on campus. Between betrayals and revelations, each character has to face his own desires and uncertainties. This new episode plunges viewers into a whirlwind of emotions, highlighting the challenges of student life, while exploring the fragile ties that bind these young adults in search of identity.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: In wanting to get closer to his daughter, Maxime discovers that Aurélie is again using drugs. A violent dispute broke out between the father and the girl, who immediately packed her bags...
programme.desc-more: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.

Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: The Angels have returned Anna back to the past to execute John and Mary Winchester, Sam and Dean's future parents. Castiel, seeing what is going on, propelled the two brothers in 1978 to stop Anna. Mary immediately admits Dean, whom she has already seen in a previous time jump, while ignoring that he is her son...
programme.desc-more: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.

programme.sub-title: At the edge of the abyss
programme.desc: Virginie's been through it. In the early morning, she tells her friend about the crazy night she spent with Serge...
programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: The college years

programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of "Les ans fac", Clarisse (Camille Raymond) confides to her best friend Laetitia (Virginie Desarnauts) about the tumults of her love life. It reveals the growing tensions between Justine (Rebecca Hampton) and Anthony Dupray, two characters with contrasting personalities who struggle to conquer Clarisse's heart. As rivalries intensify, Laetitia becomes the privileged witness of secrets and unsaid that may well change the course of their friendship. Emotional issues arise as young adults navigate the complexities of love and friendship on campus. Between betrayals and revelations, each character has to face his own desires and uncertainties. This new episode plunges viewers into a whirlwind of emotions, highlighting the challenges of student life, while exploring the fragile ties that bind these young adults in search of identity.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: In a context of intertwining human tensions and tragedies, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a heroine with a big heart, manages to reason a forerunner who took a class of students hostage, of which her daughter Clara is part. Meanwhile, the clinic where she works is shaken by the decision of Alain (David Brécourt), who is the victim of a heart attack, to put her on sale. The arrival of Maxime Servais (Stéphane Slima), a renowned surgeon, as new director, upsets the dynamics of the establishment, relegating Jeanne (Adeline Blondieau) to an ordinary medical status. At the same time, Louis (Bénédicte Delmas) faces charges of murder against Serge, while Tom (Mina Gustin), on the occasion of the anniversary of his father's death, is organizing a concert to honour his memory. Relationships are complicated: Baptiste (Mélanie Maudran) discovers Jessica's double life (Peggy Mahieu) and falls into drug addiction, while Caroline (Mina Gustin) receives an unexpected visit from her mother. Between romances, ruptures and betrayals, each struggles to find his place in a world in perpetual movement.

programme.title: Party at home
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the series Home Party
programme.desc-more: Because crooks sold the house her father had built, Ji-eun, a young writer woman, contracts with the new owner, an extremely popular actor. She will become her maid and be able to settle in a permanent home. The situation becomes sufficiently compromising for the couple to be forced to enter into a white marriage. A series of love twists that met a great success in Asia and offers as filming frame Korea, in the region of Incheon, but also Shanghai and Thailand.

programme.title: Doctor Who
programme.desc: Back to life for the eleventh time as his spaceship crashed, Dr.Déctobre meets Amy Pond, a seven-year-old girl who becomes, at adulthood, his travel companion. Their journey, constantly disturbed by a spatiotemporal fault, leads them to cross the Churchill road, in conjunction with the Daleks, but also the Weeping Angels and other evil creatures, to finally reach the cosmic portal of Pandorica, beyond which is held a terrible monster. A new Doctor, a new environment, new characters and new ways! After the acclimatization of use, a fifth exciting season in which a wind of freshness blows.
programme.desc-more: Amy, Rory and the Doctor, still looking for Melody Pound, came back in their own time. But under the threat of Mels, a childhood friend of Amy and Rory pursued by the police, the team was forced to board the Tardis again. Mels uses his gun and damages the device. In 1938, the Tardis crashed in Berlin in Hitler's office, and was invaded by toxic smoke.

programme.title: Stargate SG-1
programme.desc: Ori ships are moving at full speed towards Earth to subordinate the population to their religion. Vala, who gave birth to a little drug powers, Adria, fails to channel the power of the child. The young woman now takes the lead of the Oris. Daniel Jackson thinks that a fabulous weapon, designed by the magician Merlin, could definitely stop the invaders. He's going to Camelot to try to locate her. Meanwhile, Adria has been numbing her mother's feelings. A final season that ends in apotheosis, for a series that comes with "Stargate Atlantis" in 2004, then "Stargate Universe" in 2009 and even in cartoon.
programme.desc-more: In the near future, the long-inactive Stargate program is suddenly revived following an unexpected invasion of an alien commando that storms the Stargate Command (SGC) base on Earth. Under the leadership of Colonel Jonathan O'Neill (Richard Dean Anderson), the CGS is awakening from its torpor to deal with this imminent threat. This special service of the American Air Force is designed to explore unexplored worlds through the doors of the stars, mysterious devices allowing you to travel to other planets and dimensions. Together, a heteroclite team of scientists and soldiers, including the brilliant astrophysician Samantha Carter (Amanda Tapping) and the doctor of Team Daniel Jackson (Michael Shanks), embarks on perilous missions. They quickly discover that the universe is full of dangers, including the dreadful Goa的uld, a parasitic race that enslaves countless civilizations. Each trip confronts them with complex moral choices and conflicts of interest, while strengthening the links between team members. Through thrilling adventures, the GSC will have to navigate between fragile alliances and fierce fighting, while seeking to protect the Earth from growing alien threats. The stakes are high, and each mission could change the course of humanity.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.
programme.desc-more: In a world where the supernatural mixes with everyday life, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles) find themselves facing an unexpected situation when a mysterious man bursts into their hotel room. This man, Henry Winchester, their grandfather, reveals that he travelled through time to escape Abaddon, a fearsome demon who took possession of a young woman to track him. As the threat grew, the Winchester brothers had to not only protect Henry, but also find a way to send him back to his original era before it was too late. With the help of Castiel (Misha Collins), the fallen angel, and other allies, Sam and Dean plunge into a race against the clock, facing dark demons and forces. The stakes are higher than ever, as they try to defeat Abaddon's Machiavellical plans while preserving their family heritage.
programme.desc: In a world where the supernatural mixes with everyday life, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles) find themselves facing an unexpected situation when a mysterious man bursts into their hotel room. As the threat grew, the Winchester brothers had to not only protect Henry, but also find a way to send him back to his original era before it was too late. With the help of Castiel (Misha Collins), the fallen angel, and other allies, Sam and Dean plunge into a race against the clock, facing dark demons and forces. The stakes are higher than ever, as they try to defeat Abaddon's Machiavellical plans while preserving their family heritage.

programme.title: Supernatural
programme.desc: On Earth, chaos reigns while Lucifer (Mark Pellegrino) escaped from the underworld, causing a rise of dark forces. The angel Castiel (Misha Collins), whose fate seemed sealed, set out on a desperate quest to find the archangel Gabriel, hoping that he could help him counter the devil's Machiavellical plans. Meanwhile, Sam Winchester (Jared Padalecki), initially overwhelmed by despair, regains courage and decides to fight again the evil entities that threaten humanity. Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles), who had initially refused to associate with his brother, realized the importance of their relationship and reconciled with Sam. Together, the brothers face disturbing supernatural creatures, such as a witch stealing years of life from poker players, a teenager capable of exchanging her body, and a monster tracking patients in a psychiatric hospital. Their path is stumbling, but their determination to restore order in an increasingly dangerous world never weakens.

programme.title: The college years
programme.sub-title: At the edge of the abyss
programme.desc: Annette doesn't like seeing Aristide with Agnes...
programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: As Abby's mother's instability increases, Benton learns the identity of her nephew's killer and Greene is informed of the sad reality of her condition.
programme.desc-more: Carter agreed to take a cure to treat his drug addiction. Abby, who herself struggles with her addiction to alcohol, tries to support him. The unexpected arrival of her mother, who suffers from bipolar disorders, does not favour the balance of the young woman. Kerry, for his part, is deeply troubled by Kim Legaspi, a beautiful psychiatrist who does not make a mystery of her homosexuality. A dense season, exploring the complexity and subtlety of the characters, including Kerry Weaver, which reveals unexpected depths.

programme.desc: Annette doesn't like seeing Aristide with Agnes...
programme.desc-more: In this episode of the series "Les ans fac", Annette, a dynamic student, finds herself confronted with a delicate situation when her friend Aristide starts to associate with Agnes, a young woman with irresistible charm. Annette, who has always been close to Aristide, experiences growing jealousy in the face of this new relationship, questioning her own friendship and feelings. As she tries to manage her conflicting emotions, she starts a personal inquiry to understand Agnes' true intentions, convinced that he is hiding something behind his smile. Over the days, Annette discovers that appearances can be misleading and that bonds of friendship can be tested by love. This emotional dilemma leads him to reflect on his own desires and the complexity of human relations at university, where each choice can have unexpected consequences.

programme.desc: On a vibrant campus of life, Virginia (Virginie Desarnauts) finds herself at an emotional crossroads after becoming aware of her true feelings for Luke (Christophe Rippert). Each of them has evolved, and the experiences since their separation have changed them. Surrounded by their friends, including Camille (Camille Raymond) and Fabien (Fabienemblier), they will have to navigate through unexpected tensions, rivalries and revelations. As the past resurfaces, Virginia will have to face her choices and find out if love can really forgive everything.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: In this intriguing episode of the series "Les ans fac", Virginia (Virginie Desarnauts) finds herself in an emotional impasse, stubbornly refusing to address Luc (Christophe Rippert), a classmate with whom she shares a complex story. As their relationships deteriorate, tensions rise on campus, affecting not only their personal dynamics, but also their friends' dynamics. Camille (Camille Raymond), Virginia's best friend, tries to understand the reasons behind this silence, while Fabien (Fabien Remlier) and Magalie (Magalie Madison) try to calm tensions. As the episode unfolds, flashbacks reveal the events that led to this breakdown of communication, highlighting buried secrets and misunderstandings. The growing pressure of social scrutiny and expectations is intensifying the situation, and everyone must face his own demons to hope to restore harmony within their group of friends.

programme.title: The college years
programme.desc: On a university campus in the midst of a bustle, Virginia (Virginie Desarnauts) spends a passionate night with Serge, a classmate whose charm she fell. Meanwhile, Annette (Magalie Madison) and Aristide (François Rocquelin), worried about their friend Luc (Christophe Rippert), went to search for him. Their quest leads them to the streets of the city, where they discover a world that is unseen and troubling, populated by tramps and left behind. As Annette and Aristide try to understand the reasons that led Luke to isolate themselves in this hostile environment, they realize that student life is not only about parties and success. The tensions and difficult choices they face force them to face their own fears and responsibilities. In this night of uncertainty, bonds of friendship will be tested, revealing unexpected truths about each one.

programme.title: Under the sun
programme.desc: Laure returns from Africa to seek care for Zacharia, a 10-year-old orphan. She's got a car accident with Jessica, who's having a miscarriage. Jessica and Baptiste opt for adoption and eventually welcome Zacharie. Laure cancels a trip to Africa to support Jessica, in the midst of depression. The yacht of Yannis Nomikos, David's father, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Yannis learns that he has an incurable disease but asks Lucie not to say anything. Grégory returns to Saint-Tropez after spending ten years in a Colombian prison. Caroline learns that she is pregnant but dare not tell David, who fears fatherhood. A season marked by the return of Frédéric Daban, in the role of Gregory.
programme.desc-more: In Saint-Tropez, Laure (Tonya Kinzinger), a medical student, is preparing to marry Alain. However, on the day of her marriage, she felt an irrepressible impulse to find Grégory (Stéphane Slima), her youthful love, and decided to flee the altar. At the same time, Louis (Romeo Sarfati), the brother of Grégory, was dismissed from high school and crossed the road to Caroline (Adeline Blondieau), an attractive singer but engaged with the artist Samuel. Louis was immediately charmed and engaged in a quest to conquer his heart, even if it brought him into conflict with Samuel. As each person's life crosses, Jessica (Marie-Christine Adam), an American woman met by Gregory on a trip, arrives at Saint-Tropez. Laure, wary of this new coming, ends up being friends with her, which further complicates the relationships between the characters. Tearing choices and complex feelings emerge in this canvas of life full of passion and twists.

programme.title: Party at home
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 7 of the series Home Party
programme.desc-more: Because crooks sold the house her father had built, Ji-eun, a young writer woman, contracts with the new owner, an extremely popular actor. She will become her maid and be able to settle in a permanent home. The situation becomes sufficiently compromising for the couple to be forced to enter into a white marriage. A series of love twists that met a great success in Asia and offers as filming frame Korea, in the region of Incheon, but also Shanghai and Thailand.

programme.title: Emergency
programme.desc: Carter agreed to take a cure to treat his drug addiction. Abby, who herself struggles with her addiction to alcohol, tries to support him. The unexpected arrival of her mother, who suffers from bipolar disorders, does not favour the balance of the young woman. Kerry, for his part, is deeply troubled by Kim Legaspi, a beautiful psychiatrist who does not make a mystery of her homosexuality. A dense season, exploring the complexity and subtlety of the characters, including Kerry Weaver, which reveals unexpected depths.
programme.desc-more: Back at Cook County Hospital, Dr.John Carter (Noah Wyle) discovered an environment radically transformed by technological innovation that upset the emergency department during his absence. In the face of his colleagues, he must navigate between his traditional methods, which some consider to be outdated, and the integration of new practices. Meanwhile, Dr. Banfield (Laura Innes) and her husband make the choice to adopt, a process that plunges them into intense reflections on parenting and the challenges that accompany it. At the same time, Sam's situation (Eriq La Salle) becomes more complicated when his mother, with a tumultuous past, arrives in the emergency room, generating strong tensions and emotions. Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.

Through these intertwined narratives, "Emergences" explores not only the medical challenges, but also the human dynamics and personal struggles that take place in the background of a hospital service always under pressure.
