programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Panic at Coopers"Sheldon has decreed boycott of his favourite bread brand, but this measure takes unthinkable propotions. Georgie's trying to console Veronica.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Grouses Heads and Snowballs" After Dr.Sturgis' depression, Mary Cooper fears that the same will happen to Sheldon. Don't forget, Georgie discovers a talent for sale.
programme.desc-more: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.sub-title: At the end of the trail
programme.desc: "At the end of the Track"The convoy of wagons faces its last test of force.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series "Miracle Workers", the convoy of wagons, led by the charismatic and daring Craig (Daniel Radcliffe), finds itself confronted with a final challenge that puts to the test not only their determination, but also their team spirit. While the members of the group, including the pragmatic and ingenious Eliza (Geraldine Viswanathan) and the comic but loyal Benny (Karan Soni), have to overcome unexpected obstacles, internal tensions are beginning to emerge. Tensions between personalities and individual ambitions threaten to undermine their mission. In this chaotic context, they must show courage and ingenuity to navigate through perilous situations, while striving to remain united in the face of adversity. Pressure rises as they head towards their final destination, where the ultimate test of strength awaits them, forcing them to redefine their priorities and discover the true value of friendship.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: "Father in distress"A bomb placed in a church explodes, wounding a sacristan. Malik and Hugo are witnessing an accident involving a child on a bicycle and a motorcycle.
programme.desc-more: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: "And who is the boss? The cupcake shop is soon to open its doors. The girls then decide to hire a trainee. But both of them struggle to do their part.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Blue Flu" Captain Holt and Amy are doing their best to manage an understaffed police station. Meanwhile, Jake and Charles are investigating the matter.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "A laser on the moon"Penny and Leonard spend a crazy night, which Leonard hastened to interpret as something other than a regrettable mistake: contempt is blatant.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The robot to do everything! Howard uses a robotic weapon for his own pleasure. Penny gives Sheldon advice so that her first date is best.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Zookeeper
programme.desc: The animals in the zoo are talking! And they are determined to stop their favorite guardian from leaving his job by helping him to win back his dulcinate.
programme.desc-more: At Franklin Park Zoo, Griffin Keyes (Kevin James), the caretaker with a big heart, stands out for his unique connection to animals, who consider him one of their own. Unfortunately, his love life is chaotic; His girlfriend, Stephanie (Leslie Bibb), refused his proposal, leaving him distraught. Convinced that his sentimental situation can only improve through radical change, Griffin decided to leave his post to seek a more prestigious job. However, animals, attached to their human friend, come together to develop a clever plan to convince them to stay. Through hilarious dialogues and nasty situations, they reveal Griffin the true values of love and friendship. As he enters this unexpected adventure, he discovers that happiness can reside where one least expects it, while learning to overcome his fears of love.

programme.title: Pixels
programme.desc: With a woman lieutenant-colonel, three video game champions are trying to stop an invasion of their heroes sent by an alien power.
programme.desc-more: In the summer of 1982, Sam Brenner and his friends were teens who were passionate about video games in a small suburban town. Sam, the most talented of them, competed in the World Arcade Championship, but lost to champion Eddie Plant. Thirty years passed and Sam, who never evolved, remained President Will Cooper's best friend. But the situation is changing when an alien invasion of pixels occurs.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Tests of aptitude"Sheldon settles with Dr. Sturgis during the weekend to see what his life will look like at university. Mary's trying to get in touch with the other Coopers.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Grouses Heads and Snowballs" After Dr.Sturgis' depression, Mary Cooper fears that the same will happen to Sheldon. Don't forget, Georgie discovers a talent for sale.
programme.desc-more: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: "A nest of vipers"Venturi, concerned about the death of several policemen, finally turns away from the virulent attacks of the press against him.
programme.desc-more: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: "Clébards et raccoons laveurs"Frank tries to raise Shred's morale, saddened by Emily and Rick's romance. Meanwhile, the brigade discovered Victoria's white wedding.
programme.desc-more: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale) decides to devote his day to raising the morale of his friend Shred, who is going through a difficult period because of the emerging relationship between Emily (Vella Lovell) and Rick (Ravi Patel). While Frank is trying to distract Shred with a lot of stuff, the brigade is shaken by unexpected news: Victoria (Grace Palmer) married a man in order to obtain a permanent resident card. This decision raises many questions within the team, who questions whether Victoria acted out of love or whether it was manipulated. While Frank and Shred are trying to find meaning in their own lives, tension is rising within the brigade, each facing their own emotional dilemmas. This episode combines humour and reflections on friendship, love and the difficult choices that one sometimes has to make.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: "Chats et apes"Shred loves dating apps, Frank's great damn. Emily wants to beat Templeton at the adoption contest. Patel's looking for a good investment.
programme.desc-more: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, the team is faced with a series of unexpected challenges that test their camaraderie and professionalism. Shred (Joel McHale), the team veteran, is regaining a renewed sense of motivation and enthusiasm, particularly for dating apps, which is not without a mixed reaction among his colleagues. Meanwhile, Emily (Vella Lovell), determined to face Templeton, a formidable competitor, is seeking the help of her teammates to win an animal adoption contest. This competition, which promises to be fierce, will test the skills and ingenuity of the team. At the same time, Patel (Ravi Patel) discovers an attractive investment opportunity that could change his life, but that requires juggling his professional responsibilities with his personal aspirations. In a context where loyalty and mutual support are essential, each member of the team will have to demonstrate creativity and solidarity to overcome these obstacles.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: "Tortues and Labradors"Frank discovers a trafficking of animals. Shred explores night fur evenings. Victoria has a secret admirer and Patel is teaming up with Templeton.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale), an animal service agent, finds himself facing a major scandal when he discovers an illegal animal trafficking network. In parallel, Shred (Michael Rowland), a somewhat clumsy colleague, made his debut at a night watch, diving into the surprising and sometimes confusing universe of "Fur evenings", where animals are at the centre of unexpected events. Meanwhile, Victoria (Vella Lovell) draws the attention of a secret admirer, adding a touch of mystery to his personal life. To top it all, Patel (Ravi Patel) and Templeton (Gerry Dee), two agents who often disagree, are forced to work together to resolve a delicate situation that forces them to set aside their differences. This episode promises a dose of humour, suspense and emotion, while highlighting the daily challenges facing those who work for the protection of animals.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the credit card advance agreement
programme.desc: "And the prior credit card agreement" Girls get a prior agreement to receive a credit card. Immediately, they struggle to suppress a terrible desire for shopping.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The Devended Troll" Howard Wolowitz tries to get help from Penny, Katee Sackhoff and George Takei, so that all this little world can come back together, with Bernadette.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Transfer and subterfuge"Jake learns that an old friend has been arrested. He gets to be able to arrange for his own transfer to another prison, in order to spend time with him.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "The new captain"Ray Holt, a new official, took over a New York police station deemed lax. Detective and trubble Jake Peralta and he will oppose.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: "Big dogs and small horses"Frank fears Emily's presence on patrol because she's too strict. Shred and Patel, for their part, celebrate their new status as owners.

programme.title: Hollow Man: The Man Without Shadows
programme.desc: In a routine test, a genius biologist suddenly finds himself trapped in his own invention, which allows him to become invisible.
programme.desc-more: In a state-of-the-art laboratory, the brilliant but arrogant scientist Sebastian Caine (Kevin Bacon) dedicates his life to research on invisibility. After many years of hard work and hard work, he and his team, composed of biologist Linda McKay (Elisabeth Shue) and engineer Matt Kensington (Josh Brolin), finally discovered a revolutionary formula. However, in an effort to prove his superiority, Caine hides his advances from the army, his employer, to carry out experiments on himself. Once invisible, he frees himself from all the moral constraints that held him, leaving room for his darkest desires. This power of invisibility quickly becomes a curse, for Caine, in the midst of violent impulses, begins to manipulate and terrorize those around him. As his colleagues realize the gravity of the situation, they must find a way to stop Caine before he completely loses his humanity and causes irreversible devastation.

programme.desc-more: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale) decides to devote his day to raising the morale of his friend Shred, who is going through a difficult period because of the emerging relationship between Emily (Vella Lovell) and Rick (Ravi Patel). programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: "Tortues and Labradors"Frank discovers a trafficking of animals. Shred explores night fur evenings. Victoria has a secret admirer and Patel is teaming up with Templeton.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale), an animal service agent, finds himself facing a major scandal when he discovers an illegal animal trafficking network. In parallel, Shred (Michael Rowland), a somewhat clumsy colleague, made his debut at a night watch, diving into the surprising and sometimes confusing universe of "Fur evenings", where animals are at the centre of unexpected events. Meanwhile, Victoria (Vella Lovell) draws the attention of a secret admirer, adding a touch of mystery to his personal life. To top it all, Patel (Ravi Patel) and Templeton (Gerry Dee), two agents who often disagree, are forced to work together to resolve a delicate situation that forces them to set aside their differences. This episode promises a dose of humour, suspense and emotion, while highlighting the daily challenges facing those who work for the protection of animals.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Transfer and subterfuge"Jake learns that an old friend has been arrested. He gets to be able to arrange for his own transfer to another prison, in order to spend time with him.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The famous ring" On the occasion of a garage vacuum, the boys found a ring that had been used during the film "The Lord of the Rings" and entrusted it to Penny.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The robot to do everything! Howard uses a robotic weapon for his own pleasure. Penny gives Sheldon advice so that her first date is best.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.desc: A spaceship and its crew are returning to the past to face formidable and dangerous aliens who have come to exterminate the Earthlings.

programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The robot to do everything! Howard uses a robotic weapon for his own pleasure. Penny gives Sheldon advice so that her first date is best.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Lolita despite me
programme.desc: After spending his youth in Africa with his zoologist parents, Cady Heron (Lindsay Lohan) returned to the United States and was about to join a public high school for the first time. Disturbed by the social dynamics of the campus, she quickly met Damian and Janis, two eccentric students who opened her eyes to the unwritten rules that governed school life. However, Cady also draws the attention of Regina George (Rachel McAdams), the seductive and manipulative leader of the "Plastics", a group of popular girls who rule as masters over the high school. Educated by their glamorous way of life, Cady is quickly drawn into a world of rivalries and betrayals, where friendship is tested. As she navigates between loyalty and the desire for acceptance, Cady will have to face the consequences of her choices, thus redefining her identity and values.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: As the Earth is on the brink of extinction, a final battle is being fought between humans and the dreadful Esphenis aliens. Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, returns from a mysterious captivity aboard an alien ship, more determined than ever to defend his species. Upon his return, he discovered that the situation had changed considerably, as the alien forces had taken control of several regions. In parallel, the 2nd Massachusetts Regiment, led by charismatic Weaver (Will Patton), is organizing to conduct a desperate offensive to release prisoners held in the alien ghettos. Meanwhile, young fighters, like Ben Mason (Drew Roy) and Matt Mason (Maxim Knight), must navigate through the confusion and fear that reign among the survivors. In this exciting season of Falling Skies, the stakes are higher than ever, and every decision could change the fate of humanity.
programme.desc-more: In a world devastated by an alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Within a few days, infrastructure was destroyed and 90% of the human population disappeared, leaving survivors in a desperate struggle for their survival. In Boston, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a history teacher, finds himself alongside his sons in this fierce struggle against the invaders. While the alien forces capture and enslave the still alive teenagers, Mason becomes the leader of a group of resistors determined to regain their planet. Together, they try to decipher the motivations and strategies of these hostile creatures. By exploring family dynamics and human resilience to adversity, "Falling Skies" plunges spectators into an odyssey of survival, hope and sacrifice, while questioning the very nature of humanity in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: After a devastating alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Cities are in ruins and the majority of the human population has been destroyed. In this sorry world, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, rises to lead a group of survivors, the 2nd Regiment of Massachusetts. As a leader, Tom must juggle his new responsibility as a fighter with his role as a father, caring for his sons, one of whom is a captive alien. While the regiment struggles for its survival, it also faces internal tensions and heartbreaking moral dilemmas. His group members, such as Anne Glass (Moon Bloodgood) and Hal Mason (Drew Roy), are fighting not only for their own lives, but also for the restoration of hope within humanity. As battles progress, alliances are formed and broken, while each one faces his own demons and the ubiquitous threat of invaders.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the ball in the blind spot
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) is a waitress at the Williamburg Diner in Brooklyn, where she juggles between difficult clients and a modest daily. She came from a disadvantaged environment and learned to fight for survival. When Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs), a fallen heiress, was hired as a new waitress, their encounter seemed unlikely. Caroline, who has always lived in luxury thanks to her father's fortune, suddenly finds herself in a precarious situation after he was exposed to fraud. Despite their class differences, the two young women are building a strong bond and supporting each other. Together, they dream of opening their own cupcake business, while working hard at dinner. Through ups and downs, hilarious misadventures and daily challenges, Max and Caroline navigate the world of work, learning to overcome their obstacles while cultivating their friendship and entrepreneurial spirit.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, just emerged from a detoxification cure, determined to regain control of her chaotic life. As she tries to rebuild her daily life, her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic whose she has not heard from in years, is resurfaced with the intention of getting closer to her daughter. This unexpected intrusion complicates the situation, for Bonnie, with her often immature attitude and inappropriate moral lessons, does not facilitate Christy's task. At the same time, Christy's life is also disturbed by the challenges associated with her teenage daughter, Violet (Sadie Calvano), who is facing her own rebellions and trials. By juggling her work as a waitress with family tumults, Christy discovers that the road to redemption and mutual understanding is strewn with pitfalls, but it is also full of moments of tenderness and unexpected laughter.

programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

But the care goes first, so Carla always ends up falling on Turk and Elliot has a hard time avoiding JD. The second season continues to explore the characters of the characters and highlights less developed relationships, such as Cox and Elliot, or advances already well-established relationships, such as Turk and Carla.
programme.desc-more: Two medical students, and also roommates, JD Dorian and Christopher Turk, began their boarding school at the Sacred Heart Hospital. Turk is sensitive to the charm of the energetic chief nurse, Carla Espinosa, while JD would gladly fall for another freshly arrived intern, Elliot Reid. JD has a difficult relationship with Dr. Cox, whose arrogance is equal only to the competence, and even more so with the concierge, who becomes his sworn enemy. Between humour and gravity, a collection of characters and situations that have been staggered in the hospital universe. From his first season, "Scrubs" pulled his pin from the game and was able to win.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.
programme.desc-more: In the 99th district of New York, the morale of the troops was at the lowest, with the inhabitants losing all confidence in the police. Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher), determined to correct the situation, finds himself facing an eccentric and often disorganized team, composed of Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant but immature detective, Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), a formidable investigator, Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), a sergeant both muscular and sensitive, and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), a perfectionist with a great heart. While the team needs to rethink its investigative methods, the investigations are going to be a little bit of a problem. Jake, with his sense of humour and sometimes awe-inspiring ideas, offers unexpected solutions to revive team spirit. This sixth season, marked by a strong fan mobilization after the Fox canceled, promises thrilling intrigues and hilarious moments of camaraderie.

programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
programme.desc: Captain Picard and the Enterprise crew are defending the Ba'Ku, a peaceful people, who have a source of eternal youth and lead a simple and agrarian life. The latter are increasingly threatened by the Son'a, a population with degeneration of the skin and supported by Admiral Dougherty. Picard does not think there is a question of letting what is like genocide.

programme.title: Star Trek: first contact
programme.desc: Commander Riker is marrying Councillor Deanna Troi. Is both members of the Enterprise and the assembled crew celebrates the event. But no question of a wedding trip for the newlyweds, because Captain Jean-Luc Picard is given the mission of driving the Enterprise to the planet Romulus and of renewing diplomatic relations with the Romulans. The ship is moving on when an unknown planet is spotted, on which the carcass of an android is discovered, clearly designed on the model of Data, the android of Enterprise.
programme.desc-more: The Borg, half-organic, half-synthetic creatures, invade the Federation. Their ship is heading towards Earth. Starfleet is wary of Captain Picard, because he was captured in the past by the Borg. The Enterprise must stay away from the fighting. But Picard decided to take a Borg ship by pursuit. He manages to destroy it and hunts down a shuttle that escaped... to return to the past.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "A marriage proposal and a crucifix" George is happy, because Veronica will come to the Cooper house for a few days. Meemaw and Dr. Sturgis celebrate their first birthday.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: "UDH"Freya proposes her candidacy for the presidency of the Union of the Living People of Boomtown. Meanwhile, Morris embarks Sid on a perilous business trip.
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series, Benny (Daniel Radcliffe), a member of a convoy en route for an uncertain destiny, makes a bold decision by leaving his companions to resume his former activities. However, his initiative quickly turned against him when he was captured by an Indian tribe, the Blackfoot. Benny, who is plagued by a series of visions and reflections on his role, is convinced that he has been chosen to become the savior of this community. As he tries to gain the trust of the tribe members, he faces moral dilemmas and unexpected challenges that force him to question his deep motivations and identity. Through unforeseen encounters and moments of introspection, Benny discovers that the real act of rescue lies not only in heroic gestures, but also in understanding and respecting different cultures.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: "And on the weekend at the mountain"Caroline and Max go on a trip because Caroline refuses to believe that an order for a wedding cake will actually materialize.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Jeu de Boyle"Terry, Jake and Charles go to the countryside to visit the farm of the Boyle family. Meanwhile, Amy and Rosa are helping Captain Holt.
programme.desc-more: Retroduced by Commissioner Wuntch, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) found himself forced to leave his office to return to the field, where he had to adapt to a new working environment. His new partner, Debbie Foggel, a competent but unconventional police officer, pushes him out of his comfort zone. At the same time, eccentric Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and his faithful friend, the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews), continue to navigate in the ludicrous situations and the farfetched investigations that characterize the New York 99th District police station. As Captain Kim takes over the precinct, trying to integrate into this happy gang of unorthodox police, the dynamics between the characters evolve. In this seventh season full of humour and twists, brigade members face unexpected challenges while preserving their team spirit and comradeship.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "The new captain"Ray Holt, a new official, took over a New York police station deemed lax. Detective and trubble Jake Peralta and he will oppose.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The Devended Troll" Howard Wolowitz tries to get help from Penny, Katee Sackhoff and George Takei, so that all this little world can come back together, with Bernadette.
programme.desc-more: As soon as he returned from the North Pole, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) found himself in the arms of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), reviving a tumultuous romance. Meanwhile, Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), who is still as eccentric and neurotic, is making efforts to tolerate the presence of his roommate's girlfriend, although he often has difficulty hiding his irritation at social interactions. L-intrigue takes an unexpected turn when Sheldon finally engages in a relationship with Amy Fowler (Mayim Bialik), a woman just as introverted as he did, which leads to comical and delicate moments, marked by their divergent personalities. The band's dynamics are further complicated by the appearance of Wil Wheaton, playing his own role, adding a touch of fame to this season. With incisive humour and nasty situations, the series continues to captivate viewers, becoming one of the most popular sitcoms of its time.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Live Nobel Prize"Sheldon invites the entire school to attend a celebration for the Nobel Prize announcement. Meemaw learns more about Dr. Sturgis' past.
programme.desc-more: Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage), the young man who has been gifted at the exceptional IQ, continues to evolve in a world that never ceases to surprise him. As he entered the university at an early age, he crossed the road of an eccentric professor who quickly became a model for him. The latter, charming and atypical, also fascinates Meemaw (Annie Potts), Sheldon's grandmother, adding an unexpected dimension to their relationship. At the same time, Sheldon meets Paige, a young prodigy whose intellectual talents surpass even her own. This intellectual rivalry stimulates feelings of jealousy, but also admiration, prompting him to question himself. In an academic environment where challenges are as diverse as they are stimulating, Sheldon navigates between her aspirations, family relations and social interactions, thus providing a humorous and touching look at the life of a gifted child in search of recognition and acceptance.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: "Grouses Heads and Snowballs" After Dr.Sturgis' depression, Mary Cooper fears that the same will happen to Sheldon. Don't forget, Georgie discovers a talent for sale.
programme.desc-more: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: "A man drifting"The passenger of a taxi kills his driver with a gun. The R.I.S. team arrives at the crime scene and picks up the first clues.
programme.desc-more: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.

programme.sub-title: And the curse of the seer
programme.desc: "And the curse of the seer"After Andy's hasty departure, Caroline consults a visionary to reassure herself about her future in love. It's a failure. A curse is being cast.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother seeking redemption, is emerging from a detoxification cure with the hope of rebuilding her life and getting closer to her children. However, her return to reality becomes more complicated when her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic she has not seen in years, makes an unexpected reappearance. Bonnie, eager to reconnect with her family, brings with her a dose of immaturity and often displaced moral lessons, creating tensions between mother and daughter. Meanwhile, Christy also has to juggle with the challenges of her daily life: an early teenage girl who navigates the tumults of adolescence, a job as a waitress who leaves little time for herself, and friends who constantly remind her of her past. This touching comedy addresses the themes of family, redemption and personal struggles with humour and sensitivity.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: While Bonnie (Allison Janney) and Adam (William Fichtner) fly off for a long-awaited honeymoon, Christy (Anna Faris), their daughter, sees this as a golden opportunity to take over the reins of the family bar. Taking advantage of her parents' absence, she is tackling a series of changes she considers necessary to modernize the institution and attract younger clientele. However, this initiative is not proceeding smoothly. Christy faces unexpected challenges, including resistance from employees, who are attached to Bonnie's traditional methods. Between whoproquos and tensions, she must juggle her ambitions and respect for family heritage. Meanwhile, Bonnie and Adam, immersed in the carelessness of their romantic getaway, do not doubt the upheavals that are preparing for their return. The reunions are rich in surprises and emotions.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "Last day - Part One"Now, the parents of little Mac, Jake and Amy are trying to reconcile their personal life with their profession. The same applies to the entire team during a difficult period.
programme.desc-more: In this final season of the acclaimed series, the Brooklyn police station is facing major upheavals caused by the Covid-19 pandemic and the demonstrations that followed the death of George Floyd. Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), disappointed by the system she served, chose to leave her position to become a private detective, seeking to regain her passion for justice outside police constraints. Meanwhile, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) struggles to maintain the balance of his relationship with Kevin, while the challenges of the outside world put their love to the test. Hitchcock (Dirk Blocker) retired, but remained connected to Scully (Joel McKinnon Miller) through FaceTime, bringing a touch of humour to their friendship. Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg) and Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero) are trying to juggle their new parenting responsibilities with their careers, adding family dynamics to the police comedy. This season skillfully mixes themes sensitive to the humour characteristic of the series, while offering a reflection on contemporary issues.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "The new captain"Ray Holt, a new official, took over a New York police station deemed lax. Detective and trubble Jake Peralta and he will oppose.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "The Irish pub formula" Leonard wants to do everything to make sure that no one knows, and especially not Rajesh, that he spent the night with his sister: Sheldon gives him a little help.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: "A man who has drifted away"After committing a bloody murder, Flandrin mocks the investigators who were being targeted at him: he asks them for a large sum to stop killing.
programme.desc-more: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.

programme.title: Falling Skies
programme.desc: "Living and learning"An alien invasion has decimated human beings. A survivor, a former history teacher, took over the command of a group of alien-resistant people.
programme.desc-more: After a devastating alien invasion, the Earth is plunged into chaos. Cities are in ruins and the majority of the human population has been destroyed. In this sorry world, Tom Mason (Noah Wyle), a former history teacher, rises to lead a group of survivors, the 2nd Regiment of Massachusetts. As a leader, Tom must juggle his new responsibility as a fighter with his role as a father, caring for his sons, one of whom is a captive alien. While the regiment struggles for its survival, it also faces internal tensions and heartbreaking moral dilemmas. His group members, such as Anne Glass (Moon Bloodgood) and Hal Mason (Drew Roy), are fighting not only for their own lives, but also for the restoration of hope within humanity. As battles progress, alliances are formed and broken, while each one faces his own demons and the ubiquitous threat of invaders.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: "And the hip breaks"As Max and Caroline try to get a puppeteer out of front of the shop, the man slides on a cupcake and falls on his precious puppet.
programme.desc-more: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: While Bonnie (Allison Janney) and Adam (William Fichtner) fly off for a long-awaited honeymoon, Christy (Anna Faris), their daughter, sees this as a golden opportunity to take over the reins of the family bar. Taking advantage of her parents' absence, she is tackling a series of changes she considers necessary to modernize the institution and attract younger clientele. However, this initiative is not proceeding smoothly. Christy faces unexpected challenges, including resistance from employees, who are attached to Bonnie's traditional methods. Between whoproquos and tensions, she must juggle her ambitions and respect for family heritage. Meanwhile, Bonnie and Adam, immersed in the carelessness of their romantic getaway, do not doubt the upheavals that are preparing for their return. The reunions are rich in surprises and emotions.
programme.desc-more: Christy (Anna Faris), a young single mother, is out of a detoxification cure hoping to rebuild her life and give her teenage daughter Violet a better future. As she strives to juggle her work as a waitress with her parental responsibilities, her daily life is upset by the unexpected return of her mother, Bonnie (Allison Janney), a former alcoholic with whom she lost all contact. Bonnie, full of good intentions, wants to catch up with lost time, but her immaturity and displaced moral lessons complicate the situation. While Christy is trying to navigate the tumults of her new life, she also has to face Violet's frascs, who seek to assert themselves and test the limits. Between moments of tenderness and tension, this comedy addresses themes such as redemption, family dynamics and the challenges of motherhood, while offering a humorous look at the daily struggles of a determined mother.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: "The new captain"Ray Holt, a new official, took over a New York police station deemed lax. Detective and trubble Jake Peralta and he will oppose.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: "Sevening with girls" Boys are organizing a movie evening but fear that too large a public will prevent them from seeing the film. Penny and Bernadette invite Amy to her first girlfriend party.
programme.desc-more: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.

programme.title: Deliver us from evil
programme.desc: In New York, an experienced policeman joins a renegade priest in putting out of order the evil forces that are raging in the city.
programme.desc-more: The violence and darkness, Sergeant Ralph Sarchie knows well. Flic in the Bronx, he is a witness every day to the worst of human nature. What he endures has even affected his relationship with his wife, Jen, and their little daughter, Christina. Yet nothing had prepared him for the case that he and his partner Butler will discover. Overtaken, Sarchie will have to join forces with a renegade priest, who tries to convince him that the horrific events that are multiplying are linked to demonic possessions. Together, they accumulate evidence that evil is at work.
