programme.title: Dangerous seduction
programme.desc: A journalist learns about the murder of her friend, who is engaged in an extramarital relationship with an influential advertiser. She decides to investigate the man.
programme.desc-more: Rowena Price, a journalist, decides to devote herself to a personal matter: one of her childhood friends, Grace, has just been murdered. At their last meeting, Grace had told Rowena that she was harassing Harrison Hill, a famous commercial who had left her after their brief affair. Rowena, helped by her friend Miles, gets hired as an intern in her agency.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.sub-title: A parasol and a smug throw
programme.desc: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Young Sheldon
programme.desc: At the dawn of her last year of high school, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) found herself facing a decisive turning point in her life. Invited to a prestigious conference in Caltech, he aspires to convince his mother, Mary (Zoe Perry), to let him continue his university studies. While her father, George (Lance Barber), is involved in this process, Mary struggles with her own fears and the role of a protective mother. At the same time, Georgie (Montana Jordan) began exploring the world of work while initiating romantic relationships, while Missy (Raegan Revord) discovered a passion for sport, which led him to romantic adventures. Despite their own concerns, the two teenagers are not missing an opportunity to tease their gifted brother. In this third season, the series continues to portray with humour and tenderness the family dynamics and challenges of the transition to adulthood of Sheldon and his loved ones.
programme.desc-more: In the deep America of the 1990s, Sheldon Cooper (Iain Armitage) grew like a living riddle. At only nine years old, this prodigy to stratospheric IQs and in ways as rigid as its meal schedules amazes the Texas landscape of his native city. Between his complex equations scratched on improvised black paintings and his inability to understand the most basic social codes, the young boy embodies a permanent challenge for his entourage. At the heart of this intellectual storm is the Cooper family, as warm as they are uncharted. Mary (Zoe Perry), her godly and loving mother, oscillates between pride and exasperation in the face of this son who questions the Bible with the same rigour as the laws of physics. George Sr. (Lance Barber), his father football coach, desperately tries to instill in him the virile values of Texas, without success. Not to mention Missy (Raegan Revord), her twin sister, who with a mixture of agitation and affection supports her brother's unlikely life lessons, and Georgie (Montana Jordan), her eldest, much more concerned about her teenage conquests than with Sheldon's scientific theories.

programme.title: Miracle Workers
programme.desc: Climate change, endangered species, God wants to send an asteroid to start all over again. But Eliza and Craig have a plan.
programme.desc-more: In a world where chaos reigns on Earth, the disastrous consequences of climate change threaten to destroy humanity. Species disappear at an alarming rate, and madness takes hold of men, driven to desperate acts by the environmental distress. In this apocalyptic context, God, the eccentric boss of Heaven Inc., is totally overwhelmed by events beyond his control. As he tries to manage a team of angels with varying skills, each facing existential crises, he also has to deal with the incessant complaints of desperate humans. The employees of Heaven Inc. find themselves involved in situations as bad as they can be, navigating between the absurd and the tragic. The series explores with humour and derision the challenges of divine creation in the face of a humanity in perdition, while questioning the sense of faith and responsibility in a world in crisis.

programme.title: R.I.S. Scientific Police
programme.desc: Within the French police's Research and Scientific Investigations department, officers are doing their utmost to collect clues that will confuse criminals. Marc Venturi, head of a strong team of investigators, thus leads the investigation into the death of a business manager. He doesn't believe in the thesis of suicide. Later, it was a bomb, which exploded in a church, which occupied the police. The attack created panic among the public. Venturi is directly threatened by the bomb-layer. An innovative police series, about life in a multi-tasking police service, which does not exist in France in this centralized form.
programme.desc-more: Sandrine, 30, is found stabbed in the elevator of a large Parisian hotel. Venturi and his team are on the spot to collect clues. They found that before she died, the young woman had participated in a bachelor's party organized in the hotel. Besides, his room was sacked. Nathalie and Malik, for their part, investigate the death of another woman left for dead on the roadside.

programme.title: Animal Control
programme.desc: In this episode of Season 2 of Animal Control, Frank (Joel McHale) finds himself in a difficult situation when his colleague Emily (Vella Lovell) joins him for a patrol. While Frank prefers a more relaxed approach, Emily is known for her strict adherence to the rules, which promises to make the day particularly chaotic. Tensions are rising as they face unforeseen situations involving wandering animals and eccentric owners. At the same time, Shred (Michael Rowland) and Patel (Ravi Patel) are celebrating a significant event: their accession to the property. To mark this new stage in their lives, they are organizing a festive evening that attracts the attention of their friends and neighbours. The two intrigues intertwine while Frank has to navigate between Emily's demands and Shred and Patel's festivities, while managing the unforeseen nature reserves for him.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.sub-title: And the curse of the seer
programme.desc: While Max (Kat Dennings) and Caroline (Beth Behrs) are trying to realize their entrepreneurial dream by opening a cupcake shop, their journey is full of pitfalls. In this new season, Caroline's father, still in prison, continues to weave Machiavellic plans that threaten to undermine the friendship of the two young women. After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

After a daring robbery in their restaurant, their relationship is put to the test. Although their generosity often pushes them to spend their hard-earned money, they are temporarily at soup kitchen. However, this blow of fate becomes an opportunity when the establishment closes, offering them an ideal space for their new business. With the help of Sophie (Jennifer Coolidge), who becomes their partner, they embark on the adventure of managing their shop. As they navigate the challenges of the business world, secondary characters such as Earl (Garrett Morris) and Han (Matthew Moy) gain in depth, adding layers to this comedy full of twists.
programme.desc-more: Max Black (Kat Dennings) and Caroline Channing (Beth Behrs) are two waitresses with diametrically opposite paths, working together in the Williamburg Diner, a retro-style New York restaurant. Max, who had come from a modest environment and had experienced many difficulties, was cynical and disillusioned with life, while Caroline, once raised in luxury, saw her life change after her crooked father was imprisoned. Despite their differences, the two young women formed an unlikely friendship and decided to become roommates. Their common dream is to raise $250,000 to open their own pastry, a project that pushes them to overcome everyday challenges and bumpy situations. Surrounded by colourful characters, such as chef Oleg (Jonathan Kite) and the eccentric owner of the dinner, their journey is stunned with hilarious moments and life lessons, exploring with humour the themes of friendship and resilience.

programme.title: Big Bang Theory
programme.desc: The tumultuous relationship between Leonard (Johnny Galecki) and Penny (Kaley Cuoco) is reaching a new turning point when their breakup forces them to re-evaluate their respective feelings. As Penny entered a new romance with Zack, a man whose contempt for Leonard's geek friends was palpable, he turned to Priya, Raj's sister (Kunal Nayyar). However, Priya's jealousy of Leonard's persistent friendship with Penny complicates their emerging relationship. At the same time, Sheldon (Jim Parsons) continues to explore her platonic relationship with Amy (Mayim Bialik), whose interactions provide memorable comic moments throughout the season. The relationship challenges and social dynamics between these staggered characters highlight the struggles of friendship and love in an academic setting. In January 2011, the series received its first Golden Globe, rewarding Jim Parsons' outstanding performance in Sheldon's iconic role.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant city of Pasadena, Leonard Hofstadter (Johnny Galecki) and Sheldon Cooper (Jim Parsons), two roommates passionate about quantum physics, lead an existence marked by their intellectual genius, but their social malfeasance. Their days are rhythmic by discussions on complex scientific theories and video game marathons, but their love life is far from fulfilling. The arrival of Penny (Kaley Cuoco), a charming and life-filled young woman, in the nearby apartment is a turning point in their daily lives. Leonard quickly develops feelings for her, creating both excitement and confusion in the group of friends. At the same time, their comrades Howard Wolowitz (Simon Helberg) and Rajesh Koothrappali (Kunal Nayyar) are trying to navigate through the tumults of encounters and relationships in love, enriching the group dynamics. Over the seasons, their friendship is growing and evolving, as they face the challenges of modern life, mixing humour, science and the sometimes chaotic daily life of human relations.

programme.desc: In the vibrant Brooklyn area, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) faced a major challenge when he was appointed to head a police station known for his chaotic atmosphere. His team, made up of eccentric personalities, is a light-years away from his vision of an exemplary police service. At the heart of this dynamic is Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), a brilliant yet immature investigator whose staggered humour and idleness test the captain's patience. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), is a young student and ambitious inspector, obsessed with the idea of proving her worth in Holt's eyes. At their side, colourful characters such as the muscular Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the sarcastic Gina Linetti (Chelsea Peretti) bring a comic touch to sometimes unexpected investigations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" offers a refreshing satire of the police genre, while exploring friendship and camaraderie within a team of varied talents.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant Brooklyn neighbourhood, Captain Raymond Holt (Andre Braugher) is appointed to head a police station, where he has to juggle with a team of eccentric and unpredictable detectives. Indeed, Inspector Jake Peralta (Andy Samberg), although brilliant, is also known for his immaturity and hilarious frascism, which does not facilitate the task of Holt, a fervent defender of order and discipline. His partner, Amy Santiago (Melissa Fumero), ambitious and determined, aspires to gain the approval of their new leader while sailing in a chaotic working environment. Surrounded by equally colourful colleagues, such as the hard-working Terry Jeffords (Terry Crews) and the frank Rosa Diaz (Stephanie Beatriz), they are regularly caught up in looted investigations and nasty situations. "Brooklyn Nine-Nine" is a police comedy that combines offbeat humour and reflection on teamwork, while paying tribute to tropes of the genre.

programme.title: The Vatican Exorcist
programme.desc: On 4 June 1987, in Tropea, Italy, Father Gabriele Amorth (Russell Crowe), a renowned exorcist, was called by Father Gianni, the local priest, to intervene in a house where a young man seems to be possessed by a demon. Amorth, known for his unorthodox methods, manages to expel the evil creature, but his reputation is being undermined. A month later, Julia, an American woman, arrived in Spain with her teenage daughter Amy and her young son Henry, who had remained silent since her father's tragic death. They come to restore an abbey inherited from the latter, but the atmosphere is quickly disturbed by strange events. Meanwhile, in the Vatican, Amorth faced a severe reprimand from his superiors, who questioned his methods and faith. Tension rises as dark forces seem to awaken around Julia and her family, and Father Amorth must prove the validity of his beliefs in the face of an increasingly skeptical hierarchy.

programme.title: Arnaud Tsamere : 2 weddings & 1 funeral

programme.title: Make us laugh!
programme.desc: Comedie+ offers a second edition of its explosive show talent! Under Sébastien Thoen's leadership, go looking for the nugget of humor 2026. Thirty humorists, coming from all over France and even Europe, will ignite the plateau of FACTS-NOW LEARN! to win the title of revelation of the year. Talents in the process, sorted out on the stage, ready to compete against an exceptional jury: Issa Doumbia, La Bajon and Jeanfi Janssens. After three selection awards, only thirteen comedians will be in the semifinal... Then six finalists will have the privilege of being coached by the sizes of the humorous scene: Yann Guillarme, Tania Dutel and Jérémy Lorca. Objective: to convince the jury and the public at a grandiose final prize! Who will be the great winner of this season on Comedy+?

programme.title: The year of LOL
programme.desc: "The Year of LOL"** invites you to relive the funniest, unexpected and memorable moments that marked the year, on television, on radio, on stage and on the web. Each episode focuses on a specific year, revisited with humor and nostalgia. Humorists, actors, animators and media figures are retraceing the cult blunders, unforgettable improvisations and spontaneity moments that have made millions of spectators laugh. As a bonus, invited celebrities share their personal memories and reveal new anecdotes, transforming these memories into real treasures of good humor.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Amateur videos, stars in unfortunate posture, missed TV shows... Internet is full of funny and unusual sequences, the most striking of which are broadcast tonight. The show also compiles the most beautiful falls, the most memorable laughter and the most amazing performances seen on television. While there are obviously many slippages and technical incidents in this florileg, the palm is probably the responsibility of those who have participated in reality TV shows that have been the victims of the live broadcast. And while the excerpts presented often show surprising or even perilous situations, fortunately, everything always ends well and in good mood.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... "Le Zap" offers a florileg of the best sequences that are buzzing on the Web. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. The result is amazing videos, both about talented personalities and about Internet users who are not afraid of ridiculous. programme.title: Decaffeinated: The last 2 friends of the world
programme.desc: In a world where no one can get along, Rémi Deval and Clement Parmentier are the last two true friends, making them pariahs. programme.title: H
programme.desc: Jamel, Sabri and Aymé continue their misadventures in the hospital's orthopaedic department. Sabri has more than one stupid idea in his bag and he's hired as a bartender in a restaurant. Aymé is still a sexually-reducing applicant and is constantly on the lookout as soon as a pretty woman presents herself. Jamel learns that his brother Maurad is gay. A second season of 20 episodes, mostly directed by Jean-Luc Moreau. If Catherine Benguigui leaves sitcom during the season, Edgar Givry appears in the role of the hospital director. With a guest star ribbelle.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Sabri and Jamel always have unlikely combinations to achieve their ends. Aymé, on her side, is ready to do anything to seduce a woman. Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.

programme.desc: "Maquillage"Isa and Gaby have three children, Paul, Laetitia and Jules, aged 8-16. Every day, they fluctuate between contradictions and bad faith, great principles and small disappointments, marital and parental duties, small clashes and great effluences, passing resignations and unfavorable tricks to limit conflicts. In this first season, only Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret appear, their children are still filmed from the back.

programme.title: H

Roland Magdane also struggles with his family and his wife and looks at the health situation and its sometimes ubiquitous consequences on everyday life.

programme.title: Good evening, Mr. Devos.
programme.desc: On November 9, 2022, Raymond Devos would have been 100 years old. The Taloche Brothers propose to celebrate his birthday and pay tribute to him at the Royal Opera in Wallonia. During the evening, many artists and friends of Raymond Devos performed his texts, highlighting Raymond Devos' career and his fantastic imagination, made of music, circus and theatre.

programme.title: Francois-Xavier Demaison : Wine(s)
programme.desc: Ten bottles of wine serve as a red thread for this fourth show by François-Xavier Demaison, which combines confidence and colourful characters. The year or origin of these crus is only used as a pretext for a journey in time and space, from 1973 to the present, from the Catalan country to New York. The actor's memories are mixed with those of the audience, and the tasting becomes a reflection on a strange period.

programme.title: Edward Baer - The elucubrations of a man suddenly struck by grace
programme.desc: Captured in June and July 2023 at Théâtre Antoine (Paris). Almost alone in this show "The elucubrations of a man suddenly struck by grace", Edouard Baer gives a poetic dimension to his character. In a theatre, suddenly a man appears, the air running away. Who's after him? Is there a threat? He could go back and go back to his life. But what exactly is going on? Is this a moment of panic, a misguided referral, an unexpected encounter? Or is he going to drop the moorings forever? During this suspended moment when everything can swing, he starts to imagine other lives and great destiny.

programme.title: The big comedy show
programme.desc: Bringing together the most significant moments of the Just for Laughs festival in Montreal, an essential event bringing together among the greatest Francophone stars, this program offers novel sets of cults, parodys and duos. The following are present: Florence Foresti, Dany Boon, Laurent Gerra, Blanche Gardin, Franck Dubosc, Anne Roumanoff, Claudia Tagbo, Patrick Timsit, Elie Semoun, Michaël Youn, Jean-Luc Lemoine and Nadia Roz. A guaranteed evening 100% good mood.

programme.title: Teen : Biafine
programme.desc: Between his reflections - on the beekeeper's profession, his difficulties in staying in a relationship or his vision of the current situation - and the reactions they provoke in the public, Dédo demonstrates the strength of dialogue and our need to be able to continue to laugh, of oneself, of everything, together.

programme.title: Funny girls
programme.desc: Composed of sketches, parodys, archives and film excerpts, this documentary gives a panorama of humour to the feminine, from the few pioneers to the present day.
programme.desc-more: For International Women's Rights Day, the channel is a part of women's politics. Unforgettable sketches, excerpts from cultic films or hilarious images from the TV archives, this documentary offers a focus on French comedians' favourites, from pioneers from the past century to contemporary artists.

programme.desc: This zapping is for the generation that grew up with a remote control at hand: amateur videos, people, TV shows... Relaxation and surprises are at the rendezvous of this program not like the others.

programme.title: A friend's advice
programme.desc: Alain wants to separate from his girlfriend Julie. He confides his desires to his friend Boris. The latter does not understand this breakup, while he is on the verge of committing himself by marrying his girlfriend Claire. Boris, in order to mitigate this decision, advises Alain to invent a mistress, to so-called better justify her breakup and avoid a difficult life for Julie. But things don't go as planned.

programme.title: On the heads of the children!
programme.desc: One evening, Julie and Alban, in love and superstitious, swear ten years of loyalty to their children's heads. After holding 9 years, 11 months and 15 days, each prepares for the arrival of the fateful date. What happens between them once the couple is freed from their reciprocal oath?

programme.title: H
programme.desc: In a Parisian hospital, three young employees, Jamel, the standardist, Aymé, the nurse, and Sabri, the brancardier, work in a sleazy atmosphere and multiply gaffes and professional mistakes. They met daily with the fantasy of Professor Maximilien Strauss, Beatrice, physician of the Orthopaedic Service, and Clara, the chief nurse of the same service. Jamel constantly invents lies so that he doesn't work. Aymé suffers from hypersexuality and counts the conquests in love. Sabri, he's accumulating the blunders. A first season of 20 episodes, largely by Edouard Molinaro, in AB Productions' studios, and which was a great success on Canal+.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.desc-more: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: The Vultures' Ball
programme.desc: The grieving widow barely closed her husband's coffin and they came one by one to her door to offer her their condolences. "They", are the heirs, those who search, gauge, evaluate the valuables and the profit to be derived from them. They have neither scruples nor tact, but they have the right on their side.
programme.desc-more: Her husband's coffin is closed only, and a widow sees a horde of unscrupulous beings knocking on her door. The latter, although they have come to offer their condolences, will focus more on the benefit they can derive from the situation. These raptors are the happy beneficiaries of the deceased's inheritance, his heirs.

programme.title: Elisabeth Buffet : My stories of heart
programme.desc: La Toulonnaise Elisabeth Buffet, a comedian, actress and to a lesser extent also television animator, after a career in marketing, began as a comedian in 2005. Today she plunges us into a wonderful comic journey filled with self-deteriority. From the emotional and sexual difficulties between Cap d'Agde in the Hérault and Pornic in the Loire Atlantique, restaurants in the dark and thalassotherapy centers, she tells her failures with a touch of humour and reflection on modern life.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: As the countdown until Christmas is on, here is a selection of the best images found on the Internet or broadcast on televisions around the world. hilarious sequences, unusual moments, hidden cameras and cult sections of zappings, such as falls, children's pits or too cute animals, are the main part of this program that is conducive to laughter, and to sharing with the family. The unexpected will therefore be in the spotlight, knowing that, as tradition has it, everything is always well and well, despite some involuntary stunts.

programme.title: Richard 3's return by the 9:24 train
programme.desc: Pierre-Henri, a man at the end of his life, decided to reunite his family in his country house in an attempt to repair broken relationships before it was too late. Rather than inviting his family, he made a bold decision: to call on actors to embody each of his family members. The idea of reconciliation through false family members seems promising at first, but the actors too are haunted by their own neurosis. But very quickly, Pierre-Henri discovered that the quest for reconciliation is much more complex and chaotic than he had imagined.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Sabri and Jamel always have unlikely combinations to achieve their ends. Aymé, on her side, is ready to do anything to seduce a woman. Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.

programme.title: New faces: Just for laughs
programme.desc: With the success of its first edition, "Les Nouveaux Faces Juste pour laughter" rendezvous with a new selection of talents ready to mark the future of Francophone humour. Spotted across the French-speaking world, these emerging artists are on stage to share their best creations and reveal worlds as unique as they are audacious. A veritable springboard for the next generation, this iconic tray of Just for Laughs offers the public the opportunity to discover today the comedians we will talk about tomorrow.

programme.desc: The first edition of the "New Faces of Humor" was led by Pascal Cameron, and brought together 55 emerging talents from Quebec, Canada and the Francophone community. Among them were Erickson Alisme, Laurianne Lalonde, Steve Biko, Mimo Larzak, Nikoz, Mibenson Sylvain, Ilona Dufresne and Leonardo De Hemptinne, offering an overview of the French humorous succession.

programme.title: The big comedy show
programme.desc: Bringing together the most significant moments of the Just for Laughs festival in Montreal, an essential event bringing together among the greatest Francophone stars, this program offers novel sets of cults, parodys and duos. The following are present: Florence Foresti, Dany Boon, Laurent Gerra, Blanche Gardin, Franck Dubosc, Anne Roumanoff, Claudia Tagbo, Patrick Timsit, Elie Semoun, Michaël Youn, Jean-Luc Lemoine and Nadia Roz. A guaranteed evening 100% good mood.

programme.title: Saturday Night Live
programme.desc: L-humorist Druski becomes the first content creator to animate the SNL. An episode that was rigged by political news following the mid-term elections, crazy characters and a surprise appearance of Emma Stone. The Strokes is the musical guest.

programme.title: Jamel Comedy Club
programme.desc: Guests: Mcfly and Carlito

programme.title: On site or take away?
programme.desc: The two were determined to succeed, one in gastronomy, the other in business, Boriss and Samy opened a kebab in their city. Despite a huge desire to do well and ideas to be finished, their establishment is not achieving the desired success. Accompanied with sarcasm by PV, first-hour customer, they juggle between daring and failure.

programme.title: Philippe Bouvard : The art of laughter
programme.desc: With his bonhommie and insolence, Philippe Bouvard made France laugh for more than 40 years. From the Théâtre de Bouvard to the Big Heads, a successful audience for talent discoveries, this mediaman managed to impose his inimitable style in the PAF. This documentary is an opportunity to relive its cult moments of television through archives, unpublished anecdotes and interviews of the personalities who have accompanied it. With the participation of Bernard Mabille, Jacques Mailhot, Anne Roumanoff, Stéphane Bern, Chantal Ladesou, Philippe Chevallier, Mimie Mathy, Enrico Macias and Smain.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... "Le Zap" offers a florileg of the best sequences that are buzzing on the Web. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. The result is amazing videos, both about talented personalities and about Internet users who are not afraid of ridiculous. The show also allows you to discover TV images or original advertisements that have toured the world via the Internet.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Amateur videos, stars in unfortunate posture, missed TV shows... Internet is full of funny and unusual sequences. The show also compiles the most beautiful falls, the most memorable laughter and the most amazing performances seen on television. While there are obviously many technical mishaps and incidents in this florileg, the palm is probably the responsibility of those who have participated in reality TV programmes that have been victims of the direct. And while the excerpts presented often show surprising situations, everything always ends in a good mood.

programme.title: Comedy @ Home
programme.desc: A group of five artists are invited to perform in a private apartment and in front of a privileged audience. The comedians were welcomed by Blandine Lehout.

programme.title: Comedy @ Home
programme.desc: Comedie@Home is back for a new season! Who ever dreamed of having comedians in his living room? "A band of five artists are invited to perform in a private apartment and in front of a privileged audience." The comedians are greeted by Blandine Lehout, their MC for the evening, and each play a sketch in front of a few lucky spectators. Each show has a new band, a new audience and a new apartment.

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Isa and Gaby have three children, Paul, Laetitia and Jules, aged 8 to 16. Every day, they fluctuate between contradictions and bad faith, great principles and small disappointments, marital and parental duties, small clashes and great effluences, passing resignations and unfavorable tricks to limit conflicts. Together, they try to control the situation but often crash in a rather lamentable way. In this first season, only Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret appear, their children are still filmed from the back.
programme.desc-more: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: H

programme.title: Popeck: No more laughing, we're closing!
programme.desc: At the dawn of entering the tenth decade of its existence, the inimitable Popeck offers himself a final lap with the promise that it is indeed his last show. The humorist with a melon hat and a Yiddish accent presents himself on stage with a multitude of objects that have been part of his daily life during the five decades of his brilliant career.

programme.title: Roland Magdane : Unhappiness
programme.desc: After 40 years of career following one man show, films, theatre and television, Roland Magdane returns, surrounded by his mythical characters, with the same energy for a humor-rich evening. He's having a fight with his family, his wife. He struggles in his life, all the time! The art of this comedian is to observe his quidams under a humorous microscope to make it a totally crazy spectacle. The trubillon takes the opportunity to interpret all the characters of his previous shows like Pépé and Mémé, more wild than ever.

programme.title: Knights of the Fire: Mr. and Mrs. Lambert at the Olympic Games
programme.desc: Mr. and Mrs. Lambert could not miss the world event of the Olympic Games, which is taking place on French soil in 2024. Martine's dream is to attend the rhythmic gymnastics test. They rent an apartment via Airbnb, they buy tickets online, but when they arrive in Paris, the mess begins. Will the Lamberts live a unique and hilarious adventure? The Knights of the Fire give themselves to joy by inviting their iconic couple to the sporting event of 2024.

programme.title: Decaffeinated: The last 2 friends of the world
programme.desc: In a world where no one can get along, Rémi Deval and Clement Parmentier are the last two true friends, making them pariahs. To get back to normal, they're gonna do everything they can to get confused. Written in collaboration with La Bajon and Vincent Leroy, their show explores the absurdities of the time.

programme.title: Francois-Xavier Demaison : Wine(s)
programme.desc: Ten bottles of wine serve as a red thread for this fourth show by François-Xavier Demaison, which combines confidence and colourful characters. The year or origin of these crus is only used as a pretext for a journey in time and space, from 1973 to the present, from the Catalan country to New York. The actor's memories are mixed with those of the audience, and the tasting becomes a reflection on a strange period.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: An amazing zapping that targets the generation that grew up with a computer or tablet at hand. Amateur videos, people, TV shows... Internet is full of funny sequences, more unusual than each other. In the ZAP find the most beautiful falls, memorable laughs, amazing performances that will surprise you over and over again. Many nuggets on the rendezvous in a program not like the others!

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: A few days from the holidays, the show offers a selection of the funniest images, gleaned on the Web or broadcast on televisions around the world. Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... "The Zap" offers a florileg of the best sequences that make the buzz. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. The result is amazing videos, both about talented personalities and about Internet users who are not afraid of ridicule.

programme.title: Tax hernia
programme.desc: Frank, a somewhat red-handed merchant, decides to buy a small disconnected parenthesis for a weekend. He cuts off his cell phone, orders a meal, a lady in company, and puts his feet under the table. Unfortunately, nothing is going to happen as planned. A tax checker, a private detective and a hit man are gonna ruin his plans.

programme.title: The break of the year
programme.desc: Caterina Khéroul, a renowned burglaryman and assiduously sought by police around the world, wants to recover a historic and priceless jewel in the home of a PSG star player, while he is in the middle of the game. The only unexpected thing was that the same evening and at the same time, Sam, a small-scale burglar, also decided to attack the house.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Jamel, Sabri and Aymé continue their misadventures in the hospital's orthopaedic department. Sabri has more than one stupid idea in his bag and he's hired as a bartender in a restaurant. Aymé is still a sexually-reducing applicant and is constantly on the lookout as soon as a pretty woman presents herself. Jamel learns that his brother Maurad is gay. A second season of 20 episodes, mostly directed by Jean-Luc Moreau. If Catherine Benguigui leaves sitcom during the season, Edgar Givry appears in the role of the hospital director. With a guest star ribbelle.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Isa and Gaby have three children, Paul, Laetitia and Jules, aged 8 to 16. Every day, they fluctuate between contradictions and bad faith, great principles and small disappointments, marital and parental duties, small clashes and great effluences, passing resignations and unfavorable tricks to limit conflicts. Together, they try to control the situation but often crash in a rather lamentable way. In this first season, only Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret appear, their children are still filmed from the back.
programme.desc-more: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: Valérie Lemercier's TV
programme.desc: Many of the show business personalities evoke the journey of Valérie Lemercier, actress, director, screenwriter, comedian and singer.
programme.desc-more: From his beginnings in the funny "Palace" miniseries to the presentation of the Caesars through his collaborations with Les Nuls or Kad and O, Valérie Lemercier's appearances on television became cult. With a humor in total contrast with the image she returns, the comic, actress, screenwriter and director has been able to impose her leg. Back on his best television footage with in the background the comments of his friends and relatives: Danièle Thompson, Marc-Olivier Fogiel, Didier Bénureau, Bertrand Burgalat, Thomas Sotto, François Rollin, Patrick Timsit, Pierre Lescure or Kad Merad.

programme.title: Funny girls
programme.desc: Composed of sketches, parodys, archives and film excerpts, this documentary gives a panorama of humour to the feminine, from the few pioneers to the present day.
programme.desc-more: For International Women's Rights Day, the channel is a part of women's politics. Unforgettable sketches, excerpts from cultic films or hilarious images from the TV archives, this documentary offers a focus on French comedians' favourites, from pioneers from the past century to contemporary artists.
programme.desc: For International Women's Rights Day, the channel is a part of women's politics. Unforgettable sketches, excerpts from cultic films or hilarious images from the TV archives, this documentary offers a focus on French comedians' favourites, from pioneers from the past century to contemporary artists.

programme.title: Elisabeth Buffet : My stories of heart
programme.desc: La Toulonnaise Elisabeth Buffet, a comedian, actress and to a lesser extent also television animator, after a career in marketing, began as a comedian in 2005. Today she plunges us into a wonderful comic journey filled with self-deteriority. From the emotional and sexual difficulties between Cap d'Agde in the Hérault and Pornic in the Loire Atlantique, restaurants in the dark and thalassotherapy centers, she tells her failures with a touch of humour and reflection on modern life.

programme.title: Edward Baer - The elucubrations of a man suddenly struck by grace
programme.desc: Captured in June and July 2023 at Théâtre Antoine (Paris). Almost alone in this show "The elucubrations of a man suddenly struck by grace", Edouard Baer gives a poetic dimension to his character. In a theatre, suddenly a man appears, the air running away. Who's after him? Is there a threat? He could go back and go back to his life. But what exactly is going on? Is this a moment of panic, a misguided referral, an unexpected encounter? Or is he going to drop the moorings forever? During this suspended moment when everything can swing, he starts to imagine other lives and great destiny.

programme.title: Tristan Lucas "French Content"
programme.desc: Self-proclaimed "French content", the humorist with falsely nonchalant humour mocks with finesse of himself, the bobos, the quest for meaning and the contradictions of the contemporary era. Without taboo, he tackles the most sensitive subjects, convinced that humour is a formidable space for reflection.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... "Le Zap" offers a florileg of the best sequences that are buzzing on the Web. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. The result is amazing videos, both about talented personalities and about Internet users who are not afraid of ridiculous. The show also allows you to discover TV images or original advertisements that have toured the world via the Internet.

programme.title: Francois-Xavier Demaison : Wine(s)
programme.desc: Ten bottles of wine serve as a red thread for this fourth show by François-Xavier Demaison, which combines confidence and colourful characters. The year or origin of these crus is only used as a pretext for a journey in time and space, from 1973 to the present, from the Catalan country to New York. The actor's memories are mixed with those of the audience, and the tasting becomes a reflection on a strange period.

programme.title: Montreux Comedy Festival
programme.sub-title: The comedians of the public benches
programme.desc: The public bench at the bottom of its building occupies a prime place in Hakim Jemili's existence. Indeed, it is its headquarters, where all its projects come to life. It is therefore logical that he presents his new show with his "most precious instrument, and a floppy of humorists who accompany him on stage, among them Fadily Camara, PV, Yassine Hitch, Jérémie Dethelot, Florence Mendez, Alexis Le Rossignol, Pierre Thevenoux, Thibaud Agoston, Jérémy Nadeau, Julie Conti and Juan Rodrigues.

programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Isa and Gaby have three children, Paul, Laetitia and Jules, aged 8 to 16. Every day, they fluctuate between contradictions and bad faith, great principles and small disappointments, marital and parental duties, small clashes and great effluences, passing resignations and unfavorable tricks to limit conflicts. Together, they try to control the situation but often crash in a rather lamentable way. In this first season, only Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret appear, their children are still filmed from the back.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Jamel, Sabri and Aymé continue their misadventures in the hospital's orthopaedic department. Sabri has more than one stupid idea in his bag and he's hired as a bartender in a restaurant. Aymé is still a sexually-reducing applicant and is constantly on the lookout as soon as a pretty woman presents herself. Jamel learns that his brother Maurad is gay. A second season of 20 episodes, mostly directed by Jean-Luc Moreau. If Catherine Benguigui leaves sitcom during the season, Edgar Givry appears in the role of the hospital director. With a guest star ribbelle.
programme.desc-more: Between blunders, bad taste jokes and other mistakes, you never get bored with Sabri, Aymé and Jamel!

programme.desc: Jamel, Sabri and Aymé continue their misadventures in the hospital's orthopaedic department. programme.title: Parents instructions for use
programme.desc: Being parents is not a big deal. You must be listening to your offspring, but you must also be able to be firm and never be carried away by your own emotions. For the couples concerned, this often reveals a puzzle, especially since family obligations must also be combined with professional constraints while preserving one-to-one moments. In 2015, the series received the Best Short Program Award at the Festival de la fiction TV de La Rochelle. It revealed the initial couple, composed of Alix Poisson and Arnaud Ducret.

programme.title: Fanny Ruwet: We said we were partying
programme.desc: True to its taboo and disillusioned style, Fanny Ruwet says we're partying to better address tons of small questions that we ask each day without necessarily having the answers. In this show, she thus addresses in background the questions of the lives of adults often ignored. So, how can we make new friends by being adult and sober? Where are the emotions that we don't allow ourselves to feel? What is the best way to make a body disappear? Do the others all pretend to know what to do with their lives? How far do we have to pretend to love a gift we hate? Why don't we make an adult end-of-year show?

programme.title: Alexandre Kominek : Sensitive bastard
programme.desc: He is a Tunisian Polish born in Switzerland. It could be the beginning of a joke so he decided to make it a show. Alexandre Kominek confirms a separate trajectory, that of a humorist who moves without seeking to round the angles. His frontal humour shook and exposed contemporary contradictions such as desire, masculinity or social relations. For 1 hour and 45 minutes, he smacks his audience with big blows of stories as crazy as they are authentic. Singing, animal, mischievous, charming, fragile, romantic, excessive: the Swiss comedian is a little bit of it at once!

programme.title: Looking for the perfect sketch
programme.desc: To concoct his sketch, Guillermo Guiz surrounded himself with humorists whose writing he admires especially, inspired by their ingenuity and ideas, in order to shape his own performance. If this gala was to mark his last visit to Montreux, the humorist would leave a mark indelible by signing an unforgettable sketch.

programme.title: Montreux Comedy Festival
programme.sub-title: The comedians of the public benches
programme.desc: The public bench at the bottom of its building occupies a prime place in Hakim Jemili's existence. Indeed, it is its headquarters, where all its projects come to life. It is therefore logical that he presents his new show with his "most precious instrument, and a floppy of humorists who accompany him on stage, among them Fadily Camara, PV, Yassine Hitch, Jérémie Dethelot, Florence Mendez, Alexis Le Rossignol, Pierre Thevenoux, Thibaud Agoston, Jérémy Nadeau, Julie Conti and Juan Rodrigues.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 4 of the series Generation Guignols

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The Guignols take out brushes, aprons and other feathers to show the extent of their talent. L-art is an area that loves them and they take advantage of it to barb, scratch and rake some of the greatest works ever made. Jack Lang, the inveterate Minister of Culture, has only to stand up.

programme.title: The Pride Comedy Show of Just for Laughs
programme.desc: On the occasion of the Gay Pride 2026, a close-up was made on the Pride Comedy Show that exported to Quebec as part of the Just for Laughing Festival 2026. This year's film festival celebrates the pride of being yourself through the talents of the French-speaking comedy scene LGBTQIA+. A festive, inclusive and uncomplicated meeting, placed under the sign of laughter and living together.

programme.title: The zap
programme.desc: Fools, spectacular falls, unusual characters... The zap offers a florileg of the best sequences that make buzz on the Web. For better or worse, the Internet offers everyone the possibility to become famous in just a few clicks. This results in amazing videos, both on talented personalities and on Internet users who are not afraid of ridiculous. The program also allows you to discover original television sequences or advertisements that have toured the world via the Internet.

programme.title: Programme not communicated
programme.desc: Future clarification on the nature of the broadcast program.

programme.title: H
programme.desc: Sabri and Jamel always have unlikely combinations to achieve their ends. Aymé, on her side, is ready to do anything to seduce a woman. Charlotte, Professor Strauss' very pretty daughter, arrives from the United States and starts working in the hospital. She's gonna become the three boys' favorite and fantasy. Her father still considers her a little girl when she's 25 years old. Sabri is still a bartender, not far from the hospital, and there are always mishaps in his bar. A third season of 20 episodes still as effective. Former Miss France Linda Hardy integrates casting into the role of Professor Strauss' daughter.

programme.desc-more: Jamel, the standardist, Aymé, the nurse, and Sabri, the brancardier, always work at the Robert-Debré hospital in Paris, in a farfetched atmosphere, multiplying the gaffes and professional mistakes. Professor Strauss is no longer a man of malicious character and is laid off, then working in the Sabri bar. The latter is temporarily employed in the hospital as a surgeon. Aymé is still in sexual hyperactivity and continues his love conquests. He is dating the hospital director's wife. A final season, still as bland, that ends with the death of all the characters, except Sabri.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: "Europe, Europe, Europe!" said General de Gaulle. When the Guignols talk about Europe, it is of course the European Union, and its champions. François Bayrou in the lead, always ready to make love to his German counterparts - but also to his detractors, such as Jean-Pierre Chevènement or Philippe de Villiers.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: François Bayrou, his charm, his speech, his Modem, his buffs to the turbulent children, his missed appointments with France: the eternal centrist was a "good customer" of the Guignols, never short of ideas to mock his lukewarm, opportunistic and unreadable political positioning for the voters.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The sport seen by the Guignols was not only the players of the football team. The show offers a compilation of the best sequences of the Guignols on Formula 1... There are cult puppets like Alain Prost, Jean Alesi, Romain Grosjean and Lewis Hamilton and their offbeat comments on French news.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The political-judicial affairs have brought happiness to the Guignols. Jacques Chirac's puppet was the main protagonist of this great era: always accused, but always out of the question, thanks to his sense of formula, his unperturbable bad faith and his legendary charism.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The Guignols de l'info paint a robot portrait of the world of music with a compilation of their best sketches from the years 1990 to 2018. Among other things, David Guetta, Lara Fabian, Florent Pagny and Johnny Hallyday are here to interpret some of their hits and comment on the music news.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The Guignols have made Bin Laden a must-see since September 11. His puppet is always ready to explode and find justifications, making PPD and others terrorized. In their own way, they treat by derision a serious subject, a weapon just as legitimate against hatred.

programme.title: Generation Guignols
programme.desc: The Guignols stage the "young people", targets of the demagogy of politicians. The programme includes Jacques Toubon, who talks with the suburbs, Nadine Morano and "Abdelbriss" Hortefeux, who raptures at the foot of the HLM bars and Jean-Marie Cavada, who is debating with Farid and Jamel. programme.title: Olivier de Benoist : The other day
programme.desc: The expression "The Other Day" is often used as an introduction to many stories. It is therefore normal for Olivier de Benoist to start all his sketches with these few words in order to tell his adventures, stuck between his ambitions too high and his intellectual quotient too low. The comedian presents a one-man show that turns his daily life into an adventure novel.

programme.title: The legends of war aviation
programme.desc: The B-29 Superfortress is the most effective strategic bomber of the Second World War. He celebrates for dropping atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: The legends of war aviation

programme.sub-title: Ancient pile, screaming mummy and iron hand
programme.desc: Archaeologists are studying three mysterious artifacts: a vase from the Baghdad Museum stolen in 2003, with metal components similar to an ancient electric battery, an Egyptian mummy of three millennia with a face frozen in horror, discovered in a tomb in the Valley of Kings, and an iron hand with articulated fingers of the sixteenth century, remarkably preserved in a castle in Baden-Württemberg.

programme.sub-title: John Paul II the triumph of reaction
programme.desc: "Denazification: impossible mission"On 8 May 1945, Nazi Germany was defeated. Overmediated, the Nuremberg trial rang a few months later as a promise to clear Germany from a deadly ideology.
programme.desc-more: The posterity bequeathed John Paul II the image of a modern pope, that of a sovereign Pontiff champion of freedoms. Yet, by favouring the proponents of traditional morality over the progressives, the Holy Father has stifled many scandals that could have tainted an institution that was intended to be exemplary. In a church hard-tested by the distancions and dreads of the twentieth century, many shadow zones remain, despite its early canonization which came to cut short any question.

programme.title: Behind the scenes of history
programme.desc: This collection proposes to revisit events that everyone believes they know, to help them understand the ideas they have received. In this episode: the Normandy Landing. The seed made it a masterful operation and crowned with immense success. In fact, Operation Overlord almost turned into a fiasco, especially as the calendar was particularly tight, but also because the constant influx of American soldiers into southern Britain posed real logistical problems. This forced cohabitation creates tensions between the Allied soldiers.

programme.title: The Death and Love of Claude Lanzmann
programme.desc: Back to the genesis of "Shoah", Claude Lanzmann's monumental project on the Holocaust. He plunges into the centre of the twelve years of hard work necessary for his creation. This feature explores in depth the journalist's investigative methods, the numerous obstacles encountered, as well as his complex personality and his links with Simone de Beauvoir and Jean-Paul Sartre.

programme.title: They released Bergen-Belsen
programme.desc: Directed by film director Sam Mendes, this documentary tells the story of two soldiers, Sergeants Mike Lewis and Bill Laurie of the British Army photographic and film unit, who filmed the release of the Bergen-Belsen concentration camp in April 1945.

programme.title: Picasso: the shadow and the light
programme.desc: Pablo Picasso, certain of his genius, landed in Paris in 1901 to paint a revolutionary canvas. His beginnings were difficult, between the misery of Montmartre, which inspired his blue period and his relationship with Fernande Olivier, who nourished his pink period. Their conflicts fuel his creativity, a destructive pattern he repeats with other women. He reached his goal in 1916.

programme.title: Picasso: the shadow and the light
programme.desc: Now recognized as one of the greats of the art world, Picasso is organizing an exhibition in Paris. The war inspired some of his greatest works, including "Guernica".

programme.title: Picasso: the shadow and the light
programme.desc: Picasso's creativity does not weaken with age; He's trying to get his hands on ceramics and movies. As his relationship with Dora Maar deteriorated, he took a turn on young artist Françoise Gilot and moved to Vallauris with her. This period is marked by mythological scenes. Françoise will be the only companion to leave him. His last muse will be Jacqueline Roque, inspiring a new era in his work.

programme.title: The War of the Thrones, the True History of Europe
programme.sub-title: Louis XVII, the child of Europe (February 1793-June 1795)
programme.desc: "Lucien, the rebel (1798-1799)"In the face of the regime's mistakes, Lucien Bonaparte and the Prince of Talleyrand were in a hurry to fight a coup. But Napoleon eventually betrayed his own brother.
programme.desc-more: The death of Louis XVI led to the fury of Europe and the royalists of France. After an expeditious trial, the Convention has the Queen guillotined. Time is running out to save the new king of France, Louis XVII, 7 years old, and what remains of monarchy. In Paris, in order to save the first Republic, France plunges into a period of Terror. Theorigne de Méricourt then tries to calm the spirits. Pauline Leon is arrested. In Europe, Spain and England joined Prussia and Austria in the first Coalition war. France is sinking into chaos. The borders are being forced. But it's too late. The heir to the throne of France, abandoned in his jail, stoked.

programme.title: 1945: Children of chaos
programme.desc: On May 8, 1945, the victorious allies celebrated the end of World War II. Yet, at the same time, a silence of death reigns in the heart of Europe, transformed into a gigantic field of ruins. This is where hundreds of thousands of lost children will be found. For them, the nightmare will continue for several years. Some will have to flee Europe to survive, when others will be displaced again, torn from their adoptive families or stolen by countries that have a vital need to repopulate. Many will only discover their true identity many years later.

programme.title: Mysterious objects
programme.desc: Investigation of Towie's mysterious balls, carved stone artifact from the Neolithic and found in Aberdeenshire, in northeastern Scotland. programme.title: Mysterious objects
programme.desc: In 1848, in Vermont, USA, Phineas Gage, a foreman of the American railways, was seriously injured during an accidental explosion at a site. Although his skull was crossed by a metal bar, he survived. However, doctors have found psychological sequelae. The wound on the left frontal lobe of his brain is indeed a strong alteration of his personality.

programme.title: Ramses the Great
programme.desc: During his sixty-seven years of reign, Ramses II consolidated the borders of the Egyptian empire, established peace with the kingdoms surrounding it and built temples with unparalleled splendor. Blessed by the gods, he ruled so long that his people believed him immortal. This series tells of the birth of the 19th dynasty, which marked the ancient Egypt.

programme.title: Unseparable, a family facing World War II
programme.desc: After their mother was arrested, deported to Auschwitz, the seven Weber children fled and were hidden by farmers near Berlin. For two years, they survived hunger and bombing, united by the promise to their father to stay together. At the end of the war, they declared themselves orphans to be able to emigrate to the United States, but they would be separated for forty long years.

programme.title: 1914, a summer in hell
programme.desc: The assassination of the Franz Ferdinand Archiduke caused Europe to burst. Young men are mobilized in the middle of the summer, interrupting their activities. They go to the front with a mixture of patriotic fervour and apprehension. Upon their arrival on the battlefield, the soldiers are confronted with a brutal reality, overwhelmed by a flood of shells and plunged into the horror of war.

programme.title: 1914, a summer in hell
programme.desc: In August 1914, German troops invaded Brussels, leaving behind destroyed villages and atrocities that shocked the Allied soldiers. During the battle of the Belgian Ardennes, in a rain of shells, French and German fighters realize that this conflict marks the beginning of a ruthless industrial war. Intimate notebooks reveal the fear of all these soldiers.

programme.title: The War of the Thrones, the True History of Europe
programme.sub-title: Marie-Antoinette, Europe for help only - June-September 1791
programme.desc: "Marie-Antoinette, Europe for only help - June-September 1791"With the help of his now famous room of the map of Europe, Bruno Solo reveals the unknown consequences of the flight to Varennes on the French Revolution.
programme.desc-more: June 1791, two years after the capture of the Bastille, the royal family of France decided to flee Paris. But his arrest in Varennes not only caused the people of France to react, but also Europe as a whole. Reunited in exile, the Counts of Provence (later Louis XVIII) and Artois (later Charles X) now have only one goal, raising Europe to save the French monarchy and their older brother, King Louis XVI. But European sovereigns are hard to convince. In Austria, Théroigne de Méricourt, whose revolutionary ideas are considered dangerous, was arrested and then imprisoned.

programme.desc-more: Bruno Solo tells how the French wanted to enter the war against Europe! To their head, Theroigne de Méricourt. Freed by the Austrians, after being a victim of the royalists, she returned ovated to France. Like Pauline Leon, the chocolate maker, she wants to save the Revolution by arming women. Faced with this threat, with the agreement of Louis XVI, France declared war on Austria. But the National Legislative Assembly suspects Queen Marie Antoinette of connivance with Austria and Prussia.

programme.title: Triumph: Jesse Owens and the Berlin Games
programme.desc: In 1936, at the Berlin Olympics, Jesse Owens won four gold medals ahead of Adolf Hitler, breaking the theory of the so-called superiority of the Aryan "race".
programme.desc-more: In 1936 in Berlin, Jesse Owens upset history by winning Olympic gold in four athletic disciplines. His triumphs in sprint, relay and long jump shake Nazi racial theories. In the face of these exploits that contradict his propaganda about Aryan superiority, Hitler refuses any contact with the American champion, symbol of triumph over prejudice.

The pilots finally managed to re-light the engines, but the reduced visibility prevented them from distinguishing the runway as they approached Jakarta. After a miraculous landing, all passengers and crew members evacuated the aircraft safely. The investigation revealed that BA009 had passed through a cloud of volcanic ash, causing the engines to go out.

programme.desc-more: On 28 November 2016, LaMia flight 2933, connecting Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, and Medellín, Colombia, crashed against the side of a hill five minutes from the runway of the arrival airport. On board, the Brazilian football team from Chapecoense was preparing to play the go-to match of the Copa Sudamericana final. Seventy-seven people were on board, of whom only six survived the crash. The causes of this accident are clear: a simple fuel failure and the fact that the crew delayed admitting the seriousness of the situation.

programme.desc-more: On 28 November 2016, LaMia flight 2933, connecting Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, and Medellín, Colombia, crashed against the side of a hill five minutes from the runway of the arrival airport. On board, the Brazilian football team from Chapecoense was preparing to play the go-to match of the Copa Sudamericana final. Seventy-seven people were on board, of whom only six survived the crash. The causes of this accident are clear: a simple fuel failure and the fact that the crew delayed admitting the seriousness of the situation.

This debate divided the crew, some like Jorick, determined to convince his colleagues to cross the line of legality, while others, guided by ethical principles, categorically refused to yield to temptation. This face-to-face between loyalty, survival and ethics raises deep questions about the morality of human choices in desperate circumstances, testing the bonds that bind these men at sea.

No leads, no witnesses can provide clues about the fate of children, plunging the city into an atmosphere of tension and despair. Maya Rosetti (Sara Forestier), a young and determined commissioner, is responsible for this delicate investigation. However, to solve this mystery, she has to face her own demons by reconnecting with her ex-compagnon, a man who prefers to turn the page. In addition, the prosecutor, in disagreement with her methods, further complicates her work. In this fight against time, Maya will have to juggle her personal relationships with the professional stakes to find the missing children.

programme.title: Chicago Police Department
programme.desc: Atwater is infiltrating a weapons trafficking network to dismantle the organization. But during his mission, he recognized another officer, also undercover.
programme.desc-more: In the tumultuous streets of Chicago, the Hank Voight (Jason Beghe) brigade continues to fight crime relentlessly. Determined to protect their city, the team members do not hesitate to cross the limits of legality to achieve their goals. However, this seventh season is marked by internal tensions, including the arrest of Ruzek (Patrick John Flueger) for professional misconduct and obstruction, an incident that challenges the team's loyalty and integrity. As the internal affairs investigation is intensifying, each member of the team faces difficult choices and moral dilemmas. The arrival of new characters, including those performed by Anne Heche and Paul Adelstein, promises to add even more complexity to this season full of twists.

programme.title: Chicago Police Department
programme.desc: The team investigates the murder of a girl child, while facing new obstacles related to increased attention to police reform.
programme.desc-more: In Chicago district 21, police officers fight daily against a pervasive crime, ranging from murder to drug trafficking. Under the leadership of Sergeant Hank Voight (Jason Beghe), this elite team must navigate a constantly changing environment, marked by a controversial reform that challenges the traditional methods of police. As the city faces the consequences of the Covid-19 pandemic, tensions are rising and challenges are increasing, testing the resilience of agents. Kevin Atwater (LaRoyce Hawkins), particularly affected by the challenges of police violence, finds himself at the heart of difficult debates, while seeking to make his voice heard in an era of radical change. This eighth season, although shortened to 16 episodes, plunges into the heart of moral dilemmas and internal struggles that define the daily life of the law enforcement forces, while maintaining a haunting and captivating rhythm.

programme.title: Disappearance of concern
programme.desc: Lewansky receives a text from a 17-year-old girl who tells her that she left her baby alone in her studio, feeling too young to be a mother.
programme.desc-more: Esther Lewanski (Alix Poisson), recently promoted judge, finds himself drawn between her new career and her instincts as an investigator. When she learned of the disappearance of Julia Royer (Sara Forestier), a young mother she knew, her anxiety grew. Julia is suspected of having abandoned her baby, Zoe, but Esther is convinced that her knowledge of Julia would never allow her to commit such an act. Driven by her intuition, she is involved in the investigation, which takes a disturbing turn with the discovery of another young woman, Charlie, whose death, originally considered a suicide, turns out to be a homicide. The links between Julia and Charlie are disturbing, especially through a threat made by Julia just before her disappearance. Esther then finds herself immersed in a complex mystery where secrets, lies and tragedies interlacent, testing her convictions and her commitment to justice.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: A woman, a labour executioner, was raped after participating in a very private party organized by her boss. A complex investigation then begins.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: The ghost of the saints
programme.desc: In the company of her youthful love, a captain investigates the death of the owner of a hotel of the Holy, similar to a legend of two centuries old.
programme.desc-more: In the Saintes, the paradise island of the West Indies, the tranquility is suddenly broken when Caroline Boissaux' lifeless body, the owner of the Tourment d'Amour hotel, is discovered at the foot of a cliff. Captain Gaëlle Boissaux (Anne Décis), from Terre-de-Haut and sister of the victim, is in charge of the investigation. As she immerse herself in the meandering of this troubling affair, she is joined by Ludovic Augustin (Denis Marshal), her former youthful love, sent to assist her. Together, they must navigate through the secrets of the island and the tensions that are intensifying among the inhabitants. programme.title: New York Special Unit

programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. programme.title: Mom's missing.
programme.desc: Two sisters who have been distant from life are found after their mother's disturbing disappearance. Their research will reveal family secrets.
programme.desc-more: Louise (Claire Borotra) and Céline (Claire Keim), two sisters with diametrically opposed personalities, met after their mother's mysterious disappearance. Their separation over the years has widened a gap between them, but the urgency of the situation has prompted them to set aside their differences to investigate what really happened. Convinced that their mother did not disappear without a hidden reason, they are engaged in a frantic quest to reveal the truth. As they investigate, they discover a multitude of clues that reveal deep buried family secrets. Tensions are rising as they face unexpected revelations that threaten to upset their understanding of their own history. Their search will also bring them into contact with unexpected allies and formidable opponents, each having their own reasons to intervene in this mystery. In a world where the past and present intertwine, Louise and Céline's quest to find their mother will force them to question their own identity and values.

programme.title: Internal kitchen
programme.desc: Chef cook, Adriana dreams of stars and is about to open her first restaurant. But his partner's troubles are harmful to him.
programme.desc-more: At the heart of the vibrant city of Paris, Adriana, a French-Senegalese chef with exceptional potential, feeds a fiery dream: to get the star so much coveted of the Michelin guide for his restaurant, the Balalst. Passionate and determined, she invested herself body and soul in her kitchen, hoping to make her establishment shine on the culinary scene. However, his ascension took an unexpected turn with the arrival of brothers and sisters Jeff and Angèle Rubens, who presented themselves as new "associates". Their initial commitment seems promising, but their real intention is quickly revealed: to turn the back room of the Balalst into a clandestine poker circle, attracting a clientele from the Parisian community to the tedious activities. As poker games grow, the restaurant becomes a respected facade for a growing criminal empire. Adriana is then torn between her gastronomic aspirations and the reality of a dark world that threatens not only her dream, but also the integrity of her establishment. In this context of increasing tension, it must navigate through difficult choices to try to save what it has built, while confronting the dangers surrounding it.

programme.title: Sagah
programme.desc: After filing a complaint, Sagah is summoned to the police station. But how can we tell the indescribable when we suffer from post-traumatic stress?
programme.desc-more: After deciding to file a complaint, Sagah finds himself at the police station, faced with the difficulty of putting words on his traumatic experience. In the midst of post-traumatic stress, she struggles to tell the indescribable, while the memories of her past haunt her. The young woman, determined to free herself from this weight, tries to navigate through a judicial system that she often finds incomprehensible and insensitive. Interactions with police officers, although sometimes benevolent, are often tinted with mistrust and misunderstanding, making it even more difficult to move forward. As the interviews progressed, Sagah also discovered the power of solidarity, while other victims joined her in sharing their stories. This path of resilience leads him to redefine his own strength, while seeking justice for himself and for those who have suffered in silence.

programme.title: Disappearance of concern
programme.desc: Lewansky receives a text from a 17-year-old girl who tells her that she left her baby alone in her studio, feeling too young to be a mother.
programme.desc-more: Esther Lewanski (Alix Poisson), recently promoted judge, finds himself drawn between her new career and her instincts as an investigator. When she learned of the disappearance of Julia Royer (Sara Forestier), a young mother she knew, her anxiety grew. Julia is suspected of having abandoned her baby, Zoe, but Esther is convinced that her knowledge of Julia would never allow her to commit such an act. Driven by her intuition, she is involved in the investigation, which takes a disturbing turn with the discovery of another young woman, Charlie, whose death, originally considered a suicide, turns out to be a homicide. The links between Julia and Charlie are disturbing, especially through a threat made by Julia just before her disappearance. Esther then finds herself immersed in a complex mystery where secrets, lies and tragedies interlacent, testing her convictions and her commitment to justice.

programme.title: New York Special Unit

programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police.
