programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: Chicago Fire
programme.desc: Voight suspects a firefighter to be involved in criminal activity after a robbery at the barracks. Cruz investigates undercover to find a suspect.
programme.desc-more: In the heart of Chicago, Case 51 is preparing to face a devastating fire that puts the courage and resilience of its firefighters to the test. As the flames ravage the building, the team, made up of experienced professionals, struggles hard to save lives. The intervention takes a tragic turn when one of their own, a respected and respected member of the team, loses his life in the performance of his duties. This drama upsets not only the balance of the barracks, but also the life choices of several members of the squad, including Matthew Casey (Jesse Spencer) and Joe Cruz (Joe Minoso), who now face the brutal reality of their profession. Marked by the loss of a pillar, this season explores the themes of friendship, sacrifice and mourning, while highlighting the emotional and physical challenges that firefighters face on a daily basis.

Under the leadership of Lieutenant Matthew Casey (Jesse Spencer), the team often finds itself confronted with overwhelming emergencies, ranging from devastating fires to heroic rescues in the middle of the night. Each member of this team, such as the charismatic firefighter Kelly Severide (Taylor Kinney) and the determined paramedic Sylvie Brett (Kara Killmer), brings his own expertise and experience, while facing personal challenges that affect their work. Beyond dramatic interventions, the series explores the interpersonal relationships that form in this intense setting, the camaraderie between team members and rivalries with other emergency services. Chicago Fire pays tribute to the heroes of everyday life.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: As the team celebrates the arrival of the child of Rollins and Carisi, another child disappears in broad daylight. It's a young girl named Maddie. The latter was at the store with her parents when her father lost track. On the way back, Olivia's attention is drawn to a girl in a van. programme.desc-more: In the hectic New York City, the Special Police Unit is dedicated to the fight against sexual crimes and cases involving vulnerable victims, orchestrated by the determined detective Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay). Each episode plunges investigators into often sordid and complex situations where the discovery of a revolting crime requires their sensitivity and professionalism. The members of this unit, composed of experienced detectives, are engaged in thorough investigations, gathering evidence and interviewing suspects with the aim of bringing the culprits to justice. Cases, including rape, abuse of minors and sexual trafficking, are not only sensitive but also emotionally stressful. The Special Unit would not only act as investigators, but also as support for victims, highlighting their trauma and the challenges they face in rebuilding themselves.

programme.title: Disappearance of concern
programme.desc: In a quiet suburb, Tony, a man apparently filled with family life, juggles between a stable job and small, clandestine deals to make ends meet. Married and father of two children, he seems to have everything to be happy, but this facade hides a much more complex reality. When Laura, one of her clients, succumbs to an overdose, Tony's life is changing. The tragedy draws the attention of Maya Rosetti (Sara Forestier), a pregnant prosecutor, who finds herself involved in a delicate investigation. In seeking to understand the circumstances of Laura's death, Maya discovers disturbing links between this case and the kidnapping of prosecutor Dassault. Dived into Laura's intimacy, which she knew only superficially, Maya must navigate through a dark and dangerous world where loyalty and betrayal mix together, while fighting against her own demons.

programme.title: Disappearance of concern
programme.desc: "Motherly instincts"Lewansky receives a text from a 17-year-old girl who tells her that she left her baby alone in her studio, feeling too young to be a mother.
programme.desc-more: Esther Lewanski (Alix Poisson), recently promoted judge, finds himself drawn between her new career and her instincts as an investigator. When she learned of the disappearance of Julia Royer (Sara Forestier), a young mother she knew, her anxiety grew. Julia is suspected of having abandoned her baby, Zoe, but Esther is convinced that her knowledge of Julia would never allow her to commit such an act. Driven by her intuition, she is involved in the investigation, which takes a disturbing turn with the discovery of another young woman, Charlie, whose death, originally considered a suicide, turns out to be a homicide. The links between Julia and Charlie are disturbing, especially through a threat made by Julia just before her disappearance. Esther then finds herself immersed in a complex mystery where secrets, lies and tragedies interlacent, testing her convictions and her commitment to justice.

programme.title: New York Special Unit
programme.desc: "Someone good" The team is looking for a suspect who allegedly murdered the child of an inspector. Rawlins is thinking about a professional opportunity that has been offered to him.
programme.desc-more: After the tragic murder of a girl, Olivia Benson (Mariska Hargitay) is at the head of a complex investigation that leads her to team up with Frank Cosgrove (Ice-T) and Jalen Shaw (Octavio Pizano), both members of the judicial police. Together, they are engaged in an investigation that plunges them into the depths of a large criminal network, while Eliott Stabler (Christopher Meloni), Benson's former partner and expert in organized crime, brings his experience to unravel this sinuous affair. Throughout the season, the team is confronted with a series of disturbing cases, including an international criminal operation that tests their limits. Season 24 begins with a captivating crossover bringing together the universes of "New York, Special Unit", "New York, Criminal Police" and "New York, Organized Crime", promising fans an immersion in thrilling intrigues and unexpected twists.

programme.title: Hostage Game
programme.desc: An ex-Navy finds himself in the heart of a hostage-taking with his daughter and stepfather. Despite his post-traumatic disorders, he must protect them.
programme.desc-more: In a world of ubiquitous tension, Hostage Game plunges spectators into the troubled universe of Kyle Snowden (Tyrese Gibson), a former navy whose traumas of the past haunt him. As he tries to rebuild his life after a difficult separation with his wife, he finds himself taking over the custody of his young daughter, Angel. Their daily lives take a dramatic turn when they find themselves held hostage in a grocery store, alongside Sam (John Malkovich), Kyle's stepfather and an influential member of Congress. Their abductor, driven by a desire for revenge, targets Sam for personal reasons, holding him responsible for the arrest of his father, currently incarcerated. In this crisis situation, Kyle must draw on his military skills and protective instincts to save his daughter and face his inner demons. As hours pass, tensions intensify, and every decision could have fatal consequences. Between the struggle for survival and that of his family, Kyle must navigate through a real game of cat and mouse, where the slightest false step could be tragic. The outcome of this confrontation will depend not only on his physical abilities, but also on his emotional resilience to a ruthless opponent.

programme.desc-more: In a world where the fantastic is close to everyday life, the series "Grimm" plunges spectators into a world of mythological creatures, the Wesen, who hide behind the faces of humans. Nick Burkhardt (David Giuntoli), a detective of the Portland police, discovers that he is the heir of a line of monster hunters called the Grimms. As he tried to reconcile his professional life with his new responsibilities, Nick found himself plunged into an ancestral conflict between the Wesen and the human. In this thrilling episode, tension rises as Renard's mother (Sasha Roiz) arrives at the hospital in a critical state, using her powers to try to save her son. Meanwhile, Adalind (Claire Coffee), who had successfully completed his mission in Austria, found himself trapped in Viktor Castle, which questioned his loyalty following the mysterious death of one of his agents. While Theresa (Bree Turner) follows a Wesen with tentacles, Monroe (Silas Weir Mitchell) and Rosalee (Bree Turner) are trying to find a way to restore Nick's powers, adding a layer of complexity to this struggle for survival. The stakes are increasing, and each character faces crucial choices, while the danger is around every corner, making their quest even more perilous.

programme.desc: During a mountain hike, Romy, an imaginative teenage girl, bores herself with the verbose Sacha, her little sister. To channel her overflowing energy, she proposes a bold game: Sacha will have to embody a chamois, a discreet and mysterious creature, in order to silence her incessant chatter. At first, Romy had fun pushing Sacha into her role, giving her increasingly farfelus challenges that plunge her into a world of play and improvisation. Sacha, first amused, starts taking this game too seriously, being carried away by the illusion of its transformation into a chamois. programme.desc: While dinosaurs have evolved and even go to the Moon, a giant asteroid is dangerously moving towards the blue planet: can the announced disaster be avoided?
programme.desc-more: In a future where dinosaurs have not only evolved but have also succeeded in reaching the Moon, peace reigns on their planet. However, this tranquillity is threatened by the imminent arrival of a giant asteroid heading straight to Earth. The inhabitants, huge feathered and scaled creatures, are facing a catastrophe that could upset their lives. Among them, a group of young dinosaurs, led by the courageous Rex (Paul-Louis Aeberhardt), is running against the clock to find a way to divert the asteroid and save their world. Along the way, they meet unexpected allies and formidable opponents, while discovering secrets about their own history and the origin of their evolution. As the countdown accelerates, Rex and his friends will have to join forces and demonstrate ingenuity in trying to save their blue planet from certain destruction.

programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: After the appearance of an alien spaceship over Washington, the president of the United States fled by helicopter with a mysterious aircraft.
programme.desc-more: In the near future, humanity faces an unprecedented threat when aliens launch a devastating attack on the United States, annihilating the capital, Washington, D.C. In this chaotic context, the president (Ari Hader) manages to escape on a helicopter. However, his flight is short-lived, as he crashes near a small town in Connecticut, leaving the leader isolated and vulnerable. The inhabitants of this peaceful village quickly find themselves plunged into horror when extraterrestrial soldiers invade their territory, determined to capture the president and to get hold of a mysterious apparatus that could change the course of the war. In the midst of panic and desolation, a diverse group of citizens, including local figures such as a veteran (Matthew Pohlkamp) and a young mother (Christina Licciardi), unite to defend their city and protect the president. As tensions rise and aliens intensify their research, the inhabitants must navigate between fear and courage, seeking ways to resist this ruthless invasion. In this struggle for survival, each one will have to face his own demons and discover how far he is ready to go to save not only his city, but all humanity.

programme.title: Pacific Rim : Uprising
programme.desc: The idle son of a war hero and talented pilot of giant robots resumes service during a new attack of alien creatures.
programme.desc-more: In Pacific Rim: Uprising (2018), following the successful film by Guillermo del Toro, the story unfolds ten years after the human victory over the mysterious aliens known as Precursors, who had unleashed the terrifying Kaijus on our planet. The scars of this titanium war are still visible in the devastated landscapes, especially in Santa Monica, where reconstruction is difficult to advance. Jake Pentecost, incarnated by John Boyega and son of Stacker Pentecost, the legendary hero of the first battle, chose to lead a marginal life, far from the honours and glory of his father. He is involved in various trades, and is particularly famous in the illegal trade in Jaegers technologies, these gigantic robots designed to confront monsters. His life took an unexpected turn when he crossed the path of Amara Namani (Cailee Spaeny), an orphaned teenage girl with exceptional talent to hack the systems of combat robots. As a new threat emerges, endangering precarious peace on Earth, Jake and Amara find themselves being trained in a race against the clock to form a new generation of Jaegers pilots. This unlikely duo, both opposite and complementary, must bring together a heteroclite team to relive the spirit of camaraderie and sacrifice that had allowed to triumph over Kaijus. By rubbing themselves with the challenges of constantly evolving technology and an unexpected threat, they will have to face their own demons and accept their legacy to save humanity.

Jake Pentecost, incarnated by John Boyega and son of Stacker Pentecost, the legendary hero of the first battle, chose to lead a marginal life, far from the honours and glory of his father. He is involved in various trades, and is particularly famous in the illegal trade in Jaegers technologies, these gigantic robots designed to confront monsters. His life took an unexpected turn when he crossed the path of Amara Namani (Cailee Spaeny), an orphaned teenage girl with exceptional talent to hack the systems of combat robots. As a new threat emerges, endangering precarious peace on Earth, Jake and Amara find themselves being trained in a race against the clock to form a new generation of Jaegers pilots. This unlikely duo, both opposite and complementary, must bring together a heteroclite team to relive the spirit of camaraderie and sacrifice that had allowed to triumph over Kaijus. By rubbing themselves with the challenges of constantly evolving technology and an unexpected threat, they will have to face their own demons and accept their legacy to save humanity.

programme.title: When the chamois shut up
programme.desc: During a mountain hike, Romy, an imaginative teenage girl, bores herself with the verbose Sacha, her little sister. To channel her overflowing energy, she proposes a bold game: Sacha will have to embody a chamois, a discreet and mysterious creature, in order to silence her incessant chatter. At first, Romy had fun pushing Sacha into her role, giving her increasingly farfelus challenges that plunge her into a world of play and improvisation. Sacha, first amused, starts taking this game too seriously, being carried away by the illusion of its transformation into a chamois. As they travel in the middle of nature, the two sisters will have to navigate between imagination and reality, thus revealing unsuspecting facets of their fraternal relationship. This initiatory journey then becomes an exploration of family ties, childhood and the need to grow up while preserving a touch of magic.

programme.title: Dinosaurs : The True Story
programme.desc: While dinosaurs have evolved and even go to the Moon, a giant asteroid is dangerously moving towards the blue planet: can the announced disaster be avoided?
programme.desc-more: In a future where dinosaurs have not only evolved but have also succeeded in reaching the Moon, peace reigns on their planet. However, this tranquillity is threatened by the imminent arrival of a giant asteroid heading straight to Earth. The inhabitants, huge feathered and scaled creatures, are facing a catastrophe that could upset their lives. Among them, a group of young dinosaurs, led by the courageous Rex (Paul-Louis Aeberhardt), is running against the clock to find a way to divert the asteroid and save their world. Along the way, they meet unexpected allies and formidable opponents, while discovering secrets about their own history and the origin of their evolution. As the countdown accelerates, Rex and his friends will have to join forces and demonstrate ingenuity in trying to save their blue planet from certain destruction.

programme.title: Highlander
programme.desc: Steven Keane, an Immortel, wants to settle his accounts with MacLeod who killed two of his friends. MacLeod is ready to accept his revenge without fighting.
programme.desc-more: Duncan MacLeod (Stan Kirsch), an immortal from the MacLeod lineage, lives in the shadow of his illustrious ancestor, Connor MacLeod. Like his grandfather, he was condemned to go through the centuries, only to die by beheading. But Duncan is not alone in this eternal quest: other immortals, also endowed with this supernatural power, are surveying the world, driven by a devouring ambition. Their goal is clear: to eliminate others to appropriate their vital energy, thus becoming more and more powerful. In this context, Duncan is fighting for his survival, supported by his companion Tessa (Alexandra Vandernoot), who shares his tumultuous life. Together, they often find themselves engaged in spectacular duels, where honour and loyalty are put to the test. While the threat of other immortals is becoming clearer, Duncan must navigate between friendship, betrayal and an endless struggle for life.

programme.title: The Return of the Mummy
programme.desc: London, 1933. After their turbulent adventures in Egypt, Rick O的Connell (Brendan Fraser) and Evelyn Carnahan (Rachel Weisz) finally found a peaceful life, far from the pharaoh curses and supernatural creatures. Set in a comfortable London home, they raise their son Alex (Freddie Boat), an eight-year-old boy as lively as he is curious, heir despite him of blood mixed with the history of ancient mysteries. The shelves are full of Egyptian artifacts, memories of a past they thought was permanently buried, and Evelyn, now a successful author, draws inspiration from these extraordinary stories for her novels. But fate, like mummies, has the unfortunate habit of coming back when one least expects it. When a mysterious Egyptian bracelet is discovered during excavations, troubles start again. This simple object, charged with evil energy, awakens much more than a memory: it revives Imhotep (Arnold Vosloo), the cursed high priest, whose mummy, reduced to ashes a decade earlier, is restored in the shadow, thirsty for revenge. Worse still, this resurrection is accompanied by a procession of infernal, half-human, half-scorpions creatures who sow terror in the streets of London. The legends that Rick and Evelyn thought they had sealed forever surfaced, more threatening than ever.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the animated series, Candice Flynn (Ashley Tisdale) finds himself at the end of his nerves in the face of the strange disappearance of his brothers' inventions, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster). Every time their mother comes home, her brothers' ingenious creations seem to evaporate into the air, leaving Candice in a delicate situation where she appears to be a liar in the eyes of her mother. Determined to prove the truth, she is embarking on a quest to capture the magic of these disappearances and demonstrate that her brothers are not as innocent as they claim. At the same time, Phineas and Ferb, always looking for new adventures, decided to open a restaurant in their garden, quickly attracting a host of customers in search of a unique culinary experience. This new establishment quickly became the fashionable place, highlighting the ingenuity of the two brothers while further complicating Candice's life.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.sub-title: Mother instinct / A game more true than nature
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", entitled "The Mother Instinct", the two brothers, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), discover a mysterious egg in their garden, which they think is that of their pet, Perry the Ornithorynca. Emused by the idea of becoming parents, they decide to build an innovative robot to incubate the egg and make sure it is splintering in the best conditions. In the second part, "A game more true than nature", Phineas and Ferb tackle a new challenge: creating a revolutionary video game inspired by real characters. By integrating elements of their daily lives, they strive to bring life to a playful world where their friends and adventures take the lead. This mix of imagination and technology promises to plunge them into unexpected situations, while capturing the attention of Candice and their entourage.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: The Greens, an eccentric and endearing family, make the decision to leave Big City to return to their farm in the countryside, hoping to reconnect with the simplicity and authenticity of their past. However, their return is far from the sweet dream they had imagined. Upon arriving, they discover that their former haven of peace has radically changed, and the idyllic memories of their childhood fade in the face of a disconcerting reality. The landscapes are unrecognizable, and relations with the former neighbours are tinted with a feeling of strangeness. The Greens must then navigate through unexpected challenges and comical misunderstandings that test their family unity. Between the longing for past days and adapting to an uncertain present, each family member must learn to redefine what really means "to go home". Laughters and tears mix as the Greens try to regain their place in a world that has evolved without them.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: As the Grant-Gomez prepare to spend a family game evening, the atmosphere is friendly and laughter. However, Fred (Michael Cimino) and Hiromi (Carolina Ravassa) face an unexpected threat: an army of robots programmed to take over their high school. The evening then turns into an unpredictable adventure, where humour and action mix, testing the family ties and team spirit of the protagonists. Between board games and fighting against robots, each member of the family will have to show courage and ingenuity to overcome this double threat.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Phineas and Ferb", the inventor brothers meet Thaddeus and Thor, their temporary neighbours who share a similar passion for bold projects. While Phineas and Ferb are attacking the construction of an exact replica of a paper-mache aircraft, Thaddeus and Thor, with their flair for innovation, are trying to surpass the exploits of the two brothers. The episode highlights the friendly rivalry that develops between the two duos, each seeking to prove its superiority in the art of creation. Meanwhile, Perry the Ornithoryn, their pet, continues his double life as a secret agent, launching a mission to counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz. The hilarious adventures and unexpected twists make this episode a entertaining moment, rich in creativity and camaraderie, where the imagination of children comes up against the entrepreneurial spirit of their neighbours.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Giant Rat / The Theft of Collars
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: When Dingo builds his house upside down, he has to go to the Magical Isle with Mickey and Minnie to find a magic potion that would put it back in the right direction.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.sub-title: On your marks, ready, push / Rio into space
programme.desc: The adventures of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales, who join with Superheroes to defeat their enemies and discover that teamwork is the best way to save the situation. The third season introduced a new plot called
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: When Dingo builds his house upside down, he has to go to the Magical Isle with Mickey and Minnie to find a magic potion that would put it back in the right direction.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The Black Knight's Ghost / Phinedroids & Ferbots
programme.desc: On their vacation in England with Ferb's grandparents, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and his brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) discovered the fascinating legend of the Black Knight, a mysterious hero whose exploits resonate throughout the ages. Enthusiasmous by this story, they decide to organize a medieval tournament of life-size, inviting their friends to participate in chivalry and relive heroic times. Meanwhile, Phineas' sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), desperately tries to unmask her brothers' plans to expose them to their parents. At the same time, in another intrigue, the two boys, faced with the impossibility of carrying out all their summer projects, are starting to create robots called "Phinedroids" and "Ferbots". These ingenious creations are designed to help them carry out their summer activities, but they soon provoke hilarious and unexpected situations.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The SuperChatons and the Catastrosis / The SuperChatons and the War of the Bad
programme.desc: The SuperChatons are tasked with preventing Zsa-Zsa from stealing all pink objects from Feliville. Mr. Petites-Pattes and Chapardeur are fighting for the title of the city's best villain.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: The Greens, an eccentric and endearing family, celebrate their 100th adventure in Big City, a landmark event that promises unexpected twists. As they prepare to hold a big celebration to commemorate this milestone, each member of the family is faced with personal challenges. Marieve, Herington, the dynamic matriarch, tries to juggle the preparations for the celebration and the management of tensions between her children. Chris (Houghton), the dreamer son, has to face his own doubts about his future, while Bob (Joles), the wise grandfather, shares memories that bring back long buried family secrets. Artemis (Pebdani), the farfetched aunt, brings a touch of offbeat humour and wild ideas that make things even more difficult. As this celebration unfolds, the Greens will discover that family ties are being tested, but that love and humour can overcome all trials.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Bobby and his best friend Romy are convinced that their French coast town is home to evil forces. During one of their monster hunts, they discover a megalith: Subterra's door. They're opening it by accident. Bobby finds himself a victim of a curse, and a monster of fog soon takes them out. It was then that they met a mysterious warrior with superhuman powers.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: When Dingo builds his house upside down, he has to go to the Magical Isle with Mickey and Minnie to find a magic potion that would put it back in the right direction.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc: The adventures of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales, who join with Superheroes to defeat their enemies and discover that teamwork is the best way to save the situation. The third season introduced a new plot called
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inventor brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to take up a new challenge by building an artificial biosphere. Their aim is to allow a group of scouts to win new badges, even in the event of torrential rain. As they implement their bold plan, their project quickly takes on unexpected dimensions, mixing science, adventure and a good dose of humor. At the same time, Candice Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), Phineas' sister, finds herself in a difficult situation. She promised her best friend Stacy to spend a day with girls, but she was forced to juggle her friendly obligations with her boyfriend, which made her schedule difficult. Quiproquos and twists are bound up, offering a mixture of adventure and comedy, while stressing the importance of friendly and family relations.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.sub-title: Listen to me / On a large screen
programme.desc: In this episode of the animated series "The Greens in Big City", the story revolves around Cricket Green (Chris Houghton), who faces a delicate situation after losing a crucial audition. In a desperate effort to hide this failure from his grandfather Bill (Bob Joles), Cricket embarked on a series of comical schemes to keep his secret, while learning lessons about pressure and truth. At the same time, the Green family decided to enjoy an evening at the outdoor cinema, where Gloria (Marieve Herington) took the lead in proving to everyone that her life was as exciting as her photos on Snap-A-Gram. In trying to capture the perfect moment, she finds herself involved in crazy and unexpected situations, revealing both her aspirations and family dynamics. This episode explores themes of authenticity, self-acceptance and the importance of family ties.

programme.desc: In this special episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the famous Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire) and agent P. Meanwhile, Perry, as a secret agent, continues his secret missions to counter the Machiavellical plans of Doofenshmirtz, adding a dimension of action and humour to this celebration of the best moments of "Phineas and Ferb".

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In a full summer of promises, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to explore the mysteries of time by building a travel machine in the future. Their enthusiasm is quickly tempered when their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale), determined to unmask them, gets hold of this revolutionary invention. Using the machine, it causes a series of unforeseen events that turn their world into a future nightmare. This new future is marked by invasive robots and environmental disasters, a direct result of the actions of Phineas and Ferb. While the brothers try to repair the damage caused by their time experience, they realize that their choices have far wider repercussions than expected. Candice, though initially motivated by the desire to make known the exploits of her brothers, realizes that she also has a crucial role to play in restoring balance in this deranged world.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The Epi-Browse / Rodeo Mounting of Sheep
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Tilly Green (Marieve Herington) disagrees with family traditions during his epi-breast, a symbolic event that marks the transition to adulthood. His decision to derogate from established rites caused the anger of his grandmother (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who saw this break as an infringement of family heritage. At the same time, his brother Cricket (Chris Houghton) has a dream of becoming an expert in sheep rodeo. programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas et Ferb", entitled "Les Baljeatles", Baljeet (Vincent Martella) is inadvertently registered at a summer rock camp. Unfortunately, this science enthusiast has no musical experience and does not know how to play an instrument or sing. Faced with this unexpected challenge, he must navigate through the trials of the camp while trying to conceal his incapacity. In parallel, "The pizzazium infinionite" plunges the characters into a frantic race through the largest shopping centre in the region of the three states. The brothers Phineas (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) and Ferb (Vincent Martella) embark on a thrilling adventure to find this mysterious material, attracting a series of hilarious and unexpected situations. Between Baljeet's anguish in the face of his campmates and the frenzy of the shopping mall, this episode promises moments of laughter and friendship, while celebrating the creativity and innovation of young heroes.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Meg Birthday Mom / Travel to Candice Center
programme.desc: For their mother's birthday, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are embarking on a grand quest to offer her memorable gifts, which may cause her daughter Candice (Ashley Tisdale) to forget those carefully prepared. Determined not to be overshadowed, Candice strives to do everything possible to thwart the plans of her brothers, hoping to prove to their mother that her gifts are the best. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb, still looking for adventure, decided to build a mini submarine to explore the mysterious world that is hidden inside the dog of Isabella (voice of Kelly Hu). However, their experience takes an unexpected turn when they accidentally find themselves inside Candice's body, diving into a fantastic universe where they will have to navigate through his thoughts and emotions. The crazy situations are going on, mixing humour and imagination, while the two brothers try to find their way back and celebrate their mother's birthday in an unforgettable way.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Giant Rat / The Theft of Collars
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this explosive episode of season 4 of "The Greens in Big City", Chip (Chris Houghton) embarks on a Machiavellian plan to avenge the Greens, whom he considers responsible for his misfortunes. Obsessed with destroying their reputation, he worked to manipulate the people of Big City by persuading them that the Greens were responsible for the degradation of their community. To do this, Chip staged deceptive events, orchestrating incidents that put the Greens in an unfavorable light. Meanwhile, members of the Green family, faced with this denigration campaign, are trying to prove their innocence and restore the truth. As tension rises and alliances develop, each one must navigate in a climate of growing distrust. This conflict highlights the themes of loyalty, revenge and the consequences of manipulation in this city full of surprises.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Bobby and Romy are back at the megalith, hoping to cancel Bobby's curse. But things go wrong when a marsh monster chases them. Worse still, they're being chased by a fierce warrior, who thinks Bobby's curse makes him a threat. They're looking for answers from the mysterious lighthouse guard. Bobby and Romy have to face their double opponents and find a solution before the end of the time.
programme.desc-more: Les Doomies (2026)
programme.desc: Les Doomies (2026)

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Thanks to some clever Maxi-Tools, Mickey, Donald and Dingo are organizing a surprise for Pat's birthday.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: As the harbour festival in Danville approaches, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are not reluctant to test their creativity by building an impressive metal shark. Their bold project draws the attention of their sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), who is determined to prove to their mother that her brothers are doing something incredible. At the same time, the two inventors embark on an intergalactic adventure by going to the Moon to create the most delicious ice cream ever tasted. In another corner of Danville, Irving (Tyler Alexander Mann) is preparing a surprise for Phineas' birthday by making a video clip, while Carl (Dan Povenmire) is embarking on an infiltration mission to spy on the activities of Phineas and Ferb. Finally, the day ends with the grand parade of the Unification of the Three States, where all the creations of the two brothers are put to the honor, mixing magic, inventions and a hint of chaos.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: After being petrified by fear during a traumatic experience, Remy (Chris Houghton) made the decision to transform her life into an expert in martial arts. Motivated by a strong desire to overcome his anxieties, he engages in intensive training, hoping to gain the confidence necessary to face his fears. At the same time, the loss of Cricket's precious earth jar (Marieve Herington) acts as a catalyst, referring it to his childhood memories and the time when the Greens lived peacefully in the countryside. This return to the sources reminds him of the family values and simplicity of rural life. While he juggles his martial learning with his nostalgic reflections, Remy also discovers the importance of friendship and solidarity within his family. With the help of his loved ones, he will have to learn how to combine his new skills with his daily life, while facing the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In a full summer of promises, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to explore the mysteries of time by building a travel machine in the future. Their enthusiasm is quickly tempered when their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale), determined to unmask them, gets hold of this revolutionary invention. Using the machine, it causes a series of unforeseen events that turn their world into a future nightmare. This new future is marked by invasive robots and environmental disasters, a direct result of the actions of Phineas and Ferb. While the brothers try to repair the damage caused by their time experience, they realize that their choices have far wider repercussions than expected. Candice, though initially motivated by the desire to make known the exploits of her brothers, realizes that she also has a crucial role to play in restoring balance in this deranged world.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Meg Birthday Mom / Travel to Candice Center
programme.desc: For their mother's birthday, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are embarking on a grand quest to offer her memorable gifts, which may cause her daughter Candice (Ashley Tisdale) to forget those carefully prepared. Determined not to be overshadowed, Candice strives to do everything possible to thwart the plans of her brothers, hoping to prove to their mother that her gifts are the best. Meanwhile, Phineas and Ferb, still looking for adventure, decided to build a mini submarine to explore the mysterious world that is hidden inside the dog of Isabella (voice of Kelly Hu). However, their experience takes an unexpected turn when they accidentally find themselves inside Candice's body, diving into a fantastic universe where they will have to navigate through his thoughts and emotions. The crazy situations are going on, mixing humour and imagination, while the two brothers try to find their way back and celebrate their mother's birthday in an unforgettable way.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Giant Rat / The Theft of Collars
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this explosive episode of season 4 of "The Greens in Big City", Chip (Chris Houghton) embarks on a Machiavellian plan to avenge the Greens, whom he considers responsible for his misfortunes. Obsessed with destroying their reputation, he worked to manipulate the people of Big City by persuading them that the Greens were responsible for the degradation of their community. To do this, Chip staged deceptive events, orchestrating incidents that put the Greens in an unfavorable light. Meanwhile, members of the Green family, faced with this denigration campaign, are trying to prove their innocence and restore the truth. As tension rises and alliances develop, each one must navigate in a climate of growing distrust. This conflict highlights the themes of loyalty, revenge and the consequences of manipulation in this city full of surprises.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Doomies
programme.desc: Bobby and Romy are back at the megalith, hoping to cancel Bobby's curse. But things go wrong when a marsh monster chases them. Worse still, they're being chased by a fierce warrior, who thinks Bobby's curse makes him a threat. They're looking for answers from the mysterious lighthouse guard. Bobby and Romy have to face their double opponents and find a solution before the end of the time.
programme.desc-more: Les Doomies (2026)
programme.desc: Les Doomies (2026)

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.desc: Max's mom's on a space mission and the teenager's gonna have to learn to live without her. Marinette's looking for an idea to make Max live this separation well.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Thanks to some clever Maxi-Tools, Mickey, Donald and Dingo are organizing a surprise for Pat's birthday.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.
