programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc: The adventures of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales, who join with Superheroes to defeat their enemies and discover that teamwork is the best way to save the situation. The third season introduced a new plot called
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.desc: Vee left Transylvania to integrate a boarding school and to get closer to her musical dream. But by concealing her vampire nature, she finds herself confronted with unforeseen events that risk re-immerse her in the darkness.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: As the harbour festival in Danville approaches, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are not reluctant to test their creativity by building an impressive metal shark. Their bold project draws the attention of their sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), who is determined to prove to their mother that her brothers are doing something incredible. At the same time, the two inventors embark on an intergalactic adventure by going to the Moon to create the most delicious ice cream ever tasted. In another corner of Danville, Irving (Tyler Alexander Mann) is preparing a surprise for Phineas' birthday by making a video clip, while Carl (Dan Povenmire) is embarking on an infiltration mission to spy on the activities of Phineas and Ferb. Finally, the day ends with the grand parade of the Unification of the Three States, where all the creations of the two brothers are put to the honor, mixing magic, inventions and a hint of chaos.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: After being petrified by fear during a traumatic experience, Remy (Chris Houghton) made the decision to transform her life into an expert in martial arts. Motivated by a strong desire to overcome his anxieties, he engages in intensive training, hoping to gain the confidence necessary to face his fears. At the same time, the loss of Cricket's precious earth jar (Marieve Herington) acts as a catalyst, referring it to his childhood memories and the time when the Greens lived peacefully in the countryside. This return to the sources reminds him of the family values and simplicity of rural life. While he juggles his martial learning with his nostalgic reflections, Remy also discovers the importance of friendship and solidarity within his family. With the help of his loved ones, he will have to learn how to combine his new skills with his daily life, while facing the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) discover a mysterious machine that landed in their garden. Intrigued by its futuristic appearance, they decide to apply reverse technology to see what it can do. This choice propels them into a series of unexpected events, while the machine reveals surprising abilities that turn their daily lives into an extraordinary adventure. At the same time, they are trained in a fascinating underwater quest in search of the legendary engulfed city of Atlantis. With the help of their friend Isabella (Alyson Stoner) and their faithful companion Perry the Ornithoryncus, they dive into the depths of the ocean, discovering extraordinary marine creatures and forgotten mysteries. This episode promises to mix humour, imagination and exploration, while captivating young spectators with unexpected twists and lessons on friendship and curiosity.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The honey casa / The dog mayor
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of season 3 of "The Greens in Big City", the children, driven by a spirit of adventure and camaraderie, are developing a bold plan to take over the honey from Bill's hive, a local beekeeper. Cricket (Chris Houghton) and Rémy (Zeno Robinson) take over this exciting mission, determined to overcome all the obstacles that stand in their way. At the same time, another issue is on the horizon: the dog Phoenix, a charismatic and loyal animal, becomes the ideal candidate for municipal elections. Cricket and Rémy, convinced that Phoenix can make positive changes to their city, are launching a frantic campaign to get him elected mayor. Between election strategies and holding-up plans, this episode explores the themes of friendship, ambition and creativity, while offering a good dose of humor and unexpected adventures.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: Tranquil Bill / Rabbits on the farm
programme.desc: In this episode of "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Chris Houghton) discovers that the serenity of the lake brings out the fun and carefree side of his friend Bill. Their complicity is reinforced over the days spent together, where laughter and games seem to drive away the worries of everyday life. However, this tranquillity is threatened when hungry rabbits begin to invade Bill's fields, endangering his precious harvest. Faced with this unexpected invasion, Nancy (Marieve Herington) took charge and decided to call on their friends in the campaign to try to save the situation. Together, they develop a clever plan to keep rodents away while preserving the lake's harmony. This episode highlights the importance of friendship and community in the face of adversity, while providing a touch of humour and tenderness that characterizes the series.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: For whom the beautiful trolls / A divided art house
programme.desc: While Hamster (Michael Cimino) and Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) are preparing for the long-awaited premiere of a film of which they are heroes, a social media influencer, eager for sensational, threatens to tarnish their reputation. The latter, known for his acerbic criticism and his immense reach on the networks, seems ready to do anything to attract attention, including to distort reality to create a drama. In a series of increasingly chaotic events, Hamster and Gretel find themselves being dragged into a spiral of comical and embarrassing incidents that threaten not only their image, but also their friendship. As the first approach, tensions rise, and the duo must unite its forces to overcome this crisis. They will find that friendship and mutual support are the keys to facing challenges, even when media pressure becomes overwhelming.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of the animated series, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to carry out an ambitious project: building a teleporting machine. Their goal is simple: to move instantly from one place to another and to experience new adventures. However, the construction of this farfetched invention will not be a rest, and the two brothers will face unexpected challenges along the way. At the same time, Candice (Ashley Tisdale) is launching a television dance competition with her crush, Jérémy (Tyler Alexander Mann). Enthusiasmous by this opportunity, she is determined to impress her partner and win the competition. However, the evil Dr. Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire) also has his own plans: he wants to take advantage of the show to broadcast his evil message on television. The two intrigues cross as competition and teleportation take an unexpected turn, promising an episode rich in twists and laughter.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: Father-daughter competition / One afternoon with Suzy
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the father of the two boys, eager to spend a moment complicit with them, accidentally discovers the secret of their pet, Perry the Ornithoryncus. To protect Perry's secret identity, he finds himself facing a dilemma: entering a memory eraser, an invention of his sons. Meanwhile, Candice, the boys' sister, was given the custody of Suzy, a little girl she feared she would have to watch over an entire afternoon. At first, Candice thinks that Suzy could be an obstacle to his plans to trap Phineas (Mitchel Musso) and Ferb (Dan Povenmire). However, she quickly discovers that Suzy is more than just a little girl to watch. Indeed, the latter proved to be a valuable ally in his attempts to expose his brothers' wild inventions, transforming their afternoon into an unexpected adventure.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: New Powers / A Hit to Take
programme.desc: In a world where the extraordinary is close to everyday life, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Joey King), two inseparable brothers, find themselves endowed with super powers after an unexpected encounter with aliens. While Hamster flourishes in his new role as superhero, Gretel, full of enthusiasm, embraces this adventure with an overflowing energy. However, their brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), who aspires to be a hero in his own right, is relegated to the role of "collateral damage", which creates tensions within the fratry. As a threatening meteorite moves towards Earth, the differences between Gretel and Kevin's views on how to stop it may jeopardize their mission. Their disagreements and the challenges that result will test their family ties, forcing them to learn to work together and accept their differences to protect their city and save the world.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: The recipe for disaster / Fracasse Maths
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Hamster & Gretel", Kevin and Gretel face a major challenge: saving the family dinner that is going to be catastrophic. As tension rises in the kitchen, Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) faces a cowboy who is as unpredictable as he is fearsome, threatening to disrupt their plans. At the same time, their father, Dave (Matt Jones), is struggling to find the perfect birthday gift for Caroline (Liza Koshy), but his efforts seem doomed to failure. In a whirlwind of comedic events and unpredictable actions, the characters navigate between humour and thrills. The interactions between Kevin (Michael Cimino), Gretel and other family members bring a touch of emotion and camaraderie, while unexpected twists test their ingenuity and determination. This mixture of family adventure and comedy promises to captivate the public, while exploring the themes of responsibility and brotherly love.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of season 4 of "The Greens in Big City", Bill (Chris Houghton) finds himself facing a family dilemma when his daughter Tilly (Marieve Herington) climbs to a tree, stubbornly refusing to go down. His growing concern for Tilly's safety prompted him to consider unorthodox methods to convince her to return to the ground. At the same time, Remy (Zeno Robinson) told Vasquez (Danny Trejo) that he no longer needed protection, a statement that led to a series of unexpected events. Vasquez, determined to understand this change, decided to consult a therapist, seeking to explore the implications of this new dynamic. This episode explores the themes of parenting, autonomy and vulnerability, while highlighting the humorous and touching interactions between the characters. Tensions rise as each protagonist faces his own challenges, making this episode both comical and emotionally rich.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", a documentary on nature reveals the mysteries of Big City, portrayed as a wild and vibrant ecosystem. At the heart of this adventure, Rémy (Chris Houghton), a passionate collector, finds himself in a crisis of existential existence when he discovers that his friend Cricket (Marieve Herington) has taken hold of the rarest and most coveted collection map of all. This moment of revelation triggers a series of reflections on Rémy's devouring passion for collectibles and human relations. As he tries to overcome this disappointment, he embarks on a frantic quest to prove his worth and regain his place in the world of collectors. This episode explores the themes of friendship, rivalry and redefinition of self within a complex and fascinating urban environment.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: Bazaar at the museum / Big work
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: One of Clarabelle's songbirds is missing. It's up to Mickey and his friends to find him so Clarabelle can finish his morning song with them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. programme.sub-title: The clones of Zola / Electro robot fireflies
programme.desc: The adventures of Peter Parker, Gwen Stacy and Miles Morales, who join with Superheroes to defeat their enemies and discover that teamwork is the best way to save the situation. The third season introduced a new plot called
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this dynamic episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inseparable brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to dive into the flamboyant world of fashion by creating their own line of summer clothes. With an overflowing creativity and an unparalleled sense of style, they tackle the design of unique pieces that capture the essence of summer holidays. Meanwhile, their friend Isabella Garcia-Shapiro (Alyson Stoner), recently operated on tonsils, became their muse. In parallel, Perry's plans for the Ornithoryncus (voice of Dan Povenmire), who leads a double life as a secret agent, intersect with the adventures of his young masters. The episode promises an avalanche of laughter, surprises and touching moments as the characters juggle between creative ambition and the hazards of everyday life. A fun exploration of friendship and personal expression in the heart of summer.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is delighted: for some time now, everything seems to be fine in Paris. But she learns that a film is preparing for the script that decredifies Ladybug and Chat Noir.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

And if Spidey finds himself in a difficult situation that requires even more superpowers, no doubt a friend of Avenger will rush to help him. Whether the Spidey team acts alone or assisted by an Avenger, these superheroes will join forces to save the situation! Some flashing sequences or light patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: The shopping center / The art of the Spirit of the Wolf
programme.desc: In this episode of the series "Kiff", Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a young optimistic and energetic, embarks on a bold mission: she trains her group of friends at the mall in the hope of finding a free pretzel. However, this adventure turns out to be more complex than it imagined. By taking over the group, Kiff discovers that leadership involves many responsibilities, including managing dynamics between friends and making crucial decisions. At the same time, Kiff and his faithful companion Barry (Michael Croner) are intrigued by rumours about a ghost wolf that haunts the place. Determined to break this mystery, they are embarking on an investigation that will lead them to meet unexpected characters and face nasty situations. Between friendship, humour and discovery, this episode highlights the challenges of growing up while keeping his spirit of adventure.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this explosive episode of season 4 of "The Greens in Big City", Chip (Chris Houghton) embarks on a Machiavellian plan to avenge the Greens, whom he considers responsible for his misfortunes. Obsessed with destroying their reputation, he worked to manipulate the people of Big City by persuading them that the Greens were responsible for the degradation of their community. To do this, Chip staged deceptive events, orchestrating incidents that put the Greens in an unfavorable light. Meanwhile, members of the Green family, faced with this denigration campaign, are trying to prove their innocence and restore the truth. As tension rises and alliances develop, each one must navigate in a climate of growing distrust. This conflict highlights the themes of loyalty, revenge and the consequences of manipulation in this city full of surprises.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Nelson, Loïc and Ray are being akumatized to destroy the love between Marinette and Adrien. The three super-villains will do everything they can to break their couple.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: One of Clarabelle's songbirds is missing. It's up to Mickey and his friends to find him so Clarabelle can finish his morning song with them.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: To celebrate the anniversary of Phineas (Vincent Martella), Irving, the best friend of the two brothers, is embarking on an ambitious project: to make a memorable video clip in honour of Phineas. He called on Baljeet (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), the genius of technology, Isabella (Ashley Tisdale), the neighbor in love with Phineas, and Buford (Dan Povenmire), the soft hearted force, to help him conceive this surprise. Meanwhile, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), Phineas' sister, sees this as a golden opportunity to accumulate evidence to expose her brothers and prove to their mother that their farfetched inventions are not just child games. The tension rises as the group makes every effort to create a clip that captures the spirit of adventure and creativity of Phineas, while struggling with Candice's plans that threatens to ruin everything.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: The Greens, an eccentric and endearing family, make the decision to leave Big City to return to their farm in the countryside, hoping to reconnect with the simplicity and authenticity of their past. However, their return is far from the sweet dream they had imagined. Upon arriving, they discover that their former haven of peace has radically changed, and the idyllic memories of their childhood fade in the face of a disconcerting reality. The landscapes are unrecognizable, and relations with the former neighbours are tinted with a feeling of strangeness. The Greens must then navigate through unexpected challenges and comical misunderstandings that test their family unity. Between the longing for past days and adapting to an uncertain present, each family member must learn to redefine what really means "to go home". Laughters and tears mix as the Greens try to regain their place in a world that has evolved without them.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Heroic brotherly rivalry / The goat is a mystery!
programme.desc: In a world where the ordinary is close to the extraordinary, Hamster and Gretel, two brothers united by an unfailing bond, receive super powers from a mysterious race of aliens. While Gretel (Melissa Povenmire) embraces her new role as superhero with enthusiasm and determination, her brother Kevin (Michael Cimino), although not having received any powers, finds himself in a delicate position, acting as "collateral damage" to their adventures. While a meteorite threatens to crash into their city, a divergence of opinion is emerging between Kevin and Gretel on how best to deal with this imminent crisis. Kevin, a pragmatic, advocates a strategic approach, while Gretel, driven by his boldness, leans for direct intervention. This fraternal rivalry puts their relationship to the test, while they must learn to collaborate to save their community. Between humour, action and life lessons, this episode explores the complex dynamics between power, responsibility and family ties.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this dynamic episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inseparable brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to dive into the flamboyant world of fashion by creating their own line of summer clothes. With an overflowing creativity and an unparalleled sense of style, they tackle the design of unique pieces that capture the essence of summer holidays. Meanwhile, their friend Isabella Garcia-Shapiro (Alyson Stoner), recently operated on tonsils, became their muse. In parallel, Perry's plans for the Ornithoryncus (voice of Dan Povenmire), who leads a double life as a secret agent, intersect with the adventures of his young masters. The episode promises an avalanche of laughter, surprises and touching moments as the characters juggle between creative ambition and the hazards of everyday life. A fun exploration of friendship and personal expression in the heart of summer.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: While Kevin is on a quest to find a new secret den, Hamster and Gretel are facing each other with two mysterious workers with formidable psychic powers. These unexpected opponents, who seem to come from another world, threaten the tranquillity of their neighbourhood. To deal with this threat, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Emma Ramos) must unite and strengthen their skills, while learning to master their own powers. In this tense context, Tobor (Beck Bennett), the robot coach, plays a crucial role in guiding them and helping them develop strategies to counter their enemies. As tension rises and danger approaches, our heroes will have to draw from their inner resources and show courage to protect their city from an alien threat that could change the course of history.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Hamster & Gretel", the Destroyer, a fearful super-villain, finds herself facing an unprecedented crisis. His Machiavellic plan is threatened by the emergence of a superpowering artificial intelligence (AI) that is interfering with his world. As tensions rise and danger approaches, Gretel discovers unexpected truths about her own abilities and the nature of technology. This captivating episode mixes action, humour and lessons about fraternity, while questioning our relationship to technology and artificial intelligence.

programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Hamster & Gretel", the school is plunged into panic when a mysterious monster threatens to disrupt the peace of the students. While Gretel and Hamster join forces to solve this mystery, they will also face unexpected trials, testing their courage and ingenuity. The episode promises a mixture of humour, adventure and suspense, while exploring the themes of friendship and solidarity in the face of the unknown.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: High-risk delivery / Not very on horseback
programme.desc: In this exciting episode of the series, the Green family finds themselves in a messy situation when they decide to order a pizza. As the attractive smell of delivery begins to invade their home, Tilly (Marieve Herington), the youngest in the family, finds herself confronted with an unexpected phobia: she hates horses. This unexpected aversion for equidae will take on hilarious proportions when the pizza order comes with an unexpected equestrian event in the neighborhood. Family members, each with their unique personality, try to support Tilly while juggling the complications that this situation imposes on them. Between whoproquos and moments of frank laugh, this episode brilliantly illustrates the family dynamics and small crises of everyday life, while addressing themes of acceptance and humour in the face of irrational fears.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, life seems peaceful for the adorable Bitsy kittens, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy, who spend their days playing and lounging in the Purr 'N' Play space. However, this tranquillity is often disturbed by the arrival of wicked determined to sow chaos. When troubles arise, these four friends become SuperChatons, feline heroes who do not hesitate to defend the animals and the inhabitants of their city. With impressive superpowers, cat-martre gadgets and unwavering team spirit, they face antagonists such as Mr. Puppypaws, Lab Rat, Cat Burglar and Zsa-Zsa. Their mission is to correct the wrongs and make the world more cat-like, while showing kindness and empathy. Together, the SuperChatons prove that even the smallest can accomplish great things when they act with courage and solidarity.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends clean the Garden with their maxi tools. Once the cleaning is done, they enjoy their little party by the pool.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb, two brothers who are full of imagination, are delighted to spend the summer with their grandparents in the countryside. Accompanied by their friends, they are embarking on an ambitious project: to renovate two tree huts to make them extraordinary play places. While Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are implementing their creative plans, their sister Candace (Ashley Tisdale) does not lose a second to try to report them to their mother. At the same time, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a luscious inventor, is concocting a new Machiavellic plan to dominate the city, while his eternal rival, Agent P (Perry the Ornithorync), is preparing to face it. The adventures of Phineas and Ferb take an unpredictable turn, mixing laughter, fraternal rivalries and unbridled creativity, while every day is the occasion of a new farfetched invention and a dose of unexpected.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Max's mom's on a space mission and the teenager's gonna have to learn to live without her. Marinette's looking for an idea to make Max live this separation well.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: In a colorful and adventure-filled universe, Kiff, a young creature full of life, finds herself in a delicate situation when her magical hat disappears. This hat is not just an accessory: it is the key to the self-confidence of his friend Barry (Michael Croner), who relies on him to believe in his own abilities. Determined to restore this confidence, Kiff embarks on a frantic quest to find the hat, exploring unexpected places and meeting colorful characters. At the same time, Kiff and Barry are confronted with another mystery: a lost diary whose personal content could endanger the privacy of its owner. Together, they must navigate through the challenges of friendship, trust and responsibility, while ensuring that the newspaper's secrets remain well-kept, for the good of all in their small town.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: A demonic family / The Green Incognito
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", the Green family finds itself confronted with a delicate situation that causes them to hide. Chip (Chris Houghton), the most eccentric member of the family, takes the initiative to recruit unexpected help to deal with imminent danger. As tensions rise and family secrets begin to emerge, each Green member must navigate through rock-capped situations and hilarious quiproquos. Marieve Herington embodies the determination of the matriarch, who, although panicked, tries to keep the family morale intact. Meanwhile, Artemis Pebdani and Bob Joles bring a touch of humour and chaos, making their camouflage plan even more farfetched. The challenges that confront them force them to rediscover the importance of family solidarity, even when circumstances seem desperate.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends clean the Garden with their maxi tools. Once the cleaning is done, they enjoy their little party by the pool.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.sub-title: The sand maze / An animated carnival
programme.desc: In a world where superheroes are living alongside daily life, Peter Parker (Benjamin Valic), Miles Morales (Jakari Fraser) and Gwen Stacy (Lily Sanfelippo) face a major challenge. While a colourful and lively carnival takes place in the city, an unexpected event disturbs this festive atmosphere. A series of misdeeds orchestrated by formidable enemies not only threatens visitor safety, but also the integrity of attractions. The three friends, united by their determination and respective skills, engage in a thrilling adventure to thwart the Machiavellical plans of these opponents. By sailing through rides, games and treats, they must not only use their powers, but also their ingenuity to restore order and ensure the safety of their fellow citizens. As this quest progresses, bonds of friendship are strengthened and lessons of courage and solidarity emerge, while keeping the mystery of the true intentions of their enemies.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Max's mom's on a space mission and the teenager's gonna have to learn to live without her. Marinette's looking for an idea to make Max live this separation well.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The One-Day Tour of the World
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb are already arriving at half their vacation and feel they have not yet taken advantage of it. For the longest day of the year, they want to hit hard and start, together with their friends, to embark on a round the world.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "The Greens in Big City", the Green family goes to the beach for a relaxing day, but things are quickly taking an unexpected turn. Cricket (Luke Lowe), always looking for entertainment, decides to play a prank with the bathers, hoping to create laughter and fun. However, his joke plans are met with unforeseen consequences, putting the peace of the beach at risk and leading to nasty and chaotic situations. At the same time, in the "Cricket puppeteer" segment, Cricket discovers a new intriguing ability: he can penetrate into his family's dreams and exert a malicious influence. As he interferes with the unconscious of his loved ones, he turns their dreams into real nightmares, causing tensions and strife within the home. This episode explores with humour the themes of family, imagination and the repercussions of jokes, while offering hilarious moments and unexpected lessons.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Phineas et Ferb", entitled "Le gîte-inateur / Le rodeo de robots", the two brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), embark on an unprecedented adventure that combines innovation and fun. On the one hand, Ferb's chameleon, after having been accidentally touched by the ray of the giant-inator of the infamous Doofensmirtz, undergoes a spectacular transformation, taking the size of a dinosaur. This unexpected change leads to a series of hilarious peripetias while the chameleon, which has become giant, sows chaos in the garden. On the other hand, Phineas and Ferb, always looking for original activities, organize a rodeo of robots, where the machines compete in spectacular events. This technological duel promises to captivate their friends and create memorable moments. Between the escape of the chameleon and the futuristic rodeo, the two intrigues intertwine to offer a day full of surprises and laughter.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: The Art of Conduct / The Hidden Face of the Moon
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series, Candice (Ashley Tisdale) is embarking on a course on "the art of directing", which provides him with ingenious strategies to finally trap his brothers, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster). In parallel, they are embarking on an ambitious project: the construction of an all-terrain vehicle, combining creativity and ingenuity, which promises to lead them towards new adventures. As Candice implements his new skills to upset his brothers' plans, the situation is taking an unexpected turn. In another intrigue, Phineas and Ferb set an even greater goal: to erect the highest tower in the world. Candice, determined to arrest them, appealed to his new servant knight, Albert, to help him in his quest. The confrontations between the brothers and their sister promise hilarious twists and moments of tension, while highlighting the unique family dynamics that characterize the series.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: To celebrate their parents' wedding anniversary, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) decided to make an ambitious project: to reform an iconic 80s rock band, the Love Händel. Enthusiastic, the two brothers tackle the task with the determination and creativity that characterize them, bringing together their friends and using all the resources at their disposal to bring this musical dream to life. Meanwhile, their sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), is embarking on a mission to arrest them and prove to their parents that his brothers are preparing a great surprise. At the same time, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire) is developing a new Machiavellic plan, disrupting the boys' efforts. In a series of hilarious twists, music, friendship and fraternal rivalry mix together, creating a memorable adventure that celebrates the power of rock'n'roll and childish creativity.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: Enigmes, more puzzles / One day of restraint
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "Kiff", Kiff (Kimiko Glenn) and his friend Barry (Michael Croner) find themselves on an unexpected adventure when they decide to help a local troll in distress. The latter, although attached, proves to be a master of complex guesses, plunging our heroes into a series of puzzles that test their ingenuity and friendship. After having been restrained for a reason still unclear, Kiff and Barry meet a diverse team of students, each with their own talents and personalities. Together, they are developing a bold plan to escape this delicate situation. Between laughter, twists and lessons on camaraderie, this episode explores the themes of solidarity and creativity, while maintaining a light and fun tone. The characters reveal themselves in a new light, enriching the colorful and staggered universe of "Kiff".
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 6 of the Miraculous series, the adventures of Ladybug and Chat Noirs, with Anouck Oboe, Benjamin Bollen, Antoine Tomé
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends celebrate Hot Dog Day. As Willie the Giant cannot stay with them, they decide to surprise him and bring him a giant hot dog.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.sub-title: Spidey cleans up / no touch to tomatoes!
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Spidey and his extraordinary friends," Peter Parker (Benjamin Valic), Miles Morales (Jakari Fraser) and Gwen Stacy (Lily Sanfelippo) join forces to face a new threat to New York. While the city is in a state of turmoil, a series of disasters caused by formidable supervillains, including the dreaded Vulture, are taking place on the inhabitants. Young heroes must not only face these enemies, but also learn to work together effectively to protect their loved ones and restore order in the city. As they come to life, they discover the importance of friendship and mutual trust. While Miles uses his spider skills for bold maneuvers, Gwen is demonstrating tactical intelligence to develop strategies. Peter, as a mentor, must juggle his responsibility as a superhero with his teenage life. This epic fight will test their skills and solidarity, while confronting them with difficult choices.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: When the Greens welcomed Mamie (Wendi McLendon-Covey) and Rémy (Danny Trejo) to Big City, the atmosphere was emotional. The family is determined to enjoy every moment with their loved ones before saying goodbye. As Grandma strives to convey her wise advice of life, Rémy, with her sparkling humour, is involved in local activities that make the community laugh and gather. However, the pressure of the imminent farewells weighs heavily on each other's shoulders. Children, including the frenetic and inventive Casey (Marieve Herington), are trying to create unforgettable memories, while their father, the pragmatic and caring Green (Chris Houghton), is concerned about how to manage this separation. Over the days, tensions are emerging, secrets are revealed and bonds are strengthened, transforming these farewells into a celebration of family relationships and shared memories. The Greens learn that every end can also be a new beginning.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: SuperChatons and Bitsy shovel / SuperChatons and intensive training.
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and lively world, the SuperChatons, a group of fearless and resourceful kittens, find themselves confronted with an unexpected situation when Bitsy, one of their members, causes an incident by accidentally cloned with the help of an invention by Rastic. Bitsy's clones, though cute, turn out to be little troublemakers, sowing disorder and making the daily life of the SuperChatons chaotic. In the face of this crisis, the team must show solidarity and ingenuity to thwart the clones' plans and restore order in their neighbourhood. At the same time, Zsa-Zsa, a bold SuperChaton, embarks on an unexpected adventure by flying the Super-Robochaton. She hopes to escape the intense training she fears so much. This mix of humour and action will test the team spirit of the SuperChatons, who will have to overcome their differences to save their friend and regain harmony.
