programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In the colorful and sparkling world of Bluey, a young blue bitch, the daily adventure takes a playful and imaginative turn. Accompanied by her little sister Bingo, Bluey transforms everyday situations into captivating games. When Bluey receives an invitation to a birthday party, the excitement is at its peak. However, Bingo, with his magical pen, complicates the preparations by introducing unexpected and fanciful elements that test the patience of the whole family. At the same time, their father, Bandit (David McCormack), is confronted with the challenges of daily life when he has to drive his daughters to school. The two little bitches, with their overly creativeness, will not fail to imagine hilarious and surprising scenarios, making each moment memorable. Through games that reflect their daily lives, Bluey and Bingo learn valuable lessons about friendship, family and imagination, while bringing joy and laughter to those around them.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the animated series "Phineas et Ferb", our heroes, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decide to transform their garden into a real circus. With the help of their friends, they set up a series of spectacular attractions, ranging from bold acrobatics to enchanting magic numbers, thus attracting the attention of the children of the neighborhood. Meanwhile, their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale) is facing an unexpected situation: an allergy to mimosas that gives him a serious and comical voice, which complicates his attempts to denounce the exploits of his brothers. At the same time, Phineas and Ferb imagine a new toy inspired by their ornithorynical friend, Perry, who promises to be the best on the market. The two intrigues intersect in a fun way, illustrating the spirit of invention and adventure that characterizes this series, while highlighting fraternal relationships and the challenges of everyday life.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.sub-title: The melody of Helen / The joys of the supermarket
programme.desc: In the vibrant atmosphere of Table Town College, students are about to experience a new experience: the creation of their first musical dedicated to Helen, an emblematic figure in their community. Young artists, all more enthusiastic than others, are involved in this ambitious project, which aims to pay tribute to their comrade, while discovering the challenges and joys of the stage. At the same time, the Chatterley family embarks on its traditional weekly trip to the supermarket. However, their release quickly turns into a series of unexpected misadventures. The crazy encounters and absurd situations are linked, testing each other's patience and creativity. As the musical and the shopping at the supermarket cross, the characters will learn that the real magic lies in the bonds they weave and the unexpected that mark their daily lives.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.sub-title: Santa Claus chocolate / Happiness is in the Pre
programme.desc: In the middle of summer, Big City's small town is preparing to host an outdoor festival, promising laughter and festivities. However, Cricket (Marieve Herington), in charge of the famous chocolate Santa Claus for Bill (Bob Joles), is facing a major challenge: creating a new chocolate that will capture the festive spirit while meeting the expectations of the community. While she hopes to enjoy a peaceful weekend in the countryside at Grandma's (Artemis Pebdani), her plans are disturbed by the effervescence of the festival that attracts a bigarrée crowd. Between chaotic preparations and unexpected interactions with visitors, Cricket must juggle with the pressure of his responsibilities and the desire to please his family. This weekend promises to become a memorable adventure, where creativity and tradition intertwine, and where each character plays a key role in this summer celebration.

With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: Phineas and Ferb are embarking on a new effort to create roller coasters. But this time, they imagine a colorful music version.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the inventor brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), decided to take up a new challenge by building an artificial biosphere. Their aim is to allow a group of scouts to win new badges, even in the event of torrential rain. As they implement their bold plan, their project quickly takes on unexpected dimensions, mixing science, adventure and a good dose of humor. At the same time, Candice Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), Phineas' sister, finds herself in a difficult situation. She promised her best friend Stacy to spend a day with girls, but she was forced to juggle her friendly obligations with her boyfriend, which made her schedule difficult. Quiproquos and twists are bound up, offering a mixture of adventure and comedy, while stressing the importance of friendly and family relations.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: As the harbour festival in Danville approaches, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are not reluctant to test their creativity by building an impressive metal shark. Their bold project draws the attention of their sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), who is determined to prove to their mother that her brothers are doing something incredible. At the same time, the two inventors embark on an intergalactic adventure by going to the Moon to create the most delicious ice cream ever tasted. In another corner of Danville, Irving (Tyler Alexander Mann) is preparing a surprise for Phineas' birthday by making a video clip, while Carl (Dan Povenmire) is embarking on an infiltration mission to spy on the activities of Phineas and Ferb. Finally, the day ends with the grand parade of the Unification of the Three States, where all the creations of the two brothers are put to the honor, mixing magic, inventions and a hint of chaos.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: To celebrate the anniversary of Phineas (Vincent Martella), Irving, the best friend of the two brothers, is embarking on an ambitious project: to make a memorable video clip in honour of Phineas. He called on Baljeet (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), the genius of technology, Isabella (Ashley Tisdale), the neighbor in love with Phineas, and Buford (Dan Povenmire), the soft hearted force, to help him conceive this surprise. Meanwhile, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), Phineas' sister, sees this as a golden opportunity to accumulate evidence to expose her brothers and prove to their mother that their farfetched inventions are not just child games. The tension rises as the group makes every effort to create a clip that captures the spirit of adventure and creativity of Phineas, while struggling with Candice's plans that threatens to ruin everything.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", a documentary on nature reveals the mysteries of Big City, portrayed as a wild and vibrant ecosystem. At the heart of this adventure, Rémy (Chris Houghton), a passionate collector, finds himself in a crisis of existential existence when he discovers that his friend Cricket (Marieve Herington) has taken hold of the rarest and most coveted collection map of all. This moment of revelation triggers a series of reflections on Rémy's devouring passion for collectibles and human relations. As he tries to overcome this disappointment, he embarks on a frantic quest to prove his worth and regain his place in the world of collectors. This episode explores the themes of friendship, rivalry and redefinition of self within a complex and fascinating urban environment.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The meaning of the dollar / The true cry
programme.desc: To prove to his parents that he has a true sense of business, Rémy (Chris Houghton) embarks on the entrepreneurial adventure by setting up his own business. This initiative, though ambitious, is in reality a deep need for recognition and affection from his family. At the same time, Bill (Zeno Robinson), feeling neglected and isolated, seeks comfort from a group of ravens, establishing an unexpected connection with these malicious birds. As Rémy tries to navigate the complex world of business, he discovers the challenges of responsibility and the trials of failure. Bill, for his part, finds a form of camaraderie in this singular friendship, offering him a new insight into the notion of family and belonging. Both characters, each in their own way, will have to learn to overcome their feelings of loneliness and redefine what it really means to be surrounded by those they love.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: La Sombrerona / Two girls, a guy and Düm's advice
programme.desc: In a park of energy-stimulating attractions, a mysterious woman appears, inciting curiosity and distrust among visitors. Bailey and Gretel, two young adventurers who can't be separated, decide to spend an unforgettable day at Nordle, a park renowned for its spectacular rides and delusional attractions. As they immerse themselves in the fascinating universe of the park, they begin to notice strange events surrounding this enigmatic woman, who seems to have a particular connection to the mysteries of the park. In parallel, Bailey and Gretel are searching for the secrets of this intruder while enjoying the attractions and shows that make Nordle famous. Laughter and excitement mix with an atmosphere of increasing tension, while the two friends discover that what lies behind the woman's smile may well upset their day in unexpected ways.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.sub-title: Nano a Nano / The Unnatural History of Dr. MedusaSaurus
programme.desc: During a school trip to a robotics factory, young Kelly, a Gretel comrade (Melissa Povenmire), accidentally finds herself under the influence of a nanorobot, resulting in unexpected and comical events. Meanwhile, Kevin (Michael Cimino) and his loyal companion Hamster are trying to help their friend Fred get rid of disturbing memories of past battles. However, they discover that one of these memories is particularly tenacious, making their mission more complex than they anticipated. At the same time, at the Natural History Museum, an even more disturbing situation is taking place. Extraterrestrials, in a daring act, managed to awaken the deceased paleontologist, Dr. Medusa Saurus. The latter, reinvigorated by mysterious energy, is unleashed alongside an army of reanimated fossils, threatening to plunge the museum into chaos. While the protagonists have to deal with both crises, friendship, bravery and ingenuity will be tested in a thrilling adventure.

programme.sub-title: The evil key / One ornithorync can hide another
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series, Phineas and Ferb, the two brothers overflowing with imagination, decide to build a revolutionary supercomputer. Their goal? Find out what could make their mother happy, Linda. As they tackle this ambitious project, their sister, Candace (Ashley Tisdale), is not missing an opportunity to try to expose them to their mother, convinced that they will once again go beyond the limits of absurdity. At the same time, the Ornithoryncus Agent P (Dee Bradley Baker) is embarking on a mission to counter the machiavelic plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), who has concocted a new gadget intended to sow chaos. In another adventure, Phineas and Ferb take the direction of the Moon, where they strive to create the most delicious ice creams in the universe. The two intrigues meet in a whirlwind of humour, inventiveness and surprises, typical of this outmoded universe.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In a thrilling episode of the animated series, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are launching the creation of an ultra-modern mobile phone with voice teletransporter functionality, specifically designed for their sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale). This episode promises hilarious twists and lessons on creativity and family.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: As the Grant-Gomez prepare to spend a family game evening, the atmosphere is friendly and laughter. However, Fred (Michael Cimino) and Hiromi (Carolina Ravassa) face an unexpected threat: an army of robots programmed to take over their high school. As they try to thwart the plans of these malicious machines, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) and Gretel (Joey King) are being dragged into a strange situation. Hypnotized by the catchy jingle of a new cereal for breakfast, they find themselves in a state of trance, temporarily forgetting their heroic mission. The evening then turns into an unpredictable adventure, where humour and action mix, testing the family ties and team spirit of the protagonists. Between board games and fighting against robots, each member of the family will have to show courage and ingenuity to overcome this double threat.
programme.desc-more: In an ordinary city, Gretel, a sparkling teenager, finds herself at the heart of an extraordinary adventure when she and her hamster, a little companion named Hamtaro, are accidentally endowed with superpowers by aliens. Together, they form an unlikely yet complementary duo, combining intelligence and agility. As Gretel discovers the limits and abilities of her new powers, she also faces the challenges of a girl's daily life, juggling between school, friends and family. Hamtaro, meanwhile, became a mischievous partner, ready to help him in his new missions. Together, they commit themselves to protecting their city from the threats that arise, whether they be intergalactic bad guys or more common but equally dangerous situations. As they go on their journeys, Gretel learns not only to master his abilities, but also the value of friendship, courage and responsibility.

programme.title: Hamster & Gretel
programme.desc: After an epic confrontation with a dreadful villain, Hamster (Melissa Povenmire) suddenly finds himself amnesia, losing all her memories and heroic abilities. As he navigates this new and confusing reality, his sister Gretel (Joey King) and their friend Nordle face an equally strange situation. They meet a mysterious scone, with surprising powers and an eccentric personality. This scone, which seems to know a lot about Hamster's past, may well hold the key to restore his memory. Together, Gretel and Nordle try to understand the nature of this powerful scone, while trying to help Hamster regain her identity and abilities. Between the baffled adventures and the lessons on the importance of memory and friendship, this episode promises to plunge the spectators into a world where the magic of the scones and the challenges of amnesia meet unexpectedly.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Cricket (Marieve Herington) finds himself facing a serious creative block as he prepares to celebrate the traditional April Fish. He was accustomed to being the band's farcer, and felt compelled by the pressure to concoct a memorable joke, which plunged him into a state of growing frustration. Meanwhile, Bill (Chris Houghton), his father's protector, hides a secret from his mischievous daughter, Tilly (Artemis Pebdani), who convinced her that everything was fine as he struggled with his own concerns. As preparations for this day of jokes intensify, family tensions rise and hidden truths begin to emerge. Between Cricket's attempts to overcome his blockage and Bill's lies that threaten to change everything, this episode explores the themes of creativity, trust and family relations, all in a humorous and touching setting.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The Seed Thief / The Douched Dumpster
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Mickey and his friends clean the Garden with their maxi tools. Once the cleaning is done, they enjoy their little party by the pool.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In the great disarray of Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), their summer projects are disrupted when their sister Candice (Ashley Tisdale) finally manages to convince their mother, Linda, that her brothers are troublemakers. As a result, the two boys were sent to a reform camp to try to correct their unacceptable behaviour. Meanwhile, Candice sees this as a golden opportunity to get rid of her brothers, but she does not know that they will not remain inactive. With their usual ingenuity, Phineas and Ferb plan to transform their stay into an unforgettable adventure. At the same time, their sworn enemy, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), is developing a new evil plan to conquer the world, which could interfere with the boys' plans. Events are going on as summer turns unexpected, mixing laughter, inventions and twists.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The bone bandand / has the continuation of the cheese mill
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Kiff
programme.desc: Kiff, a young student full of determination and enthusiasm, aspires to enter the teachers' room, a place that symbolizes authority and knowledge for her. However, her ambition is tested when she finds herself facing an unexpected challenge: she must succeed in her personal assistant training course organized by Helen, the head of the institution. Inside this room, Kiff discovers a complex world where teachers share not only their knowledge, but also their doubts and rivalries. While she desperately tries to fail this internship to avoid a test of orientation she fears, she realizes that the dynamics of power and human relations are much more complicated than she had imagined. Between surprising encounters and unexpected revelations, Kiff will have to navigate this educational microcosm while remaining faithful to herself.
programme.desc-more: In the charming mountainous city of Table-Ville, an enchanting universe is unfolding where animals and magical creatures coexist in perfect harmony. Kiff (Kimiko Glenn), a squirrel in the heart of gold, and Barry (Michael Croner), a soft, nonchalant rabbit, are the best inseparable friends who discover the joys and challenges of school life. Together, they navigate a world of eccentric and colorful characters, each bringing their own touch of magic to their daily lives. As they learn to know each other and accept each other, Kiff and Barry find themselves confronted with unforeseen situations that test their friendship. Between thrilling adventures and life lessons, the two friends will have to show courage and solidarity to overcome the obstacles that stand in their way. Their journey will lead them to discover the true meaning of friendship and acceptance in a world as fantastic as it is complex.

programme.desc: Fearing that he would not like her if she didn't accompany her to the movies, Marinette overcomes her phobia to go see a horror movie with Adrien.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: This funny and sincere look at modern family life celebrates how creative games help to shape children. Bluey, an Australian puppy-poy, has a mind-blowing imagination and loves to turn daily life into fun adventures. She and her little sister Bingo are embarking on exploring their world, using the game to overcome their fears and try to play adult roles. They are more pleased with nothing than to train their parents, especially their father, in their games. Mom, Chilli, went back to work, and Dad, Bandit, juggles between child care and telework. But if he thinks he's the one who commands it, it's the girls who lead the dance when it comes to playing, but also for everything else!

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.sub-title: The Battle of Robots Against Octopus / The Ultra Powerful Battery
programme.desc: Spidey, our favourite flyer, joins Ghost-Spider (Gwen Stacey) and Miles Morales to form the Spidey team. They will all be assisted by Trace-E, the amusing and faithful Spider-robot of Spidey. And if Spidey finds himself in a difficult situation that requires even more superpowers, no doubt a friend of Avenger will rush to help him. Whether the Spidey team acts alone or assisted by an Avenger, these superheroes will join forces to save the situation! Some flashing sequences or light patterns may affect photosensitive viewers.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.title: Waverly Place: the new sorcerers
programme.desc: In season 2, Billie is confronted with the fact that belonging to the Russo family could be more complicated than she thought, especially since she is no longer the only witch in the house. Thanks to the new magical powers of Roman and Milo, Justin now has to train three young sorcerers for the family witchcraft competition. As the stakes intensify within and outside the family, a new mysterious threat emerges, which could destroy Russo forever.
programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

But in the lighthouse, Bobby, Doug and Kim face a freezing siege. Romy, stuck with his authoritarian family, must be able to get away with it alone. Will she be able to convince her family to help her destroy the knights once and for all?

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.sub-title: At the Stone Age / The Doof Dynasty
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", the two intrepid brothers, Phineas (Vincent Martella) and Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), embark on a prehistoric adventure by inventing revolutionary creations such as wheel and automobile, defying the limits of their time. In parallel, a temporal leap leads them to the 16th century in China, where the evil Doofus Kahn (Dan Povenmire) took away the beautiful Princess Isabella (Ashley Tisdale). In this tumultuous time, Perry the Ornithoryncus (voice of Richard O'Brien), now master kung-fu, stands up against the forces of evil. With the help of Phineas and Ferb, he developed a bold plan to save Isabella from Doofus Kahn's claws. Between prehistoric inventions and epic fighting, this episode combines humour and action, while highlighting the ingenuity of the characters and their unwavering friendship in times of very different stakes.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.sub-title: The Epi-Browse / Rodeo Mounting of Sheep
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Tilly Green (Marieve Herington) disagrees with family traditions during his epi-breast, a symbolic event that marks the transition to adulthood. His decision to derogate from established rites caused the anger of his grandmother (Wendi McLendon-Covey), who saw this break as an infringement of family heritage. At the same time, his brother Cricket (Chris Houghton) has a dream of becoming an expert in sheep rodeo. However, his enthusiasm led him to a series of hilarious misadventures as he found himself trapped in an endless set of challenges related to his training. This episode skillfully blends humour and tenderness, illustrating the generational struggles within the Green family, while highlighting the individual aspirations that drive them. The tensions between tradition and modernity create a rich and dynamic context for the characters.
programme.desc-more: Les Green à Big City (2017)
programme.desc: Les Green à Big City (2017)

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series, Tilly (Marieve Herington) decides to go to the mall in the hope of finding a new, more mature look that reflects her desire to grow. In search of her identity, she explores various shops, trying to suit various styles while navigating the challenges of adolescence. At the same time, Cricket (Chris Houghton) persuaded his father, Bill (Bob Joles), to invest in a revolutionary farm robot. The latter, designed to facilitate agricultural tasks, promises to reduce Bill's workload considerably, which often feels overwhelmed by the demands of farm life. As Tilly experimented with his transformation, Cricket's adventures with the robot took an unexpected turn, mixing humor and crazy situations. This episode explores the themes of personal growth and family relations while providing a fun look at modern technology applied to rural life.

programme.title: Phineas and Ferb
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Phineas and Ferb", entitled "The Tank Race", the two inseparable brothers, Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), are organizing a spectacularly ambitious tank race. With the help of their friends, they build unique and colourful vehicles, each more extravagant than the previous one, in order to win the title of champion. Meanwhile, their older sister, Candice Flynn (Ashley Tisdale), sees this as a golden opportunity to prove to their parents that her brothers' strenuous activities are not just children's games. She is therefore part of a reality TV program entitled "Tele imprêtality", determined to reveal their secret projects in the open. Tensions are rising as the race becomes more intense, mixing rivalries, surprises and a lot of hilarious twists. Who will win the victory and who will succeed in breaking the truth?
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is convinced that Nora and her colleague Brindille have feelings for each other, but they dare not say so, at the risk of falling behind love.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: SuperChatons
programme.sub-title: The Seed Thief / The Douched Dumpster
programme.desc: Bitsy, Ginny, Sparks and Buddy are... SuperChatons! Redressing the wrongs wherever they are, this feline quartet has the mission of making the world a better and more cat-lit place.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.desc: The SuperChatons and Willa prevent Mr.Petits Pattes from stealing a diamond duck hidden in the jungle. Then they help Zsa-Zsa, who is convinced that he saw a monster.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Kittydale, an unexpected event attracts the attention of the inhabitants: a series of small daily problems begin to disrupt the peaceful life of the feline community. When the situation becomes critical, four adorable kittens become superheroes, each with extraordinary skills. They are ready to respond to the call of their fellow citizens in difficulty, whether it is to find a lost toy, to resolve a conflict between friends or to help a neighbour in need. These kittens, armed with their courage and ingenuity, demonstrate that even the most formidable challenges can be overcome with kindness, friendship and a hint of creativity. As they come together, they will learn the importance of teamwork and solidarity, while proving that the real power lies in the small altruistic actions of everyday life. Kittydale will never be the same thanks to these hair heroes again.

programme.title: Miraculous, Ladybug and Black Cat adventures
programme.desc: Marinette is convinced that Nora and her colleague Brindille have feelings for each other, but they dare not say so, at the risk of falling behind love.
programme.desc-more: In the vibrant heart of Paris, Marinette Dupain-Cheng (Anouck Oboe) and Adrien Agreste (Benjamin Bollen), two teenagers with apparently normal lives, become superheroes to protect their city from threats to it. When the evil Papillon began to sow chaos by turning Parisians into supervillains thanks to Akumas, Marinette took on the role of Ladybug, while Adrien became a Black Cat. Together, they form a dynamic team, but their secret identities complicate their relationship. Marinette, in love with Adrien, does not know that her precious Black Cat is in reality the one she desires, while Adrien, captivated by Ladybug, does not know that she is the classmate he admires. As the episodes unfold, the two heroes will not only have to fight formidable enemies, but also navigate the meanderings of friendship, love and mysteries that surround their double lives.

programme.title: Mickey+'s house
programme.desc: Clarabelle teaches Minnie, Daisy and Dingo how to become strong and courageous knights.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Mickey Mouse (Tress MacNeille) and his friends, Minnie, Donald, Dingo and Daisy, are about to experience a multitude of exciting adventures that celebrate friendship, mutual help and imagination. Each episode of this dynamic series invites young spectators to participate in fun challenges, where they will have to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles with the help of their favorite characters. Mickey's friends encourage children to interact, sing and dance while learning valuable lessons about collaboration and creativity. In each adventure, the characters encounter enchanted surprises and unforeseen situations that prompt them to think critically and work together. With exciting songs and moments of contagious laughter, Mickey and his band create a magical universe where fun and learning go hand in hand, captivating young minds throughout their journeys.

programme.title: The Greens in Big City
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series "The Greens in Big City", Tilly, a young girl full of imagination, finds herself in a delicate situation as she tries to impress her new friend. To do this, she tells her a fascinating story about the gargoyles that she believes are taking life at night and watching over the world. However, this innocent lie quickly becomes alarming when Tilly, desperate at losing his comrade's friendship, begins to weave a network of increasingly dangerous lies. At the same time, the Green family goes to a trendy restaurant in Big City, hoping to spend a pleasant evening. But their expectations are quickly undermined, as unforeseen events disrupt their dinner. The two intrigues intertwine, exploring the themes of friendship, truth and the unexpected consequences of the stories we tell.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: As an Australian young bouvier, Bluey transforms every day into a playground of games and adventures thanks to her lively imagination and inexhaustible energy.
programme.desc-more: In a colorful and fun world, Bluey, a six-year-old Australian Bouvier puppy, lives thrilling adventures alongside her family. With an overly imagination, Bluey explores the world around her with insatiable curiosity. Each episode follows Bluey's games and interactions with her father, Bandit (David McCormack), and her mother, Chilli (Melanie Zanetti), who encourage her creative spirit while teaching her valuable life lessons. Whether it's transforming itself into a fearless explorer or organizing improvised shows, Bluey turns everyday situations into extraordinary adventures. The episodes also highlight relationships with her little sister, Bingo, and her friends, illustrating the challenges and joys of childhood. Through touching and humorous narratives, the series addresses universal themes such as friendship, family and imagination, captivating an audience of all ages.

programme.title: Spidey and his extraordinary friends
programme.desc: Spidey, our favourite flyer, joins Ghost-Spider (Gwen Stacey) and Miles Morales to form the Spidey team. programme.desc-more: In a colorful and dynamic universe, Peter Parker, alias Spidey, teamed up with his friends Gwen Stacy, known as Ghost Spider, and Miles Morales, nicknamed Miles. Together, they form a team of young superheroes committed to protecting their city from threats. Each episode plunges them into thrilling adventures where they face iconic villains such as the Vautour, the Rhino and the Green Goblin. Their friendship is tested as they learn to work together, combining their unique powers to overcome challenges. Between school, homework and the fight against crime, these budding heroes juggle with the responsibilities of daily life while cultivating their sense of humour. With lessons of courage, camaraderie and solidarity, they discover that team spirit is the key to triumphing over the dangers that threaten their world.

programme.desc-more: Billie (Janice LeAnn Brown), a young witch with exceptional powers, finds herself at the heart of a mysterious prophecy that could upset the balance between the world of witches and that of mortals. To master her abilities and understand the stakes surrounding her, she is sent to the human world, where she is placed under the teaching of Justin Russo (David Henrie), a seasoned sorcerer and former student of the magic school. As they sail together in the daily life of mortals, Billie also faces dark forces that seek to exploit her potential. In parallel, she develops a strong friendship with Justin (David Henrie), who becomes not only her mentor, but also a valuable ally in her quest for truth. Together, they will have to thwart the machiavelic plans of those who threaten to reveal the existence of the sorcerers and plunge the world into chaos. The adventure becomes more intense as they discover the buried secrets of prophecy and the crucial importance of their choices.

programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Phineas and Ferb", entitled "The Ray of Inaction", the young inventors Phineas Flynn (Vincent Martella) and Ferb Fletcher (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) find themselves struck by a mysterious ray that makes them completely apathetic and boring. Their unexpected behavior despairs their sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), who sees this as a golden opportunity to report them to their parents. As she tries to take advantage of this situation to make their farfelus projects fail, Candice discovers that her brothers' passivity hides an unexpected potential. At the same time, in the "Malenquite" plot, Dr. Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire) is convinced that his daughter Vanessa (Caroline Rhea) is mad at him for expressing the wish to have a son. This misunderstanding leads to a series of hilarious quiproquos, while Doofenshmirtz seeks to prove his paternal love while pursuing his Machiavellical plans. Both stories intertwine in a whirlwind of humour and inventiveness.
programme.desc-more: In the charming town of Danville, Virginia, Phineas Fletcher (Vincent Martella) and his half-brother Ferb (Thomas Brodie-Sangster) are looking to escape the boredom of summer holidays. Driven by an overly imagination, they embark on a series of extravagant inventions and bold projects, ranging from the construction of a park of attractions to the creation of a stunning Russian mountain in their garden. Their big sister, Candice (Ashley Tisdale), is constantly on their tracks, ready to report their exploits to their mother, but she often encounters the inability to prove their folly. Meanwhile, the drama is played in parallel with the secret agent Ornithorynque Perry (Dee Bradley Baker), who must counter the Machiavellical plans of Dr.Heinz Doofenshmirtz (Dan Povenmire), a clumsy inventor. Each episode combines humour, adventure and a hint of fraternal rivalry, while exploring the themes of creativity and imagination without limits.

programme.title: D'Artagnan and the three Musketeers
programme.desc: In his native village near Tarbes, young D'Artagnan dreams of becoming an emeritus epherist and being one of the famous Musketeers. D'Artagnan was sent to Paris with only one sword, an old horse and a letter of introduction to the captain of the Musketeers, Mr. De Treville.
programme.desc-more: On the advice of a friend, the young d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover), full of dreams and ambitions, leaves his peaceful Gascogne to join Paris, where he hopes to join the ranks of Musketeers in the service of his Majesty, the King. Upon his arrival, he discovered a capital in the midst of political intrigues and devious plotting. Far from the romantic image he had forged, life in Paris proved to be a major challenge. D-Artagnan quickly encountered unexpected rivalries and dangers, including crossing the path of the enigmatic Milady of Winter, whose obscure motivations intrigue and frighten him at once. In seeking to prove his worth, he immerse himself in a world of bravery and loyalty, while associating with the famous Musketeers, Athos, Porthos and Aramis, who will help him navigate the turbulent waters of the court. D-Artagnan must be cunning and courageous to overcome the obstacles that stand in his way.

programme.title: D'Artagnan and the three Musketeers

programme.desc-more: In a context of political tensions and conspiracy in the heart of Paris, the young d'Artagnan (Eduardo Jover), ardent and determined, left his native Gascony on the advice of a friend, with the hope of making a name for himself by serving the King. When he arrived in the capital, he quickly realized that Musketeer life was not a path paved with roses. Faced with rivalries and court intrigues, d'Artagnan must navigate between loyalty and betrayal. His meeting with the legendary Musketeers Athos (Manuel Peiró), Porthos (Jesús Nieto) and Aramis (Javier Dotú) opened the doors to a world that was both fascinating and dangerous. Together, they will face formidable enemies, while defending honor and justice. Between sword fighting and ploys, d'Artagnan will learn that friendship and courage are the real keys to overcoming the challenges ahead.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: Curiosity is a very bad flaw and Joris will learn it at his expense. While he plays quietly with Pupuce in the reserve, a magical object draws his attention... CLAC! This is the boy who is imprisoned by the legendary "key-to-head claps ". How can I get him out of here? Easy, according to Kerubim, just say the right password. You have to remember that again!
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.desc: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: In an inventory of the reserve, Joris and Simone discover an old dusty and frankly smelly set: the Bouftou set! Kerubim being not there to tell them how he found her, Joris and Simone decided to reconstruct the adventure that allowed the old Ecaflip to gather all the pieces of the famous panoply.
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Renaissance
programme.desc: In 2054, a policeman tried to find a scientist who had been abducted. By meeting the young woman's relatives, he makes strange discoveries.
programme.desc-more: In Paris, in 2054, the life of Ilona Tasuiev, a brilliant biologist working for the multinational Avalon, took a dramatic turn. Known for her innovative research, she attracts the attention of many colleagues, but her success also attracts unexpected lusts. One afternoon, as she crosses a busy street, Ilona is kidnapped under disturbing circumstances, leaving her loved ones worried. Paul Dellenbach, Avalon's vice president, worried about the image of his company, entrusts the mission of finding her to Barthélémy Karas, a lonely and determined police officer, known for her specialization in kidnapping cases. As he investigates, Barthélémy discovers that other parties, with obscure motivations, are also looking for Ilona, revealing a complex network of power and plot. As he sinks into this perilous investigation, he realizes that the key to finding Ilona may well be linked to secrets buried within Avalon itself.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: Joris won his bet with Simone: he managed to cross the terrace of Bock la Begue, blindfolded, by escaping all obstacles! A "proceeding"? Huuum... has another opinion on the matter. Joris, this little fool, used the Ding-Dong belt of his Papycha. And what says Kerubim's object, says magic object of course!
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: ‘Justicemen of Chacharm "It was a time when Kerubim and Lou formed the most glamorous couple of adventurers: the "Justice of Chacharm". From this period, Kerubim kept many magical objects... Of which this evil mask with which Joris plays carelessly! To discourage him from doing it again, Kerubim tells him the story.
programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.desc-more: After the devastating explosion at the Wall of Lamentations, twelve legendary warriors, presumed dead, emerged in a completely transformed world. Their armors, now imbued with the blood of the goddess Athena, give them a new power, erecting them as knights of gold, ready to face new challenges. Among them, Aiolia (Nobutoshi Canna), the Lion's knight, faces a staggering reality and formidable enemies. By exploring this new universe, he makes an unexpected encounter that will lead him to perilous missions. Accompanied by his comrades, Aiolia must navigate through complex intrigues and epic battles to defend justice and protect the goddess Athena. As their quest unfolds, gold knights will face their own demons and dark forces that threaten to plunge the world into chaos.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: "Dragodingues" In trying to clean an old dusty trophy, Simone provokes the high screams of Kerubim. Why? Because this half-cut has a lipstick mark that reminds him of an important moment in his life. programme.desc-more: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

Will he agree to join the fight?...
programme.desc-more: In the episode entitled "Gold Knight vs. Gold Knight", Scorpion Miro (Nobutoshi Canna) faces a decisive turning point in rebelling against Surtr, the dreadful god of war, whose ambitions threaten the balance of divine forces. Meanwhile, Aiolia (Toshihiko Seki) and Lyfia (Aya Hisakawa), on their way to the Yggdrasil tree, meet face to face with the Mask of Death. This unexpected encounter plunges Lyfia into astonishment, because she realizes that this man, though charismatic, does not in any way resemble a Holy Gold. As tensions rise, the question arises: will the Mask of Death join the fight against Surtr, or will he choose to stay back? This captivating chapter highlights the fragile alliances and crucial choices that will determine the fate of the Gold Knights in a world in chaos.

programme.sub-title: The Seven Divine Warriors Gather Together
programme.desc: "The seven divine warriors gather together" Milo believes that Saga has defeated his rivals but they rise without scratching. Saga thinks they're protected by the Yggdrasil Tree. Sigmund then attacks Saga, who tries to reason with him because evil forces threaten the world and he plans to counter them...
programme.desc-more: In this captivating episode of the series, Milo, one of the divine warriors, is convinced that his mentor Saga has succeeded in defeating his opponents. However, he is surprised to discover that they are recovering without any injury, revealing a much greater threat than expected. Saga, conscious of the evil power behind this resurrection, suspects that the Yggdrasil Tree, symbol of life and death, protects them. As the dark forces gather together, Sigmund, one of the feared rivals, launches a surprise attack on Saga. In a tense exchange, Saga tries to reason Sigmund, making him understand that the hour is grave: darkness threatens not only their existence, but also that of all humanity. The struggle for balance between good and evil is intensifying, and each warrior must face his own demons while uniting their forces to fight this imminent threat.

programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.
programme.desc-more: In a future where time and space are malleable borders, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes), two elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, devote themselves to protecting the interests of their intergalactic empire. Their mission leads them through different times and dimensions, where they face both technological and mystical threats. By traveling through strange and fascinating worlds, they discover conspiracies that could upset the balance of the universe. Each adventure challenges them to navigate in interstellar conflicts while preserving harmony among civilizations. Their duo dynamics, combining bravery and intelligence, push them to develop ingenious strategies to overcome obstacles. As they immerse themselves in complex intrigues, Valerian and Laureline must also manage their own personal relationships, faced with choices that will test their loyalty and commitment to their mission.

programme.title: The Legend of the Golden Apple
programme.desc: In a world where mythology and animation meet, "The legend of the golden apple" plunges spectators into an epic adventure marked by the conflict between good and evil. Eris, the goddess of discord, takes advantage of the appearance of the comet Repulse to orchestrate a diabolical plan: she removes Athena, the goddess of wisdom, in order to siphon her energy with the help of a mysterious golden apple. This capture jeopardizes the balance of the universe, and the Knights of the Zodiac, courageous defenders of justice, are launching a race against the clock. In the face of the growing shadow of Eris, the Knights must first face his formidable servants, the Ghost Knights, who are ready to do anything to protect their mistress. Each battle is a test of strength and determination, while our heroes must navigate through perilous challenges and unexpected betrayals. With sunset as the final maturity, the fate of Athena and the future of humanity rest on the shoulders of these brave warriors. Their quest, marked by obstacles and revelations, promises to keep spectators in breath until the last minute. The story explores themes of sacrifice, friendship and courage, while offering a visual spectacle rich in colours and emotions.

programme.title: Zorro, the legend continues
programme.desc: In colonial California, Diego de la Vega (Zorro's alter ego) leads a captivating double life. Although he came from a respected bourgeois family, he felt a deep duty of justice towards the oppressed. At night, he wears his iconic costume, including a mask, hat and a black cape, to become Zorro, the masked vigilante who defies corrupt authority. His faithful servant, Bernardo, not only prepares his horse and equipment, but also joins him in his bold adventures. Together, they form a formidable duo, using their ingenuity and bravery to thwart the plans of the authorities, including Lieutenant Gabriel and Sergeant Gonzales, who are determined to capture Zorro and break his secret. Meanwhile, Diego struggles with her feelings for the beautiful Lolita, whose ignorance of her double play further complicates her quest for justice.

programme.title: Zorro, the legend continues
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of the series, Diego de la Vega's heroism (Duncan Regehr) is put to the test while his companion, Lolita (Michele Scarabelli), returns from a trip to Europe. She notes with dismay that Diego seems to have lost her bravery and her fighting spirit. Determined to defend the oppressed against the tyranny of the Spanish army, Lolita embarked on bold actions that put it in danger, attracting the attention of the authorities. Meanwhile, Diego, as Zorro, fears that her heroic acts would be discovered by Lolita, fearing that she would discover her secret identity. However, Diego's faithful servant, Bernardo (Joaquín de Almeida), soon discovered the mystery surrounding his master. Between passion, courage and secrets, this episode explores the moral dilemmas of heroism and love, while highlighting the struggle for justice in a context of repression.

As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Detective Conan
programme.desc: inspired by the Japanese manga of Gisho Aoyama
programme.desc-more: Shinichi Kudo, 17, is a very talented young footballer and a valuable reinforcement of the Japanese police. In an investigation into a gun trafficking, the young detective surprises men in black who are following him and administering him an experimental poison. Shinichi Kudo wakes up ten years younger. In order to find the antidote, he takes the false identity of Conan Edogawa, follows his father, a poor detective, and solves in his place complex cases, thanks to the gadgets of Professor Agasa, the only one who knows Conan's dual identity.

programme.title: Fairy Tail
programme.desc: Fairy Tail is the most famous magic guild in the kingdom of Fiore. Lucy has keys to appeal to stellar spirits. She seeks to collect as much as possible and wants to join the guild with the help of Natsu. The A-1 Pictures production house is also known for being the origin of the famous "Black Butler".
programme.desc-more: The kingdom of Fiore is a world of magic and mysteries. Magic is part of everyday life and its business is completely free. Some, who have become masters in this field, have decided to make it their profession. They're called the Magi. For reward, they work for the good of the community. Created in 2006 by mangaka Hiro Mashima, "Fairy Tail" has had a considerable success and an adaptation in animated that has conquered the hearts of fans.
