programme.title: Saint Seiya : Soul of Gold
programme.desc: In this thrilling episode of "Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold", the Gold Knights find themselves confronted with formidable adversaries who push them to fully exploit their divine abilities. While Heracles, the powerful half-god, manages to take the advantage over Aldebaran (Takeshi Kusao), he finds himself trapped by the roots of the mythical Yggdrasil tree, symbolizing oppression and despair. Meanwhile, Dohko (Hiroshi Okamoto), the former Dragon Knight, discovers that the encapsulated silhouette that intrigue him is nothing other than Lyfia, in trance state, a mysterious element that could influence the course of the battle. As tension rises, Camus (Ken'yû Horiuchi) has to face Shura (Nobutoshi Canna) in a fight that puts their loyalty to Athena to the test. Camus finally took the side of Athena, marking a decisive turning point in the fight against the dark forces.
programme.desc-more: Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold (2015)
programme.desc: Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold (2015)

programme.title: Saint Seiya : Soul of Gold
programme.sub-title: Baldur, the chosen of the gods
programme.desc: In the knowledge hall, Mu, the gold knight of Aries, finds himself confronted with Fafnir, a formidable opponent whose strength is fed by the sapphire of Odin. This intense encounter puts to the test the abilities of Mu, who must deploy all his knowledge and mastery of sacred techniques to resist the assaults of his enemy. As the tension rises, Deathmask, the golden knight of La Balance, makes his appearance, ready to avenge his comrades. Their confrontation propels them into the hall of the dead, a place where the stakes become deadly. Fafnir, in a final pressure, threatens to attack the brothers and sisters of Helena, Deathmask's sister, if he refuses to surrender. In this duel between loyalty and survival, knights will have to navigate between their sacred duties and threats to their loved ones, thus revealing the depths of their commitment and courage.

programme.title: Signed Cat's Eyes
programme.desc: Quentin investigates incognito on a clandestine casino located on board a luxurious ship. He asks Tam to accompany him. On the spot, the young woman suddenly recognized a work by her father. Unfortunately, the situation degenerates when the inspector is unmasked and captured. Tam must act quickly to save him and secure the precious picture.

programme.title: Signed Cat's Eyes
programme.desc: Quentin is still a prisoner aboard the luxurious casino ship. To free him and get their father's picture, Sylia infiltrates herself by pretending to be a croupière. Thanks to the valuable help of Alex and Tam, the sisters managed to deceive the owner, save the inspector and seize the much-loved work of art.

programme.title: Corto Maltese: The secret court of the Arcanes
programme.desc: In 1919, as the consequences of the First World War resonated across Europe, Russia and Asia plunge into chaos. Corto Maltese, an adventurer with undeniable charm, heads for Shanghai when his path crosses the Red Lanterns, a Chinese sect in distress. Pushed by a sense of honour, he agreed to help them locate an armoured train carrying the gold of Admiral Kolchak's counter-revolutionary government. Accompanied by his faithful friend Rasputine, Corto embarks on a perilous quest through the tumultuous lands of Russia, Siberia and Manchuria. As they journey, they must navigate through fragile alliances and betrayals, while avoiding the claws of the fearsome General Chang, a ruthless warlord. The stakes are increasing as Corto and Rasputine find themselves confronted with dark forces, determined to preserve their secrets and power.

programme.title: Once upon a time... space
programme.desc: The cargo ship Ursus, damaged as a result of the supernova cataclysm, crashes on an isolated planet. Pierrot, Psi and Metro are exploring the surrounding area.

programme.title: Once upon a time... space
programme.desc: Discover the summary of the episodes of season 1 of the series Once upon a time... space

programme.title: Valerian and Laureline
programme.desc: In the distant future, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes) are elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, charged with protecting the interests of their galactic empire. Their mission leads them through time and space, where they must navigate a complex universe of extraordinary creatures and exotic civilizations. When an unexpected peril threatens the balance of the universe, Valerian and Laureline find themselves immersed in an intergalactic conspiracy. By confronting formidable enemies and discovering hidden truths, they will have to show courage and ingenuity. Through futuristic landscapes and different times, their journey will put them to the test, strengthening their link while revealing their own weaknesses. Together, they must defeat the Machiavellical plans that seek to upset the established order and ensure the survival of the universe as they know it.
programme.desc-more: In a future where time and space are malleable borders, Valerian (Mélodie Orru) and Laureline (Sophie Deschaumes), two elite agents of the Spatio-temporal Service, devote themselves to protecting the interests of their intergalactic empire. Their mission leads them through different times and dimensions, where they face both technological and mystical threats. By traveling through strange and fascinating worlds, they discover conspiracies that could upset the balance of the universe. Each adventure challenges them to navigate in interstellar conflicts while preserving harmony among civilizations. Their duo dynamics, combining bravery and intelligence, push them to develop ingenious strategies to overcome obstacles. As they immerse themselves in complex intrigues, Valerian and Laureline must also manage their own personal relationships, faced with choices that will test their loyalty and commitment to their mission.

programme.title: Dofus: to the treasures of Kerubim
programme.desc: In a world of magic and adventure, Kerubim Crépin (Sauvane Delanoë), an Ecaflip with a history of adventures, looks at his youth and shares his memories with his adopted son, Joris. Through his captivating stories, he evokes unforgettable encounters, epic battles and unexpected treasures that have marked his journey. Kerubim, both funny and wise, remembers moments of bravery, but also life lessons learned through trials. With each story, Joris, curious and amazed, discovers not only his father's heroic heritage, but also the values of courage, friendship and loyalty that unite them. As Kerubim tells his adventures, he makes an unwavering connection with his son, conveying to him the passion for exploration and the importance of cherishing memories. Together, they are on the path of discovery, ready to write their own legend.

programme.title: Zorro, the legend continues
programme.desc: In the sunny city of Los Angeles, Diego de la Vega (Duncan Regehr), known under the mask of Zorro, faces accusations of laziness and cowardice. His reputation is being undermined, especially with the parents of Lolita (Michele Scarabelli), who see him as an opportunity to take advantage of his position. They dream of a marriage that is advantageous to their daughter, but Lolita, determined not to marry a man whom she considers to be a coward, questions Diego's true courage. As tensions rise and intrigues are tying around them, Diego has to prove that he is more than an undecided man. Between the duels of cape and sword and the fires that threaten the city, he found himself trained in a fight for his honour and that of Lolita. The struggle for truth and bravery is just beginning.

programme.title: Zorro, the legend continues
programme.desc: In the episode "Prestige de l'uniforme" of the series "Zorro, the legend continues", Diego de la Vega (Duncan Regehr) finds himself facing a major challenge to prove his courage in Lolita (Michele Scarabelli). In a context where honour and bravery are paramount, he resolutely opposes members of the army, hoping to impress the beautiful. However, his efforts were quickly overshadowed by the arrival of an ambitious new lieutenant who interposed and captured everyone's attention, robbing Diego's star. The latter, frustrated but resolved, finds a childhood friend, Oro (David Lipper), who also shares the aspiration to join the army. Together, they navigate a complex world where loyalty and rivalry mix, while discovering the real stakes of military power. Diego will have to be a cunning and brave man not only to defend his honour, but also to support his friend in this quest.

programme.title: Detective Conan
programme.desc: inspired by the Japanese manga of Gisho Aoyama
programme.desc-more: Shinichi Kudo, 17, is a very talented young footballer and a valuable reinforcement of the Japanese police. In an investigation into a gun trafficking, the young detective surprises men in black who are following him and administering him an experimental poison. Shinichi Kudo wakes up ten years younger. In order to find the antidote, he takes the false identity of Conan Edogawa, follows his father, a poor detective, and solves in his place complex cases, thanks to the gadgets of Professor Agasa, the only one who knows Conan's dual identity.

programme.title: Fairy Tail
programme.desc: Fairy Tail is the most famous magic guild in the kingdom of Fiore. Lucy has keys to appeal to stellar spirits. She seeks to collect as much as possible and wants to join the guild with the help of Natsu. The A-1 Pictures production house is also known for being the origin of the famous "Black Butler".
programme.desc-more: The kingdom of Fiore is a world of magic and mysteries. Magic is part of everyday life and its business is completely free. Some, who have become masters in this field, have decided to make it their profession. They're called the Magi. For reward, they work for the good of the community. Created in 2006 by mangaka Hiro Mashima, "Fairy Tail" has had a considerable success and an adaptation in animated that has conquered the hearts of fans.

programme.title: Saint Seiya : Soul of Gold
programme.desc: In this captivating episode of "Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold", Sigmund, consumed by the desire for revenge following the tragic death of his younger brother Siegfried in the last battle of Ásgard, is embarking on a desperate confrontation. Facing him stands Saga (Tôru Nara), the knight of gold recognized for his unrivalled power, which, with disconcerting ease, quickly takes over Sigmund. Saga's strength even impresses Andreas, another fighter involved in this conflict. As Saga prepares to end their duel, a mysterious ray of light arises, interrupting the course of the fight. At the same time, another battle is taking place in the Chamber, where Aiolia (Kenji Nojima) is facing Fodi (Ryotarô Okiayu). Lyfia (Aya Hisakawa) made an unexpected appearance, revealing a disturbing truth: it was the one that raised the twelve Gold Knights, thus immerse all the protagonists in a whirlwind of revelations and conflicts.
programme.desc-more: Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold (2015)
programme.desc: Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold (2015)

programme.title: Saint Seiya : Soul of Gold
programme.sub-title: Aiolia against Andreas, a decisive fight
programme.desc: As he recalls Lyfia's last words, Aiolia (Hideyuki Tanaka), the Lion's Holy Gold, prepares to face his sworn enemy, Andreas (Takumi Yamazaki). In a confrontation where emotions and rage mix together, Andreas reveals to Aiolia that Lyfia was only a puppet in his Machiavellic game, a confession that stirred the anger of the Saint. Determined to end this tragedy, Aiolia draws on her resources and intensifies her cosmos to an unmatched level, transforming her armor into God Cloth. This tenfold power allows him to release his devastating attack, the Lightning Plasma, in order to eradicate Andreas' threat and put an end to the terrible battle that ravages Asgard. Meanwhile, Frodi (Yûji Mitsuya), trapped by Utgard (Ken'yû Horiuchi) and his formidable blade, struggles to maintain a solid defense in the face of the increasing pressure of his opponent. The stakes are high, and each movement can decide the fate of the battle.
